pmid-6145249.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍と正常胎盤におけるhCG産生細胞を、超微細免疫組織化学で検討した1984年の報告。胎児性癌内の合胞体栄養膜巨細胞や絨毛癌の合胞体細胞で、粗面小胞体を中心にhCG陽性反応が認められた。一方、細胞により反応性にばらつきがあり、hCG陰性の細胞栄養膜様細胞も確認された。胚細胞腫瘍のhCG産生細胞の同定に寄与する知見である。
pmid-6145249.summary_en: This 1984 ultrastructural immunohistochemistry study localized human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in placenta and testicular germ cell tumors using labeled Fab' fragments against hCG-alpha and hCG-beta. In embryonal carcinoma, hCG reaction products were found mainly in the rough endoplasmic reticulum and perinuclear spaces of syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells, while choriocarcinoma syncytial cells showed consistent positivity. Syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells varied in immunoreactivity, and cytotrophoblast-like cells lacking hCG staining were noted. The findings clarify the cellular source of hCG production in germ cell tumors.

pmid-6146206.summary_ja: 腹腔内に存在した精巣に悪性変化が生じ、セミノーマを含む混合組織型の腫瘍として浸潤を伴った症例報告(1984年)。セミノーマにもかかわらず血清腫瘍マーカーが陰性であった点が特徴的である。固定術では悪性化リスクは低減せず、思春期以降では精子形成も保たれないため、異所性精巣では精巣摘除術が推奨されると述べている。
pmid-6146206.summary_en: This case report describes malignant change in an intra-abdominal testis in a Black man, presenting with a mixed-cell tumor histology, invasive spread, and seminoma. Serum tumor markers were absent despite seminoma, which is atypical. The authors emphasize that orchiopexy does not reduce malignancy risk and does not preserve spermatogenesis in postpubertal patients, so orchiectomy is advised for all maldescended testes, especially intra-abdominal ones. The case underscores the need for careful management of undescended testes.

pmid-6146564.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌(LT奇形癌)から、準二倍体の分化細胞株LT-Dを単離した1984年の研究。染色体数は12か月以上安定して40本を維持し、胎児性癌のマーカーであるSSEA-1やアルカリホスファターゼ活性は失われていた。LT-D細胞は筋管様構造へ融合して筋特異的マーカーを発現し、同系マウスでの腫瘍形成能は認められなかった。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学研究に関わるモデルの解析である。
pmid-6146564.summary_en: This 1984 study isolated a near-diploid differentiated cell line (LT-D) from a murine LT teratocarcinoma. The line maintained a stable modal chromosome number of 40 for over 12 months and lacked embryonal carcinoma markers SSEA-1 and high alkaline phosphatase. LT-D cells fused into myotube-like structures expressing muscle creatine phosphokinase and desmin, and did not form tumors in syngenetic mice. The work characterizes a differentiated lineage derived from teratocarcinoma, a murine model relevant to germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-6149236.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性縦隔奇形腫に含まれる膵組織を、免疫組織化学と形態計測で検討した4例の報告(1984年)。奇形腫内の膵組織では内分泌細胞の総体積密度が増加し、特にソマトスタチン陽性のD細胞の割合が高かった。この所見は新生児の膵組織に類似しており、奇形腫内での膵組織の機能的分化の変化を示唆する。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍における組織分化の理解に寄与する。
pmid-6149236.summary_en: This 1984 study examined four cases of benign cystic mediastinal teratoma containing pancreatic tissue using immunohistochemistry and morphometry. The teratomatous pancreas showed an increased total volume density of endocrine cells, particularly somatostatin-containing D cells, compared with normal adult pancreas. The pattern resembled neonatal pancreatic tissue, suggesting altered functional differentiation of pancreatic elements within teratomas. The findings contribute to understanding of tissue differentiation in mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-6149643.summary_ja: 持続性ミュラー管構造を伴う男性仮性半陰陽の2症例(1984年)。両側停留精巣と46,XY核型を有する。39歳の症例では腹腔内精巣にセミノーマが認められ、女性性器と精巣を全切除した。腹腔内精巣の腫瘍化頻度は単純な停留精巣と同程度とされ、本症候群における精巣腫瘍の報告としては10例目である。
pmid-6149643.summary_en: This 1984 report describes two cases of male pseudohermaphroditism due to persistent müllerian structures with bilateral cryptorchidism and 46,XY karyotype. The second patient, aged 39, had a seminoma in an intra-abdominal testis, and total resection of female organs and testicles was performed. The authors note that tumoral degeneration of intra-abdominal testes in this syndrome occurs at rates similar to simple cryptorchid testes. This is the tenth reported testicular tumor in this syndrome, highlighting its malignant potential.

pmid-6149659.summary_ja: 11歳以上の片側停留精巣35例を開腹探索し、全例で精巣生検を行った1984年の研究。肉眼的に正常な精巣の2例に悪性腫瘍(セミノーマと微小浸潤を伴う上皮内癌)が認められた。大半で精子形成の著明な低下がみられた。思春期以降に発見された片側停留精巣では精巣固定術より精巣摘除術が望ましいと結論づけている。
pmid-6149659.summary_en: This 1984 study surgically explored unilateral undescended testes in 35 patients over age 11 and biopsied all testes to assess spermatogenesis. Two patients with macroscopically normal testes had malignancy: a seminoma and carcinoma in situ with micro-infiltrative carcinoma. Most patients showed substantial loss of spermatogenesis, with severe degeneration in most. Based on these findings, the authors recommend orchiectomy rather than orchidopexy for unilateral undescended testes presenting at puberty or later.

pmid-6150548.summary_ja: 11歳時に両側停留精巣に対して精巣固定術を受けた29歳男性の症例報告(1984年)。右精巣は未発見で無形成と考えられていたが、精巣がん早期発見のためのフォローアップ中に腹腔内で発見され摘出された。左精巣の生検で上皮内癌が確認され、摘除標本から浸潤性セミノーマが見つかった。固定術後も悪性化の危険があり、長期のフォローアップの重要性を示す。
pmid-6150548.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old man who had orchiopexy for bilateral cryptorchidism at age 11, with the right testis presumed aplastic and not found. During follow-up for testicular cancer detection, the right testis was found intraperitoneally and removed. A left testicular biopsy revealed carcinoma in situ, and orchiectomy showed invasive seminoma. The case illustrates the risk of malignancy in undescended testes even after surgical correction and the importance of long-term surveillance.

pmid-6152579.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞の体外分化を追跡するための細胞表面糖タンパク質マーカーを検討した論文です。SSEA-1はEC細胞のマーカーであり、DBA受容体は内胚葉細胞や準無分化性EC細胞を示すとされています。発生段階で調節されるエンボグリカンが重要な担体として挙げられています。多能性EC細胞の基礎的な性質を整理しており、胚細胞腫瘍の分化機構の理解に関連します。
pmid-6152579.summary_en: This paper examines cell surface glycoprotein markers, including SSEA-1, SSEA-3, and various lectin receptors, used to monitor in vitro differentiation of embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells. SSEA-1 marks EC cells, while DBA receptors mark endoderm and quasi-nullipotent EC cells. The authors highlight embryoglycan, a developmentally regulated lactosaminoglycan-type glycoprotein carrier, as an important marker-bearing molecule. The work is a basic characterization of pluripotent EC cells, a germ cell tumor model, relevant to understanding differentiation of these tumors.

pmid-6152581.summary_ja: 移植可能な奇形癌腫から、胎児性癌(EC)細胞株EC1Phと2つのクローン亜株を樹立した研究です。細胞は二倍体の40,XY核型を保ち、同系マウスへの移植で分化した誘導体を含む奇形癌腫を生じました。SSEA-1とECMA-7はわずかまたは発現せず、一部の継代ではクラスI H-2抗原が発現しました。ヒトの奇形癌腫細胞株に似た表現型を示し、多能性胚細胞腫瘍の研究モデルとして有用です。
pmid-6152581.summary_en: The authors established a murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell line, EC1Ph, from a transplantable teratocarcinoma, along with two cloned sublines. The cells keep a diploid 40,XY karyotype and produce teratocarcinomas with differentiated derivatives after inoculation into syngeneic mice. They express low or no SSEA-1 and ECMA-7 antigens, and some passages show class I H-2 expression. The phenotype resembles that of human teratocarcinoma cell lines, making these lines useful models of pluripotent germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-6152793.summary_ja: 開腹手術で診断された良性卵巣腫瘍342例(289例)を検討した論文です。良性嚢胞性奇形腫が最も多く、腫瘍の26%を占めました。妊娠中に関連することが多いとされています。予想外に悪性と判明した例が8例(2.8%)ありました。年齢、腫瘍径、疼痛、石灰化、捻転の頻度なども報告されています。
pmid-6152793.summary_en: This study reviewed 342 benign ovarian tumors diagnosed at laparotomy in 289 patients. Benign cystic teratoma was the most common histologic type, accounting for 26% of tumors and frequently associated with pregnancy. Eight patients (2.8%) had unexpected malignancy. The paper also describes age, parity, tumor size, pain symptoms, calcification patterns, and torsion frequency. Mature cystic teratoma is a major component of this cohort, so the germ cell content is substantial.

pmid-6197156.summary_ja: 妊娠31週で胎児の悪性奇形腫を出生前に診断した症例報告です。羊水過多を契機に超音波検査を行い、頭部、顔面、眼、頸部の変形が確認され、CTでも裏付けられました。羊水穿刺により1番染色体の逆位重複が検出され、出生後の解析で腫瘍に限局していました。構成核型は正常でした。出生前に悪性腫瘍を直接染色体検出した初の報告とされています。
pmid-6197156.summary_en: This case report describes prenatal diagnosis of a fetal malignant teratoma at 31 weeks of gestation. Polyhydramnios prompted ultrasound, which showed fetal head, face, eye, and neck deformation, confirmed by CT. Amniocentesis revealed an inverted duplication of chromosome 1 in amniotic fluid cells, which was confined to the tumor on postnatal analysis, while the constitutional karyotype was normal. The authors report this as the first direct chromosomal detection of malignancy before birth.

pmid-6198019.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対し、ステロイドを含まない併用化学療法を受けた患者の骨壊死症例です。左大腿骨頭、左舟状骨、両側大腿骨内側顆に多発性の骨壊死が生じました。通常の単発パターンと異なります。抗炎症薬と理学療法で症状は軽快しました。ステロイドを含まない化学療法でも骨壊死が起こりうると結論づけています。
pmid-6198019.summary_en: This case report describes avascular necrosis of bone in a patient with testicular teratoma treated with combination chemotherapy that did not include corticosteroids. Necrosis involved the left femoral head, left scaphoid, and both medial femoral condyles, a multifocal pattern unusual for this complication. Symptoms improved with anti-inflammatory drugs and physiotherapy. The authors conclude that avascular necrosis can occur with steroid-free cancer chemotherapy, not only with regimens containing corticosteroids.

pmid-6198064.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん114例を対象に、シスプラチンの高用量と低用量を比較した無作為化試験です。両群ともビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンと併用しました。全体の奏効率は90%で、完全寛解は高用量群で高率でした(63%対43%)。生存率も高用量群で優れましたが、白血球減少などの毒性は増えました。再発は4例のみでした。
pmid-6198064.summary_en: This Southwest Oncology Group randomized trial compared high-dose (120 mg/m2 monthly) with low-dose (15 mg/m2 daily for 5 days monthly) cisplatin, both combined with vinblastine and bleomycin, in 114 patients with advanced testicular cancer. Overall response was 90%, with complete remission higher in the high-dose arm (63% vs 43%). High-dose therapy also improved survival, while causing more leukopenia and toxicity without irreversible functional impairment. Relapses were rare, with four in total.

pmid-6198067.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の15例で、循環免疫複合体(CIC)をhCGと併せて追跡した研究です。胞状奇胎では初診時のCICは正常で、腫瘍量減少後に上昇しました。絨毛癌では初診時からCICが高値で、除去術と化学療法後にhCGと平行して低下しました。両疾患の複合体には父親由来のHLA抗原が含まれていました。
pmid-6198067.summary_en: This study followed circulating immune complex (CIC) levels in 15 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia alongside serum hCG. CIC was normal in molar pregnancy and rose only after tumor reduction, whereas patients with choriocarcinoma had elevated CIC that declined with hCG after evacuation and chemotherapy. The authors identified paternal HLA antigen as a component of the complexes in both diseases, providing a method to characterize host humoral responses and recover tumor-associated antigens in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6198243.summary_ja: 卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍6例を対象に、術後化学療法中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を連続測定した研究である。治療前のAFPは著明高値だったが、化学療法で一時的に低下した。進行例の多くは術後4〜9か月で死亡した。AFPの連続測定は効果判定と予後指標として有用と結論づけている。
pmid-6198243.summary_en: This 1984 Gynecologic Oncology study followed six patients with ovarian endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor, and one also had a malignant teratoma. All received postoperative combination chemotherapy. Serial serum alpha-fetoprotein measurements were obtained. Pretreatment AFP levels were markedly elevated, from 2,500 to 100,000 ng/ml. Marker levels fell during chemotherapy, but most patients with stage III disease died within 4 to 9 months. The authors conclude that serial AFP measurement may serve as both a response marker and a prognostic indicator.

pmid-6198970.summary_ja: 19歳男性の縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。放射線療法は無効だったが、シスプラチン・アドリアマイシン・ビンクリスチンの併用化学療法で腫瘍は縮小し、AFPは正常化した。その後耐性を獲得し、治療開始9か月後に死亡した。
pmid-6198970.summary_en: This 1984 case report describes a 19-year-old man with a huge anterior mediastinal tumor and superior vena caval syndrome. Serum AFP was high, and the tumor was diagnosed as a malignant mediastinal germ cell tumor. Radiation therapy was ineffective, but combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, adriamycin, and vincristine clearly reduced tumor size and normalized AFP. The tumor later became resistant, and the patient died nine months after treatment began. Histology showed yolk sac tumor features, including Schiller-Duval bodies.

pmid-6198998.summary_ja: 悪性縦隔奇形腫の切除後に化学療法を受けた20歳男性の症例である。5か月後に汎血球減少と骨髄壊死が出現し、剖検で播種性の巨核球系腫瘍が確認された。化学療法との因果関係が示唆されるが、発症までの期間は治療関連白血病の潜伏期より短い。
pmid-6198998.summary_en: This 1984 case report describes a 20-year-old man who received four cycles of vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin after resection of a malignant mediastinal teratoma. Five months later he developed pancytopenia, circulating blasts, and bone marrow necrosis. Autopsy revealed a disseminated megakaryocytic neoplasm. The authors suggest a causal link with chemotherapy. The interval was shorter than typical latency periods for therapy-related leukemias. The case is compared with other reports of therapy-related megakaryocytic disorders.

pmid-6199233.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性54例を対象に、治療前後の精子数と血清FSHを検討した研究である。散乱放射線で患者の2/3以上に無精子症が生じた。精子の回復には中央値540日を要した。補助化学療法は回復にほとんど影響しなかった。
pmid-6199233.summary_en: This 1984 Fertility and Sterility study measured sperm counts and serum FSH in 54 men with testicular germ cell cancer, including 34 with seminoma and 20 with nonseminomatous tumors. Measurements were taken after unilateral orchiectomy and before radiotherapy and chemotherapy. Scattered radiation to the remaining testis caused azoospermia in more than two-thirds of patients. Sperm recovery took a median of 540 days, and the pretreatment count took 1250 days. Adjuvant chemotherapy did not appear to affect restitution appreciably.

pmid-6199440.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株3種を用い、メトトレキサートの細胞増殖とhCG・β-hCG産生への影響を検討した研究である。効果は時間よりも濃度に依存した。hCGの一過性上昇は細胞障害ではなく分泌増加によると考えられた。
pmid-6199440.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese study examined methotrexate effects on three choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, GCH-2, SCH). Cell growth and production of hCG and beta-hCG were measured. Effects were dose-dependent rather than time-dependent. Concentrations of 10 to the minus 6 M or higher had distinct effects. Lower concentrations had little effect. Most hCG was secreted extracellularly, so the transient in vitro hCG elevation after methotrexate may reflect increased secretion rather than cell damage. SP-1 production remained low.

pmid-6199521.summary_ja: 小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍14例を検討した研究である。AFPやβ-hCGを含むマーカーは予後と関連しなかった。後腹膜リンパ節郭清は無病生存期間を延長しなかった。転移例では補助化学療法が有効であった。
pmid-6199521.summary_en: This 1984 Journal of Urology review examined 14 children with yolk sac carcinoma. Immunohistochemical marker proteins, including AFP and beta-hCG, were not prognostic. Six patients underwent retroperitoneal node dissection, and one had retroperitoneal metastasis. Dissection did not improve disease-free survival. The authors recommend against routine retroperitoneal node dissection in children with yolk sac tumors. Adjunctive chemotherapy was highly effective in salvaging patients with metastatic disease.

pmid-6199706.summary_ja: 播種性精巣非セミノーマ18例を対象に、Einhorn療法の前後で肺機能と腎機能を測定した研究である。GFRの変化とT1COの変化には有意な正の相関が認められた。重度の腎機能障害がある患者へのブレオマイシン投与には注意が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-6199706.summary_en: This 1984 Oncology study examined 18 patients with disseminated testicular non-seminoma before and after induction chemotherapy using the Einhorn regimen. Pulmonary function, including T1CO, and renal function, including GFR and ERPF, were measured. A significant positive correlation was found between changes in GFR and T1CO. No significant relationship was found between ERPF and T1CO. The authors conclude that bleomycin should be given cautiously to patients with severely impaired renal function.

pmid-6199967.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍について、乳酸脱水素酵素アイソザイム1(LD 1)の免疫組織化学的局在を検討した研究である。セミノーマと奇形癌の全29例、胎児性癌7例中4例でLD 1陽性を認めた。血清LD 1の高値は腫瘍組織に由来し、腫瘍量との関連を説明しうると示唆された。他臓器の腫瘍との比較から染色の特異性も評価されており、精巣腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を考えるうえで重要な知見である。
pmid-6199967.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry with an antibody to lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (LD 1) to examine germ cell neoplasms of the testis. All 29 seminomas and teratocarcinomas and four of seven embryonal carcinomas stained positive. The findings suggest that elevated serum LD 1 in patients with germ cell tumors originates directly from tumor tissue, which explains the correlation between serum LD 1 and tumor burden. The authors also assessed staining in tumors from other organs to determine how specific LD 1 is for testicular tumors.

pmid-6200387.summary_ja: 非転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の2例を対象に、中等量メトトレキサート療法中の血清β-hCGとメトトレキサート濃度を連続測定した研究である。β-hCGは8日間の治療で1〜1.5桁低下し、5〜6週で完全寛解に至った。明らかな毒性は認めなかった。治療前のβ-hCG値に基づき、メトトレキサートの総投与量を事前に設定できる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6200387.summary_en: This study compared serial serum beta-hCG and methotrexate levels in two patients with nonmetastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated with intermediate-dose methotrexate with citrovorum rescue. Methotrexate peaks were followed by rapid plasma clearance, and beta-hCG fell by one to 1.5 logs over eight days, with complete remission within five to six weeks. Toxicity was minimal. The authors suggest that the total methotrexate dose could be preselected according to the pretreatment beta-hCG level.

pmid-6200421.summary_ja: 胚様体や各発生段階の胚性・胚外性構造を含む精巣悪性奇形腫を、組織化学的および免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。ムチン、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCG、CEAなど多数の物質の分布を奇形成分内で評価した。その分布パターンを初期胚発生との関連から考察し、腫瘍成分の生物学的特徴に関する知見を示している。
pmid-6200421.summary_en: The authors examined a testicular malignant teratoma containing embryoid bodies and embryonic and extraembryonic structures at varying developmental stages. Using histochemical and immunohistological methods, they mapped substances including mucins, argyrophil and argentaffin cells, AFP, alpha-1-antitrypsin, lysozyme, beta-hCG, and CEA within the teratomatous elements. The distribution patterns were discussed in relation to early embryonic development, offering insight into the biology of these tumor components.

pmid-6200463.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の画像診断と病期分類を総説した論文である。病期分類には腹部・胸部のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)が最適で、β-hCGとAFPの放射免疫測定と併用すると臨床病期診断の精度は80〜90%に達する。超音波検査は痩せた患者や潜在性病変の検出に有用である。フォローアップには腫瘍マーカーとCTを組み合わせる方法が示されている。
pmid-6200463.summary_en: This review covers imaging and diagnosis of testicular tumors. Abdominal and chest CT is the preferred staging modality, and combining CT with serum beta-hCG and AFP radioimmunoassays achieves 80 to 90 percent clinical staging accuracy. Ultrasonography helps in thin patients and in detecting occult testicular lesions, while lymphangiography is reserved for stage I patients not receiving elective retroperitoneal treatment. Follow-up relies on serial marker measurements and periodic CT. Emerging imaging techniques are also mentioned.

pmid-6200576.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍45例を対象に、精巣摘除術のみで臨床的再発まで治療を遅らせた前向き臨床試験である。80%は無病状態を維持し、20%が再発した。再発の大半は化学療法や手術で救済された。再発率は胎児性癌が57%、奇形癌が17%と高かった。日常的なリンパ節郭清や照射の省略を支持する予備的結果である。
pmid-6200576.summary_en: This prospective trial enrolled 45 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who received orchiectomy alone, with other treatment deferred until clinical relapse. Eighty percent remained disease-free for a median of 19.5 months, while 20 percent relapsed, most within seven months. Most relapsing patients were salvaged with chemotherapy or surgery. Relapse was more frequent in embryonal carcinoma (57 percent) than in teratocarcinoma (17 percent). The authors suggest routine lymphadenectomy or lymph-node irradiation may be omitted in this setting.

pmid-6200611.summary_ja: 病理学的病期IIの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍40例を対象とした研究である。病期IICの患者のみに補助化学療法を行い、病期IIA・IIBは毎月のフォローアップのみとした。未治療群の35%が再発したが、大半は救済療法で寛解した。病期IIA・IIBは再発時に治療する方針が安全と結論された。病期IICには補助化学療法の有用性が確認された。
pmid-6200611.summary_en: The authors reviewed 40 consecutive patients with pathologic stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis who underwent retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Only stage IIC patients received adjuvant cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin, while the rest were followed monthly. Relapse occurred in 35 percent of untreated patients versus none of the treated patients, but most relapses were salvaged, and 97.5 percent were disease-free. The authors conclude stage IIA and IIB patients can be managed safely with treatment reserved for relapse, while adjuvant chemotherapy remains warranted for stage IIC.

pmid-6200618.summary_ja: 胎児性癌の根治的治療後に、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が偽陽性として持続的に上昇した症例を報告する。AFPは非セミノーマ性精巣がんにおける特異度の高い腫瘍マーカーとされ、偽陽性の報告はこれまでなかった。本症例は、腫瘍マーカーの解釈には臨床経過全体を踏まえる必要があることを示している。
pmid-6200618.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with embryonal carcinoma whose serum alpha-fetoprotein remained falsely elevated after curative therapy. AFP is regarded as a highly specific marker in nonseminomatous testicular cancer, so a persistent false-positive elevation is clinically important. The authors note that such falsely positive results had not previously been reported. The case highlights the need to interpret tumor marker levels in the context of the full clinical picture.

pmid-6201259.summary_ja: 病期IIIまたは腫大を伴う病期IIの精巣純粋セミノーマ7例に、VAB-6レジメンを行った報告である。全例が化学療法のみで完全寛解に到達した。5例は19〜38か月寛解を維持し、2例は9か月と18か月で再発した。重度の骨髄抑制による発熱や一過性のクレアチニン上昇が認められた。進行した転移性セミノーマに有効と結論されている。
pmid-6201259.summary_en: Seven patients with stage III or bulky stage II pure testicular seminoma were treated with the VAB-6 regimen, which combines cyclophosphamide, vinblastine, dactinomycin, bleomycin and cisplatin, given in repeated inductions. All achieved complete remission with chemotherapy alone. Five remained in remission for 19 to 38 months, while two relapsed at nine and 18 months. Toxicities included febrile myelosuppression and transient creatinine elevation. The authors conclude VAB-6 is effective for advanced metastatic seminoma.

pmid-6201266.summary_ja: レチノイン酸でマウス胎児性癌をin vivoで分化誘導し、得られた腫瘍を移植した基礎研究である。分化腫瘍の移植の多くは良性の嚢胞性奇形腫となり、対照の胎児性癌は急速に増殖した。まれに悪性の増殖を示す例があり、元腫瘍の有糸分裂活性の高い固形領域がその予測因子となることが示された。分化によって胎児性癌の生物学的性質が変化することを示す。
pmid-6201266.summary_en: The authors induced differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma tumors in vivo using retinoic acid and transplanted the resulting tumors into strain 129 mice. Most transplants from differentiated tumors were benign cystic teratomas that grew slowly or not at all, whereas control embryonal carcinomas grew rapidly and killed the hosts. Rarely, differentiated tumors gave rise to malignant growing tumors, and mitotically active solid areas in the original tumor predicted this propensity. The findings show that differentiation alters the biology of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-6201406.summary_ja: 同一の奇形腫に由来し、初期マウス胚発生の段階を反映する3種の胎児性癌細胞株について、指数増殖期の細胞周期を比較した研究。多能性株はG1期を中心に分裂間期の変動が大きく、PCC3 N/1株ではG1期がほぼ二峰性分布を示し平均3.4時間、F9株は平均1.5時間であった。S-G2期の長さは3株でほぼ同じだった。
pmid-6201406.summary_en: This study compared the cell cycle kinetics of three embryonal carcinoma cell lines (F9, PCC4 Azal, PCC3 N/1), all derived from the same teratoma OTT6050 and representing successive stages of early mouse embryogenesis. Multipotent lines showed greater intraclonal variability in intermitotic time, especially in G1 phase. PCC3 N/1 had an almost bimodal G1 distribution with a mean of 3.4 hr, versus 1.5 hr in F9. S-G2 duration was similar across all lines. The findings relate cell cycle differences to the developmental potential of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-6201575.summary_ja: 久留米大学病院で1970年から1983年に治療された卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の22例を後方視的に検討した。1977年以前は主に術後放射線療法が行われ、13例中2例のみが生存した。1978年以降は多剤併用化学療法により予後が改善したが、初回治療での薬剤耐性や副作用による脱落もみられた。最適な治療法は確立していないと結論づけている。
pmid-6201575.summary_en: This retrospective review of 22 patients with ovarian endodermal sinus tumor treated at Kurume University Hospital from 1970 to 1983 compared outcomes across treatment eras. Before 1977, mainly postoperative radiotherapy was given and only 2 of 13 patients survived. After 1978, multidrug chemotherapy improved survival to 6 of 8 patients, though half developed drug resistance during first-line therapy and two dropped out due to toxicity. The authors conclude that the optimal regimen for malignant germ cell tumors remains undefined.

pmid-6201859.summary_ja: hCGα鎖遺伝子の3'側フランキング領域の多型制限酵素部位を遺伝的マーカーとして、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、正常胎盤などを解析した。ほとんどの胞状奇胎は父親由来の遺伝子のみを示した。一方、絨毛癌では頻度の低い多型パターンが優勢で、このパターンを持つ奇胎は絨毛癌へ進展しやすい可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6201859.summary_en: This study used polymorphic restriction sites in the 3' flanking region of the hCG alpha subunit gene as genotypic markers to examine trophoblastic tissues, including normal placenta, hydatidiform mole, choriocarcinoma, and leukocytes. Most moles showed only a paternal genetic contribution. An uncommon genotype, homozygous for absent EcoRI and present HindIII sites, predominated in choriocarcinoma, suggesting that moles with this pattern may be more likely to progress to choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6201998.summary_ja: 進行した悪性胚細胞腫瘍の男性79例を対象に、シスプラチンを含む3週間隔の併用化学療法を、手術や放射線療法と組み合わせて行った。3年生存率は58%だった。予後不良因子は、前治療後の再発、後腹膜の巨大病変、肝転移、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やβ-hCG、LDHの著明な高値であった。純粋セミノーマでは治癒率が高かった。
pmid-6201998.summary_en: This report describes 79 men with advanced malignant germ cell tumors treated with three-weekly cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy, with or without surgery and/or radiotherapy. The 3-year survival rate was 58%. Poor prognostic factors included relapse after prior chemotherapy, bulky retroperitoneal disease, liver metastases, and very high AFP, beta-hCG, and LDH levels. Patients with pure seminoma had high cure rates, and toxicity was acceptable. The authors note that more aggressive primary chemotherapy is needed for poor-risk patients.

pmid-6202402.summary_ja: 卵巣の未熟奇形腫の組織から樹立した細胞株YKを解析した。この細胞はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を分泌し、継代とともに分泌量は低下した。ヌードマウスに高い造腫瘍性を示した。レチノイン酸は増殖を完全に抑制し、同時にAFP分泌を増加させた。乳酸脱水素酵素のアイソザイム解析では、精巣由来のLDH-Xに類似したバンドが見られた。
pmid-6202402.summary_en: This study established an immature teratoma cell line (YK) from a human ovarian tumor and characterized it. The cells secreted alpha-fetoprotein, which decreased during serial passage. They were highly tumorigenic in athymic nude mice and grew with a doubling time of about 20 hours. Retinoic acid completely inhibited proliferation while increasing AFP secretion. Lactate dehydrogenase activity was elevated in cultured cells, and a characteristic LDH isoenzyme band resembled testicular LDH-X.

pmid-6202408.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性精巣がん異種移植モデルで、ブレオマイシンの持続投与と毎日の間欠的ボーラス投与を比較した前臨床研究。持続投与は精巣がんの臨床試験で広く用いられてきた。腫瘍株ごとに有効性の機序が異なる可能性を考慮し、両投与法を直接比較した。抗腫瘍効果に有意な差はみられなかった。
pmid-6202408.summary_en: This preclinical study compared continuous-infusion and daily intermittent bolus bleomycin schedules in a human embryonal testicular cancer xenograft model. Continuous infusion was motivated by murine tumor data and was widely used in clinical testicular cancer trials. Because mechanisms favoring infusion may not apply to every tumor line, the authors tested both schedules directly. They found no significant difference in antineoplastic response between the two methods.

pmid-6202829.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍や肺転移巣に由来する3種のヒト奇形癌細胞株を樹立し、レトロウイルス様粒子を検討した。この粒子は上皮様細胞や分化細胞の一部でのみ産生された。生化学的に誘導可能で、感染性はないか特異な宿主域を示し、動物レトロウイルスとは免疫学的に無関係であった。内在性のRNA依存性DNAポリメラーゼ活性を持つことから、新規なレトロウイルス群と考えられた。
pmid-6202829.summary_en: Three human teratocarcinoma cell lines were established from testicular tumors or pulmonary metastases and examined for retrovirus-like particles. The particles were produced by only a fraction of epithelioid and differentiating cells. They could be induced biochemically in a retrovirus-like manner, showed either no infectivity or a peculiar host range, and were immunologically unrelated to animal retrovirus strains. They carry an endogenous RNA-dependent DNA polymerase, leading the authors to propose a novel group of human retroviruses.

pmid-6202888.summary_ja: 1984年の論文で、精巣腫瘍152例を対象に非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療成績の変遷を検討した。低病期では後腹膜リンパ節郭清などにより生存率が向上し、進行例ではプラチナ併用多剤化学療法と適切なリンパ節郭清により無病生存率が改善したと報告している。低病期と進行期を統合した治療方針を提案している。
pmid-6202888.summary_en: This 1984 retrospective review of 152 patients with testicular tumors traces how treatment of nonseminomatous germ cell tumors changed over seven years. Survival for low-stage disease improved with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and sandwich irradiation, while platinum-based polychemotherapy and selective lymphadenectomy raised disease-free survival in advanced stages. The authors propose a unified management plan for low- and advanced-stage nonseminomatous testicular tumors.

pmid-6202891.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者に併用化学療法を行った際、気道内腫瘍の融解により気管支破裂という生命を脅かす合併症が生じた経過を報告している。この合併症のため以後の化学療法が遅延した。膿瘍形成、膿胸、気胸など、化学療法による腫瘍融解に伴う他の肺合併症についても考察している。
pmid-6202891.summary_en: This report describes a life-threatening bronchial rupture in a patient with metastatic germ cell tumor of the testis treated with combination chemotherapy. The rupture resulted from lysis of an endobronchial tumor after treatment, which delayed subsequent chemotherapy. The authors also review other pulmonary complications of chemotherapy-induced tumor lysis, including abscess formation, empyema, and pneumothorax. The report highlights the importance of recognizing pulmonary complications of tumor lysis in metastatic disease.

pmid-6202899.summary_ja: 進行精巣腫瘍13例（セミノーマ2例、非セミノーマ11例）にブレオマイシン・ビンカアルカロイド・シスプラチン(BVP)併用化学療法を行った。奏効率は92%、完全奏効は69%で、平均30か月の追跡で54%が無病生存していた。巨大転移、既治療への不応、奇形腫性転移は予後不良因子とされた。アレルギー反応を除き、毒性はシスプラチンと同程度であった。
pmid-6202899.summary_en: Thirteen patients with advanced testicular tumors (two seminoma, eleven nonseminoma) received induction chemotherapy with bleomycin, vinca alkaloid, and cisplatin (BVP), followed by maintenance chemotherapy. The overall response rate was 92%, with complete response in 69%. At a mean follow-up of 30 months, 54% were alive without evidence of disease. Bulky metastases, prior chemotherapy failure, and teratomatous metastases were poor prognostic factors. Toxicity was similar to that of cisplatin, except for allergic reactions.

pmid-6203411.summary_ja: ヒトの良性および悪性奇形腫の症例に対し、神経フィラメント、グリアフィラメント、ミエリン塩基性タンパクに対する単クローン抗体で免疫組織化学染色を行い、神経抗原の発現を検討した。多くの腫瘍では3種類のうち2〜3種類の神経抗原が検出され、成熟した神経要素の存在と3種類すべての発現が相関していた。神経抗原の検出は奇形腫内の神経成分の同定に有用であり、予後因子となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6203411.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry with monoclonal antibodies against neurofilament, glial filament protein, and myelin basic protein to examine a series of human benign and malignant teratomas for neural antigens. Most tumors expressed two or three neural markers, and all three were detected in tumors with mature neural elements. Two malignant teratomas lacked all markers despite neural tissue on microscopy. The authors suggest that neural antigen detection allows confident recognition of neural elements and may have prognostic significance.

pmid-6203643.summary_ja: 1971〜1979年のMDアンダーソン病院で、初発病期III胚細胞腫瘍60例に対しVB+P化学療法後の手術の役割を検討した。残存腫瘤には生存癌や成熟奇形腫が見られ、手術の利益は限定的であった。血清腫瘍マーカーが上昇している症例は手術すべきでなく、非セミノーマ性腫瘍の残存腫瘤は生存癌の不在を確認するため切除すべきと結論している。
pmid-6203643.summary_en: This retrospective review from M.D. Anderson Hospital (1971–1979) examines the role of surgery in 60 patients with initial stage III germ cell tumors treated with vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin. Residual masses often contained viable carcinoma or mature teratoma, and surgery offered benefit only in unusual circumstances. The authors conclude that optimal chemotherapy is central, that patients with elevated serum markers should not be explored, and that residual masses in nonseminomatous tumors must be resected to confirm the absence of viable carcinoma.

pmid-6203752.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍について、PVB化学療法後の後腹膜転移を含めてCEAの局在と血清値を検討した1984年の研究である。免疫染色では卵黄嚢腫瘍と成熟奇形腫にCEAが認められたが、血清CEA値は腫瘍活動性を反映せず、血清腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性は限定的であった。
pmid-6203752.summary_en: This 1984 study examined carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) in non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis and in retroperitoneal metastases after PVB chemotherapy. Immunoperoxidase staining localized CEA in yolk sac tumor and mature teratoma, but serum CEA levels did not reflect tumor activity and were not useful as a serum tumor marker. The only elevated post-chemotherapy value coincided with bleomycin pneumonitis. CEA was also present in cyst-lining cells of mature teratoma, where it correlated with high cyst-fluid levels. The authors concluded that CEA had limited value for monitoring these tumors.

pmid-6203815.summary_ja: 本症例報告では、卵巣の卵黄嚢(内胚葉洞)腫瘍を有する17歳患者で、αフェトプロテインと4種の胎盤性蛋白を測定した。血清のαFPは14 mg/mlを超えて著明に高値で、腫瘍組織に局在していた。血清では胎盤性蛋白は検出されなかったが、24時間蓄尿濃縮液で断続的にhCGが検出され、胎盤性hCGと類似していた。免疫組織化学では腫瘍内にhCGは検出されなかった。著者らは、蓄尿濃縮液が血清より検出感度が高いと述べ、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の可能性も示唆している。
pmid-6203815.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old with ovarian yolk sac (endodermal sinus) tumor, in whom alpha-fetoprotein and four placental proteins were measured. Serum AFP was markedly elevated, above 14 mg/ml, and was localized to tumor tissue immunohistochemically. None of the placental proteins was detectable in serum, but hCG appeared episodically in 24-hour urinary concentrates and resembled placental hCG. Immunohistochemistry did not detect hCG in the tumor. The authors noted that urinary concentrates were far more sensitive than serum for hCG detection and raised the possibility of a mixed germ cell tumor with limited sampling.

pmid-6203825.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍38例の原発巣と転移(性)病変を比較した組織学的研究である。化学療法後に分化した奇形腫が残存した転移(性)病変24例のうち19例は、原発巣に奇形腫成分を有していた。診断時の血清hCG・AFP高値は、原発巣の栄養膜成分・卵黄嚢成分とそれぞれ関連していた。
pmid-6203825.summary_en: This histopathological study compared primary and metastatic germ cell tumors from 38 male patients. Of 24 metastases showing residual differentiated teratoma after therapy, 19 derived from primaries containing teratoma, a statistically significant association. The authors interpret the apparent 'maturation' of metastases as selective destruction of anaplastic components rather than true differentiation. Serum hCG and AFP elevations at presentation correlated with trophoblastic and yolk sac elements in primary tumors. The authors recommend specific histological reporting of teratomatous, trophoblastic, and yolk sac components, since these predict metastatic morphology.

pmid-6203857.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫170例と充実性奇形腫19例を対象に、hCG・AFP・CEAの免疫細胞化学的局在を検討した研究である。充実性奇形腫では、これらのマーカーの存在が高い組織学的グレードと関連し、グレード判定に役立つ可能性が示された。消化管膵神経内分泌細胞は内胚葉由来とする所見が得られた。
pmid-6203857.summary_en: This immunocytochemical study examined neurohormonal peptides and oncofetal antigens (hCG, AFP, CEA) in 170 benign cystic teratomas and 19 solid ovarian teratomas graded 0 to 3. In solid teratomas, the presence of hCG, AFP, and CEA was associated with higher histological grade, suggesting a possible role in grading. Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine cells appeared in cystic teratomas without neural tissue. The authors proposed an endodermal rather than neural crest origin for these cells, which contrasts with earlier reports. The findings link marker expression to malignant potential in ovarian teratomas.

pmid-6204019.summary_ja: 原発性性腺外セミノーマ21例を対象に、従来療法と高用量シスプラチンによる初回化学療法を含む多剤併用療法の成績を比較した、診療録に基づく後方視的研究である。従来療法群では10例中5例が再発し、併用療法群では転移性疾患で死亡したのは11例中1例のみであった。初回化学療法を含む併用療法が優れると結論づけている。
pmid-6204019.summary_en: This review of 21 patients with primary extragonadal seminoma compared conventional radiotherapy with or without surgery against multimodality therapy beginning with high-dose cisplatin. Five of ten conventionally treated patients relapsed, and four died of disease. In the multimodality group, only one of eleven died of metastatic disease. Among six patients who underwent surgical resection after chemotherapy, five had completely necrotic tumor. The authors concluded that combined modality therapy with initial high-dose cisplatin rapidly reduces tumor burden and appears superior to treatment without initial chemotherapy.

pmid-6204258.summary_ja: 1944年から1983年にMDアンダーソン病院で治療された卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍42例を後方視的に検討した研究である。診断時の中央値年齢は16歳で、腹痛が最も多い症状であった。最適な治療は手術に続く併用化学療法とされ、セカンドルック開腹術と腫瘍マーカーのモニタリングの役割も論じている。
pmid-6204258.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 42 patients with mixed germ cell tumors of the ovary treated at M. D. Anderson Hospital between 1944 and 1983. The median age was 16 years, and abdominal pain was the most common symptom, present in 90 percent. Twenty of 42 patients were alive and well at analysis. The paper details clinical and pathologic features and discusses the roles of second-look laparotomy and tumor marker monitoring in management. The authors conclude that optimal treatment is surgery followed by combination chemotherapy.

pmid-6204519.summary_ja: 純粋型精巣セミノーマ38例の後方視的研究で、血清・尿中hCGを測定し、hCG様物質の産生細胞を免疫染色で検索した。hCG陽性細胞は、合胞体栄養膜巨細胞とセミノーマ細胞と区別できない単核細胞の2種が確認された。hCG高値や合胞体栄養膜巨細胞の有無にかかわらず、予後は良好であった。
pmid-6204519.summary_en: This retrospective study of 38 patients with pure testicular seminoma measured serum and urinary hCG and searched for the cellular source of hCG-like substance using immunoperoxidase on step sections. Eight patients had elevated hCG, and five showed hCG-positive cells in tumor sections. Two cell types were identified: syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells and mononuclear cells indistinguishable from seminoma cells. Patients responded well to radiation therapy or chemotherapy, and outcomes were favorable regardless of syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells or mildly elevated hCG.

pmid-6204543.summary_ja: 本研究は、Con AおよびLCH交差線アフィニティー免疫電気泳動を用い、卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍担癌ヌードマウスおよび患者血清のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)サブフラクションを解析した。卵黄嚢腫瘍のAFPは糖鎖の違いにより胎児肝由来のAFPと区別でき、成熟・未熟奇形腫でも二種のサブフラクションが認められた。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のAFP合成には複数の因子が関与すると結論づけられた。
pmid-6204543.summary_en: This study used Con A and lentil lectin crossed-line affinity immunoelectrophoresis to separate alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) subfractions in sera from nude mice bearing human ovarian yolk sac tumor and from patients with yolk sac tumor or mature or immature ovarian teratoma. Yolk sac tumor and fetal liver AFP subfractions were distinguishable by carbohydrate moieties, indicating differing glycosylation between tumor-derived and fetal yolk sac AFP. Both mature and immature teratomas contained two AFP subfractions derived from yolk sac or fetal liver. The authors conclude that multiple factors regulate AFP synthesis in ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-6204557.summary_ja: 21歳男性で女性化乳房を呈し、精巣の胎児性癌がヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を産生してライディッヒ細胞の著明な過形成を来した症例を報告した。内因性hCGによるライディッヒ細胞の組織・超微細構造変化を初めて記載した。エストロゲンの上昇がアンドロゲンより大きかった。形態変化とテストステロン産生の間には相関がなかった。
pmid-6204557.summary_en: The authors describe a 21-year-old man with gynecomastia whose testicular embryonal carcinoma produced human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), causing massive Leydig cell hyperplasia. Histologic and ultrastructural changes in Leydig cells due to endogenous hCG were documented for the first time. The hCG-driven stimulation raised estrogen levels more than androgen levels. The authors conclude that hCG-secreting testicular embryonal carcinoma can cause Leydig cell hyperplasia resembling that seen in other conditions, and that these morphologic features do not correlate with testosterone production.

pmid-6204734.summary_ja: 精巣転移性癌127例と原発巣不明の2例を検討した。原発巣は前立腺、肺、黒色腫、大腸が多かった。精巣転移は胚細胞腫瘍より高齢者に発生する。リンパ管・血管侵襲の強さや精細管を残す間質性パターンは転移を示唆する。若年者で血清AFPやhCGが著明に高値の場合は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を疑う。
pmid-6204734.summary_en: This review analyzes 127 cases of metastatic carcinoma involving the testis, plus two additional patients whose presenting sign was a testicular mass from a nontesticular primary. Common primary sites included prostate, lung, melanoma, and colon. Secondary testicular tumors occurred in older patients than germ cell tumors. Extensive lymphovascular invasion and an interstitial pattern sparing seminiferous tubules suggest metastasis. Markedly elevated serum AFP and hCG in young patients suggest nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, which is important for distinguishing these entities from primary testicular neoplasms.

pmid-6204739.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍34例(セミノーマ18例、胎児性癌10例など)でケラチンの免疫組織化学染色を行った。セミノーマは全例陰性で、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌などは少なくとも部分的に陽性であった。単クローン抗体が染色の背景が最も明瞭だった。ケラチン染色はセミノーマと胎児性癌の鑑別に有用である。
pmid-6204739.summary_en: The authors examined keratin expression by immunohistochemistry in 34 germ cell tumors, including 18 seminomas, 10 embryonal carcinomas, 2 teratocarcinomas, 3 yolk sac tumors, and 1 choriocarcinoma. All seminomas were keratin-negative, whereas embryonal carcinoma, the epithelial component of teratocarcinoma, yolk sac tumors, and choriocarcinoma were at least focally positive. A monoclonal antibody against keratin classes of 40, 50, and 56.5 kDa gave cleaner staining. Fresh-frozen or alcohol-fixed tissues gave the best results. Keratin immunostaining can help distinguish seminoma from embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-6204750.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株9株(妊娠由来7株、非妊娠由来2株)を用い、HLA-A,B,C抗原などを定量した。細胞表面のHLA発現は株により異なり、1株は全く検出されなかった。HLA重鎖のmRNA量は表面発現と平行したが、β2ミクログロブリンmRNAは全株で認められた。絨毛癌でのHLA発現はβ2ミクログロブリンではなく重鎖mRNAによって制限されていた。
pmid-6204750.summary_en: The authors quantified HLA-A,B,C antigens, beta-2-microglobulin, and trophoblast antigens on nine choriocarcinoma cell lines, seven of gestational and two of nongestational origin. Surface HLA expression varied, and one line had none. All lines secreted beta-2-microglobulin. Northern blot analysis showed that HLA heavy-chain mRNA levels paralleled surface HLA expression, whereas beta-2-microglobulin mRNA was present in all lines. Thus HLA-A,B,C expression in choriocarcinoma is limited by heavy-chain mRNA rather than beta-2-microglobulin mRNA, with implications for trophoblast HLA regulation.

pmid-6204875.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、PVB療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RLND)を施行した症例を2群で比較した。維持化学療法後4~6か月で手術した群では成熟奇形腫が主で、臓器様分化を示した。PVBのみで4~6週後に手術した群では、壊死を伴う未分化成分が混在していた。維持療法または時間経過により成熟奇形腫が臓器様構造へと分化すると考えられた。
pmid-6204875.summary_en: The study compared retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimens from testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients. Group I received PVB induction plus maintenance chemotherapy and surgery 4-6 months later, while group II had PVB alone with surgery at 4-6 weeks. Group I specimens mostly showed mature teratoma with organoid differentiation. Group II specimens contained small mature teratoma areas with less-differentiated structures beside large necrotic areas. The authors suggest that maintenance chemotherapy or a longer interval allows mature teratoma to further differentiate toward organoid structures.

pmid-6205109.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫の症例で、グリア芽腫成分を含みAFPが上昇していた。VCAD様の化学療法後にAFPは正常化したが病勢は悪化し、剖検で奇形腫成分の中に広範なグリア芽腫様組織の浸潤が認められた。血清AFPは腫瘍マーカーとして信頼性に欠けたと判断された。グリア芽腫成分の攻撃性が予後に重要であると結論づけた。
pmid-6205109.summary_en: The authors report an ovarian immature teratoma containing a glioblastoma component, with elevated serum AFP. Although the patient received vincristine, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide chemotherapy and AFP normalized, the condition worsened. Autopsy showed recurrent and metastatic tumors widely infiltrated by glioblastoma-type tissue within other teratomatous elements. The serum AFP was judged unreliable as a tumor marker. The authors emphasize that the aggressive potential of the glioblastoma component is important for prognosis in ovarian immature teratoma.

pmid-6205243.summary_ja: 播種性悪性仙尾部腫瘍の小児2例に、ビンブラスチン、シスプラチン、ブレオマイシンを6コース施行した。4コース後の開腹探索では悪性所見は認められなかった。両者とも血清αフェトプロテインは正常のまま、それぞれ30か月および18か月間無病生存している。小児仙尾部悪性腫瘍の転移例に有効である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6205243.summary_en: Two children with disseminated malignant sacrococcygeal tumour were treated with six courses of vinblastine, cisplatin, and bleomycin. Both underwent exploratory surgery after four courses, and no histologic evidence of malignancy was found. Both remained disease-free with normal alpha-fetoprotein levels for 30 and 18 months, respectively. The report suggests that this regimen may be effective for metastatic malignant sacrococcygeal tumors in children.

pmid-6205353.summary_ja: 13例の充実性卵巣奇形腫を免疫細胞化学的に検討し、原始神経上皮の量に基づく組織学的グレーディング法を再評価した。視野数による分類は標本採取に左右され適用が難しいため、全検体中の神経上皮の推定割合で分類する方法を提案している。抄録は途中で切れている。
pmid-6205353.summary_en: This 1984 study examined 13 solid ovarian teratomas immunocytochemically and reassessed the histologic grading system based on primitive neuroepithelium proposed by Norris et al. The authors found that counting neuroepithelial fields is sensitive to sampling and difficult to apply consistently. As an alternative, they propose grading by the estimated percentage of neuroepithelial tissue across all examined sections: 0% for grade 0, up to 10% for grade 1, about one-third for grade 2, and half or more for grade 3. The abstract provided is truncated.

pmid-6205635.summary_ja: 絨毛癌8例と未熟胎盤2例を用い、β-hCGに対する2種類のモノクローナル抗体と多クローン抗体を比較した。1種類は完全型と遊離型の両方を認識したが、もう1種類は遊離β-hCG鎖のみに反応した。固定パラフィン包埋組織で各種のβ-hCGを検出できることから、診断病理への有用性が示された。
pmid-6205635.summary_en: This 1984 study generated monoclonal antibodies against beta-hCG and compared them with a polyclonal antiserum on eight choriocarcinomas and two immature placentas using formaldehyde-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissue. One monoclonal antibody recognized intact and free beta-hCG, while the second reacted only with free beta-hCG chains, as shown by absorption studies. The authors conclude these antibodies can reliably detect the various forms of beta-hCG in archival tissue sections, which is useful for diagnostic pathology of trophoblastic and germ cell tumors.

pmid-6206242.summary_ja: 1960～1982年に治療した精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍11例をレビューし、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の意義をαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値と併せて検討した。鼠径部からの精巣摘除術と化学療法後もAFPが持続的に高値の患者に限定すべきと結論し、管理のフローシートも提示した。
pmid-6206242.summary_en: This 1984 report from two Montreal children's hospitals reviews 11 yolk sac tumors of the testis treated between 1960 and 1982. The authors critically assess the role of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in relation to serum alpha-fetoprotein levels. They propose a management flow sheet and conclude that lymphadenectomy should be reserved for patients whose AFP remains persistently elevated after inguinal orchiectomy and chemotherapy. The findings were intended to refine surgical decision-making in yolk sac tumors.

pmid-6206504.summary_ja: セミノーマにおける外科治療の適応を検討した総説。β-hCG 30IU超の上昇、AFP上昇、混合型胚細胞腫瘍などが確立した適応とされる。進行例では化学療法と減量手術の併用が生存率を向上させる。低病期では後腹膜リンパ節郭清と放射線療法を比較する無作為化試験が必要とされる。
pmid-6206504.summary_en: This 1984 review examines when surgery is indicated in seminoma. Accepted indications include beta-hCG above 30 IU, elevated AFP, mixed germ cell histology, and selected recurrent or secondary primary seminoma. Questionable indications include anaplastic seminoma, any beta-hCG elevation, and bulky disease. Combining chemotherapy with debulking surgery improves survival in high-stage disease. The authors suggest randomized trials comparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with radiotherapy for low-stage seminoma.

pmid-6206511.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のWHO国際分類を概説した総説。単一細胞型と複数細胞型に分け、セミノーマ、精母細胞性セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ポリエンブリオーマ、奇形腫の7つの基本組織型を挙げる。この分類は腫瘍マーカーや臨床経過とよく相関するとされる。
pmid-6206511.summary_en: This 1984 review outlines the WHO International Classification of testicular tumors, which divides them into single-cell-type and mixed-type categories. Seven basic histologic groups are recognized: seminoma, spermatocytic seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, polyembryoma, and teratoma. The authors note that this classification correlates well with tumor markers and with clinical behavior, supporting its use in clinical decision-making for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6206705.summary_ja: 23歳男性の精巣未熟奇形腫の症例報告。精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清(転移なし)の後、肺結節に化学療法を施行した。残存した結節は切除の結果、完全に良性の成熟奇形腫と判明した。強力な化学療法後の残存病変が良性奇形腫である可能性と、化学療法による奇形腫の成熟誘導が示唆された。
pmid-6206705.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 23-year-old man with testicular immature teratoma treated with orchiectomy, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (negative), and combination chemotherapy for pulmonary nodules. The nodules were later resected and proved to be completely benign mature teratoma. The authors highlight that residual lesions after intensive chemotherapy are often benign and suggest an apparent chemotherapy-induced induction of benign teratoma.

pmid-6206822.summary_ja: 10年間の469症例から、膵組織を含む奇形腫17例を抽出した。縦隔前部11例、仙骨尾骨部5例、後腹膜1例に分布していた。膵島や外分泌腺が認められ、瘻孔からの排液の血糖やアミラーゼを測定すると、一部に異常値がみられた。著者らは、奇形腫内の膵組織が正常膵に類似すると結論した。
pmid-6206822.summary_en: This 1984 pathology series identified 17 teratomas containing well-differentiated pancreatic tissue among 469 cases reviewed over ten years. Most were in the anterior mediastinum (11 cases), followed by the sacrococcygeal region (5) and retroperitoneum (1). Islets of Langerhans and exocrine elements were typically present. Glucose and amylase measured in fistula discharge from some tumors showed mild or marked abnormalities, and the authors judged the pancreatic tissue similar to normal pancreas both histologically and functionally.

pmid-6206937.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣がん91例を対象に、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン(PVB)による導入化学療法と、1年間のシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン維持療法を実施した。化学療法のみで54%、化学療法後の手術を含めると69%が完全寛解に達した。5年生存率は完全寛解例で95%、部分寛解例で32%、全体で72%であった。このレジメンにより生存率は大きく改善し、従来の病期II患者の成績に匹敵するとされた。
pmid-6206937.summary_en: Ninety-one patients with disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors were treated with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin induction chemotherapy followed by one year of cisplatin and vinblastine maintenance. Forty-nine patients (54%) achieved complete remission with chemotherapy alone, and 14 (15%) achieved it after surgical resection, for a total complete remission rate of 69%. The 5-year survival was 95% for complete responders, 32% for partial responders, and 72% overall. The authors conclude that this regimen markedly improved survival, comparable to that of Stage II patients in earlier literature.

pmid-6207011.summary_ja: 絨毛癌クローン細胞株JEG-3が分泌するヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のαサブユニットの糖鎖を解析した基礎研究です。遊離型αサブユニットは結合型より分子量が大きく、N結合型糖鎖の含量も多いことが示されました。両者の糖鎖構造の違いを化学的に示した点が特徴です。
pmid-6207011.summary_en: This 1984 study examined glycosylation of hCG subunits secreted by JEG-3, a clonal human choriocarcinoma cell line. Free hCG alpha-subunit had a larger apparent molecular weight than the combined form obtained by dissociating secreted hCG. Radiolabeled sugar incorporation showed that free alpha-subunit contained more carbohydrate, including more N-acetylneuraminic acid, and both forms carried two major N-linked oligosaccharide chains. The findings provide direct chemical evidence that the free alpha-subunit has higher carbohydrate content, which is relevant to hCG biosynthesis in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6207116.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍などのAFP産生腫瘍で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の糖鎖不均一性をレクチンクロマトグラフィーで解析しました。病期分類や予後の判定には有用ではありませんでした。一方、化学療法関連の肝障害などの良性肝機能障害との鑑別には役立ちました。
pmid-6207116.summary_en: This study evaluated concanavalin A lectin-based analysis of AFP glycosylation heterogeneity in patients with AFP-producing tumors, mainly non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, ovarian germ cell tumors, and hepatocellular carcinoma. The method did not provide useful information for staging or prognosis. However, it helped distinguish benign liver dysfunction, such as alcoholic hepatitis or chemotherapy-related liver damage, from liver involvement by non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. It could not reliably separate recurrent germ cell tumor from hepatocellular carcinoma when serum AFP was elevated.

pmid-6207317.summary_ja: 原発性の肺および縦隔の悪性胚細胞腫瘍3例を臨床・病理学的に検討した報告です。初診時の画像診断と病理診断は困難でしたが、腫瘍マーカーと臨床経過から、悪性奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌と診断されました。1例では多様な組織への分化が認められました。
pmid-6207317.summary_en: This case series describes three patients with primary malignant germ cell tumors of the lung or mediastinum. Germ cell tumors are thought to arise from primitive totipotent germ cells. Initial radiographic and pathologic diagnoses were difficult. Final diagnoses were malignant teratoma in the first patient, yolk sac tumor in the second, and choriocarcinoma in the third, guided by tumor markers and clinical course. In one case, the tumor differentiated into several tissue types and showed growth and metastasis.

pmid-6207473.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍24例に併用化学療法を行った報告です。病期I の症例には、短期間のビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド療法が推奨されました。進行例では卵黄嚢腫瘍成分に対しシスプラチン併用療法が有効で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の推移は治療中止の判断や二期開腹術の回避に役立つとしています。
pmid-6207473.summary_en: This 1984 series treated 24 women with ovarian germ cell tumors using combination chemotherapy. Fifteen received intensive vincristine, actinomycin-D, and cyclophosphamide, and most remained disease-free. Patients with endodermal sinus tumor components who failed that regimen responded transiently to cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin. The authors recommend short-course therapy for stage I tumors requiring adjuvant treatment, fertility preservation, and serial AFP monitoring to guide treatment discontinuation and possibly avoid second-look surgery.

pmid-6207906.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ23例で、肝臓型および心筋型フェリチンに対する免疫組織化学染色を行いました。全例で陽性で、多くは強い染色性を示しました。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が陰性または低値でも血清フェリチンが上昇する例があり、診断や再発評価への有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-6207906.summary_en: This study examined immunohistochemical ferritin in 23 testicular seminomas using antisera to liver and myocardial ferritin. All tumors stained positively, most often strongly. The authors note that both basic and acidic isoferritins are present in most seminomas, and serum ferritin is often elevated in seminoma patients even when hCG and AFP are negative or low. They suggest serum ferritin may aid diagnosis and assessment of extent and recurrence of testicular seminoma.

pmid-6208154.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera 1を免疫原として作製した3種の種特異的モノクローナル抗体(5.1.H、8.7.D、13.7.A)を報告する。これらの抗体は未分化なヒト胎児性癌細胞に限局して反応し、レチノイン酸やホルボールエステルによる分化誘導後には抗原発現が消失した。競合実験により3抗体は異なる抗原を認識することが示された。生体内での組織分布が極めて限られることから、腫瘍胎児性抗原として胎児性癌の性状や分化状態の解析に役立つと考えられる。
pmid-6208154.summary_en: This study describes three species-specific monoclonal antibodies (5.1.H, 8.7.D, 13.7.A) raised against the Tera 1 human embryonal carcinoma cell line. The antibodies recognize antigens restricted to undifferentiated human embryonal carcinoma cells, and their expression disappears after retinoic acid- or phorbol ester-induced differentiation. Competition experiments showed the three antibodies recognize distinct antigenic structures. The limited in vivo tissue distribution suggests these antigens are onco-foetal markers, useful for characterizing embryonal carcinoma and its differentiation state.

pmid-6208297.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス胎児性癌F9を用いてマウスインターフェロン(IFN)の腫瘍増殖抑制効果を検討したものである。F9細胞はin vitroではIFNに抵抗性であったが、毎日のIFN投与により腹腔内移植腫瘍の増殖は著明に抑制され、マウスの生存期間が延長した。付随的に、正常マウスの血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)濃度の上昇も認められた。in vivoでの効果は、細胞への直接作用だけでは説明できない可能性がある。
pmid-6208297.summary_en: Using the murine F9 embryonal carcinoma model, this study examined whether mouse interferon affects tumor growth in vivo. F9 cells were resistant to interferon in vitro, yet daily interferon administration markedly suppressed growth of intraperitoneally injected tumors and prolonged survival in mice. Interferon also incidentally increased serum alpha-fetoprotein levels in normal mice. The findings suggest that the in vivo antitumor effect may not depend solely on direct action on the carcinoma cells.

pmid-6208386.summary_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍に対しPVB療法を行い、腫瘍マーカーが正常化して化学療法反応が最大となった後に、残存腫瘤の手術を行った40例の検討である。残存腫瘤は奇形腫が45%、線維化や壊死が52%を占め、生存癌は1例(3%)のみであった。術中に線維化と壊死を確実に区別できないため、後腹膜に残存腫瘤を有する患者には完全な後腹膜リンパ節郭清が推奨されている。
pmid-6208386.summary_en: Forty patients with residual masses after cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin induction chemotherapy for advanced germ cell tumors underwent surgery after marker normalization and maximal response. Residual teratoma was found in 45%, fibrosis or necrosis in 52%, and viable carcinoma in only one patient (3%). Retroperitoneal lymph nodes often matched the histology of the mass. Because fibrosis and necrosis cannot be reliably distinguished intraoperatively, the authors recommend complete retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for all patients with residual retroperitoneal masses.

pmid-6208594.summary_ja: ヌードマウスで増殖させたヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍から精製したαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の糖鎖構造を決定した研究である。肝由来AFPにはない付加的なバイセクトN-アセチルグルコサミンが存在し、これによりコンカナバリンA(Con-A)の結合部位が遮断されていた。この構造的知見は、血中AFPが卵黄嚢腫瘍由来か肝由来かを判別するCon-A結合試験の臨床応用の根拠となる。
pmid-6208594.summary_en: This study determined the sugar chain structure of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) purified from human yolk sac tumors grown in nude mice. After enzymatic and chemical analysis, the oligosaccharide was found to carry an additional bisecting N-acetylglucosamine absent from hepatic AFP. This GlcNAc blocks the concanavalin A binding site in yolk sac AFP. The findings provide a structural basis for the clinical use of the Con-A binding test to determine whether circulating AFP originates from a yolk sac tumor or from liver.

pmid-6208748.summary_ja: 1976～1980年にデンマークで診断されたセミノーマ554例の全国的研究である。主に術後照射で治療され、3年補正生存率は病期Iで99%、病期IIで89%、病期IIIで65%であった。未分化セミノーマは典型例より転移が多く予後不良であった。ブレオマイシンと照射の併用では肺臓炎による死亡が2例あり、毒性への注意が必要とされた。
pmid-6208748.summary_en: This Danish nationwide DATECA study reviewed 554 consecutive seminoma patients diagnosed from 1976 to 1980, treated mainly with postoperative irradiation. Three-year corrected survival was 99% for stage I, 89% for stage II, and 65% for stage III. Anaplastic seminoma had higher metastatic spread and worse prognosis than typical seminoma. Treatment-related complications were few, but adjuvant bleomycin combined with irradiation caused two deaths from pneumonitis, highlighting a toxicity concern.

pmid-6208749.summary_ja: デンマーク精巣がん研究(DATECA)で、1976年以降の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を血清AFPおよびhCGで追跡した。術前後のマーカー値が揃った603例のうち、術前にマーカーが上昇していたのはセミノーマで8%、非セミノーマで60%であった。AFP上昇は卵黄嚢腫瘍成分、hCG上昇は絨毛癌成分と相関し、病期が進むほど高率であった。マーカー陰性例は予後が良好であった。
pmid-6208749.summary_en: The Danish Testicular Carcinoma Study (DATECA) monitored germ cell tumor patients with serum AFP and hCG from 1976. Among 603 patients with paired pre- and postoperative marker values, preoperative marker elevation occurred in 8% of seminoma and 60% of non-seminoma patients. Elevated AFP and hCG correlated with endodermal sinus and choriocarcinoma elements, respectively, and with higher stage. Marker-negative patients had better prognosis, and marker production in seminoma, particularly hCG, indicated poorer outcome.

pmid-6208763.summary_ja: 培養およびハムスター頬袋に移植したBeWo絨毛癌細胞に対し、抗β-hCG抗体の効果を検討した。補体存在下の抗体は一部の細胞のみを傷害し、抵抗性細胞は細胞表面にhCGを持たず、培養下でhCGを分泌しなかった。抵抗性細胞を頬袋に移植するとhCG分泌能が回復した。抗体効果が不完全となる理由は、細胞種の不均一性にあると結論づけられている。
pmid-6208763.summary_en: This study examines the effect of antibodies against the beta subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin on BeWo choriocarcinoma cells in culture and in hamster cheek pouch. Anti-beta-hCG antibodies with complement killed only part of the cells, while a resistant subpopulation lacked surface hCG and did not secrete it in vitro. Upon transplantation to the hamster cheek pouch, the resistant cells regained hCG secretion. The authors conclude that cellular heterogeneity explains the incomplete and later-stage refractoriness to antibody treatment.

pmid-6208857.summary_ja: 病期IIIの非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者28例のうち、肺転移を有する11例にPVB化学療法後の開胸術を行った。生存癌は4例で、線維化、壊死、成熟奇形腫とともに認められた。このうち3例は救済化学療法で治療に成功した。肺や縦隔の残存腫瘤は生存癌の有無を確認するため切除が必要であり、開胸術は診断的処置と位置づけられた。
pmid-6208857.summary_en: This report evaluated thoracotomy after PVB chemotherapy in 11 of 28 patients with stage III nonseminomatous testicular cancer and lung metastases. Viable carcinoma was found in 4 patients, along with fibrosis, necrosis, and mature teratoma. Three of these four were successfully retreated with VP-16-213, cisplatin, and actinomycin D. The authors conclude that resection of residual pulmonary or mediastinal masses is mandatory to identify viable carcinoma, making thoracotomy a diagnostic procedure.

pmid-6209018.summary_ja: 未分化のF9奇形癌細胞を、レチノイン酸とcAMPで培養下で分化誘導した基礎研究。モノクローナル抗体を用いた免疫蛍光法により、分化後の細胞の約50%でサイトケラチン18が合成され、線維状ネットワークを形成することを示した。免疫ブロットでも確認された。
pmid-6209018.summary_en: This study examined the differentiation of undifferentiated F9 teratocarcinoma cells, a germ cell tumor-derived line, induced in culture with retinoic acid and cAMP. A monoclonal antibody (RGE 53) against cytokeratin polypeptide 18 was used in indirect immunofluorescence. Upon differentiation, about 50% of cells synthesized this cytokeratin, which assembled into a filamentous network. Morphological changes were evident across the cultures. Immunoblotting confirmed these findings. The work is an in vitro cell biology study providing insight into germ cell tumor differentiation rather than clinical management.

pmid-6209143.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者11例を対象に、ブレオマイシン投与時の肺機能と血清ACEを検討した研究。臨床的・画像的な肺障害は認められなかったが、DLCOは有意に低下し、肺胞-内皮膜の障害が示唆された。血清ACEは治療終了後に治療前値へ戻り、治療に伴う内皮障害を反映している可能性が示された。
pmid-6209143.summary_en: This 1984 study assessed bleomycin-associated lung injury in 11 patients treated for testicular cancer, using pulmonary function tests and serum angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE). No clinical or radiological pulmonary damage occurred. Carbon monoxide diffusion capacity (DLCO) declined significantly during 126 days of pulsed bleomycin regimen, suggesting damage to the alveolar-endothelial membrane. Serum ACE was unchanged within each course but rose significantly across courses and returned to pretreatment values two months after cessation. ACE may reflect treatment-associated endothelial injury.

pmid-6209145.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍90例で、白金系化学療法後の血清AFPとhCGの低下速度を解析した研究。初回AFP半減期が9日超の3例はすべて再発した。hCGの低下速度では再発例と寛解例を区別できなかった。マーカー低下の緩徐化は再発と関連したが、分化した奇形腫の残存でも生じた。
pmid-6209145.summary_en: This study analyzed the decline of serum AFP and hCG after platinum-based chemotherapy in 90 evaluable patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Of these, 81% were alive and disease-free at a median of 28 months. All three patients with an initial AFP half-life above 9 days relapsed, though some relapsing patients had regression rates within the remission range. hCG regression rate did not distinguish patients who relapsed from those who remained in remission. Late slowing of marker decline was associated with relapse in 45% of cases, but was also seen with large residual differentiated teratoma masses.

pmid-6209171.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対しブレオマイシン治療を受けた患者で、レイノー現象と先端部硬化症という稀な副作用を生じた症例報告。両者には共通の病態機序が関与する可能性が示唆された。ブレオマイシンによる副作用は、これらの疾患を研究するための実験モデルとなり得るとされる。
pmid-6209171.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastasized testicular carcinoma who developed two uncommon adverse effects of bleomycin therapy: Raynaud's phenomenon and acral sclerosis. The authors suggest that the association of these side effects points to a common pathogenic mechanism. They further propose that bleomycin-induced reactions may serve as an experimental model for studying Raynaud's phenomenon and acral sclerosis, conditions that are otherwise difficult to investigate experimentally in humans.

pmid-6209425.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者14例で、片側精巣摘除術後の精液をフローサイトメトリーと通常の精液検査で比較した研究。大半の症例で精子形成の異常と精子染色質の変化が認められ、その変化は摘除後15か月まで持続した。反対側精巣の精子形成異常が示唆された。
pmid-6209425.summary_en: This study analyzed semen from 14 men with testicular cancer, obtained after unilateral orchiectomy and before further treatment, using flow cytometry and conventional semen analysis. Light microscopy showed decreased normal sperm production and abnormal spermiogenesis in most patients. Flow cytometry revealed increased acridine orange staining and abnormal thermal sensitivity of sperm chromatin. These changes persisted up to 15 months after orchiectomy, suggesting abnormal spermiogenesis in the contralateral testis. The authors propose flow cytometric chromatin assessment as a sensitive fertility parameter not detected by conventional analysis.

pmid-6209794.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者11例で、AFPとhCGを組織と血清で免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍10例中8例で組織AFPが陽性、7例で血清AFPが上昇していた。純粋セミノーマの1例では両マーカーとも検出されなかった。組織の免疫反応性は血清値および臨床病期とよく相関した。
pmid-6209794.summary_en: This study examined AFP and hCG in tissue and serum of 11 patients with testicular tumors, using indirect immunoperoxidase staining. In a patient with pure seminoma, neither marker was detected. Among ten patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, eight showed AFP immunoreactivity in tissue, and seven had elevated serum AFP. Five showed hCG immunoreactivity, matching five patients with elevated serum hCG. The authors concluded that tissue immunoreactivity correlated well with serum marker levels and clinical stage.

pmid-6209917.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍33例と精巣上皮内癌(CIS)でPLAPを免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。セミノーマの18/19例、非セミノーマの9/14例で陽性で、主に胎児性癌成分に局在した。CIS24例中20例で陽性であり、CISが前駆病変である可能性を支持した。血清PLAPは、セミノーマにおける腫瘍マーカーおよび再発検出の指標として有用と考えられる。
pmid-6209917.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) in 33 testicular germ cell tumors and in carcinoma in situ (CIS) of the testis. PLAP was positive in 18 of 19 seminomas and 9 of 14 non-seminomas, mainly localized to embryonal carcinoma components. PLAP was detected in 20 of 24 CIS cases, whereas normal germinal epithelium was negative. Serum PLAP above 1.0 µg/l occurred in 63% of seminoma and 21% of non-seminoma patients, consistent with tissue staining. The authors suggest PLAP is useful for diagnosis, monitoring, and detecting recurrence in seminoma, and that CIS may be the precursor state.

pmid-6210048.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理組織像をWHO分類に沿って解説した総説である。純粋型(セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、奇形腫など)と混合型に分類し、原発巣と転移巣で組織像が異なる理由を考察している。また、hCGとAFPの免疫染色が臨床病理学的検討に有用であると強調している。
pmid-6210048.summary_en: This review illustrates the histopathology of testicular germ cell tumors according to the WHO classification. It groups tumors into pure histological types (seminoma, spermatocytic seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, teratoma) and mixed types. It explains why metastatic lesions can differ histologically from primary tumors, given their differentiation toward embryonic-like structures. The authors also emphasize immunohistochemical staining for hCG and AFP as useful in clinicopathological study.

pmid-6210050.summary_ja: 若年女性に多い卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断と治療について述べた総説である。組織型により予後が異なり、血清腫瘍マーカーの測定が有用な診断法として推奨されている。VAC療法やPVB療法により患者の生存率が著明に改善したと報告しており、臨床管理上の重要性が高まっている。
pmid-6210050.summary_en: This review addresses germ cell tumors of the ovary, a small fraction of ovarian tumors that mainly affect young women. It notes that histologic types vary and that prognosis differs accordingly. Serum tumor markers are recommended as useful diagnostic tools. The authors report that the chemotherapy regimens VAC or PVB have markedly improved patient survival, which has increased the importance of these tumors in clinical management.

pmid-6210063.summary_ja: 29歳男性の右精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。精巣摘除術後もhCGとAFPが高値を示し、病理学的に絨毛癌、胎児性癌、悪性嚢胞性奇形腫の混合型と診断された。VAB-4併用化学療法により重篤な副作用なく完全寛解が得られ、腫瘍マーカーも正常化した。
pmid-6210063.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old man with a right testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. After orchiectomy, serum hCG and AFP remained elevated, and pathology showed mixed histology of choriocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, and malignant cystic teratoma. Treatment with the VAB-4 regimen (VBL, ACTD, BLM, CDDP, EX) produced complete remission without severe side effects. At follow-up, hCG and AFP had normalized, and the patient remained in good health.

pmid-6210350.summary_ja: 1975〜1982年に治療された精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移患者22例を後方視的に解析した研究である。病態群別の生存率は0〜80%で、全生存期間(全生存率)は31.8%だった。中枢神経系はPVB化学療法の聖域となりうるため、完全奏効が得られる患者には全脳照射と化学療法の併用による積極的治療が必要と結論している。
pmid-6210350.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 22 patients with brain metastases from nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors treated at Indiana University from 1975 to 1982. Patients were grouped by presentation and treatment history. Survival ranged from 0% to 80% across groups, with overall survival of 31.8%. The authors conclude that the CNS is a sanctuary site for PVB chemotherapy, and that patients who can achieve complete response should receive aggressive whole brain irradiation with concomitant chemotherapy.

pmid-6318540.summary_ja: 若年男性に多い原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の4例について、CT所見を報告した研究である。大きな前縦隔腫瘤が脂肪層を消失させ、左縦隔縁に沿って進展していた。非セミノーマ性腫瘍では、嚢胞や壊死を示す水様濃度の領域を含んでいた。CTは病変の広がりの評価と治療反応のモニタリングに重要な役割を持つとしている。
pmid-6318540.summary_en: This report describes CT findings in four patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors, typically young men. Imaging showed large anterior mediastinal masses that obliterated fat planes and extended along the left mediastinal border. Nonseminomatous tumors contained near-water-density areas consistent with cysts or necrosis, alongside soft-tissue components. The authors state that CT is valuable for assessing disease extent and monitoring response to therapy, although histologic confirmation is still needed.

pmid-6318631.summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞癌で血清hCGが高値の40例を対象に、初回化学療法後のhCG低下の程度と予後の関係を検討した。第22日のhCG比が1/200を超える場合は不完全奏効を高い感度で予測でき、40例中37例で長期転帰を正しく予測した。
pmid-6318631.summary_en: This 1984 study followed 40 consecutive patients with advanced germ-cell carcinoma and elevated serum hCG to test whether hCG decline after initial chemotherapy predicts outcome. If hCG remained elevated after the first cycle and the day-22 to day-1 ratio exceeded 1/200, an incomplete response was predicted with 90% sensitivity and 94% predictive value. A normal day-22 level or a ratio below 1/200 predicted success, with 95% sensitivity. Overall, long-term response was correctly predicted in 37 of 40 patients.

pmid-6318876.summary_ja: 1958～1978年に妊娠性絨毛性疾患で化学療法を受けた生存者445例の妊娠・出産転帰を検討した。多剤併用例で生児出産率が低い一方、先天異常の有意な増加は認めなかった。多くの女性で妊孕性は保たれたと結論している。
pmid-6318876.summary_en: This 1984 study examined obstetric outcomes in 445 long-term survivors treated with chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic tumours between 1958 and 1978. Of women wishing to conceive, 97% became pregnant and 86% had at least one live birth. All had received methotrexate. Women given three or more drugs had fewer live births than those given methotrexate alone or with one other drug. No significant excess of congenital malformations was found. The authors concluded that these regimens generally preserve fertility.

pmid-6318949.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の診断・治療直後に急性リンパ芽球性白血病を発症した症例を報告している。切除腫瘍内にリンパ芽球様の単核細胞が認められたことから、白血病は縦隔腫瘍由来の可能性があると考察している。
pmid-6318949.summary_en: This 1984 case report describes acute lymphoblastic leukemia that developed shortly after a mediastinal germ cell tumor was diagnosed and treated. The close timing of the two rare diseases, together with lymphoblast-like mononuclear cells in the resected tumor, suggested that the leukemia arose from the mediastinal tumor. The report raises the possibility of a shared or transformed origin between a germ cell tumor and a hematologic malignancy.

pmid-6318983.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎を遺伝学的にホモ接合性とヘテロ接合性に分けて続発症の頻度を比較した。ヘテロ接合性奇胎の5例中3例で続発性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を認めた一方、ホモ接合性では認めなかった。ヘテロ接合性奇胎の方が悪性化の危険が高いと結論している。
pmid-6318983.summary_en: This 1984 study compared postmolar sequelae in homozygous and heterozygous complete hydatidiform moles, using chromosomal heteromorphisms and HLA and phosphoglucomutase 1 polymorphisms. Androgenetic origin was confirmed in 49 of 56 cases. Three of five heterozygous moles developed postmolar trophoblastic disease, while none of 21 homozygous moles did, except one with degenerating residual trophoblasts. All four destructive moles were dispermic. The authors conclude that heterozygous complete moles have higher malignant potential.

pmid-6319246.summary_ja: 正期妊娠後の絨毛癌15例を検討し、診断時の転移は87%に認めた。肝・脳転移が多く、転移例の61.5%が完全寛解に至った。分娩から診断までが4か月未満では寛解率が高く、精査と初回多剤併用化学療法を推奨している。
pmid-6319246.summary_en: This 1984 study reviewed 15 patients with choriocarcinoma after term gestation among 366 patients with persistent gestational trophoblastic disease at the New England Trophoblastic Disease Center. Metastases were present in 87% at diagnosis, often involving the liver and brain. Complete remission occurred in 61.5% of metastatic cases. Remission was achieved in 87.5% when diagnosis occurred less than four months after delivery. Authors recommend meticulous metastatic evaluation and primary combination chemotherapy.

pmid-6319723.summary_ja: 前縦隔に発生した胚細胞腫瘍の1症例を報告し、関連する文献をレビューしている。抄録には組織型、治療、転帰の詳細は示されていない。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に関する症例報告である。
pmid-6319723.summary_en: This 1984 report describes a patient with a germ cell tumor of the anterior mediastinum. The authors also review the relevant medical literature on mediastinal germ cell tumors. The short abstract provides no detail on histology, treatment, or outcome. The paper is a case report with literature review focused on this tumor location.

pmid-6320076.summary_ja: 1969～1979年に1,648例中22例(1.33%)で反復性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を認めた。2回目の発症後の再発リスクは28%に上昇したが、44%は生児を得た。前回の化学療法は後続妊娠の転帰に影響しなかった。
pmid-6320076.summary_en: This 1984 study reviewed 22 of 1,648 patients with repeat gestational trophoblastic disease treated at a trophoblastic disease center from 1969 to 1979, an incidence of 1.33%. Invasive mole or choriocarcinoma was the first event in only three patients. After a second episode, the risk of a further event rose to 28%. Still, 44% of these patients delivered viable infants. Previous chemotherapy did not affect the outcome of later pregnancies.

pmid-6321194.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜再発に対する二期目手術22例を検討した。根治切除に成功したのは7例で、9例は緩和手術にとどまった。組織学的には、悪性腫瘍の残存9例、成熟奇形腫5例であり、病理所見が若年患者の治療方針を左右すると述べている。
pmid-6321194.summary_en: This 1984 study reviewed 22 second-look operations for retroperitoneal relapse of testicular germ cell tumors after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, most following cytostatic therapy. Six patients had inoperable disease from false-positive findings. Seven had successful radical resection, and nine had only palliative surgery. Histology showed viable malignancy in nine cases and mature teratomas in five. The authors emphasize that pathological findings are decisive for younger patients.

pmid-6321359.summary_ja: ヒトT細胞白血病ウイルスp19に対するモノクローナル抗体を、胎盤・絨毛性疾患の組織で免疫染色した。初期胎盤、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌の合胞体栄養膜細胞が染色され、正常組織では陰性であった。培養絨毛癌細胞では分子量28,000の単一ポリペプチドを検出した。
pmid-6321359.summary_en: This 1984 study tested a monoclonal antibody against human T-cell leukemia virus p19 on placental and tumor tissues. The antibody stained syncytiotrophoblasts in early placentas, hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinoma, but not in normal embryonal or adult tissues. In immunoblots of cultured choriocarcinoma cells, it detected a single 28,000 polypeptide. The findings identify a trophoblast-associated antigen in choriocarcinoma and placental tissues.

pmid-6321615.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎除去後の完全除去確認と絨毛性疾患の診断に子宮鏡検査が有用かを検討した1984年の報告。除去後早期の検査で奇胎遺残や壊死脱落膜が15例に認められ、6例で再搔爬が必要だった。侵入奇胎2例の診断にも役立ち、子宮鏡所見から悪性続発症の管理における有用性が示された。
pmid-6321615.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese study evaluated hysteroscopy in 21 patients after hydatidiform mole evacuation to confirm complete removal of trophoblastic tissue. Residual mole or necrotic decidua was found in 15 early examinations, and re-curettage was required in six cases. Hysteroscopy also helped diagnose invasive mole in two patients. Among 27 suspected trophoblastic disease cases, four characteristic findings were identified. Nine of 21 patients with choriocarcinoma, invasive mole or persistent disease showed one or two suggestive findings. The authors conclude hysteroscopy is useful for confirming evacuation and managing malignant sequelae.

pmid-6321616.summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍患者の免疫能を治療経過に沿って検討した1984年の報告。胞状奇胎では除去後に細胞性免疫が亢進し、侵入奇胎では液性抑制因子が治療とともに上昇した。絨毛癌では細胞性免疫が一旦低下したものの完全には消失せず、特異的免疫療法の検討を示唆している。
pmid-6321616.summary_en: This study tracked cellular and humoral immune function in patients with trophoblastic tumors over their clinical course. Hydatidiform mole showed accelerated cellular immunity after molar delivery and rising humoral suppressive factors. Invasive mole showed no significant cellular change but increasing suppressive factors that peaked around day 60. In choriocarcinoma, cellular immunity initially accelerated, then declined between days 60 and 90, while humoral suppression peaked near day 120. The authors suggest cellular immunity persisted, supporting consideration of specific immunotherapy for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6321856.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の細胞表面糖鎖を、レクチンと抗体を用いて組織化学的に比較した1984年の報告。卵黄嚢腫瘍は特定のレクチンと抗I-(Ma)抗体に一貫して陽性、セミノーマや絨毛癌はほぼ陰性であった。胎児性癌は組織構築により染色性が異なり、未熟奇形腫では分化の方向に依存した。糖鎖の変化が胚細胞腫瘍の分類に役立つ可能性が示された。
pmid-6321856.summary_en: This 1984 study examined cell surface carbohydrate chains in human germ cell tumors using four lectins and an anti-I-(Ma) antibody. Embryonal carcinomas showed staining that varied with architecture. Yolk sac tumors consistently reacted with peanut and U. europaeus agglutinins and anti-I-(Ma), while most seminomas and choriocarcinomas were negative. Immature teratomas showed patterns dependent on the direction and maturity of differentiation. The authors suggest glycan changes during differentiation may help classify germ cell tumors, though their biologic role remains unclear.

pmid-6322588.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍205例を対象に、組織切片のキナクリン染色でY・X染色体クロマチンを判定した1984年の後方視的研究。Yクロマチン陽性率は胞状奇胎9%、侵入奇胎50%、絨毛癌74%だった。悪性例での高い陽性率から、劣性変異癌遺伝子のホモ接合性は絨毛癌の発症に重要でないと考察している。
pmid-6322588.summary_en: This retrospective study assessed sex chromosome status in 205 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia cases using quinacrine staining of tissue sections for Y and X chromatin. Y-chromatin positivity occurred in 9% of hydatidiform moles, 50% of invasive moles (2 of 4), and 74% of choriocarcinomas. The high Y-chromatin rate in malignant cases suggests that homozygosity for a recessive oncogene is not an important factor in choriocarcinoma pathogenesis. The authors favor a partial allograft mechanism after nonmolar pregnancies with diminished host immunity.

pmid-6325316.summary_ja: 絨毛癌が完全胞状奇胎から生じるかを、染色体・HLA・PGM1多型により検討した。完全奇胎は雄核発生で、父親由来の完全なホモ接合性を示す。一方、絨毛癌細胞はヘテロ接合性を示し、単一精子による空卵受精由来の奇胎から発生したとは考えにくいと結論している。
pmid-6325316.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese study investigates whether choriocarcinoma arises from complete hydatidiform mole. Chromosomal, HLA and PGM1 polymorphism analyses show that complete moles are androgenetic, with paternally derived, homozygous genomes. Choriocarcinoma cells, however, display heterozygosity, indicating they did not originate from moles formed by fertilization of an empty egg by a single haploid sperm. The authors conclude that this mechanism is unlikely to be the origin of choriocarcinoma, a finding relevant to the genesis of trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-6325758.summary_ja: 小細胞肺癌と精巣セミノーマからの髄内脊髄転移の剖検2例を報告し、文献的考察を加えた。この稀な転移様式の原発巣としては肺癌よりセミノーマが最も多いとされる。動脈系および椎骨静脈系を介した血行性転移が推定されている。精巣腫瘍の稀な転移部位として注目される。
pmid-6325758.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese report presents two autopsy cases of intramedullary spinal cord metastasis, one from small cell lung cancer and one from testicular seminoma. The authors review the literature and note that seminoma, rather than lung cancer, is the most common primary tumor of this rare metastatic pattern. In their case they propose hematogenous spread via arterial and vertebral venous systems. The paper highlights spinal cord involvement as a rare site of metastasis from germ cell tumor.

pmid-6325794.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎1例と絨毛癌2例の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者で循環免疫複合体を解析した。寛解期にhCGの低下と並行して複合体が上昇した。胞状奇胎症例の複合体からは父親由来HLA抗原(AW32)に反応する物質が検出され、他の2例でも同様の父親HLA特異的な抑制が認められた。父親由来HLA抗原への免疫認識が治療反応に寄与する可能性がある。
pmid-6325794.summary_en: This 1984 JNCI study characterizes circulating immune complexes in three patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, including one hydatidiform mole and two choriocarcinoma cases. PEG-precipitable complexes rose as hCG fell during remission. Fractionation of one molar patient's complexes revealed material immunoreactive to a paternal HLA antigen (AW32), not maternal antigens, and similar paternal HLA-specific inhibition was seen in two patients. The authors suggest that immune recognition of paternal HLA antigens may contribute to therapeutic response in trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-6326253.summary_ja: 進行性悪性胚細胞腫瘍の男性29例に対しシスプラチン基盤化学療法後に行った手術33件を報告。26例で肉眼的完全切除が得られた。線維化・壊死や成熟奇形腫は予後良好で、生存腫瘍が残存した11例中5例のみが生存した。術前のAFP・β-hCG・LDH高値は残存腫瘍を示唆し、二次・三次治療の放射線療法で14例中8例が腫瘍消失した。
pmid-6326253.summary_en: This 1984 report describes 33 surgical procedures in 29 men with advanced malignant germ cell tumours treated after cisplatin-based chemotherapy with vinblastine and bleomycin. Complete macroscopic resection was achieved in 26 patients. Histology showed fibrosis/necrosis, mature teratoma, or viable malignancy, with fibrosis or mature teratoma carrying an excellent prognosis. Elevated preoperative AFP, beta-hCG, or LDH indicated residual viable tumour. Radiotherapy as second- or third-line treatment rendered 8 of 14 patients tumour-free. Residual masses should be resected as completely as possible.

pmid-6328963.summary_ja: 精巣異常を有する男性133例を解析し、受診遅延と治療経過を検討した。症状出現後1か月以内に精巣摘除術を受けた症例は52例で、41例は受診が遅れ、40例は当初ほかの疾患として治療されていた。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍89例のうち20例が死亡し、その16例では診断が遅れていた。迅速な診断・治療により死亡率は10%未満に抑えられると結論している。
pmid-6328963.summary_en: This 1984 American Family Physician article reviews 133 men with testicular abnormalities, examining delays in seeking care and treatment.
