pmid-6542580.summary_ja: ヒト妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株GCH-1を漸増濃度のメトトレキサートで培養し、耐性亜株(GCH-1:R1、GCH-1:RII)を樹立した。耐性株ではIC50が上昇し、薬剤取り込みが低下していた。形態には変化がなく、DNAヒストグラムの第二ピークも不明瞭になっていた。耐性は薬剤担体への親和性低下に起因すると示唆され、臨床上も重要な知見である。
pmid-6542580.summary_en: The authors developed two methotrexate-resistant sublines (GCH-1:R1 and GCH-1:RII) from a human gestational choriocarcinoma cell line by stepwise exposure to increasing methotrexate concentrations. The resistant lines showed markedly higher IC50 values, reduced methotrexate uptake, and altered DNA histograms, with no morphologic change. The findings suggest that resistance arises from weakened affinity of the drug for its carrier, which is a mechanism of clinical relevance for gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6542932.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株10種のメトトレキサート感受性を検討し、最も感受性の高いHCCM-5から耐性亜株HCCM-5Rを約80週間かけて樹立した。HCCM-5Rは薬剤取り込みが10分の1に低下し、細胞内DHFR活性は約5倍に上昇していた。耐性はMTXの輸送低下とDHFR増加の両方に起因すると考察されている。
pmid-6542932.summary_en: Ten human choriocarcinoma cell lines were screened for methotrexate sensitivity, and the most sensitive line, HCCM-5, was selected for stepwise adaptation over about 80 weeks. The resistant subline HCCM-5R showed roughly 10,000-fold higher IC50 for DNA synthesis, reduced methotrexate uptake, lost Y chromosome, and elevated dihydrofolate reductase activity. Resistance appears to reflect both reduced drug transport and increased intracellular DHFR, selected by prolonged drug exposure.

pmid-6543231.summary_ja: 64歳男性の胃癌症例で、腺癌の一部に絨毛癌成分を認めた。免疫組織染色によりhCGの局在を証明し、術後血清hCGの上昇と女性化乳房を伴っていた。精巣異常は臨床的に認められなかった。胃癌に絨毛癌への分化を伴う稀な報告で、腫瘍マーカーとしてのhCGの意義を示す。
pmid-6543231.summary_en: This 1984 Japanese case report describes a 64-year-old man with gastric adenocarcinoma containing a component of choriocarcinoma. Immunoperoxidase staining confirmed hCG localization within the choriocarcinomatous areas. The patient developed gynecomastia, and postoperative serum hCG was elevated, while clinical testicular abnormality was absent. The report highlights hCG-producing choriocarcinomatous differentiation within a non-germ-cell gastric carcinoma, a rare finding relevant to hCG as a tumor marker.

pmid-6543517.summary_ja: 1984年の英国における総説では、白金製剤による化学療法で治療された進行転移性セミノーマの21例を検討し、81%が長期無病生存を達成したと報告している。これは1960〜1977年の放射線療法（56%）および1960年以前（29%）と比較された。著者らは、病期分類と分類の変更が比較を交絡しうると指摘している。セミノーマは奇形腫より化学感受性が高く見え、シスプラチン単剤でも高い生存率が示された。また、Stage 1セミノーマのサーベイランス研究を開始し、11例中10例が中央値11か月で再発していなかった。
pmid-6543517.summary_en: A 1984 British review of 21 patients with advanced metastatic seminoma treated with platinum-based chemotherapy found 81% long-term disease-free survival, compared with 56% after radiotherapy in 1960-1977 and 29% before 1960. The authors caution that changes in staging and classification confound these comparisons. Seminoma appeared more chemosensitive than malignant teratoma, with cisplatin monotherapy showing high survival. They also began a surveillance study of Stage 1 seminoma, with 10 of 11 patients relapse-free at median 11 months.

pmid-6588218.summary_ja: マウス子宮角に原発した純粋卵黄嚢癌の8例を、病理所見、転移、移植実験を含めて報告した。腫瘍は子宮内膜間質を置換し、経過とともに内膜腺を破壊した。治療内容と発生との関連は認められなかった。未産マウスでの発生は単為生殖の関与が示唆された。一部のマウスでは子宮外への転移も認められた。
pmid-6588218.summary_en: This 1984 JNCI report describes eight cases of pure yolk sac carcinoma arising primarily in the uterine horn of mice. The tumors replaced endometrial stroma and destroyed original glands over time, with secondary deposits in some mice. Treatment could not be correlated with tumor development, and several nulliparous mice suggested possible parthenogenesis. Tumor transplantation into recipient mice was also studied, with histology confirming the neoplastic yolk cell morphology.

pmid-6592922.summary_ja: 後腹膜腫瘤に対する穿刺吸引細胞診で、原発性後腹膜セミノーマと診断した症例報告である。臨床的にはリンパ腫や膵癌が鑑別に挙がった。細胞像は円形核と明瞭な核小体を持つ均一な悪性細胞で、淡明または淡染性の細胞質を示し、単独または小集団で出現した。
pmid-6592922.summary_en: This 1984 case report describes primary retroperitoneal seminoma diagnosed by fine needle aspiration cytology of a retroperitoneal mass. Lymphoma and pancreatic adenocarcinoma were initially considered clinically. Cytology showed uniform malignant cells with round nuclei and nucleoli, clear or pale cytoplasm, and arrangement singly or in small groups, with intermingled lymphocytes. The cytologic appearance was consistent with seminoma, showing that FNA can establish the diagnosis of an extragonadal germ cell tumor when the differential diagnosis is broad.

pmid-6690749.summary_ja: 純粋精巣セミノーマ55例で、精巣摘除術後・放射線療法前のβ-hCG高値が予後に影響するかを検討した。病期Iの44例と病期IIAの11例で、それぞれ42%と36%がβ-hCG高値であった。12〜64か月の追跡で54例(98%)が無病生存していた。術後のhCG高値は有意な予後因子ではなく、標準的な放射線療法を行うべきと結論している。
pmid-6690749.summary_en: This review of 55 patients with pure testicular seminoma assessed whether elevated beta-hCG after orchiectomy and before radiotherapy affects prognosis. Of 44 stage I and 11 stage IIA patients, 42% and 36% respectively had elevated levels. With follow-up of 12 to 64 months, 54 patients (98%) remained disease-free. The authors concluded that elevated post-orchiectomy gonadotropin is not a significant prognostic marker, and that such patients should receive standard radiotherapy. Elevated hCG alone should therefore not change seminoma treatment.

pmid-6691202.summary_ja: 70代男性に発生した純粋な精巣胎児性癌の稀な症例を報告した。著者らは、この年齢層で長期生存が報告された唯一の症例としている。60歳以上の男性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関する文献レビューも含む。高齢者にも発症し、長期生存が可能であることを示す。臨床医にとって、非典型的な胚細胞腫瘍の提示として参考になる。
pmid-6691202.summary_en: A rare case of pure embryonal carcinoma of the testis in a man in his seventh decade is reported. The authors describe it as the only reported long-term survivor of testicular embryonal carcinoma in men of this age. The report includes a review of the literature on germ cell testicular tumors in men aged 60 years and older. The case is an unusual presentation of a germ cell tumor, and the review places it in clinical context. The paper shows that older men can develop this aggressive tumor and that long-term survival is possible.

pmid-6693207.summary_ja: 新生児に発生した心膜内奇形腫の2例を報告した。1例目は嚢胞性で分化の良い腫瘍で、完全切除後10か月無病であった。2例目は未熟組織を含む充実性腫瘍で、切除の2か月後に胸膜と心膜へ浸潤して再発し、再手術後9日で死亡した。未熟な神経上皮の存在は予後不良因子であり、このような症例には放射線療法または化学療法が推奨されるとしている。
pmid-6693207.summary_en: Two cases of intrapericardial teratoma in newborns are reported. The first was a cystic, well-differentiated tumor that was totally excised, and the child remained well at 10 months. The second was predominantly solid, with mature and immature tissue, and recurred two months after resection with pleural and pericardial invasion. The patient died nine days after reoperation. The authors consider the second case the first malignant intrapericardial teratoma in a neonate. Immature neuroepithelium is associated with poor prognosis, as in ovarian and sacrococcygeal teratomas, and the authors recommend radiotherapy or chemotherapy in such cases.

pmid-6694356.summary_ja: Tera-2奇形癌細胞株の異種移植腫瘍から単一細胞由来のクローンを樹立し、胎児性癌としての特徴を解析した。高密度培養では典型的な胎児性癌の形態とSSEA-3発現を示し、低密度では形態と抗原発現が変化した。ヌードマウス移植後の腫瘍では腺構造や神経組織への分化が認められた。多系統への分化能を保持するヒト胎児性癌クローンの初の例で、胚細胞腫瘍の研究モデルとして重要である。
pmid-6694356.summary_en: This 1984 study derived single-cell clones from a Tera-2 teratocarcinoma xenograft and characterized their embryonal carcinoma features in culture and after transplantation into athymic mice. At high cell density, clones showed typical embryonal carcinoma morphology and SSEA-3 expression, while at low density their morphology and antigen expression changed. Tumors formed in nude mice differentiated into glandular and neural tissues. These clones were the first clonal human embryonal carcinoma lines reported to retain the capacity for multilineage somatic differentiation, making them valuable models for germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-6694862.summary_ja: 良性の胸腔内奇形腫が喀血を初発症状として呈した症例を報告した。出血は胸膜癒着に伴う全身-肺動脈短絡によると考えられ、癒着の原因は感染や外傷が考えられた。腫瘍は外科的に切除された。胸腔内奇形腫の初発症状としての喀血は稀だが、癒着による異常な血管短絡が出血を来しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-6694862.summary_en: This report describes a benign intrathoracic teratoma that presented with hemoptysis. The bleeding was attributed to systemic-to-pulmonary artery shunting, likely caused in part by extensive pleural adhesions whose origin was not determined, with previous infection or trauma considered possible. The tumor was successfully removed surgically. The case shows that although hemoptysis is rare as a presenting symptom of intrathoracic teratoma, it can arise from abnormal vascular shunting secondary to adhesions, and it emphasizes the importance of considering this mechanism in patients with unexplained bleeding.

pmid-6695484.summary_ja: 24歳男性の精巣セミノーマ症例で、初回は鼠径部からの精巣摘除術と後腹膜病変への放射線療法を受けた。その後、非常に稀な部位である右甲状腺葉に再発を来した。シクロホスファミド、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンによる併用化学療法で完全寛解を得た。胚細胞腫瘍の甲状腺転移は極めて稀であることを示した報告である。
pmid-6695484.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with testicular seminoma who was initially treated with inguinal orchiectomy and radiation therapy for retroperitoneal disease. He later had an unusual recurrence in the right lobe of the thyroid gland, a rare site for isolated recurrence of germ cell tumors. He achieved complete remission after combination chemotherapy with cyclophosphamide, vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin. The authors emphasize how rarely germ cell tumors and other metastatic tumors involve the thyroid, making this case clinically notable for management and follow-up of advanced seminoma.

pmid-6697290.summary_ja: 1970年から1979年にロズウェルパーク研究所で放射線療法を初回治療として受けたセミノーマ56例を後方視的に解析した。平均52か月の追跡で全生存率は82%だったが、大きな腹部または横隔膜上転移を有する症例では33%にとどまった。治療失敗の要因を分析し、進行セミノーマの初回治療として併用化学療法を検討すべきだと論じている。
pmid-6697290.summary_en: This retrospective study from Roswell Park Memorial Institute analyzed 56 evaluable patients with seminoma who were treated initially with radiation therapy between 1970 and 1979. The overall survival rate was 82% at an average follow-up of 52 months, but patients with bulky abdominal or supradiaphragmatic metastases had only a 33% survival rate. The authors analyzed the causes of treatment failure and discussed the implications for future management. They conclude that combination chemotherapy should be considered as initial treatment for advanced seminoma, given the poor outcome of radiation alone in patients with bulky metastatic disease.

pmid-6698049.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）に悪性転化を認めた5例を報告し、特に稀な2例に注目した。1例は扁平上皮化生を伴う円柱上皮由来と考えられる腺扁平上皮癌、もう1例は偶発的に2つの腫瘍が生じた可能性のある明細胞癌であった。卵巣類皮嚢腫の悪性転化の多様性と診断上の課題を示している。
pmid-6698049.summary_en: This report presents five cases of malignant change arising in ovarian dermoid cysts, which are mature cystic teratomas, with particular attention to two unusual carcinomas. One was an adenosquamous cell carcinoma, apparently arising from columnar epithelium and its squamous metaplasia. The other was a clear cell carcinoma, which may have represented the coincidental development of two separate tumors. The findings illustrate the diversity of malignant transformation in ovarian dermoid cysts, a recognized germ cell tumor entity, and the diagnostic challenges these lesions present to pathologists and clinicians.

pmid-6698081.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がん53例に対する片側後腹膜リンパ節郭清の成績を報告した。36%に病理学的な病期IIで後腹膜リンパ節転移が認められた。術後に腫瘍活性を認めた3例は救援化学療法で治癒した。片側郭清後の多くで射精機能が保たれ、7例が父親となったことから妊孕性温存に有用とされた。
pmid-6698081.summary_en: This 1984 European Urology study evaluated unilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RLND) in 53 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer. Nineteen patients (36%) had retroperitoneal lymph node metastases at pathological stage II. Patients without tumor found at surgery underwent unilateral dissection, and postoperative tumor activity in three patients was cured with salvage chemotherapy. Most unilaterally operated patients had preserved ejaculatory function, and seven patients fathered children. The authors conclude that unilateral RLND is a sufficient diagnostic procedure in tumor-free patients and that it preserves fertility in most cases.

pmid-6699220.summary_ja: 皮下に大きな卵巣奇形癌を移植したマウスは、シクロヘキシミドを大量投与すると死亡したが、エーリッヒ腫瘍を有するマウスは耐性を示した。十分量のヘパリン投与により奇形腫担癌マウスは救命された。著者らは、シクロヘキシミドが内因性ヘパリンの放出を妨げ、増殖する奇形癌に対する宿主応答を阻害すると考察している。胚細胞腫瘍の動物モデルにおける宿主と腫瘍の相互作用を扱う研究である。
pmid-6699220.summary_en: Mice bearing large subcutaneous ovarian teratocarcinoma died when given large doses of cycloheximide, whereas mice with Ehrlich tumors survived. Adequate heparin treatment rescued the teratoma-bearing mice. The authors propose that cycloheximide impairs the release of endogenous heparin, which is an essential part of the host response to a growing teratocarcinoma. This animal study explores host-tumor interactions in a germ cell tumor model.

pmid-6699970.summary_ja: 精巣の胎児性癌に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清術および放射線療法を受けた患者が、術後5週で乳糜腹水と乳糜胸を発症した。両者の併発は稀で、報告例としては2例目である。中鎖脂肪酸トリグリセリドと経腸栄養剤を用いた食事療法に、胸水穿刺および腹水穿刺を組み合わせて治療し、良好な経過をたどった。精巣腫瘍の治療に伴う稀な合併症を示した症例報告である。
pmid-6699970.summary_en: A patient developed chyloperitoneum and chylothorax five weeks after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy and radiotherapy for embryonal carcinoma of the testis. This is reported as only the second case of this rare combined complication. The patient was managed successfully with an alimentary dietary regimen using medium-chain triglycerides and an elemental formula, together with repeated thoracentesis and paracentesis. The case highlights a rare postoperative and post-radiation complication in testicular tumor management.

pmid-6699988.summary_ja: 精巣の臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で鼠径部精巣摘除術を受けた31例を、術後に経過観察のみで追跡した。84%が無病で経過し、16%が術後2〜6か月で再発した。再発例はすべて併用化学療法で寛解に至った。明らかな所属リンパ節や臓器転移のない症例では、慎重な経過観察で十分と考えられ、即時治療の代替となり得ることを示唆している。
pmid-6699988.summary_en: Thirty-one men with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors after inguinal orchiectomy were followed without adjuvant therapy. Most patients, 84%, remained disease-free. Relapse occurred in 16% at 2 to 6 months, and all relapsing patients achieved remission with combination chemotherapy. The authors suggest that careful surveillance is sufficient for patients without obvious regional or visceral metastases, supporting surveillance as an alternative to immediate treatment.

pmid-6699989.summary_ja: 予後不良の特徴を有する非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍14例に対し、減量化学療法、手術、直後の再導入化学療法を施行した。中央値18か月の追跡で14例中12例が無病生存中であった。著者らは、この新たな治療戦略により予後不良例の治療成績が有意に改善したと報告している。
pmid-6699989.summary_en: Fourteen patients with nonseminomatous testicular tumors and poor-prognosis features were treated with cytoreductive chemotherapy, surgery, and immediate reinduction chemotherapy. Twelve of the 14 were alive without evidence of disease at a median follow-up of 18 months. The authors report that this sequential strategy markedly improved outcomes in this high-risk group compared with previous results.

pmid-6699990.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の鼠径リンパ節転移を有する22例を解析した。多くは以前に陰嚢部または鼠径部の手術歴を有していた。組織型は純粋セミノーマ、胎児性癌、混合型であり、治療は組織型や発症形式に応じて個別に行われた。追跡の結果、36%が無病生存、45%が転移により死亡していた。著者らは、陰嚢や鼠径部の手術歴があっても、全体として鼠径部転移の発生率は低いと結論している。
pmid-6699990.summary_en: Twenty-two patients had inguinal lymph node metastases from testicular germ cell tumors, most often after prior scrotal or inguinal surgery. Histology included pure seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and mixed tumors. Treatment was individualized by tumor type and mode of presentation. At follow-up, 36% were alive without disease, while 45% had died of metastases. The authors conclude that groin metastases are uncommon overall, even with a history of scrotal or inguinal surgery.

pmid-6702026.summary_ja: 炎症性および腫瘍性の陰嚢疾患36例を超音波検査で評価した。多くの病変は超音波で鑑別可能であった。精巣由来と精巣外病変の区別は高い精度で可能であり、一部では精巣腫瘍を悪性腫瘍から鑑別できた。ただし確定診断には外科的介入が必要な場合が多いと著者らは指摘している。本研究は陰嚢超音波検査の有用性を示している。
pmid-6702026.summary_en: Thirty-six intrascrotal lesions, both inflammatory and neoplastic, were evaluated by ultrasonography. The study found that sonography can distinguish many of these conditions. It separated testicular from extratesticular pathology with high accuracy, and in some cases it could differentiate testicular neoplasm from malignancy. The authors note that surgical intervention is often still required for definitive diagnosis.

pmid-6702938.summary_ja: 1962年から1981年の間に、正期妊娠後に発症した絨毛癌51例を栄養膜疾患専門施設で治療した。全体の寛解率は61%で、胞状奇胎、流産、子宮外妊娠後の絨毛癌の87%より低かった。治療開始の遅れ、異常子宮出血以外の症状での発症、肺・膣以外への転移は不良な治療反応と関連した。著者らは、高リスク因子がない限り初回多剤化学療法の利点は明らかでないと結論している。
pmid-6702938.summary_en: Fifty-one patients with choriocarcinoma after term pregnancy were treated at a trophoblastic disease center between 1962 and 1981. The overall remission rate was 61%, lower than the 87% seen after molar pregnancy, abortion, or ectopic pregnancy. Delayed treatment, presentation without abnormal uterine bleeding, and metastases beyond the lung or vagina predicted poorer response. The authors concluded that initial multiagent chemotherapy is not clearly beneficial unless high-risk features are present.

pmid-6703205.summary_ja: 1984年の報告で、小児・思春期の卵巣腫瘍63例を検討した。56例が胚細胞腫瘍で、多くは成熟奇形腫だった。主症状は腹痛と腹部腫瘤で、腹部単純X線での石灰化は良性奇形腫を示唆した。悪性13例中8例は4年半から17年にわたり無病生存しており、小児卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の多くで長期予後が良好であることを示している。
pmid-6703205.summary_en: This 1984 series reviewed 63 children and adolescents with ovarian tumors, 56 of whom had germ cell tumors, most commonly mature teratomas. Abdominal pain and an abdominal mass were the main presentations, and calcification on abdominal films suggested benign teratoma. The contralateral ovary was biopsied in 31 patients with benign tumors. Of 13 malignant cases, eight remained disease-free for 4.5 to 17 years, while four died. The study illustrates the favorable long-term prognosis of most pediatric ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-6705308.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の疫学をレビューした総説である。完全胞状奇胎は欠陥のある卵子から生じるとの証拠が示され、母体年齢による危険性の上昇、複数回の再発、家族集積、母体由来遺伝子の欠如、二精子受精などがその根拠とされる。近親婚、栄養失調、遺伝的素因、経口避妊薬、ウイルス感染、排卵障害などが寄与因子として提唱され、症例対照研究で検証が進められていた。
pmid-6705308.summary_en: This paper reviews the epidemiology of hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma, two forms of gestational trophoblastic disease. Evidence suggests that complete moles arise from a defective ovum, supported by maternal age risk, recurrence in women including with different partners, familial clustering, absence of maternal genetic material, and dispermic fertilization. Proposed contributors include consanguinity, malnutrition, genetic predisposition, oral contraceptives and viral infection. Ovulatory disorders may produce suboptimal ova. The authors note that case-control studies were ongoing to test these hypotheses.

pmid-6708114.summary_ja: 1984年の論文で、精巣がん治療を受けた男性の性的・婚姻上の問題を扱う。化学療法、放射線療法、手術により生存率は向上したが、不妊や性機能障害を伴うことが多い。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の男性の調査では、性行為の低頻度20%、勃起障害10%、オルガズム困難6%、快感低下38%が報告された。著者らは治療に伴う性的不安が主因で、性的・婚姻カウンセリングの必要性を論じている。
pmid-6708114.summary_en: This 1984 study addresses the sexual and marital difficulties faced by men treated for testicular cancer. Chemotherapy, radiotherapy and surgery improved survival but often caused infertility and sexual dysfunction. A survey of men treated for nonseminomatous tumors found low sexual activity in 20%, erectile dysfunction in 10%, orgasmic difficulty in 6%, and decreased orgasmic pleasure in 38%. The authors attribute much of this to treatment-related sexual anxiety, with possible organic contributors, and offer counseling suggestions for couples.

pmid-6708198.summary_ja: 1984年の細胞遺伝学的研究で、精巣の悪性奇形腫を解析した。腫瘍は低三倍数性の核型を示し、等長染色体i(12p)が唯一の構造異常であった。多くの細胞で12番染色体短腕の遺伝物質が7コピー存在し、他の染色体の2～3コピーより増幅していた。i(12p)が精巣悪性腫瘍に特異的な異常であるとする先行報告を支持する。
pmid-6708198.summary_en: This 1984 cytogenetic study analyzed a malignant teratoma of the testis. The tumor had a hypotriploid karyotype in which the isochromosome i(12p) was the only structural abnormality. Most cells carried three copies of chromosome 12 and two copies of i(12p), so the short-arm material was present in seven copies versus two to three for other chromosomes. The findings support earlier reports that i(12p) is a specific chromosomal abnormality in malignant testicular tumors, highlighting its diagnostic relevance in germ cell tumors.

pmid-6709283.summary_ja: 1984年の症例報告で、眼窩に浸潤したセミノーマの2例目を報告する。精巣がんは若年男性で最も多い悪性腫瘍で、ホルモン作用による眼球突出を起こすことがあるが、実際の眼窩浸潤は過去に1例のみであった。後腹膜を超えて進展した場合は化学療法が通常推奨される。全身化学療法の前に眼窩の転移巣を生検することが、侵襲の最も少ない確認法となりうると著者らは示唆している。
pmid-6709283.summary_en: This 1984 report describes a second documented case of seminoma invading the orbit. Testicular cancer, the most common malignancy in young men, can cause exophthalmos through hormonal effects, but true orbital invasion had been reported only once before. When disease extends beyond the retroperitoneum, chemotherapy is usually recommended. The authors suggest that orbital biopsy may be the least morbid way to confirm tumor status before systemic chemotherapy.

pmid-6710272.summary_ja: 1984年の南アフリカからの臨床研究で、過去10年間の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍15例を解析した。悪性卵巣腫瘍の6.4%に相当し、ディスジャーミノーマが60%で最多であった。治療は一般に手術と放射線療法で、非ディスジャーミノーマには化学療法を追加した。生存は病期と組織型に依存し、進行期は組織型にかかわらず予後不良であった。
pmid-6710272.summary_en: This 1984 South African clinical series reviewed 15 ovarian germ cell tumors diagnosed over ten years, representing 6.4% of malignant ovarian tumors referred to the center. Dysgerminoma was most frequent at 60%. Treatment was generally surgery plus radiotherapy for dysgerminoma, with chemotherapy added for non-dysgerminomas. Survival depended on stage and histology, with advanced-stage disease carrying a poor prognosis regardless of histological type. A general review of the topic is also provided.

pmid-6712263.summary_ja: 感受性マウス系統における自然発症卵巣奇形腫の発生機序を検討した研究である。異常卵胞内の単為発生により活性化した卵子が卵巣奇形腫の起源となることを、キメラマウスとβ-グルクロニダーゼ活性を指標とした解析で示した。黄体が単為発生胚の三胚葉分化を促すと考察している。
pmid-6712263.summary_en: This study in mouse strains susceptible to spontaneous ovarian teratocarcinogenesis shows that ovarian teratomas arise from parthenogenetically activated eggs within abnormal follicles, which have high beta-glucuronidase activity in granulosa cells. Using chimeras and hormonally treated ovaries, the authors show that both teratomas and parthenotes originate from susceptible strains. Parthenogenetic blastocysts adhere to follicular tissue and differentiate into three germ layers under the influence of corpora lutea. Teratocarcinogenesis appears to require both susceptible egg genetics and a permissive follicular microenvironment.

pmid-6713388.summary_ja: P. acnes菌株とその化学的分画について、マウス卵巣奇形癌（MOT）モデルに対する抗腫瘍効果を検討した研究である。高用量の菌体投与で担癌マウスの一部が生存し、ピリジン抽出分画PA-PEIIが最も強い効果を示した。過ヨウ素酸酸化で効果が失われたことから糖成分の関与が示唆された。生存マウスの一部は再攻撃された腫瘍を完全に排除した。
pmid-6713388.summary_en: This study tested Propionibacterium acnes strains and their chemically derived fractions for antitumor activity in a murine ovarian teratocarcinoma (MOT) model. High-dose whole bacteria produced survival in a substantial proportion of tumor-bearing mice, and strain PAI was more effective per weight than PAII. The pyridine-extracted PAII cell wall fraction had the strongest effect, with over half of treated mice surviving. Activity was retained in water-soluble fractions and lost after periodate oxidation, implicating carbohydrate components. Some surviving mice fully eradicated a tumor rechallenge.

pmid-6713403.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌に対してレチノイン酸を生体内で投与し、分化を誘導した研究である。多くは良性の嚢胞性奇形腫となったが、一部から移植可能な悪性細胞株が樹立され、軟骨肉腫と神経膠腫・軟骨肉腫混合型と同定された。これらは親の胎児性癌幹細胞株と染色体が異なるが、同株由来であることが示された。
pmid-6713403.summary_en: Murine embryonal carcinoma tumors were treated in vivo with retinoic acid to induce differentiation. Most treated tumors became benign cystic teratomas, but three contained mitotically active solid areas. Two of these produced permanently transplantable cell lines, characterized as a chondrosarcoma and a glioma-chondrosarcoma mixture. Both lines had chromosomal differences from the parent embryonal carcinoma stem cell line, yet were clearly derived from it. The study shows that retinoic acid can drive embryonal carcinoma toward benign differentiation while occasionally giving rise to malignant differentiated neoplasms.

pmid-6714970.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと長年のサルコイドーシスを併発した症例報告である。精巣腫瘍の出現時にサルコイドーシス病変が有意に増悪したが、両疾患の関連は疫学的に乏しく偶然の可能性が高いとされる。その後、非血液系悪性腫瘍に対する化学療法後に好中球減少性腸炎を発症した。
pmid-6714970.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a testicular seminoma who also had longstanding sarcoidosis. The sarcoid lesions markedly increased when the testicular tumor appeared, although epidemiologic data suggest the two diseases are not truly associated. The patient later developed neutropenic enterocolitis after chemotherapy for a separate non-hematologic malignancy, a complication the authors highlight as clinically significant.

pmid-6715923.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌において、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とhPLのmRNAをin situハイブリダイゼーション法で検討した。正常および奇胎では主に合胞体栄養膜細胞に発現していた。絨毛癌ではhPL mRNAは検出されず、栄養膜の分化障害が遺伝子発現の変化と関連することが示された。
pmid-6715923.summary_en: This study used in situ hybridization to localize hPL and hCG alpha and beta mRNAs in normal placenta, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma. In normal and molar tissue, transcripts were mainly in syncytiotrophoblasts, with hCG expression beginning earlier than hPL during differentiation. In choriocarcinoma, hPL mRNA was absent while hCG mRNA persisted in syncytiotrophoblastic cells. The findings suggest that hPL gene expression is lost when trophoblastic differentiation is blocked during tumorigenesis, linking gene expression to trophoblastic differentiation.

pmid-6715935.summary_ja: 1974年から1981年に千葉県で登録された胞状奇胎1,544例を対象に、奇胎後のフォローアップ体制を報告している。週数ごとのhCG値を基準に、絨毛癌や侵入奇胎などの続発症を判定した。中等度の値では自然寛解が多く、過剰治療を約36%回避できたと述べている。
pmid-6715935.summary_en: This report describes a follow-up system for postmolar patients registered in Chiba Prefecture from 1974 to 1981, covering 1,544 hydatidiform mole cases. Patients with hCG titers above defined thresholds at weeks 5, 8, and 12 were classified as having trophoblastic sequelae, including choriocarcinoma and invasive mole. Many patients with intermediate titers showed spontaneous remission. The registry-based approach allowed about 36% of patients to avoid overtreatment, supporting selective management of postmolar hCG follow-up.

pmid-6717022.summary_ja: 1959年から1978年に病期Iの精巣セミノーマ39例に放射線治療を行った後方視的検討である。縦隔や鎖骨上窩への予防的照射は行わず、5年生存率は96%であった。病期I精巣セミノーマでは、縦隔への予防照射に追加の利益はないと結論づけている。
pmid-6717022.summary_en: This retrospective review of 39 patients with Stage I testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy from 1959 to 1978 examined whether prophylactic mediastinal and supraclavicular irradiation is needed. Patients received hockey-stick fields covering ipsilateral inguinal, iliac, and para-aortic nodes, without mediastinal irradiation. The 5-year actuarial survival was 96%. The authors concluded that prophylactic irradiation to the mediastinum and supraclavicular regions gives no additional benefit in Stage I seminoma.

pmid-6719453.summary_ja: 妊娠7週の25歳女性に発生した卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。子宮全摘、左付属器切除、右卵巣部分切除、大網切除を施行した。血清AFPなどを測定し、妊娠に合併する悪性卵巣腫瘍の頻度と治療について考察している。
pmid-6719453.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman at seven weeks of gestation with an ovarian endodermal sinus tumor. She underwent hysterectomy with left salpingo-oophorectomy, right ovarian wedge resection, and omentectomy after dilation and curettage. Histology resembled endodermal sinus tumor as described by Teilum, and imprint cytology showed characteristic cells. Serum alpha-fetoprotein and immunosuppressive acidic protein were measured. The authors review the frequency and management of malignant ovarian tumors in pregnancy.

pmid-6723699.summary_ja: 38歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた扁平上皮癌の症例報告。頻度は約1%とされ、組織検査が不十分だと過小評価される可能性がある。術中迅速凍結切片検査の重要性を強調している。術後6か月時点で患者は生存し健康である。
pmid-6723699.summary_en: A case report of squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian dermoid cyst in a 38-year-old woman. The authors note that such malignant transformation occurs in about 1% of cases and may be underdiagnosed without careful histological examination. They emphasize intraoperative frozen-section examination of cysts. The patient was alive and well six months after surgery.

pmid-6723700.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織からなる稀な奇形腫性腫瘍である真性卵巣甲状腺腫3例の臨床的・病理学的観察を報告する。多くは無症状であるが、甲状腺ホルモンを分泌して甲状腺機能亢進症を起こす例もある。3例とも悪性の組織像はみられなかった。術後の比較的短い観察期間中に再発や転移はなく、卵巣甲状腺腫は通常良性であるという見解を支持している。
pmid-6723700.summary_en: Clinical and pathological observations of three cases of true struma ovarii, a rare teratomatous neoplasm composed of thyroid tissue. Most are asymptomatic, though some secrete thyroid hormone and cause hyperthyroidism. None of the three tumors showed malignant histology. No recurrence or metastasis was seen during the relatively short postoperative follow-up, supporting the view that struma ovarii is usually benign.

pmid-6723706.summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた皮脂腺癌の症例報告。腫瘍は付属器の皮脂腺に由来すると考察している。扁平上皮癌や唾液腺型悪性腫瘍の皮脂腺化生は組織学的に除外された。
pmid-6723706.summary_en: A case report of sebaceous carcinoma arising within a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. The authors propose that the tumor originates from adnexal sebaceous glands. They exclude sebaceous metaplasia of squamous cell carcinoma and of a salivary gland-type malignancy on histological grounds, supporting the adnexal origin of the lesion.

pmid-6723794.summary_ja: レチノイン酸処理したF9胎児性癌細胞において、フィーダー層は分化細胞の出現を70〜80%抑制した。抑制には細胞同士の接触が必要であった。フィーダー層は幹細胞自己複製確率を約0.25〜0.5から0.72に上昇させた。
pmid-6723794.summary_en: Fibroblast feeder layers reduced the appearance of differentiated cells in retinoic acid-treated F9 embryonal carcinoma cultures by 70-80%. Inhibition required cell-cell contact. Feeder layers increased the probability of stem cell renewal from about 0.25-0.5 to 0.72. The authors conclude that feeders suppress differentiation by promoting stem cell self-renewal, clarifying how EC stem cell fate is regulated.

pmid-6724577.summary_ja: 術前に胞状奇胎と診断された若年女性の右卵巣に純粋ディスジャーミノーマを認めた。免疫染色では、hCGを分泌する小間質細胞が検出された。従来の報告とは異なり、合胞体栄養膜細胞や絨毛組織は関与していなかった。
pmid-6724577.summary_en: A young woman with a preoperative diagnosis of molar pregnancy was found to have a pure dysgerminoma of the right ovary. Immunohistochemistry showed hCG-secreting small stromal cells, not syncytiotrophoblasts or chorionic tissue as in previously reported functioning dysgerminomas. The authors discuss ultrastructural and biochemical findings that support this unusual mechanism of hCG secretion.

pmid-6724790.summary_ja: 9歳女児の梗塞を起こした卵巣腫瘤から、胎児型構造物（ホムンクルス）が見つかった。皮膚、毛髪、四肢原基、爪を伴う足、頭蓋骨や脊椎、原始脳組織、神経節を伴う脊髄などを含んでいた。単一の腫瘍性胚細胞が示した組織化の程度として最高レベルと考察している。
pmid-6724790.summary_en: Description of an infarcted ovarian mass from a 9-year-old girl containing a fetiform structure, or homunculus. It included skin, hair, limb buds, feet with nails, skull and vertebral fragments, primitive brain tissue, a spinal cord with ganglia, notochord, and an endodermal tube. The authors consider it among the most organized development ever recorded in a single neoplastic germ cell.

pmid-6724791.summary_ja: 28歳女性で、破裂した良性嚢胞性奇形腫に続発した腹膜黒色症の症例報告。超微細構造解析で、大網と腹膜の色素結節は大量のメラニンを貪食した組織球からなることが確認された。卵巣奇形腫内に黒色細胞腫瘍は認められなかった。
pmid-6724791.summary_en: A case report of peritoneal melanosis in a 28-year-old woman, secondary to a ruptured benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. Electron microscopy showed pigment-laden histiocytes in omental and peritoneal nodules. No melanocytic neoplasm was found in the ovarian teratoma. The authors conclude that the pigmented lesions were reactive changes to melanin released from the ruptured cyst.

pmid-6726185.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来のヒト胎児性癌（EC）細胞株は、低頻度でC型レトロウイルス様のビリオンを産生する。誘導処理した3株では、スパイクを有するB型レトロウイルス様のビリオンも認められた。分化したEC細胞、卵黄嚢癌、奇形腫細胞ではビリオン産生が見られず、ウイルス複製の発生段階による調節が示唆された。
pmid-6726185.summary_en: Human embryonal carcinoma cell lines derived from testicular germ cell tumors produce at low frequency virions morphologically resembling type C retroviruses. A second spiked virion type, resembling type B retroviruses, appears in induced cells of three lines. Virion production was absent from differentiated EC cells, yolk sac carcinoma, and teratoma cells, suggesting developmental regulation of virus replication.

pmid-6726960.summary_ja: 1984年の研究で、経陰嚢的精巣摘除術などの不適切な初回治療により陰嚢が腫瘍で汚染された精巣がん32例を、根治的鼠径部精巣摘除術を受けた群と比較した。適切な後治療を行えば、無病期間と生存率に有意差はなく、陰嚢汚染のみで予後が悪化することはないと結論づけた。
pmid-6726960.summary_en: This 1984 study of 224 testicular cancer patients compared 32 who had inadequate primary procedures, such as transscrotal orchiectomy or biopsy, causing scrotal tumor contamination, with patients who underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy. Contaminated patients who received appropriate subsequent management, including hemiscrotal radiotherapy for seminoma and partial scrotectomy for nonseminoma, had no local recurrences and no significant differences in disease-free interval or survival. The authors concluded that scrotal contamination alone does not adversely affect prognosis when management is prompt and adequate.

pmid-6730122.summary_ja: 1944年から1980年に治療された黒人男性の精巣腫瘍19例を検討した1984年の報告。発生頻度は白人より低く、診断時の多くは転移性疾患であった。セミノーマや胎児性癌などの組織型と予後を示し、現在では予後が白人と比べて劣らないと述べている。
pmid-6730122.summary_en: This 1984 M.D. Anderson study reviewed 19 black men treated for testicular tumors between 1944 and 1980, about 1.4% of 1,380 patients, a frequency roughly one-fifth of what would be expected given their representation in the hospital. Histologies included seminoma (12), embryonal carcinoma (5), teratocarcinoma (1), and interstitial cell tumor (1). Most patients presented with metastatic disease, and several died of disease. The authors note that prognosis today is no worse for blacks than for whites.

pmid-6730125.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対するリンパ節郭清後に乳糜腹水を発症した2例の報告。穿刺液の脂肪滴、Sudan III陽性、リンパ球優位の所見と高い脂肪含量から診断された。中鎖脂肪酸トリグリセリド食、フロセミド、塩分制限で治療した。精巣腫瘍のリンパ節手術後の合併症として注意が必要である。
pmid-6730125.summary_en: This 1984 Urology report describes two patients who developed chylous ascites after lymph node dissection performed for testicular tumors. The diagnosis was confirmed by paracentesis fluid showing fat globules, Sudan III positivity, a lymphocyte-predominant smear, and high fat content. Treatment consisted of a medium-chain triglyceride diet, furosemide, and salt restriction. The case series highlights chylous ascites as a postoperative complication of nodal surgery in the management of testicular tumors.

pmid-6730751.summary_ja: 1945〜1980年にオーストリア西部で登録された精巣腫瘍260例を、改訂版British分類で再分類した。約92%が胚細胞由来で、セミノーマと奇形腫が主な組織型であった。発生率は10万人あたり1.9から後半10年の4.0へ上昇し、農業地域では低かった。
pmid-6730751.summary_en: This registry-based study reviewed 260 testicular tumors diagnosed in western Austria between 1945 and 1980, reclassified using the revised British classification. About 92% were germ cell in origin, with seminomas (43.8%) and teratomas (38.1%) the most common types, and mixed tumors appearing once surgical material was fully sampled. Right-sided tumors predominated, and 60% of germ cell tumors were pT3 at surgery. Incidence rose from 1.9 to 4.0 per 100,000 males over the study period, with lower rates in agricultural regions.

pmid-6731199.summary_ja: 腹部外傷後に後腹膜血腫と誤診された精巣腫瘍の症例報告である。手術で巨大な後腹膜腫瘍が判明し、その後の精巣腫大を契機に左精巣摘除術が行われた。後腹膜腫瘍は精巣癌からの転移と確認された。触知されなかった精巣病変が、外傷に伴う誤診によって見過ごされた点が特徴である。
pmid-6731199.summary_en: This case report describes a left testicular tumor with an atypical course. A patient with abdominal trauma was initially diagnosed with a retroperitoneal hematoma, but surgery revealed a bulky retroperitoneal tumor. Subsequent gradual testicular swelling prompted left orchiectomy, which confirmed that the retroperitoneal mass was a metastasis from the testicular carcinoma. The case highlights how a non-palpable primary testicular lesion can be masked by a trauma-related misdiagnosis.

pmid-6731515.summary_ja: 1970〜1982年に妊娠中絶時に発見された付属器腫瘤100例を検討した。最多は良性嚢胞性奇形腫（50%）で、悪性は2例（2.2%）のみであった。捻転は7例に生じた。腫瘍は小さいものが多く、真の発生率は過小評価されている可能性がある。
pmid-6731515.summary_en: This study examined 100 adnexal masses found during 55,278 pregnancy terminations at a Los Angeles medical center between 1970 and 1982. Benign cystic teratoma was the most common lesion (50%), while only two malignancies (2.2%) were identified. Torsion occurred in seven cases, and preoperative diagnosis was more often made in the first trimester. The authors suggest the true incidence of ovarian tumors is underestimated because many are small. A series of 998 abortion hysterectomies found 1.3% ovarian tumors.

pmid-6733403.summary_ja: 女性化乳房を呈し、触知上は正常な精巣をもつ男性2例で、陰嚢超音波検査により潜在性精巣腫瘍が診断された。悪性精巣腫瘍の最大10%に女性化乳房が認められる。触知されない腫瘍の検出には超音波検査の活用を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-6733403.summary_en: This brief report describes two men with gynaecomastia and clinically normal-appearing testes in whom occult testicular tumors were detected by scrotal ultrasonography. Gynaecomastia occurs in up to 10% of patients with malignant testicular tumors, and while masses are usually palpable, occasionally they are not. The authors argue that ultrasound should be considered in such patients to detect occult neoplasms, as it has proven useful in patients presenting with nodal disease.

pmid-6733689.summary_ja: 22歳女性の卵巣未熟奇形腫に発生した神経芽腫の症例報告である。2年後に後腹膜、縦隔、鎖骨上リンパ節および骨への転移が生じた。化学療法に続く放射線療法で完全寛解が4年以上持続した。グレード3の未熟奇形腫で長期生存するのはまれであり、文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-6733689.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with neuroblastoma arising in an immature ovarian teratoma. Grade 3 differentiation was seen in both primary and metastatic sites, which involved retroperitoneal, mediastinal, supraclavicular nodes and bone two years later. Electron microscopy showed neurosecretory granules. Combination chemotherapy followed by radiotherapy achieved complete remission sustained for over four years, which the authors note is unusual for grade 3 immature teratoma. A literature review is included.

pmid-6734753.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌OTT6050の胚様体を、拡散チャンバー内で培養した細胞を用いた実験研究である。この培養細胞を注入されたマウスは生存期間が延長し、腫瘍形成能は著しく低下した。一方、F9細胞では低下はわずかであった。F9抗原の発現は両者で維持され、未分化な状態を保っていたと考えられる。
pmid-6734753.summary_en: This experimental study examined embryoid bodies from the mouse teratocarcinoma line OTT6050 dissociated and cultured in in vivo diffusion chambers. Host mice receiving these cells survived much longer than those injected with original embryoid body cells, indicating reduced tumorigenicity. In contrast, F9 cells showed only slight reduction. F9 antigen expression persisted in both cell types, and adult-type antigen analysis suggested little differentiation, implying cells remained undifferentiated.

pmid-6735268.summary_ja: 完全内臓逆位症を有する20歳のサウジアラビア女性における卵巣胚細胞癌の症例報告です。肝左葉への転移として再発し、ブレオマイシン、ビンブラスチン、シスプラチンの併用療法で治療しました。セカンドルック開腹術で完全寛解が確認されました。内臓逆位と胚細胞腫瘍の稀な合併を報告するとともに、転移性病変に対する多剤併用療法の有効性を示しています。
pmid-6735268.summary_en: A 20-year-old Saudi woman with situs inversus totalis and ovarian embryonal cell carcinoma is described. After recurrence with liver metastases, she received combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, vinblastine and cisplatin, achieving complete remission confirmed at second-look laparotomy. The case documents a rare association of a situs anomaly with a germ cell tumor and demonstrates a successful multidrug regimen for metastatic disease.

pmid-6738071.summary_ja: ルイビル大学放射線腫瘍科で治療された卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ6例の症例レビューと文献的考察です。ディスジャーミノーマは稀な胚細胞腫瘍で、思春期に多く発症します。手術と放射線療法の併用により、早期病変では良好な治癒率が得られています。病期Iaに対する放射線療法の是非をめぐる議論を中心に詳しく考察しています。
pmid-6738071.summary_en: Six patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated at the University of Louisville Department of Radiation Oncology are reviewed alongside a literature review. Dysgerminomas, rare germ cell tumors, occur more often at puberty. Surgery followed by irradiation achieved excellent cure rates in early stages. The paper discusses in detail the controversy over irradiation for stage Ia disease, which is the central clinical question addressed.

pmid-6740333.summary_ja: ヌードマウスでの造腫瘍性が継代数により変化する奇形癌細胞株PA1を対象とした研究です。後期継代細胞から単離されたrasN遺伝子は、コドン12に点突然変異を有していました。この活性化は培養中に生じ、造腫瘍性の増強と関連すると考えられています。
pmid-6740333.summary_en: The study examines the human teratocarcinoma cell line PA1, which becomes tumorigenic in nude mice at late passages but not at early passages. A transforming rasN gene isolated from late-passage cells carries a single G-to-A point mutation at codon 12, changing glycine to aspartate. Early-passage DNA failed to induce transforming foci, suggesting the activated gene arose during in vitro culture and correlates with enhanced tumorigenicity.

pmid-6744206.summary_ja: 精巣の播種性奇形癌に対して縦隔放射線療法を受け、生存した2例が、その後食道扁平上皮癌を発症した。文献上、同様の既往をもつ食道悪性腫瘍はこれまで11例のみ報告されている。放射線療法による生存期間の延長に伴い、同様の症例は増加すると予想される。著者らは、食道周囲への放射線療法を受けた患者に綿密なフォローアップを行い、食道機能障害の症状を速やかに評価することを推奨している。
pmid-6744206.summary_en: Two patients who received mediastinal radiation for disseminated testicular teratocarcinoma and survived developed esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Only 11 similar cases had been reported previously. The authors anticipate more such cases as radiation prolongs survival, and recommend close follow-up of patients receiving radiation to periesophageal tissues and prompt evaluation of esophageal symptoms.

pmid-6744314.summary_ja: マウス胚盤胞が胎児性癌細胞のコロニー形成を制御する仕組みを検討した基礎研究。胎児性癌細胞が胚盤胞の栄養外胚葉表面と直接接触することでコロニー形成が抑制され、他の腫瘍では同様の効果はみられなかった。胚盤胞に瘻孔を作ると胎児性癌の制御は維持されたが、他の腫瘍は制御されなかった。
pmid-6744314.summary_en: This basic research study examined how the mouse blastocyst regulates colony formation of embryonal carcinoma cells. Direct contact between embryonal carcinoma cells and the blastocoele surface of trophectoderm was required to suppress colony formation, an effect not seen with the other tumors tested. Blastocysts with fistulas allowed regulation of embryonal carcinoma, while the other tumors were still not controlled. The authors conclude that trophectoderm contact regulates embryonal carcinoma colony formation in a specific, though still unknown, manner.

pmid-6744929.summary_ja: 腹痛と腹部腫瘤を呈した症例で、当初は精巣原発が明らかでなかった。CTで傍大動脈リンパ節の結節状石灰化と水腎症がみられ、これらは別病変として描出された。組織診は針生検による細胞診で確認された。リンパ節石灰化が精巣腫瘍の転移を示唆するCT所見となりうることを報告している。
pmid-6744929.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with abdominal pain and an abdominal mass in whom the testicular primary tumor was not initially evident. Nodular calcification in para-aortic lymph nodes, together with hydronephrosis, was seen, and CT showed these nodes to be separate from other findings. Histology was confirmed by needle cytology. The report highlights lymph node calcification on CT as a clue to testicular tumor spread.

pmid-6745486.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で誘導される胎児性癌細胞の分化過程で、細胞周期・細胞死・形態変化を経時的に解析した基礎研究。レチノイン酸は主にS期を延長させ、第3世代以降で細胞死を誘導した。形態分化は増殖低下に先行して第2細胞周期から始まった。胎児性癌細胞が内胚葉様細胞へ分化する過程を示す。
pmid-6745486.summary_en: Time-lapse analysis of PC13 embryonal carcinoma cells, synchronized by mitotic shake-off, examined cell cycle changes during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Retinoic acid lengthened the cell cycle in dividing cells mainly through a longer S phase, and induced cell death from the third generation onward. Morphological differentiation began in the second cell cycle, before growth slowed. The findings show that differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells toward an endoderm-like phenotype is preceded by morphological change and accompanied by a reduced growth rate.

pmid-6745491.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞と壁側卵黄嚢細胞のホルモン産生を培養系で比較した基礎研究。F9細胞はカルシトニンを分泌し、レチノイン酸による内胚葉分化に伴って減少した。一方、壁側卵黄嚢細胞は副甲状腺ホルモンを分泌し、その量は増加した。異所性のホルモン産生が発生過程の調節に関与する可能性を示唆する。
pmid-6745491.summary_en: This basic research study examined hormone production by F9 embryonal carcinoma cells and parietal yolk sac cells in culture. F9 cells secreted immunoreactive calcitonin, and production fell with retinoic acid-induced endoderm differentiation. Parietal yolk sac cells secreted parathyroid hormone, and its level rose during the same process. The authors propose that ectopic hormone production at specific stages of embryonic differentiation may contribute to regulating later steps of development.

pmid-6745734.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎様の骨盤腹部腫瘤と非常に高い血清β-hCG値を呈した20歳女性の症例報告。最終的に右卵巣のシンシチオトロホブラスト巨細胞を伴うディスジャーミノーマ、病期分類IC期と診断された。既報11例のうちIC期の初報告であり、胞状奇胎として発症した初例でもある。
pmid-6745734.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old woman with a pelvic-abdominal mass that was sonographically consistent with a hydatidiform mole and had a very high serum beta-hCG. She was ultimately diagnosed with a Stage IC dysgerminoma with syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells of the right ovary. Among 11 previously reported cases of this rare tumor, this was the first Stage IC case and the first to present as a hydatidiform mole. The paper also reviews the clinical and pathological features of the tumor.

pmid-6747531.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株PSA4とS2から作製した胚様体で、空洞形成に伴う細胞死の型を超微細構造で分類した基礎研究。空洞を形成するPSA4ではアポトーシスと壊死の両方が見られたが、形成しないS2ではアポトーシスのみだった。空洞形成に因果的に関わるのは壊死であり、アポトーシスではないと結論づけている。
pmid-6747531.summary_en: This basic research study classified cell death during cavitation in embryoid bodies derived from the embryonal carcinoma cell lines PSA4 and S2. PSA4 embryoid bodies, which cavitate, showed both apoptosis and necrosis, while S2 embryoid bodies, which do not cavitate, showed only apoptosis. The spatial distribution and apoptotic incidence did not differ between the lines. The authors conclude that necrosis, rather than apoptosis, is causally related to cavity formation.

pmid-6090244.summary_ja: F9マウス奇形癌幹細胞をレチノイン酸で分化誘導する系を用い、酪酸の作用を検討した。酪酸は、レチノイン酸添加後8時間以内の投与でのみ分化を阻害した。増殖や細胞周期は変化せず、ヒストン脱アセチル化を阻害していた。分化阻害の機序として示唆された。臨床研究ではなく基礎研究である。
pmid-6090244.summary_en: This developmental biology study examines F9 mouse teratocarcinoma stem cells, a model of embryonal carcinoma, treated with retinoic acid to induce parietal endoderm differentiation. Sodium butyrate blocked this differentiation only when added within 8 hours of retinoic acid. Growth and cell-cycle distribution were unchanged, so the effect was not due to growth inhibition. Butyrate instead inhibited histone deacetylation, a plausible mechanism for blocking differentiation. The study is laboratory-based and does not address clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-6090250.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9およびPC13の胚様体形成過程で、EGF受容体とトランスフェリンの発現時期と量を検討した。両株ともレチノイン酸処理で内臓内胚葉を含む胚様体を形成した。トランスフェリンは最大40倍に増加した。本研究は培養細胞の分化マーカーに関する基礎研究である。
pmid-6090250.summary_en: This study documents the timing and levels of EGF receptor and transferrin expression during embryoid body formation by two embryonal carcinoma cell lines, F9 and PC13. Both lines formed embryoid bodies with visceral endoderm after retinoic acid treatment, though initiation procedures differed. EGF receptors and transferrin rose at similar times in both lines, although levels differed. Transferrin increased up to 40-fold. Unstimulated F9 cells expressed low marker levels, while PC13 expression was barely detectable. These are laboratory differentiation markers, not clinical outcomes.

pmid-6095043.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌幹細胞(PSA-G)の分化に伴い発現が低下する遺伝子のcDNAクローンを単離した基礎研究。レチノイン酸などで誘導した分化に伴う転写および転写後の調節を解析した。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍への関連は間接的である。
pmid-6095043.summary_en: This basic study isolated cDNA clones for genes whose expression falls after murine teratocarcinoma stem cells (PSA-G) differentiate, induced by retinoic acid and dibutyryl cyclic AMP. Of about 1,000 clones screened, eight were isolated, and three encoded proteins were identified, including a heat shock protein. Transcriptional and posttranscriptional regulation of several transcripts was characterised. The work uses murine embryonal carcinoma-derived cells as a differentiation model and offers only indirect relevance to human germ cell tumours.

pmid-6095269.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞EC-A1を用い、ポリ(ADP-リボース)合成の低下が分化を引き起こすことを示した基礎研究。レチノイン酸処理で合成活性が形態変化に先行して低下した。3-アミノベンズアミドなどの合成酵素阻害剤で分化が誘導され、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍への直接的な臨床的関連は乏しい。
pmid-6095269.summary_en: Using murine teratocarcinoma EC-A1 cells, the authors show that retinoic acid reduces poly(ADP-ribose) synthesis before morphological and DNA-synthesis changes. Inhibiting poly(ADP-ribose) synthetase with 3-aminobenzamide or nicotinamide induced differentiation, while the inactive analogue 3-aminobenzoic acid acted mainly through cytotoxicity. Immunohistochemistry confirmed reduced nuclear poly(ADP-ribose). The findings suggest that decreased poly(ADP-ribose) synthesis triggers teratocarcinoma differentiation. The study is basic cell biology in a murine model with only indirect relevance to clinical germ cell tumours.

pmid-6098808.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞を体外培養した場合と生体内で腫瘍として増殖させた場合について、CpGのDNAメチル化を比較した。メチル化感受性制限酵素とサザンブロットを用い、腫瘍DNAは培養細胞より低メチル化であった。増殖条件や細胞間相互作用がメチル化に大きく影響すると結論している。腫瘍を対象としているが、主題は増殖環境によるエピジェネティックな変化である。
pmid-6098808.summary_en: This study compares DNA methylation at CpG sites in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells grown in vitro with cells grown as tumors in vivo. Using methylation-sensitive restriction enzymes and Southern blotting with two probes, the authors find that tumor DNA is hypomethylated relative to cultured cells. They conclude that growth conditions and cell-cell interactions can substantially affect methylation. The tumor is studied as a biological state, but the work uses EC cells mainly as a model for epigenetic regulation.

pmid-6149461.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞は通常SV40に感受性がなく、ウイルス抗原を産生しないが、SV40初期領域を組み込んだヒト細胞との雑種では大型T抗原を発現することを示した1984年の研究。定性・定量解析で確認された。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学に関連するEC細胞のウイルス抵抗性に言及するが、主題はウイルス遺伝子発現である。
pmid-6149461.summary_en: This 1984 study showed that embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, which normally resist SV40 infection and do not express large T or small t antigens, can express SV40 large T antigen when hybridized with human cells carrying integrated SV40 early region DNA. Qualitative and quantitative analyses confirmed the expression. The work bears on viral resistance of EC cells, a property relevant to germ cell tumor biology, though the focus is viral gene expression rather than tumor pathology.

pmid-6152580.summary_ja: 奇形癌腫F9細胞と精子形成細胞に共通する抗原が糖鎖構造である可能性を調べた研究です。F9細胞またはABH血液型物質で免疫したマウスでは精子形成が抑制されました。両抗血清は共通抗原を認識し、F9特異抗原にはSSEA-1が含まれました。腫瘍抗原の糖鎖が精子細胞の分化に関与するかもしれないと示唆されています。主題は生殖免疫学で、奇形癌腫細胞は免疫原・抗原源として使われています。
pmid-6152580.summary_en: This study investigates whether antigens shared by teratocarcinoma F9 cells and spermatogenic cells are carbohydrate structures. Mice immunized with F9 cells or ABH blood group substances showed inhibited spermatogenesis, and both antisera recognized common antigens, while F9-specific antigens included SSEA-1. The findings suggest that oncofetal F9 carbohydrate antigens may participate in spermatogenic cell differentiation. The primary focus is reproductive immunology, with the teratocarcinoma line used as an immunogen and antigen source.

pmid-6203029.summary_ja: 1984年の研究で、レチノイン酸による分化誘導を受けるF9奇形癌細胞を用い、分化に伴うDNAメチル化の変化を検討した。ゲノム全体のメチル化消失が観察されたが、5-アザシチジンによる脱メチル化だけではαフェトプロテインの誘導や形態的分化は起こらなかった。臨床研究ではなく、組織特異的なメチル化変化のモデル研究である。
pmid-6203029.summary_en: This 1984 study uses F9 teratocarcinoma cells, which differentiate into parietal or visceral endoderm after retinoic acid treatment, to examine DNA methylation during differentiation. Visceral endoderm specifically synthesizes alpha-fetoprotein, and differentiation causes genome-wide loss of methylation. However, 5-azacytidine-induced demethylation alone did not induce alpha-fetoprotein expression or morphologic differentiation, indicating that methylation loss is not sufficient by itself. The work is a model of tissue-specific methylation changes rather than a clinical study of germ cell tumors.

pmid-6204783.summary_ja: 未分化F9奇形癌細胞をレチノイン酸とcAMPで分化誘導し、形態変化を観察した。単クローン抗体RGF 53を用いてサイトケラチン18が分化に伴い約半数の細胞で合成され線維網を形成することを免疫蛍光法とイムノブロットで示した。奇形癌細胞を分化モデルとして用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-6204783.summary_en: Undifferentiated F9 teratocarcinoma cells were induced to differentiate with retinoic acid and cAMP, which changed culture morphology markedly. Using a monoclonal antibody against cytokeratin polypeptide 18 (RGF 53), the authors showed by immunofluorescence and immunoblotting that this cytokeratin subunit is synthesized and assembled into filaments in about half of the cells upon differentiation. The study uses teratocarcinoma cells as an in vitro differentiation model rather than addressing clinical tumor management.

pmid-6205280.summary_ja: AFP遺伝子の分化誘導時の活性化に関与するシス作用性DNA配列を同定するため、改変した遺伝子をマウスF9胎児性癌細胞に導入した。壁側または臓側内胚葉へ分化した形質転換細胞では、導入遺伝子が内因性遺伝子と質的に同様に誘導された。胎児性癌細胞株を遺伝子制御のモデルとして用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-6205280.summary_en: To identify cis-acting DNA elements involved in alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) gene activation during differentiation, modified copies of the gene were introduced into murine F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. The transformants differentiated into parietal or visceral endoderm, and the exogenous AFP gene was induced in a manner qualitatively identical, though not quantitatively, to the endogenous gene. The work uses the embryonal carcinoma cell line as a gene regulation model rather than addressing clinical tumor management.

pmid-6205984.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の表面抗原に対して作製されたモノクローナル抗体のうち、2種類がアルカリホスファターゼの肝・骨・腎アイソザイムを特異的に認識することを示した。腸型および胎盤型とは交差反応しなかった。系統学的解析では高等霊長類の肝酵素との交差反応が強く、他の哺乳類では差が見られた。主題は臨床ではなく、酵素抗原の特異性にある。
pmid-6205984.summary_en: This 1984 study describes two monoclonal antibodies raised against human embryonal carcinoma cell surface determinants. Both were found to recognize the liver/bone/kidney isozyme of alkaline phosphatase specifically, without cross-reacting with intestinal or placental isozymes. Phylogenetic analysis showed strong cross-reactivity with liver enzyme from higher primates but differing reactions with other mammals. The work is primarily about enzyme antigen specificity rather than the clinical management of germ cell tumors.

pmid-6207296.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌幹細胞を標的に選択されたモノクローナル抗体2H9の性状を報告しています。胎児性癌細胞表面の125kd糖蛋白を認識しますが、他の細胞種にも反応します。主題は抗体の免疫学的性質で、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍患者は対象ではありません。
pmid-6207296.summary_en: This study describes monoclonal antibody 2H9, selected against murine teratocarcinoma stem cells. It recognizes a major 125 kd surface glycoprotein on embryonal carcinoma cells but also detects multiple glycoproteins on other murine and human cell types. Binding is abolished by periodate or neuraminidase, indicating a carbohydrate epitope distinct from other anti-EC antibodies and lectins. The antibody is mitogenic for a subpopulation of murine splenic lymphocytes. The work is primarily immunological and uses embryonal carcinoma cells as an antigen source rather than studying patients with germ cell tumors.

pmid-6208940.summary_ja: 各種細胞におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)遺伝子の構造と発現を解析した基礎研究。未分化の胎児性癌細胞では遺伝子がDNase I感受性を示さず、分化した内胚葉細胞やAFP産生組織では感受性が高く、転写制御の関与が示唆された。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の管理を扱うものではない。
pmid-6208940.summary_en: This 1984 study examined the structure and expression of the alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) gene across various cell types. AFP RNA levels in nuclei and cytoplasm were consistent with transcriptional regulation. In undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells and in differentiated tissues that do not express AFP, the gene was resistant to DNase I. In endoderm cells derived from EC cells and in AFP-producing tissues, the gene was DNase I-sensitive. EC cells serve as a model for comparing pluripotent and differentiated states. The work is basic research rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-6209131.summary_ja: 未分化の胎児性癌(EC)細胞、EK細胞、成体マウス精巣でのみ発現する遺伝子EC1のcDNAクローンを単離した基礎研究。W/Wvマウスの精巣では発現が低下し、胚細胞がRNAの発現源であることが示唆された。既知配列との有意な相同性は認められなかった。
pmid-6209131.summary_en: This 1984 study isolated a cDNA clone, EC1, from embryoid bodies derived from embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells. The transcript was detected only in undifferentiated EC and EK cells and in adult mouse testes. Expression was significantly reduced in W/Wv mouse testes, implicating germ cells as the RNA source. The 744 bp insert showed no significant homology to known sequences. In situ hybridization localized the signal to undifferentiated regions of embryoid bodies, and Southern blotting indicated a single-copy gene. The study is basic molecular research rather than clinical tumor management.

pmid-6325455.summary_ja: F9奇形癌幹細胞のレチノイン酸への応答が変化した変異株を単離し、分化表現型を解析した。CRABP（細胞性レチノイン酸結合タンパク質）が欠損した変異株は分化できず、CRABPがレチノイン酸による分化に必要であることを遺伝学的に示した。他の変異株ではラミニンやIV型コラーゲンなどの合成・修飾に異常が見られた。臨床研究ではなく基礎研究である。
pmid-6325455.summary_en: This 1984 J Biol Chem study isolates F9 teratocarcinoma stem cell mutants with altered responses to retinoic acid and examines their differentiation phenotypes. One mutant lacking cellular retinoic acid binding protein fails to differentiate, providing genetic evidence that CRABP is required for retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Other mutants show defects in plasminogen activator, laminin, and collagen IV synthesis or processing. No alterations were found in cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity. The work is basic cell biology using an embryonal carcinoma model, not clinical germ cell tumor research.

pmid-6330245.summary_ja: 術前コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による卵巣腫瘍の良性・悪性鑑別能を137例で検討した後方視的研究である。類皮嚢腫は特徴的なCT所見を示し、診断を容易にした。それ以外では、壁からの隆起、長径15cm以上、腹水が悪性を示唆した。数量化理論による得点化で、良悪性の鑑別率は93.2%であった。
pmid-6330245.summary_en: This study assessed preoperative CT for distinguishing benign from malignant ovarian tumors in 137 pathologically confirmed cases. Dermoid cysts (42 cases) showed characteristic CT appearances and CT numbers. Among other tumors, cystic tumors with wall protrusion, solid tumors with fluid components, long diameters of 15 cm or more, and ascites predicted malignancy. CT findings were scored retrospectively, achieving 93.2% benign-malignant discrimination.

pmid-6399008.summary_ja: 本論文は、腫瘍由来の胎児性癌（EC）細胞株と、胚由来幹細胞（ES）株を比較した総説である。両者は多能性胚細胞に類似するが、EC細胞株は未分化のまま増殖し続けられる。EC株とES株が同一の起源をもつかは不明とされ、ES細胞の登場がこの問題の解決に役立つと述べている。主題は幹細胞生物学であり、EC細胞は研究モデルとして扱われている。
pmid-6399008.summary_en: This 1984 review compares embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines, derived from tumors, with embryo-derived stem (ES) cell lines. Both share features with pluripotent embryonic cells, but EC lines can proliferate indefinitely as undifferentiated cells. The authors note that it is unknown whether all EC and ES lines originate from the same embryonic stem cells, and that differences between lines might suggest distinct origins. The advent of ES cells, which appear closer to normal embryonic cells, may help resolve this question. The paper is mainly a stem cell biology perspective, with EC cells as a model system.

pmid-6399010.summary_ja: 本論文は、テラトカルチノーマ由来細胞株の分化過程で制御される遺伝子を、クローン化した遺伝子プローブでmRNA量を測定した研究である。タンパク質とmRNAの量は良く一致し、転写制御が示唆された。制御機構としてDNAメチル化とエンハンサーなどの関与が議論されている。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、初期胚の遺伝子発現のモデルとして用いられている。
pmid-6399010.summary_en: This 1984 review describes the use of cloned gene probes to measure mRNA levels of genes regulated during in vitro differentiation of teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines. The authors found good agreement between protein and mRNA levels, suggesting transcriptional regulation. They discuss two mechanisms of control: DNA methylation and interactions between cis-acting enhancer sequences and trans-acting proteins. Experiments with oncoviruses suggest that both mechanisms may contribute. The work uses teratocarcinoma cell lines as a model for early embryonic gene expression, rather than focusing on clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-6470607.summary_ja: 本研究は、8細胞期マウス胚とF9胎児性癌細胞との凝集過程における細胞間相互作用を電子顕微鏡で観察したものである。胚とF9細胞は速やかに接着し、微絨毛、接着結合、後にギャップ結合を形成した。一方、奇形癌由来の内胚葉細胞との接着は不十分で、同様の凝集体は形成されなかった。胚と胎児性癌細胞の凝集には膜相互作用が関与し、胚盤胞発生の形態形成のモデルとなりうることが示唆された。
pmid-6470607.summary_en: This 1984 study used electron microscopy to examine cell interactions during aggregation between 8-cell mouse embryos and F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Embryos and F9 cells adhered rapidly, forming microvilli, adherent junctions, and later gap junctions. In contrast, embryos adhered only loosely to teratocarcinoma-derived endoderm cells and did not form comparable aggregates, although endoderm cells readily aggregated with EC cells. The findings suggest membrane interactions mediate early embryo-EC aggregation and may model morphogenetic processes of blastocyst development.

pmid-6479244.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞4株とマウスメラノーマ細胞B16-CAPrを細胞融合させたハイブリッドの研究。ハイブリッドは親のメラノーマ細胞より色素が濃く、色素の強さは奇形癌の由来系統(129がLTより強い)に依存した。奇形癌細胞の色素関連遺伝子がハイブリッド内で活性化されると考察している。ヒトGCTの臨床研究ではなく、メラノーマの色素形成遺伝学が主題である。
pmid-6479244.summary_en: Somatic cell hybridization study fusing four mouse teratocarcinoma (embryonal carcinoma-like) lines with B16-CAPr melanoma cells. Hybrids derived from single cell pairs were more heavily pigmented than parental melanoma cells, and pigmentation strength depended on the teratocarcinoma parent strain (129 stronger than LT), mirroring host coat color. The authors suggest pigmentation-related genes of teratocarcinoma cells are activated in hybrids. The focus is melanoma pigmentation genetics rather than clinical germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-6491486.summary_ja: 71歳男性の鼻咽頭に生じた毛髪性ポリープ(類皮腫)の症例報告である。通常は出生時や幼少期に発見される腫瘤様病変で、著者らは腫瘍よりも奇形と考えるべきだと結論している。高齢発症の珍しい症例の記述であり、胚細胞腫瘍の治療を扱うものではない。
pmid-6491486.summary_en: This case report describes a hairy polyp, or dermoid, of the nasopharynx in a 71-year-old man, a tumor-like lesion usually found at birth or in early childhood. The authors note that the oldest previously reported patient was 66 years old and conclude that the condition is better viewed as a malformation than a neoplasm. The paper is a brief description of an unusual presentation rather than a study of germ cell tumor management.

pmid-6525195.summary_ja: F9マウス胎児性癌細胞の糖タンパク質から単離した大型糖鎖（embryoglycan）の構造をNMRで解析した研究である。GlcNAcβ1→3Galβが基本単位であることを示し、フコースはガラクトースよりN-アセチルグルコサミンに主に結合することを確認した。胎児性癌細胞を用いた基礎的な糖鎖生物学研究で、臨床的な示唆は限定的である。
pmid-6525195.summary_en: This study uses high-field 1H-NMR spectroscopy to characterize large carbohydrate chains (embryoglycan) isolated from glycoproteins of F9 murine embryonal carcinoma cells. Two diagnostic signals identify galactosyl residues substituted at C-3 and GlcNAc beta1-3 linkages, supporting that the fundamental repeating unit is GlcNAc beta1-3Gal beta. Glycosidase digestion confirmed that fucose is attached mainly to N-acetylglucosamine rather than galactose. The work is primarily structural glycobiology using an embryonal carcinoma cell line as a model.

pmid-6526007.summary_ja: マウスPC13胎児性癌細胞の無血清条件培地から、強力な増殖因子ECDGFを単離・特性解析した基礎研究である。分子量17,500の単鎖カチオン性疎水性タンパク質で、線維芽細胞株やPC13細胞の分化子孫においてDNA合成を誘導する。他の既知増殖因子とは構造・作用が異なる。臨床腫瘍学より細胞生物学の性格が強い。
pmid-6526007.summary_en: This study isolates and characterizes a potent growth factor, PC13 embryonal carcinoma-derived growth factor (ECDGF), from serum-free conditioned medium of murine PC13 embryonal carcinoma cells. ECDGF is a 17,500-dalton single-chain cationic hydrophobic protein that stimulates DNA synthesis in fibroblast lines and in differentiated progeny of PC13 cells. Its structure and activity differ from other well-characterized growth factors. The work is basic cell biology using an embryonal carcinoma cell line as a model.

pmid-6534382.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞の条件培地に含まれる増殖促進活性の予備的特性解析である。その分子は生物学的・生化学的性質において他の既知増殖因子と区別される。胎児性癌細胞の分泌産物に関する基礎的知見を提供するが、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の治療には直接関係しない。
pmid-6534382.summary_en: This study reports partial characterization of a growth-promoting activity secreted by murine embryonal carcinoma cells in conditioned medium. The molecules have biological and biochemical properties that distinguish them from other known growth factors. The work is preliminary and laboratory-based, using an embryonal carcinoma cell line as the source of the activity. It contributes to basic understanding of embryonal carcinoma cell secretory products rather than clinical management of germ cell tumors.

pmid-6534383.summary_ja: H6マウス胎児性癌細胞の凝集体が、カルシウム依存的なコンパクション過程で細胞接合をどのように形成するかを解析した。ギャップ結合は両凝集体で形成され、コンパクト化した凝集体では最大のものが約20倍大きかった。タイトジャンクションやデスモソームは約48時間後に出現した。発生生物学的な細胞研究である。
pmid-6534383.summary_en: This study examines how aggregates of H6 murine embryonal carcinoma cells form cell junctions during calcium-induced compaction. Gap junctions form in both compacted and uncompacted aggregates, while the largest gap junctions are about twentyfold larger in compacted ones. Tight junctions and desmosomes appear later, around 48 hours. The findings suggest compaction arises from calcium-induced cell flattening rather than gap junction formation. This is a developmental cell biology study using an embryonal carcinoma model.

pmid-6534385.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞の移植腫瘍を、無胸腺ヌードマウス、正常Snellマウス、下垂体機能低下のSnell矮小マウスで比較した1984年の研究です。下垂体ホルモンの欠損は腫瘍形成や三胚葉由来組織の分化に影響しないことが示されました。
pmid-6534385.summary_en: This 1984 study examined how pluripotent mouse embryonal carcinoma cells form tumors and differentiate in athymic nude mice, normal Snell mice, and hypopituitary Snell dwarf mice. Tumor take rates were high in nude mice and comparable between normal and dwarf Snell mice. Tumors in all hosts contained derivatives of all three germ layers alongside undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cells, suggesting that pituitary hormone deficiency did not affect tumor induction or tissue development.

pmid-6535637.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌F9細胞に対するモノクローナル抗体を用い、奇形癌幹細胞の3種類の分化抗原を定義した1984年の研究です。TEC-02とTEC-03は幹細胞と初期胚に発現し、成体組織ではほとんど検出されません。
pmid-6535637.summary_en: This study used ten IgM monoclonal antibodies raised against mouse teratocarcinoma F9 cells to define three differentiation antigens on teratocarcinoma stem cells. TEC-01 recognizes the SSEA-1 antigen. TEC-02 and TEC-03 are expressed on stem cells, parietal yolk sac cells, and early embryos, and are absent from most adult mouse tissues. These markers may help distinguish pluripotent stem cells from differentiated tissues in germ cell tumor models.

pmid-6535638.summary_ja: 奇形癌幹細胞の表面にフコース・マンノース結合性レクチンを同定し、分子量56kDaの精製蛋白質が2価カチオン非依存性の細胞接着に関与すると報告した1984年の研究です。このレクチンが認識する糖鎖は胚様体形成を阻害し、分化への関与が示唆されました。
pmid-6535638.summary_en: Researchers identified a fucan/mannan-binding lectin on the surface of teratocarcinoma stem cells, using erythrocyte rosetting and hemagglutination assays. The 56 kDa polypeptide, purified from conditioned medium, appears to mediate divalent cation-independent cell adhesion. Carbohydrates recognized by the lectin inhibited in vitro embryoid body formation, suggesting the lectin may contribute to stem cell differentiation.

pmid-6535639.summary_ja: マウス神経芽細胞腫Neuro 2a由来の抗原に対する抗体1c2を作製し、28kDの神経細胞膜蛋白質を同定した1984年の研究です。胎児性癌細胞株PCC3/A/1は抗原陰性で、低密度培養で分化させると陽性になりました。
pmid-6535639.summary_en: Monoclonal antibody 1c2 was generated against murine neuroblastoma Neuro 2a cells and recognizes a 28 kD nerve-cell membrane protein. The antigen is absent from PCC3/A/1 embryonal carcinoma cells but appears after 9 days of differentiation under low-density conditions. The antibody stains granular cells in the adult cerebellar cortex and may help analyze neural tissue development. Embryonal carcinoma cells serve mainly as a negative control in this study.

pmid-6535641.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来の神経様腫瘍とマウス胚の発生期の脳を二次元電気泳動で比較し、4種類の神経特異的蛋白質を見いだした1984年の研究です。未分化な多能性奇形癌細胞には発現しませんでした。
pmid-6535641.summary_en: Two-dimensional gel electrophoresis compared teratocarcinoma-derived tumors that formed nerve-like cells with developing mouse embryonic brain. Four putative nerve-specific proteins (29K, 26K, 20K, 16K) were found in both systems but not in undifferentiated pluripotent teratocarcinoma cells or limb muscle. NSP 29 and NSP 20 were transiently expressed early in brain development, while NSP 16 persisted in brain tissue at all stages studied.

pmid-6535642.summary_ja: 二倍体胎児性癌細胞株P10とP19を初期胚と組み合わせ、キメラ形成能の違いを比較した1984年の研究です。両細胞株とも桑実胚細胞や胚盤胞の内細胞塊とギャップ結合を形成しましたが、違いはギャップ結合では説明できませんでした。
pmid-6535642.summary_en: Two diploid embryonal carcinoma cell lines, P10 and P19, were compared for their behavior in early mouse embryos. P10 cells produced mostly normal chimeras after blastocyst injection, while P19 cells produced mostly abnormal chimeras. Both cell lines formed functional gap junctions with morula cells and the inner cell mass but not with trophoblast, so junctional contact alone does not explain their different chimera outcomes.

pmid-6535644.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来の多能性細胞株TCEと胚由来幹細胞株BLC-1を胚盤胞に注入した1984年の研究です。TCEは限られた散発的な寄与しか示さず、BLC-1は胚に定着しませんでした。
pmid-6535644.summary_en: Two pluripotent mouse cell lines, TCE (derived from OTT 6050 teratocarcinoma) and the embryo-derived stem cell line BLC-1, were injected into blastocysts. TCE cells contributed to the embryo in a limited and sporadic manner, without preferential colonization of extraembryonic membranes. BLC-1 cells failed to colonize the embryo. Normal karyotype, pluripotency, and shared surface markers do not guarantee the ability to participate in embryogenesis.

pmid-6535645.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞PCC4とマウスリンパ球の融合により作製したハイブリッド細胞H422を解析した1984年の研究です。リンパ球由来の分化特異的遺伝子産物はほぼ消失し、胎児性癌様の表現型、腫瘍形成能、多能性を保持していました。
pmid-6535645.summary_en: The hybrid cell line H422 was made by fusing PCC4 embryonal carcinoma cells with mouse lymphocytes. Two-dimensional PAGE and monoclonal antibody assays showed that stage-specific lymphocyte gene products were essentially extinguished. The hybrid retained EC phenotype, tumorigenicity, and pluripotency. The authors propose that the lymphocyte genome is either silent or reprogrammed to an undetermined state that cooperates with the EC genome.

pmid-6535646.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌TC1Phとその由来胎児性癌株EC1Phを用い、17番染色体のT-H-2領域のみが異なるマウスへの移植拒絶を調べた1984年の研究です。組換え個体の解析から、EC組織適合性の2遺伝子モデルが提案されました。
pmid-6535646.summary_en: Teratocarcinoma TC1Ph and its derived embryonal carcinoma line EC1Ph were used as grafts in mice differing only in the T-H-2 region of chromosome 17. Analysis of exceptional recombinants supported a two-gene model for EC histocompatibility. The Cech-1 gene at the T end of the region is proposed to control expression of an EC histocompatibility gene near the H-2 complex.

pmid-6535647.summary_ja: 奇形癌幹細胞の発生調節抗原TEC-1、TEC-2、TEC-3を、変異株と抗体を用いて解析した1984年の研究です。TEC-1を欠く変異株の単離に成功し、TEC-1とTEC-2の発現は糖転移酵素または糖加水分解酵素の遺伝子変異に制御されている可能性が示されました。
pmid-6535647.summary_en: Monoclonal antibodies TEC-01, TEC-02, and TEC-03 defined three developmentally regulated antigens on teratocarcinoma stem cells. Using toxin-conjugated antibody selection on mutagenized P19 cells, mutants lacking TEC-1 were isolated. Lectin-resistant F9 and OTF9-63 lines showed reduced TEC-2 and/or TEC-3 expression. The findings suggest that glycosyltransferase or glycosidase gene mutations regulate TEC-1 and TEC-2 expression.

pmid-6540337.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAr細胞株を用い、アセチレン系アンドロステンジオン類似体MDL 18,962によるアロマターゼの時間依存的な不可逆阻害を検討した。阻害薬は低い見かけのKiを示し、除去後も長時間エストロゲン合成を抑制した。主に実験モデルとして絨毛癌細胞株が用いられており、腫瘍治療への示唆は限定的である。
pmid-6540337.summary_en: This study used JAr human choriocarcinoma trophoblast cells in culture to examine time-dependent, irreversible inhibition of aromatase by the acetylenic androstenedione analog MDL 18,962. The inhibitor showed a low apparent Ki and prolonged suppression of estrogen biosynthesis after removal from the medium. The work supports the feasibility of suicide inhibition of estrogen production in intact trophoblast cells, with the choriocarcinoma line serving mainly as an experimental model.

pmid-6541297.summary_ja: マウスおよびヒトのc-fos原癌遺伝子をF9奇形癌幹細胞(多能性の胎児性癌様細胞株)へ導入した。c-fosの発現に伴い、分化マーカーを発現する形態変化した細胞が出現した。この結果から、c-fosが細胞分化に関与することが示唆された。F9細胞は分化研究のモデル系として用いられており、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の研究ではない。
pmid-6541297.summary_en: The authors transferred mouse or human c-fos proto-oncogenes into F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells, a pluripotent embryonal carcinoma-like line. c-fos expression led to morphologically altered cells expressing several differentiation markers. The findings suggest that c-fos participates in cellular differentiation. The study uses F9 cells as a model system for differentiation rather than addressing germ cell tumor biology in patients.

pmid-6546970.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株と初期胚において、温熱負荷後の熱ショックタンパク質(HSP)合成を比較した研究。PCC7-S-1009細胞はレチノイン酸による分化後にHSP誘導能を回復した。初期胚では8細胞期に誘導が見られず、胚盤胞期に68kDa HSPが誘導された。胎児性癌は腫瘍学的な臨床課題ではなく胚発生モデルとして扱われている。
pmid-6546970.summary_en: This 1984 study examined heat shock protein synthesis after hyperthermia in several mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines and in early mouse embryos. Most lines induced HSPs normally, but PCC4-Aza R1 and PCC7-S-1009 did not. Inducibility of 68 and 105 kDa HSPs was restored in PCC7-S-1009 cells after retinoic acid-induced differentiation. In early embryos, induction of the 68 kDa HSP first appeared at the blastocyst stage. The authors propose that this transition in HSP expression may be a general feature of early embryonic cells.

pmid-6583853.summary_ja: マルチポテントなマウス奇形癌幹細胞のAPRT遺伝子座において、ヘテロ接合性とホモ接合性が高頻度に切り替わる現象を解析した遺伝学研究。切り替えは突然変異ではなく、遺伝子の不活化と再活性化によると結論づけている。奇形癌細胞は臨床腫瘍ではなく、実験モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-6583853.summary_en: This 1984 genetics study examines high-frequency reversible switching at the adenine phosphoribosyltransferase (APRT) locus in clones of multipotent mouse teratocarcinoma stem cells. Heterozygous clones segregated homozygous-deficient cells at about 10^-2, and these revertants gave rise to full mutants at similarly high frequency. Chromosomal changes were not associated with the transitions, and the enzymes showed no physical differences. The authors attribute switching to reversible gene inactivation and reactivation rather than mutation. The teratocarcinoma cells are a laboratory model rather than a clinical tumor study.

pmid-6585800.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞の分化に伴うDNAメチル化の変化を、試験管内と生体内で比較した基礎研究。試験管内の分化で約30%の脱メチル化が起こり、卵黄嚢と胎盤でも同様の低メチル化が見られた。一方、胚自体は初期発生中に新規メチル化を受けた。奇形癌細胞は発生モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-6585800.summary_en: This 1984 study compares DNA methylation changes during differentiation in mouse teratocarcinoma cells in vitro with those in vivo. In vitro differentiation caused about 30% genome-wide demethylation, and a similar undermethylation occurred in yolk sac and placenta. In contrast, the embryo itself underwent de novo methylation in early development. The authors conclude that DNA methylation varies widely during early mouse development, and its link to specific gene expression remains unclear. Teratocarcinoma cells serve as a developmental model.

pmid-6591443.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株6種に対する植物レクチン10種の細胞毒性を比較した研究。6種のレクチンが多くの細胞株に毒性を示し、糖鎖変異株の選択に有用とされた。細胞株ごとの感受性差は大きく、結合性と感受性は必ずしも一致しなかった。胎児性癌細胞は糖鎖研究のモデルとして用いられている。
pmid-6591443.summary_en: This 1984 study tested ten plant lectins for cytotoxicity against six mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines, including F9, PCC4, and P19. Six lectins were toxic to most lines at 100 micrograms/ml or less, supporting their use as selective agents for isolating glycosylation mutants. Sensitivity varied markedly between cell lines, especially with wheat germ agglutinin and GS-I. Lectin binding did not always correlate with sensitivity, suggesting distinct surface carbohydrate expression. The embryonal carcinoma lines serve as cell models for glycobiology.

pmid-6591444.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9およびOTF9-63を植物レクチンで選択し、表面糖鎖が変化した変異株を5種類同定した。SSEA-1抗体結合は変化せず、レチノイン酸処理で内胚葉様細胞へ分化した。患者研究ではなく、胎児性癌細胞の表面糖鎖に関する基礎研究である。
pmid-6591444.summary_en: This 1984 study isolated lectin-resistant mutants of mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines F9 and OTF9-63 using the plant lectins from Triticum vulgaris and Ricinus communis. Five distinct resistant phenotypes were identified based on sensitivity to four lectins and altered lectin-binding properties. None of the mutants changed binding to the SSEA-1 antibody. All formed aggregates in culture and differentiated into endoderm-like cells after retinoic acid exposure, although two lines showed altered morphology on plastic. The work characterizes surface glycoconjugate changes in pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cells as a model system.

pmid-6592032.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌（EC）細胞と赤白血病細胞（MEL）の5-メチルシトシン含量を測定した。EC細胞は分化により低メチル化し、α-1グロビン遺伝子はEC細胞で高メチル化、雑種細胞では脱メチル化していた。低メチル化と遺伝子発現の相関を支持する結果であり、患者の臨床研究ではない。
pmid-6592032.summary_en: This 1984 study measured 5-methylcytosine content in genomic DNA from differentiated and undifferentiated murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells and murine erythroleukemia (MEL) cells. EC cells showed higher methylation (4.6%) than MEL cells (3.3%), and methylation dropped after EC differentiation. The alpha-1 globin genes were heavily methylated in EC cells but demethylated in EC x MEL hybrids where they were expressed. The authors support a model in which hypomethylation correlates with gene expression, and note that DNase I sensitivity did not reliably indicate activity in pluripotent EC cells.

pmid-6592584.summary_ja: マウスの脳毛細血管内皮（MBE）と卵巣内皮（MOE）への、グリオーマ細胞と卵巣由来奇形腫細胞の接着性を比較した。奇形腫細胞はMOEに優先的に接着し、グリオーマ細胞はMBEに優先的に接着した。in vivoで卵巣指向性を示す精巣奇形腫もMOEに接着した。臓器特異的転移の理解につながる基礎研究である。
pmid-6592584.summary_en: This 1984 PNAS study compared adhesion of glioma cells and ovary-derived teratoma cells to capillary endothelial cells from mouse brain (MBE) or mouse ovary (MOE). Teratoma cells adhered preferentially to MOE cells, while glioma cells preferred MBE cells, and both adhered equally to fibroblasts. A testicular teratoma with ovary-seeking behavior in vivo also adhered preferentially to MOE cells. The findings suggest that endothelial cells from different organs differ in surface properties that tumor cells can distinguish, which may relate to organ-specific metastasis.

pmid-6593721.summary_ja: 未分化胎児性癌細胞株PCC4 aza 1に組換えレトロウイルスを感染させ、約1万個に数個の割合で転写されるプロウイルスを持つクローンを得た。クローンは未分化性を保持し、他の組込みプロウイルスは発現が抑制されていた。患者の臨床研究ではなく、多能性細胞でのウイルス発現に関する基礎研究である。
pmid-6593721.summary_en: This 1984 PNAS study infected the undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma line PCC4 aza 1 with a selectable amphotropic retrovirus. Roughly one in 5,000 to 10,000 recombinant proviruses was transcribed, yielding clones with about one intact provirus per cell. Viral RNA levels varied between clones, and transcription initiated and terminated in the long terminal repeats, as in differentiated cells. The clones remained undifferentiated and SSEA-1 positive, and other integrated proviruses stayed silent. The authors propose that the chromosomal integration site or viral control element mutations determine expression.

pmid-6599936.summary_ja: HGPRT欠損のマウス奇形癌細胞株と正常胸腺細胞の雑種を解析した。雑種の多くは低四倍体で、胸腺細胞抗原は発現せず、胎児性癌幹細胞成分を保持した。腫瘍原性とキメラ形成能は低下しており、胸腺細胞の再プログラムを示す証拠は得られなかった。
pmid-6599936.summary_en: This 1984 J Exp Pathol study examined hybrids between HGPRT-deficient mouse teratocarcinoma cells and normal thymocytes. The hybrids were mostly hypotetraploid, failed to express thymocyte antigens, and retained an embryonal carcinoma stem cell component with indefinite growth in vitro. They produced multilineage tumors with reduced tumorigenicity and suppressed chimerization potential, with no chimeras detected versus 18.5-19.2% for the EC parent. The results indicate partial suppression of the neoplastic phenotype by the thymocyte genome, without evidence of thymocyte reprogramming.

pmid-6692849.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来の内胚葉性細胞株PF HR-9から、同系マウスへの移植を繰り返して腫瘍形成性の細胞株を樹立した。クローン化された株は高度悪性で、時に転移を示した。腫瘍は IV型コラーゲン、ラミニン、ヘパラン硫酸プロテオグリカンを含む基底膜様の細胞外基質を豊富に産生した。基底膜や細胞骨格の生合成研究に有用な道具となる。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍ではなくマウスモデルを用いた研究である。
pmid-6692849.summary_en: Tumorigenic clonal endodermal cell lines were derived from the mouse teratocarcinoma-derived line PF HR-9 by repeated subcutaneous injection into syngeneic mice. The cloned sublines were highly malignant and occasionally metastasized. The tumors produced abundant laminated extracellular matrix containing type IV collagen, laminin and heparan sulfate proteoglycan. The sublines retained markers of the parent cells, including cytoskeletal proteins Endo A and B. The authors propose these lines as tools for studying basement membrane and cytoskeletal biosynthesis. The work uses a murine teratocarcinoma model rather than human germ cell tumors.

pmid-6692973.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞の細胞間接着を阻害するモノクローナル抗体ECCD-1を作製した。抗体の結合にはCa2+が必要で、無細胞系でも同様であった。ウエスタンブロットで複数の細胞表面タンパク質を認識し、主要な成分は分子量124,000であった。8細胞期のマウス胚や胎児組織の上皮細胞にも反応した。本研究は奇形癌細胞をモデルとした基礎的な細胞生物学の研究である。
pmid-6692973.summary_en: A monoclonal antibody, ECCD-1, was generated that disrupts Ca2+-dependent cell-cell adhesion in mouse teratocarcinoma cells. It binds only when the adhesion system is intact and requires Ca2+ for binding, even in cell-free assays. Western blotting showed that it recognizes multiple surface proteins, with a major component of 124 kDa. The antibody also reacts with 8-cell mouse embryos and with epithelial cells across fetal tissues, affecting their adhesion. The authors show that it recognizes the same antigens as antibody DE1, raised against gp84. The study is basic cell biology using murine teratocarcinoma cells as a model.

pmid-6695326.summary_ja: 日本人乳児に生じた先天性大泉門類皮嚢腫の症例を報告し、日本人での6例目とした。文献的考察から、大泉門の類皮嚢腫は黒人に多く発生するわけではないという見解を支持している。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫と分類されることもあるが、本論文は胚細胞腫瘍そのものを扱うものではない。
pmid-6695326.summary_en: This case report describes a congenital dermoid cyst over the anterior fontanel in a Japanese infant, noted as the sixth reported case in Japanese patients. The authors review the literature and support the concept that anterior fontanel dermoid cysts do not occur predominantly in Black individuals.
