Dermoid cysts are developmental ectodermal inclusions that are sometimes grouped with mature teratomas. However, this paper addresses a congenital scalp-region lesion rather than a neoplastic germ cell tumor, so its relevance to germ cell tumors is only loosely connected and uncertain.

pmid-6703601.summary_ja: 1984年の病理学的考察で、頭頸部の発生性腫瘍の命名法を扱う。過誤腫、迷入腫、胎児腫、奇形腫、類皮嚢腫は、それぞれ異なる組織発生と臨床病理像をもつ別個の腫瘍であると論じる。現在の用法では同義に扱われがちだが、診断名は互換的ではなく、正確な分類のために用語の厳密な使い分けが重要だと指摘している。定量的な症例データは含まれない。
pmid-6703601.summary_en: This 1984 pathology consultation article addresses the nomenclature of developmental tumors of the head and neck. It argues that terms such as hamartoma, choristoma, embryoma, teratoma and dermoid denote distinct entities, each with its own histogenesis and clinicopathologic presentation. Because these diagnoses are not interchangeable, precise terminology matters for accurate classification, even though current usage often treats them as synonymous. The paper is a brief commentary rather than a case series and offers no quantitative outcome data.

pmid-6714323.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来のPCC3細胞を用いて、細胞表面タンパク質を認識するモノクローナル抗体ECCD-1の作用を検討した研究である。ルシファーイエローによる色素移行解析で、ECCD-1が細胞間の色素移行を阻害することを示した。Ca2+依存性の細胞接着系がギャップ結合の機能に必須であると示唆される。
pmid-6714323.summary_en: The monoclonal antibody ECCD-1, which recognizes certain cell surface proteins, was tested for effects on cell-to-cell communication in PCC3 teratocarcinoma stem cells. Using transfer of lucifer yellow dye between cells in colonies, the authors found that ECCD-1 inhibits dye transfer. This suggests that the Ca2+-dependent cell adhesion system is essential for gap junction function. The work is basic cell biology using an embryonal carcinoma-derived line rather than a tumor-focused clinical study.

pmid-6724137.summary_ja: LT-1奇形癌幹細胞では、未分化状態で両X染色体が活性を示す。試験管内分化に伴ってX不活性化が起こり、細胞遺伝学的変化と生化学的変化は時間的によく対応する。ただし、形態学的分化を伴わなくても不活性化が起こらない場合もあった。
pmid-6724137.summary_en: In LT-1 teratocarcinoma stem cells, both X chromosomes are active in the undifferentiated state. X inactivation occurs during in vitro differentiation, with a close temporal correlation between cytogenetic and biochemical changes. However, inactivation does not always accompany morphological differentiation. The study uses these embryonal-type stem cells as a model of X-chromosome dosage compensation.

pmid-11892798.summary_ja: 2株の胎児性癌細胞株(1003、1009)を試験管内で神経系の細胞へ誘導した。二次元電気泳動により、神経分化に特異的な変化として新しいβ-チューブリンのアイソフォームと、クレアチンキナーゼの脳型アイソザイムの蓄積を同定した。これらの変化は分化の初期に生じ、神経突起の伸長を阻害した場合でも認められた。胎児性癌細胞の神経系への分化過程を追う指標となりうる。
pmid-11892798.summary_en: Two embryonal carcinoma cell lines, 1003 and 1009, were induced to form neural derivatives in vitro. Two-dimensional gel electrophoresis identified two changes specific to the neural pathway: the appearance of a new beta-tubulin isoform and accumulation of the brain isozyme of creatine phosphokinase. Both changes occurred early in differentiation, even when neurite outgrowth was blocked. These markers may help track neural lineage commitment of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-11894922.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞は、ストレスがなくても89、70、59kDaの熱ショックタンパク質を高発現しており、線維芽細胞とは異なる性質を示した。F9細胞をレチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPで分化させると、これら熱ショックタンパク質は減少し、ヒ素による105kDaポリペプチドの誘導能が回復した。同様の熱ショックタンパク質は初期マウス胚にも見られ、胎児性癌細胞と内部細胞塊の類似性が示唆される。
pmid-11894922.summary_en: Mouse embryonal carcinoma cells constitutively express high levels of heat-shock proteins (89, 70, and 59 kd) without stress, unlike fibroblasts. The 89 kd and 59 kd proteins are not induced by arsenite, and arsenite instead induces a 105 kd polypeptide in fibroblasts but not in EC cells. Retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP differentiation of F9 cells reduces heat-shock protein abundance and restores arsenite-induced 105 kd synthesis. The same proteins appear in the early mouse embryo, suggesting a link to the inner cell mass.

pmid-37282063.summary_ja: ヒト白血病細胞に対して作製されたモノクローナルIgM抗体C-9-1について、マウス胚および成体組織における分布を検討した。抗原は胚の限られた部位や一部の成体組織に検出され、奇形癌では胎児性癌細胞が発現したが内胚葉細胞は発現しなかった。分布はSSEA-1に類似していたが、着床前胚と卵管では異なっていた。奇形癌は本研究で用いられた実験系の一つである。
pmid-37282063.summary_en: This study characterized C-9-1, a monoclonal IgM antibody raised against human null cell leukemia cells, in mouse embryos and adult tissues. The antigen appeared in restricted embryonic sites, including primordial germ cells and trophoblast, and in several adult tissues. In teratocarcinomas, embryonal carcinoma cells expressed the antigen whereas endodermal cells did not. The distribution resembled SSEA-1 but differed in preimplantation embryos and oviduct. Teratocarcinoma is one of the experimental systems used.

pmid-6132479.summary_ja: 67歳男性の、非下降性腹腔内精巣に発生したセミノーマの症例報告です。報告時点で、この病態の最高齢例と考えられています。すべての年齢で日常診察時に精巣を丁寧に触診することの重要性が示されました。後腹膜腫瘤の鑑別診断には精巣腫瘍や転移も含めるべきとされています。
pmid-6132479.summary_en: The authors describe a 67-year-old man with a seminoma arising in an undescended intra-abdominal testis, believed to be the oldest reported patient with this presentation. The case highlights the importance of careful testicular palpation during routine examination at any age. The authors also note that testicular tumor or metastases should be included in the differential diagnosis of a retroperitoneal mass. The report is a single case with teaching value for urologists and clinicians evaluating retroperitoneal masses.

pmid-6133895.summary_ja: 本研究は、生体内で継代したマウス402AX奇形癌細胞のH-2 MHC抗原発現が、脾臓リンパ球の亜集団によってどう調節されるかを検討したものです。感受性宿主では未分化腫瘍細胞はMHC抗原を欠きますが、抵抗性マウスではH-2b陽性になります。脾臓のIg陰性細胞が最も有効で、骨髄単独では不十分でした。
pmid-6133895.summary_en: This study examined how splenic lymphoid subpopulations regulate H-2 MHC antigen expression on murine 402AX teratocarcinoma cells passaged in vivo. Undifferentiated tumor cells lack MHC antigens in susceptible hosts but become H-2b positive in resistant mice. Using monoclonal antibodies and reconstitution experiments, splenic Ig-negative cells were the most efficient inducers, while bone marrow alone was insufficient. Impaired induction in beige mice suggests NK cells may contribute. The work is an immunology study using a murine germ cell tumor model.

pmid-6135502.summary_ja: 本二重盲検研究では、セミノーマ患者89例で胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)、γ-GT、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を測定しました。活動性腫瘍を有する30例のうち、PLAP高値は40%、GGT高値は33%でした。臨床的に活動性の腫瘍を有する患者の80%で、いずれかのマーカーが検出されました。
pmid-6135502.summary_en: This double-blind study measured placental alkaline phosphatase, gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase, hCG, and AFP in 89 patients with seminoma. Among 30 patients with active tumor, 40 percent had elevated PLAP and 33 percent had elevated GGT. Overall, 80 percent of patients with clinically active tumors had at least one detectable marker. Because markers are scarce in seminoma, serial measurement may aid detection and monitoring. The authors caution that false-positive and false-negative rates and marker half-lives must be considered.

pmid-6136438.summary_ja: 3世代にわたり良性嚢胞性奇形腫が認められた家系を報告しています。家族内発生と、双胎や三つ子での奇形腫の発生から、遺伝的素因と単為発生による起源が示唆されました。良性嚢胞性奇形腫は遺伝的に規定された腫瘍である可能性があると提案されています。
pmid-6136438.summary_en: The authors describe a family with benign cystic teratomas across three successive generations, a pattern they note had not been reported before. Familial occurrence and the occurrence of teratomas in twins and triplets suggest an inherited predisposition and support a parthenogenetic origin. The authors propose that benign cystic teratomas may be tumors whose origin is genetically controlled. The report is a small familial case description focused on teratoma etiology.

pmid-6136609.summary_ja: 陰嚢内精巣疾患（精巣捻転・停留精巣）の男性で精液所見と内分泌機能を評価した。精巣腫瘍（セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性）36例では精巣摘除術前に評価し、HCG陽性腫瘍ではFSHの低下と17β-エストラジオール・プロラクチンの上昇がみられた。精液異常は精巣機能障害を反映する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6136609.summary_en: This study assessed exocrine and endocrine testicular function in men with unilateral testicular disease, including torsion and cryptorchidism, and in 36 patients with seminomas and non-seminomatous testicular tumours before orchiectomy. Seminal analysis was normal in only one patient, an HCG-negative seminoma case. Men with HCG-positive tumours showed decreased FSH and elevated 17-beta-oestradiol and prolactin. Elevated FSH was seen in patients with abnormal or equivocal semen parameters after torsion or orchidopexy. The findings suggest that pretreatment hormonal and seminal assessment may reflect tumour-related testicular dysfunction.

pmid-6137429.summary_ja: SSEA-1を発現しない変異型胎児性癌（EC）細胞株を単離し、その性質を解析した。SSEA-1の発現は約500分の1に低下し、マウスでは胎児性癌細胞のみからなる奇形癌を形成した。レチノイン酸処理で壁側・臓側内胚葉様細胞への分化能も保持されており、ECの表現型の多くはSSEA-1に依存しないことが示された。
pmid-6137429.summary_en: Researchers isolated a variant embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell line lacking SSEA-1 antigen by mutagenesis of OTF9-63 cells followed by antibody-complement selection. The variant showed a roughly 500-fold reduction in SSEA-1 expression, attributed to antigen loss rather than masking. It remained tumorigenic in syngeneic mice, forming teratocarcinomas composed solely of EC cells. Upon retinoic acid treatment it formed parietal endoderm in monolayer and visceral endoderm in suspension, and it still formed embryoid bodies. The study shows that several EC phenotypic features do not depend on SSEA-1.

pmid-6137898.summary_ja: 雄性核型の胎児性癌細胞株を樹立し、静脈内投与後の局在を解析した。雌マウスでは卵巣と副腎に、雄マウスでは副腎に選択的に転移した。雄では生着率が低く腫瘍形成も遅く、ホルモンによる増殖調節の関与が示唆された。特定臓器への転移に性ホルモンが関与する可能性を示した点が特徴である。
pmid-6137898.summary_en: Investigators established a karyotypically male embryonal carcinoma cell line from a chromosomally male embryo-derived teratocarcinoma and adapted it to growth without feeder cells. After intravenous injection into adult mice, the uncloned line and its clones selectively localized to the ovaries and adrenals in females, but only to the adrenals in males. Tumour take was lower and tumour formation slower in males than in females. The authors propose that growth of this male-karyotype EC line may be hormonally regulated.

pmid-6137993.summary_ja: 一家系の非双生児の3兄弟に停留精巣と精巣腫瘍が併発した症例を報告した。セミノーマ2例と胎児性癌1例で、腫瘍マーカーはいずれも陰性であった。停留精巣では定期的な触診や生検による積極的なスクリーニングを推奨し、早期診断により予後は良好とされる。
pmid-6137993.summary_en: The authors describe three non-twin brothers in one family with simultaneous cryptorchidism and testicular tumour: two had seminoma and one had embryonal carcinoma. Serum tumour markers, including alpha-fetoprotein, beta-hCG and CEA, were negative in all three. The paper notes that familial co-occurrence of cryptorchidism and testicular tumour had not been reported before. It recommends aggressive screening by serial palpation or biopsy in cryptorchid patients, and testosterone replacement after bilateral orchiectomy in pubertal patients. It notes a good prognosis with early diagnosis.

pmid-6139754.summary_ja: F9奇形癌（胎児性癌）細胞をレチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPで長期培養すると神経フィラメントが発現した。さらに神経成長因子を加えると、チロシン水酸化酵素陽性のアドレナリン作動性様細胞が出現した。Leu-エンケファリン様ペプチドの発現も誘導され、F9細胞は神経分化のモデルとして有用であることが示唆された。
pmid-6139754.summary_en: This study examined differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma (embryonal carcinoma) cells. Long-term culture with retinoic acid and dibutyryl cyclic AMP induced neurofilament expression. Adding nerve growth factor further produced cells immunoreactive for tyrosine hydroxylase, a marker of adrenergic neurons, and for Leu-enkephalin-like peptides. The findings indicate that F9 cells can differentiate into cells with adrenergic characteristics, supporting their use as a model of neural differentiation in vertebrates.

pmid-6139790.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株におけるγ-グルタミルトランスペプチダーゼ(GGT)の生合成を解析した。短時間標識では80,000ダルトンの前駆体が検出され、長時間標識では消失して重鎖・軽鎖サブユニットが残った。ツニカマイシン処理により、この前駆体は糖鎖付加を受けて蓄積することが示された。
pmid-6139790.summary_en: The authors studied biosynthesis of gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT) in a yolk sac tumour cell line using radiolabelling, immunoprecipitation and SDS-PAGE. A radioactive 80,000-dalton species was detected after short labelling and disappeared after longer labelling, while heavy and light subunits persisted. Tunicamycin pretreatment showed that the 80,000-dalton species was glycosylated and accumulated when processing was blocked. These results support the existence of a glycosylated precursor form of GGT in cultured yolk sac tumour cells.

pmid-6140246.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣があり右精巣に悪性変化を生じた20歳男性が、S状結腸に転移性腫瘍を発症した症例報告である。停留精巣に生じた精巣がんが、消化管などの非典型的部位へ転移しうることを示す。組織型、治療、経過の記載は要旨には含まれていない。
pmid-6140246.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with bilateral cryptorchidism and malignant change in the right testicle, who developed a metastatic tumour in the sigmoid colon. The report highlights that cancer arising in an undescended testis can metastasise to unusual sites such as the gastrointestinal tract, underscoring the malignant potential associated with cryptorchidism. The abstract does not provide histology, treatment details or follow-up.

pmid-6140547.summary_ja: X連鎖性魚鱗癬でステロイドスルファターゼ(STS)欠損症を有する2例に精巣がんを認めた。著者らは、STS欠損が停留精巣と精巣がんの両方の素因となる可能性を提唱している。遺伝的酵素欠損と精巣がんの関連を示す知見である。
pmid-6140547.summary_en: This letter reports two patients with recessive X-linked ichthyosis and steroid sulphatase (STS) deficiency who were also found to have testis cancer. The authors propose that STS deficiency may predispose individuals both to cryptorchidism and to testis cancer, linking a genetic enzyme deficiency with two known risk conditions for testis cancer. This may be relevant to genetic screening or risk assessment in men with ichthyosis or cryptorchidism.

pmid-6141081.summary_ja: 1977〜1981年にヨルダン大学病院で9,037分娩中、卵巣腫瘍を合併した妊婦10例を検討した。発生頻度は約900分娩に1例であった。最多は良性の嚢胞性奇形腫で、次いで粘液性嚢胞腺腫であった。Burkittリンパ腫の1例を除き、腫瘍はすべて良性であった。
pmid-6141081.summary_en: This study reviewed ten pregnant patients with ovarian tumours among 9,037 deliveries at Jordan University Hospital from 1977 to 1981, an incidence of about 1 in 900 deliveries. Benign cystic teratomas were the most common tumours, followed by mucinous cystadenomas. All tumours were benign except one case of Burkitt's lymphoma. The paper offers epidemiologic data on ovarian tumours complicating pregnancy at a single institution.

pmid-6141938.summary_ja: 2種のモノクローナル抗体(MC631、MC813-70)は、マウス胚とヒト奇形癌腫細胞株2102Epを免疫原として作製され、胚性抗原SSEA-3およびSSEA-4を規定する独特のグロボ系ガングリオシドを認識する。2102Ep細胞の分化に伴いグロボ系糖脂質は減少し、ラクト系糖脂質が出現した。これは奇形癌腫および着床前胚の分化における糖脂質合成の移行を示唆する。
pmid-6141938.summary_en: Two monoclonal antibodies, MC631 and MC813-70, were raised against mouse 4- to 8-cell embryos and the human teratocarcinoma line 2102Ep. They define the embryonic antigens SSEA-3 and SSEA-4, which correspond to a unique globo-series ganglioside. MC813-70 recognizes the terminal 'a' structure and MC631 the internal 'b' structure. During differentiation of 2102Ep cells, globo-series glycolipids decline while lacto-series glycolipids reacting with SSEA-1 appear, suggesting a glycolipid synthesis shift during differentiation of teratocarcinoma and preimplantation embryos.

pmid-6145341.summary_ja: 停留精巣に由来した精巣腫瘍の5症例を報告する。うち1例は、肺葉切除を含む集学的治療により3年間の完全寛解を得た。本邦文献では、停留精巣由来の精巣腫瘍が182例、精巣固定術後に生じた精巣腫瘍が29例と報告されていた。停留精巣の悪性化リスクが強調されている。
pmid-6145341.summary_en: Five cases of testicular tumors arising from cryptorchid testes are reported. One patient achieved complete remission for 3 years after multidisciplinary therapy including lobectomy. A review of Japanese literature identified 182 cases of testicular tumor originating from cryptorchid testes and 29 cases occurring after orchidopexy. The report highlights the malignancy risk associated with cryptorchidism.

pmid-6184742.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の肺転移巣は、シスプラチン併用化学療法後も残存することがある。治療中にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)やhCGが正常化していた場合、この残存結節は残存癌と誤解されうる。切除標本の約25%に成熟奇形腫が認められ、病理学的な悪性の確認が推奨される。
pmid-6184742.summary_en: Pulmonary nodules from testicular germ cell cancer can persist after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. If tumor markers AFP and hCG have normalized, these residual lesions may be misread as residual cancer. Mature teratoma is found in about 25% of resected specimens. The authors recommend pathologic confirmation of malignancy before interpreting residual nodules as active disease.

pmid-6185197.summary_ja: 病期III、または巨大病変を伴う病期IIの精巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の男性36例に、維持療法なしでVAB-6療法を施行した(評価可能34例)。31例(91%)が完全寛解に達し、28例が24か月以上の観察で寛解を維持した。化学療法単独は、転移が少ない例、純粋セミノーマ、原発巣に奇形腫を含まない例で最も有効であった。骨髄抑制が主な重篤な毒性で、維持化学療法は不要と結論された。
pmid-6185197.summary_en: Thirty-six men with stage III or bulky stage II testicular malignant germ cell tumors received VAB-6 without maintenance; 34 were evaluable. Thirty-one (91%) achieved complete remission, and 28 remained in remission at a median follow-up of over 24 months. Chemotherapy alone was most effective for minimal metastatic disease, pure seminoma, and tumors without teratoma in the primary. Myelosuppression was the main serious toxicity, and maintenance chemotherapy was deemed unnecessary.

pmid-6185202.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜リンパ節転移が、化学療法により成熟化するかを検討した。化学療法群では分化型奇形腫のみからなる転移が増加したが、原発巣より分化型成分は少なかった。非奇形腫成分は化学療法でほぼ消失しており、薬剤による分化誘導ではなく選択的破壊が示唆された。
pmid-6185202.summary_en: This study examined whether chemotherapy induces maturation of retroperitoneal lymph node metastases from nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Chemotherapy increased metastases consisting only of differentiated teratoma, but these metastases still contained fewer differentiated areas than primary tumors. Non-teratomatous components were largely eradicated by chemotherapy. The findings suggest selective destruction of components rather than induction of differentiation by the drugs.

pmid-6185211.summary_ja: 予後不良因子を有する非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の評価可能な38例に、強化型VAB-5療法を施行した。18例が無腫瘍状態となり、完全寛解例のうち14例が中央値50か月で無病生存を維持した。原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の8例では完全寛解は得られなかった。腎機能障害や重度の口内炎などの毒性が報告された。
pmid-6185211.summary_en: Thirty-eight evaluable patients with poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors were treated with the intensified VAB-5 regimen. Eighteen became free of disease, and 14 of 18 complete responders remained alive and disease-free at a median of 50 months. Complete remission occurred in 13 of 15 testicular tumor patients without prior chemotherapy, but in none of eight with primary extragonadal tumors. Toxicities included transient renal dysfunction and severe mucositis.

pmid-6185280.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマの治療を検討した総説である。従来は放射線療法が初期治療であったが、患者の25〜40%は治癒しない。症例報告の検討から、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンは転移性疾患や胸郭内進行例、非セミノーマ成分を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍に有効と示された。腫瘍マーカーと化学療法を病期分類と治療に統合すべきと結論している。
pmid-6185280.summary_en: This review examines management of primary mediastinal seminoma. Radiation therapy has been the usual initial treatment, but 25 to 40 percent of patients are not cured. Reviewed case reports suggest vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin are effective for metastatic disease, advanced intrathoracic disease, and mixed germ cell tumors with nonseminomatous elements. The authors conclude that tumor markers and chemotherapy should be integrated into staging and therapy.

pmid-6185541.summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者の尿中に出現するヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)β鎖のカルボキシ末端フラグメントを解析した。見かけ分子量約14,200のフラグメントは、アスパラギン結合型糖鎖を欠くが、カルボキシ末端とO結合型糖鎖を保持していた。絨毛癌患者11例中10例で検出され、正常者へのhCG静注後や正期妊娠では検出されないか微量であった。
pmid-6185541.summary_en: Low-molecular-weight carboxyterminal fragments of the hCG beta subunit were characterized in the urine of women with choriocarcinoma. One fragment of about 14,200 apparent molecular weight lacked asparagine-linked carbohydrate but retained the carboxyterminus and O-linked sugars. Such fragments appeared in 10 of 11 choriocarcinoma patients but not after exogenous hCG infusion in normal subjects, and only in trace amounts in a term pregnancy.

pmid-6185897.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ61例と非セミノーマ113例を、組織型、病期、血清マーカーに基づいて管理した報告である。セミノーマと大半の奇形腫ではマーカーは通常正常で、連続測定が治療の指標となることはまれであった。悪性転化を伴う奇形腫などではマーカーの上昇が予後不良を示した。マーカーは画像診断と同程度に鋭敏で、持続的または上昇する値は治療抵抗性や再発を示すとされた。
pmid-6185897.summary_en: Sixty-one seminoma and 113 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients were managed by histology, stage, and serum markers (CEA, AFP, hCG, hPL, SP1). Markers were usually normal in seminoma and most teratomas, and serial measurements rarely guided therapy. Elevated markers were prognostically important in teratoma with malignant transformation, choriocarcinoma, endodermal sinus tumor, and embryonal carcinoma with admixtures. Elevated markers were as sensitive as imaging for monitoring, and persistent or rising levels indicated resistance or recurrence.

pmid-6186542.summary_ja: 奇形癌幹細胞の凝集塊を用い、N結合型糖鎖合成阻害薬ツニカマイシンの影響を検討した基礎研究。一次内胚葉様細胞の形成は保たれたが、終末分化は阻害され、基底膜形成とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)産生が見られなかった。阻害は薬剤除去後に可逆的であった。内胚葉の終末分化にはN結合型糖タンパク質が必要であることが示された。
pmid-6186542.summary_en: This in vitro study examines how tunicamycin, an inhibitor of N-linked glycosylation, affects the differentiation of teratocarcinoma stem cell aggregates into endoderm. Tunicamycin allowed formation of primary endoderm-like cells but blocked terminal differentiation: parietal endoderm basement membrane deposition and alpha-fetoprotein production were absent. The inhibition was reversible after drug removal. The findings indicate that terminal endodermal differentiation depends on N-linked glycoproteins, offering insight into the developmental biology underlying germ cell tumor differentiation.

pmid-6187426.summary_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ精巣がん10例(未治療6例、白金製剤治療後再発4例)に対し、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、VP-16による強力な4剤併用療法PVeBVを実施した。未治療例は全例完全寛解、再発例も全例で奏効した。骨髄抑制は強いが治療関連死や腎毒性(低マグネシウム血症以外)は認めなかった。
pmid-6187426.summary_en: This report describes PVeBV, an intensive four-drug regimen of cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin, and etoposide, given to ten patients with poor-prognosis nonseminomatous testicular cancer: six untreated and four relapsed after platinum-based therapy. High-dose cisplatin was delivered in hypertonic saline. All six untreated patients achieved complete remission, and all four relapsed patients responded. Myelosuppression was severe, but no treatment-related deaths or renal toxicity beyond hypomagnesemia occurred. The authors conclude PVeBV is promising and that high-dose cisplatin may warrant evaluation in other tumors.

pmid-6187445.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌由来のヒト胎児性癌クローン細胞株2102Epを電子顕微鏡と免疫組織化学で解析した。高密度培養では大部分が未分化で、多くがケラチンを含んでいた。低密度では細胞形態が複雑化し、一部はhCG抗体に反応して栄養膜様への分化が示唆された。マウス胎児性癌との類似点と相違点も指摘された。
pmid-6187445.summary_en: The authors characterized a cloned human embryonal carcinoma cell line, 2102Ep, derived from a testicular teratocarcinoma, using electron microscopy and immunohistochemistry. At high density cells remained largely undifferentiated, with most containing keratin filaments. At low density, cells displayed more complex morphology, intracytoplasmic keratin bundles, and some reacted with anti-hCG antibodies, suggesting trophoblastic differentiation. Morula-like aggregates also formed. The authors note both similarities and important differences from mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, highlighting species-specific features of human germ cell tumor models.

pmid-6187872.summary_ja: 当施設で管理した卵巣未熟奇形腫16例を後方視的に検討した。Thurlbeck-Scullyの基準で組織学的グレード分類を行い、AFP染色で混合型胚細胞腫瘍を除外した。組織学的グレードは予後と相関し、グレード3の患者は全員死亡した。グリア芽腫成分を含む症例が最も急速に進行した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は2例で上昇したが、臨床経過との関連は乏しかった。
pmid-6187872.summary_en: A review of sixteen cases of ovarian immature teratoma managed at the authors' institution. Tumors were graded histologically using the Thurlbeck and Scully criteria, and AFP immunostaining was used to exclude mixed germ cell tumors. Ten patients remained alive without recurrence, and no grade 3 patient survived, suggesting histologic grade correlated with prognosis. A tumor containing glioblastoma elements had the most fulminant course. Serum AFP was elevated in two cases but was not clearly associated with clinical course. The authors favor more aggressive surgery followed by combination chemotherapy.

pmid-6187944.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療方針を論じている。病期I・IIでは放射線療法の成績は良好だが、進行例の生存率は約40%にとどまる。転移性セミノーマ6例に全身化学療法を行い全例で完全奏効を得た。既照射例でもVP-16とシスプラチンで完全奏効が得られたが、骨髄抑制は増強した。転移性や巨大後腹膜病変には多剤化学療法と減量手術を推奨している。
pmid-6187944.summary_en: The authors discuss management of advanced seminomatous germ cell tumors. Radiotherapy yields excellent results in stages I and II, but survival in advanced disease is only about 40 percent. Six consecutive patients with metastatic seminoma treated with systemic chemotherapy all achieved complete response, including patients with prior radiation. VP-16 with cisplatin produced complete responses in previously irradiated patients, though myelosuppression was potentiated. The authors recommend multidrug chemotherapy and cytoreductive surgery for metastatic or bulky retroperitoneal disease, and suggest radiotherapy may be ineffective and may compromise chemotherapy benefit.

pmid-6188011.summary_ja: 1979年から1982年にPOMB/ACE逐次併用化学療法を完遂した転移性悪性奇形腫69例を報告。約3分の2が進行または巨大病変であったが、推定生存率は83%だった。多変量解析では病変の範囲よりも、初診時のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)濃度が生存の最も強い予測因子であった。hCG 50,000 IU/L未満かつAFP 500 kU/L未満の患者では生存率96%、腫瘍マーカーが高値の例では56%だった。
pmid-6188011.summary_en: A report of 69 men with metastatic malignant teratoma who completed sequential combination chemotherapy (POMB/ACE) between 1979 and 1982. Two-thirds initially had advanced or bulky disease, yet life-table survival was projected at 83 percent. Multivariate analysis showed that initial serum hCG and AFP concentrations, rather than clinical extent of disease, were the strongest predictors of survival. Patients with hCG below 50,000 IU/l and AFP below 500 kU/l had 96 percent survival, compared with 56 percent for those with higher tumor marker levels.

pmid-6188320.summary_ja: 純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍8例を、妊娠5～13週のヒト卵黄嚢8例と組織学的に比較した。マグマ網と好酸性硝子様小体が共通に認められ、腫瘍細胞の一部はヒト卵黄嚢の内胚葉細胞に類似し、AFPの形態と合成も類似していた。AFP高値の卵巣腺癌と胃腺癌も同様の細胞パターンを示したため、著者らは内胚葉細胞腫瘍(ECT)という名称を提案した。AFP高値の卵巣胚細胞癌や奇形癌には、卵黄嚢成分が含まれることが多いことも明らかになった。
pmid-6188320.summary_en: The authors compared histological features of eight pure endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors with eight human yolk sacs from 5 to 13 weeks gestation. Shared features included magma reticulare and eosinophilic hyaline globules, while tumor cells lining sinus structures resembled human yolk sac endoderm in morphology and AFP synthesis. Two tumors with high AFP, an ovarian and a gastric adenocarcinoma, showed similar cell patterns, leading the authors to propose the term endodermal cell tumor. They also found ovarian embryonal carcinoma with high AFP often had vitelline (yolk sac) components.

pmid-6188436.summary_ja: 女児に多い仙尾部奇形腫15例で、通常の組織学的検討に加え、CEA、AFP、hCGを免疫組織化学で検索した。良性上皮ではCEAとAFPがそれぞれ82%、53%に陽性だった。胚細胞成分が3例で認められ、うち2例では局所的にCEAとAFPが陽性だった。抗原の有無は腫瘍グレードと相関しなかった。再発が疑われる奇形腫では、どの血清マーカーを測定すべきかの判断に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-6188436.summary_en: Fifteen sacrococcygeal teratomas, mostly in female infants, were examined by immunoperoxidase for CEA, AFP, and hCG alongside routine histology. CEA and AFP were commonly present in benign epithelium, at 82 and 53 percent, respectively. Germ cell components were identified in three tumors, two of which were focally positive for both CEA and AFP. Antigen presence did not correlate with tumor grade. The authors suggest oncofetal antigen staining may help select which serum marker to monitor in patients with suspected recurrent teratoma.

pmid-6188528.summary_ja: 病期III非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍253例を対象に、組織型と臨床因子の関連を検討した。原発巣の側や停留精巣との有意な関連はなかった。絨毛癌成分は後腹膜腫瘍と関連し、hCG高値を示した。一方、AFP、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)、CEAは組織型と相関しなかった。併用療法への完全奏効や生存率も組織型で差がなく、予後因子としての重要性は低いと結論された。
pmid-6188528.summary_en: A study of 253 patients with stage III nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis examined relationships between histopathologic cell type and clinical variables. Cell type showed no significant association with the side of the primary tumor or cryptorchidism. Choriocarcinoma elements were associated with retroperitoneal tumor, and elevated hCG occurred in those patients, while AFP, LDH and CEA did not correlate with cell type. Neither response to combined modality therapy nor survival differed by cell type, suggesting cell type is not a major prognostic variable.

pmid-6189504.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍43例（非セミノーマ36例、セミノーマ7例）にBEP療法を2〜6サイクル施行した。93%が生存し、86%が無病であった。放射線療法歴のない非セミノーマでは89%が生存・無病であった。BEP療法は忍容性が良好で、有効な初回治療であると結論された。
pmid-6189504.summary_en: This 1983 report describes 43 patients with metastatic germ-cell tumours, 36 testicular non-seminomas and 7 testicular seminomas, treated with two to six cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin (BEP). Ninety-three percent were alive and 86% had no evidence of disease. Among non-seminoma patients without prior irradiation, 89% were alive and disease-free. All seven seminoma patients were alive and disease-free. The authors conclude that BEP is well tolerated and an effective first-line treatment.

pmid-6189512.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎31例で治療前の胎盤蛋白(hCG、SP1、PP5、PAPP-A)を測定した。後に絨毛癌へ進展した7例のうち3例は肺転移を伴った。SP1が16.5 IU/l以上であると悪性化の頻度が高く、感度は100%であったが特異度は45.8%であった。
pmid-6189512.summary_en: This study measured four placental proteins (hCG, SP1, PP5, PAPP-A) in 31 patients with hydatidiform mole before treatment. Seven later developed choriocarcinoma, three of them with pulmonary metastases. hCG, PP5 and PAPP-A had no predictive value. Elevated SP1 (16.5 IU/l or more) was associated with subsequent malignancy, with 100% sensitivity but 45.8% specificity and 35% predictive value, suggesting SP1 may help identify high-risk moles.

pmid-6189602.summary_ja: 従来の化学療法に抵抗性を示した妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の2例に、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン（VBP療法）を施行した。両例とも完全寛解し、20か月および33か月後も無病であった。予後不良例の二次治療として有用と結論された。
pmid-6189602.summary_en: Two patients with resistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasms had failed multiple regimens, including methotrexate, dactinomycin, high-dose methotrexate and modified Bagshawe therapy. Both achieved complete remission with vinblastine, bleomycin and cisplatin (VBP, the Einhorn regimen) and remained disease-free at 20 and 33 months. The authors conclude that VBP is highly active and should be used as second-line therapy for poor-prognosis patients who fail initial treatment.

pmid-6189659.summary_ja: 転移性精巣奇形腫の患者14例を対象に、ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン(±シスプラチン)による化学療法4クールの経過中の栄養状態を縦断的に調べた。各クールで体重とレチノール、ビタミンE・B1・B6が低下し、クール間で完全には回復しなかった。レチノールの低下はRBPの減少と相関した。
pmid-6189659.summary_en: This longitudinal clinical study followed 14 patients with metastatic testicular teratoma through four courses of chemotherapy with vinblastine and bleomycin, with or without cisplatin. Patients lost weight during each course and did not fully recover between courses. Plasma retinol and vitamins E, B1 and B6 declined during each course, and the retinol decrease correlated with falling retinol-binding protein. Retinol recovered by the fourth course on the vinblastine-bleomycin regimen, possibly from improved RBP synthesis, whereas vitamin B1 status did not improve overall.

pmid-6189719.summary_ja: stage I-IIの精巣胎児性癌患者11例で、シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン併用療法中の血管透過性と肺機能を測定した。ブレオマイシンは最大耐容量(270 mg/m2)が投与されたが、肺機能と血管からのアルブミン漏出速度は変化しなかった。治療前に低値であった血管内アルブミン量は正常化した。
pmid-6189719.summary_en: This study measured pulmonary function, transcapillary albumin escape rate, plasma volume and intravascular albumin mass in 11 patients with stage I-II testicular embryonal carcinoma before and during cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin combination chemotherapy. Patients received the maximum tolerable bleomycin dose of 270 mg/m2. Lung function did not change, and the transcapillary escape rate was unaffected, although pretreatment low intravascular albumin normalized. The authors conclude that overall microvascular leakiness does not change during bleomycin, and that its vascular effects are mainly pulmonary and modest in skin.

pmid-6189924.summary_ja: 胎児膜に発がん物質を投与して妊娠ラットに誘発した卵黄嚢腫瘍を対象に、AFP産生を超微細構造レベルで調べた。腫瘍細胞は管腔の周囲に並び、粗面小胞体の拡張した槽内にAFPと同定された物質が蓄積していた。AFPは通常のタンパク質合成と同様の過程で合成・蓄積されると考察している。
pmid-6189924.summary_en: This study examined yolk sac tumors induced in pregnant rats by applying carcinogens to the fetal membranes, focusing on AFP production at the ultrastructural level. Electron microscopy showed cuboidal tumor cells arranged in rows around a tubular cavity, with microvilli, partial interdigitation and large nuclei. Enlarged rough endoplasmic reticulum cisternae contained a dense substance identified as AFP, and cytoplasmic granules carried the same material. The authors propose that AFP is synthesized on ribosomes and accumulated in the rough ER through a process similar to normal protein synthesis.

pmid-6189988.summary_ja: 日本で行われた質問票調査で、奇形腫の乳児・小児61例の血清AFP値を正常値と比較した。成熟奇形腫の23/24例、悪性奇形腫の31/32例で結果が一致し、未熟奇形腫は症例数が少なかった。乳児期においてもAFPは診断的価値が高いと結論している。以前の予備報告で生後2か月未満では区別できないとした結論を改める内容である。
pmid-6189988.summary_en: This Japanese questionnaire survey analyzed serum AFP levels in 61 infants and children with mature, immature, or malignant teratoma and compared them with normal reference ranges. AFP was normal in 23 of 24 mature teratomas and elevated in 31 of 32 malignant teratomas, while immature teratoma numbers were too small for firm conclusions. The authors conclude that AFP has high diagnostic value even in infancy and childhood when interpreted against normal ranges. They note that an earlier preliminary conclusion that AFP could not separate benign from malignant teratoma before 2 months of age is now revised.

pmid-6190021.summary_ja: 肝硬変の43歳男性で血清AFPとhCGが上昇した症例を報告する。左精巣と鎖骨上リンパ節の病理像は混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。除睾後hCGは正常化したがAFPは上昇を続けた。剖検では肝細胞癌が確認され、AFPは肝細胞癌、hCGは胚細胞腫瘍由来と推定された。
pmid-6190021.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with liver cirrhosis who had elevated serum AFP and hCG. Histology of the resected left testis and supraclavicular lymph nodes showed a mixed germ cell tumor. After castration, hCG normalized but AFP continued to rise. Autopsy did not clearly show mixed germ cell tumor, but revealed massive hepatocellular carcinoma. The authors suggest that the hepatocellular carcinoma produced AFP while the mixed germ cell tumor produced hCG, illustrating how tumor markers can help distinguish two coexisting malignancies.

pmid-6190022.summary_ja: 進行胃癌とAFPの著明な上昇を示した67歳男性の症例である。剖検で胃原発の胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が確認され、肝、肺、腹膜、門脈へ広範に転移していた。原発巣と転移巣の両方でAFP産生が免疫染色により示された。治療にもかかわらず、発症3週間後に肝不全で死亡した。
pmid-6190022.summary_en: This case report describes a 67-year-old man with advanced gastric cancer and markedly elevated serum AFP, initially suspected to be a double cancer of stomach and liver. He died of hepatic failure three weeks after admission despite anticancer treatment. Autopsy revealed embryonal carcinoma with yolk sac tumor elements originating in the stomach, with extensive metastases to liver, lung, peritoneum and portal vein. Immunostaining showed that both primary and metastatic tumor cells produced AFP, establishing an AFP-producing extragonadal germ cell-type tumor of gastric origin.

pmid-6190072.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往を持つ252例で血清LDHとアイソザイムを測定した。病変のある患者ではLDH上昇が多く、特にセミノーマで腫瘍量と相関した。LDH上昇例は生存期間が短く、LDHは有用な腫瘍マーカーとされる。アイソザイムの日常的測定は推奨されていない。
pmid-6190072.summary_en: This study measured serum LDH and its isoenzymes in 252 patients with a history of testicular germ cell tumors. Raised LDH was found in 15 of 37 patients with active disease and 7 of 215 without. LDH correlated with total tumor volume, especially in seminoma, and patients with metastases and raised LDH had shorter survival. The authors conclude that LDH is a valuable tumor marker, especially in seminoma, but routine isoenzyme measurement is not recommended. Raised LDH-1 in patients with prior TGCT and unexplained elevation suggests residual tumor.

pmid-6190282.summary_ja: 32歳男性の原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例を、光学顕微鏡・電子顕微鏡・免疫蛍光法で検討した。AFPの免疫蛍光陽性は、PAS陽性の硝子様小体および電子密度の高い沈着物と一致した。血清AFPは治療効果のモニタリングに有用であり、卵黄嚢腫瘍の予後は一般に不良であると述べている。
pmid-6190282.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with a primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor was examined by light, electron, and immunofluorescence microscopy. AFP immunofluorescence correlated with PAS-positive hyaline globules and electron-dense deposits, both intracellular and extracellular. The authors note that serum AFP is useful for monitoring therapy and that yolk sac tumor prognosis is generally poor.

pmid-6190350.summary_ja: 精巣摘除標本189例(セミノーマ95例、非セミノーマ94例)を免疫組織化学的に解析し、AFPとhCGの発現を検討した。セミノーマはAFP陰性で、非セミノーマの66%がAFP陽性であった。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の約70%でAFPおよび/またはhCGが陽性であり、マーカー陽性は転移の有無と関連しなかった。
pmid-6190350.summary_en: Immunoperoxidase staining of 189 orchidectomy specimens (95 pure seminomas, 94 non-seminomas) assessed AFP and hCG. Seminomas were AFP-negative, while 66% of non-seminomas stained for AFP. hCG appeared in choriocarcinoma components and in syncytiotrophoblast-like cells of some seminomas. About 70% of non-seminomatous tumors stained for AFP and/or hCG, and marker positivity was not linked to metastatic disease.

pmid-6190351.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍170例で、腫瘍組織および術前血清のAFPとhCGを免疫学的手法で比較した。純粋セミノーマはAFP陰性であったが、13%で腫瘍組織にhCGが検出された。非セミノーマでは、組織のAFP陽性例の85%で血清AFPが上昇していた。マーカー陽性率は転移例と限局例で差がなく、マーカー陰性例に対する新規マーカーの探索が推奨されている。
pmid-6190351.summary_en: Tumor tissue and preoperative serum were compared for AFP and hCG in 170 testicular germ cell tumor patients. Pure seminomas were AFP-negative, though 13% had hCG in tumor tissue and 9% had raised serum hCG. Among non-seminomas, 85% of patients with AFP-positive tissue had raised serum AFP. Marker positivity did not differ between metastatic and localized disease, and about 23% of non-seminoma patients were marker-negative.

pmid-6190400.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫の4例を報告し、文献をレビューした。腫瘍の多くは片側卵巣に限局し、75%超が25歳未満の女性であった。予後因子は病期と組織学的グレードであり、外科的減量後の併用化学療法で良好な生存が得られた。子宮全摘・対側付属器切除や術後放射線療法は生存を改善しなかった。
pmid-6190400.summary_en: Four cases of ovarian immature teratoma are reported alongside a literature review. Most tumors were confined to one ovary, and over 75% occurred in women under 25. Stage and histologic grade were the key prognostic factors. Optimal survival followed surgical debulking plus combination chemotherapy, while adding hysterectomy, contralateral adnexectomy, or postoperative radiation did not improve outcomes. AFP may help monitor disease status.

pmid-6190712.summary_ja: 新たに樹立したヒト妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株HMを、他の妊娠性4株および非妊娠性2株と比較した。HMは主に細胞栄養膜様細胞からなり、hCGの産生・分泌はきわめて低かった。他の株でLDH3が優位であるのに対し、HMは心筋型LDH1へ偏っていた。HMは絨毛癌の細胞生物学的不均一性を研究するための有用な材料とされる。
pmid-6190712.summary_en: A new human gestational choriocarcinoma cell line, HM, was established and compared with four other gestational and two nongestational choriocarcinoma lines. HM cells were mostly cytotrophoblast-like, with very low hCG production and few syncytiotrophoblast-like giant cells. Unlike other lines dominated by LDH3, HM shifted toward the heart-type LDH1 isozyme. The authors propose HM as a useful model for studying choriocarcinoma heterogeneity.

pmid-6190713.summary_ja: 妊娠19週の17歳初妊婦に卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を合併した症例を報告し、妊娠中発症例として8例目である。AFPなどの癌胎児性抗原が急速な増殖を促すと推定されている。AFPなどに対する抗体を用いた免疫療法により、予後不良の転帰が改善する可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-6190713.summary_en: A 17-year-old primigravida at 19 weeks of gestation with a concurrent ovarian endodermal sinus tumor is reported, the eighth such case in pregnancy. The authors propose that AFP and other oncofetal antigens drive its rapid growth. They suggest that immunotherapy with antibodies against AFP and other oncofetal antigens might improve the usually unfavorable outcome.

pmid-6191044.summary_ja: 本論文は、精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し術前化学療法としてブレオマイシンを投与された患者の麻酔・手術リスクを検討したものである。こうした患者では術後呼吸窮迫症候群のリスクが高まるとされる。主な関連因子は術中・術直後の吸入酸素濃度であり、その監視と忍容できる最低濃度の維持が推奨されている。
pmid-6191044.summary_en: This 1983 urology paper addresses anesthesia and surgical risks in patients given bleomycin as preoperative chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. The authors note such patients appear at increased risk of postoperative respiratory distress syndrome. Based on their experience and a literature review, they associate the risk mainly with intraoperative and early postoperative inspired oxygen concentration. They recommend careful monitoring of inspired oxygen and keeping the concentration at the lowest tolerated level during that period.

pmid-6191398.summary_ja: 本研究は絨毛癌22例、胞状奇胎5例、妊娠初期対照17例の血清および脳脊髄液中のβ2-ミクログロブリン(BMG)を測定した。絨毛癌では血清BMGが上昇し、特にヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が50,000 U/Lを超える例で高値であった。頭蓋内転移例では血清・脳脊髄液とも上昇はみられず、腎機能は正常であった。BMGはトロホブラスト細胞で発現するか、母体免疫細胞が産生する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6191398.summary_en: This 1983 South African study measured beta-2-microglobulin (BMG) in serum and cerebrospinal fluid from 22 patients with choriocarcinoma, 5 with hydatidiform mole, and 17 first-trimester pregnancy controls. Serum BMG was elevated in choriocarcinoma, particularly when hCG exceeded 50,000 U/L. BMG was not raised in serum or CSF when cranial metastases were present, and renal function remained normal. The authors suggest BMG and HLA antigens are expressed on trophoblastic cells, or that maternal immunocytes produce more BMG.

pmid-6191586.summary_ja: 1983年の病理学研究で、プラスチック包埋と酵素染色を用い、多数のヒト胚細胞腫瘍および性腺検体でアルカリホスファターゼの組織化学的検討を行った。すべてのセミノーマと胎児性癌では、腫瘍の胚細胞の形質膜に強い陽性反応が認められた。妊娠性および非妊娠性の絨毛癌と成熟奇形腫は陰性であった。著者らは、アルカリホスファターゼ染色が胚細胞癌の診断に有用な補助手段であると結論づけている。
pmid-6191586.summary_en: This 1983 pathology study examined alkaline phosphatase histochemistry in a large series of human germ cell tumors and gonadal specimens using plastic embedding and enzyme staining. Neoplastic germ cells in all seminomas and embryonal carcinomas showed strong plasma membrane alkaline phosphatase positivity. Choriocarcinomas, both gestational and nongestational, and mature teratomas were negative. The authors conclude that alkaline phosphatase staining is a useful adjunct for diagnosing germ cell cancers.

pmid-6191970.summary_ja: 本内分泌学研究は、免疫親和性吸着法で正常・悪性栄養膜細胞培養、妊娠血清、絨毛癌患者血清中のhCG二量体と遊離サブユニットを分離した。培養JAr絨毛癌細胞は遊離βサブユニットを分泌し、全βサブユニットの37%が遊離型であった。絨毛癌患者血清プールでは15%が遊離型であった。著者らは、hCG二量体形成を制限するのはβではなく結合可能なαサブユニットの供給であると提案している。
pmid-6191970.summary_en: This 1983 endocrinology study used immunoaffinity adsorption to separate hCG dimer from free subunits in cultures of normal and malignant trophoblast cells, pregnancy sera, and choriocarcinoma patient sera. Cultured JAr choriocarcinoma cells secreted free beta subunit, with 37% of total beta subunit in free form. Free beta subunit comprised 15% of total in pooled choriocarcinoma patient sera. The authors propose that the supply of combinable alpha subunit, rather than beta, limits hCG dimer formation.

pmid-6192072.summary_ja: 本病理学研究は仙尾部奇形腫内の膵組織を検討した。形態学的には成熟しているように見えた膵組織が、免疫反応性アミラーゼを異常に産生していた。奇形腫内の成熟した組織は正常に機能するという従来の仮定に疑問を投げかけている。形態的分化が機能的分化を必ずしも伴わないため、奇形腫を組織分化の実験モデルとして用いる前に両面を慎重に評価すべきだと論じている。
pmid-6192072.summary_en: This 1983 Human Pathology study examined pancreatic tissue within sacrococcygeal teratomas. Pancreatic tissue appeared morphologically mature but produced abnormal, immunoreactive amylase. The finding challenges the assumption that mature-appearing somatic tissue in teratomas functions normally. The authors argue that morphologic and functional characteristics should both be assessed carefully before teratomas are used as experimental models of tissue differentiation, since functional differentiation does not always follow morphologic maturation.

pmid-6192268.summary_ja: 本総説は婦人科悪性腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーを概説している。hCGは絨毛性疾患の特異的指標であり、β-サブユニットC末端ペプチドのRIAで低濃度まで検出可能で、寛解確認や早期再発の検出に有用とされる。AFPは胎児性癌、LDHはディスジャーミノーマの感受性の高いマーカーである。CEAは卵巣癌や子宮頸癌の治療モニタリングに有用だが、早期発見には不向きとされる。
pmid-6192268.summary_en: This 1983 Japanese review covers tumor markers in gynecologic malignancies. hCG serves as a tumor-specific index for trophoblastic disease, and a radioimmunoassay for its C-terminal beta-subunit peptide detects low concentrations, useful for confirming remission and detecting early recurrence. AFP is a sensitive marker for embryonal carcinoma, and lactate dehydrogenase for dysgerminoma. CEA may help monitor therapy for ovarian or cervical carcinoma but is not useful for early detection.

pmid-6192269.summary_ja: 本総説は泌尿器科腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーを扱う。精巣腫瘍の一部はAFPとhCGを産生するため、早期発見には使えないが、組織型分類と経過観察に有用である。β-hCGはhCGより特異性が高いとされる。前立腺癌では免疫化学的に測定した前立腺酸性ホスファターゼが高感度・特異的であり、再発例では組織ポリペプチド抗原の上昇が示唆されている。
pmid-6192269.summary_en: This 1983 Japanese review addresses tumor markers in urologic oncology. Part of testicular tumors produce AFP and hCG, so these markers cannot detect disease early, but they are valuable for typing testicular tumors and monitoring disease courses. beta-hCG appears more specific than hCG. For prostate cancer, immunochemically assayed prostatic acid phosphatase is sensitive and specific, and prostate antigen correlates with it. Tissue polypeptide antigen was elevated in recurrent cases.

pmid-6192289.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍21例で、化学療法後に部分寛解にとどまった残存腫瘤に対し外科的生検・切除を行った。76%が無病生存し、予後不良因子は病理組織学的検査での残存癌と術前の腫瘍マーカー高値であった。化学療法後手術は予後評価や追加化学療法の判断に有用な組織を提供し、奇形腫成分では腫瘍量の減量にも寄与すると結論づけている。
pmid-6192289.summary_en: This 1983 study reviewed 21 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors who had only partial clinical regression after chemotherapy and then underwent surgical biopsy or resection of residual masses. Most (76%) remained disease-free at a median of over 30 months. Adverse prognostic factors were persistent cancer on histopathological examination and elevated serum tumor markers at surgery. The authors conclude that postchemotherapy surgery provides tissue essential for prognostic assessment and guiding further chemotherapy, and reduces tumor bulk in differentiated teratoma and persistent cancer.

pmid-6192765.summary_ja: AFPのレクチン親和性をConAおよびLCAを用いて解析した。ConA非結合AFP分画は卵黄嚢腫瘍と転移性肝癌で増加し、肝細胞癌や胎児期・新生児期の状態では少なかった。AFPの糖鎖性状の差を利用し、肝細胞癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍、転移性肝癌などの鑑別診断に役立つ可能性を示した。
pmid-6192765.summary_en: This 1983 study analyzed lectin affinity of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) using Con A sepharose chromatography and crossed immuno-affino-electrophoresis. Con A non-bound AFP fractions were small in hepatocellular carcinoma, neonatal hepatitis, biliary atresia, cirrhosis, and cord sera, but increased in yolk sac tumor and metastatic liver cancer. LCA affinity patterns were uniform in cord sera and cirrhosis but variable in hepatocellular carcinoma. The authors suggest lectin affinity analysis of AFP can help distinguish hepatocellular carcinoma from yolk sac tumor and metastatic liver cancer.

pmid-6192802.summary_ja: 巨大な原発性性腺外セミノーマに対し、従来の第一選択であった放射線療法ではなく、シスプラチンとビンブラスチンによる化学療法を初回治療として行った症例である。後腹膜リンパ節郭清により完全寛解が確認された。性腺外セミノーマに対する初回化学療法の有用性を示唆する。
pmid-6192802.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a bulky primary extragonadal seminoma treated initially with chemotherapy using cisplatin and vinblastine rather than radiotherapy, which had traditionally been the first-line choice for seminoma. Complete remission was confirmed by retroperitoneal nodal dissection. The report suggests chemotherapy may be a viable primary treatment for extragonadal seminoma, with surgical restaging used to document the response.

pmid-6192898.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍17例で、hCGとAFPの免疫組織化学的所見と組織内濃度が良好に相関した。57腫瘍での検討では、hCGはセミノーマや胎児性癌の合胞体栄養膜巨細胞と絨毛癌の合胞体細胞に、AFPは卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌に認められた。両マーカーを同時に発現する細胞はなかった。
pmid-6192898.summary_en: This 1983 study compared immunohistochemical demonstration of hCG and AFP with tissue concentrations in 17 testicular germ cell tumors, finding good correlation. In 57 tumors, hCG was localized to syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells in seminoma or embryonal carcinoma and to choriocarcinoma syncytial cells. AFP was found in yolk sac tumor cells and embryonal carcinoma, and occasionally in hyaline globules. No cell expressed both markers. The authors discuss the pathogenetic significance of marker-positive cells.

pmid-6192908.summary_ja: ヌードマウスで増殖させたヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍から精製したAFPの糖鎖構造を解析した。ヒドラジン分解で遊離させたオリゴ糖を中性と酸性に分離し、酵素消化などで構造を決定した。卵黄嚢腫瘍が産生するAFPの糖鎖の分子レベルの特徴を示し、臨床で用いられる腫瘍マーカーの理解に寄与する。
pmid-6192908.summary_en: This 1983 study determined the carbohydrate structures of alpha-fetoprotein purified from human yolk sac tumors grown in nude mice. Oligosaccharides released by hydrazinolysis were separated into neutral and acidic fractions. Structural analysis using exoglycosidase digestion, per-O-methylation, and periodate oxidation identified several complex-type glycan structures, including fucosylated and sialylated forms. The work characterizes the glycosylation of AFP produced by yolk sac tumor, providing molecular detail on this clinically used tumor marker.

pmid-6192996.summary_ja: 1976～1982年にコペンハーゲンで治療した原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍16例の成績である。12例にシスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン(PVB)療法を行い、8例が完全寛解、5例が部分寛解を得た。奇形癌と胎児性癌で成績が良く、絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍にはより有効な化学療法レジメンが必要と結論づけた。
pmid-6192996.summary_en: This 1983 study reports outcomes in 16 patients with primary extragonadal germ cell tumors treated at the Finsen Institute, Copenhagen, from 1976 to 1982. Twelve received cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB). Eight achieved complete remission and five partial response, and 86% of complete responders remained disease-free at a median 42 months. PVB worked best for teratocarcinomas and embryonal carcinomas, while choriocarcinomas and endodermal sinus tumors need more effective regimens.

pmid-6193791.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の一部の患者血清が認識する抗原決定基を検討した。マウス奇形癌細胞の大型糖鎖に反応する抗体が検出され、α-ガラクトシダーゼで活性が消失したことから、α-ガラクトシル残基が決定基と同定された。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に関連した腫瘍関連の発現が示唆される。
pmid-6193791.summary_en: This 1983 study identified the antigenic determinant recognized by sera from patients with ovarian germ cell tumors. Certain patients developed antibodies reacting with large glycans from murine teratocarcinoma cells. Alpha-galactosidase digestion abolished antigenic activity, while other glycosidases did not, indicating an alpha-galactosyl residue as the determinant. Blood group B and P1 antigens were excluded. The authors suggest this unusual alpha-galactosyl expression is tumor-associated in human ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-6193801.summary_ja: 本研究は、悪性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法中および治療後における血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の解釈上の問題を検討したものである。高感度ラジオイムノアッセイにより、AFPを産生しない腫瘍患者の多くで、腫瘍由来ではない免疫反応性AFPが検出された。治療後も高値が持続する例、特に治療終了3か月後に20kU/Lを超える例は再発の予測因子となった。腫瘍由来AFPと他部位由来AFPを区別する必要性が強調されている。
pmid-6193801.summary_en: This 1983 study examined how serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) levels should be interpreted during and after chemotherapy for malignant germ cell tumours. Using a sensitive radioimmunoassay, many patients with non-AFP-producing tumours had measurable immunoreactive AFP that did not reflect tumour activity. Persistently elevated AFP after chemotherapy, especially above 20 kU/L three months after treatment, predicted relapse. AFP detection during chemotherapy depended on the regimen, particularly in gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors stress the need to distinguish tumour-derived AFP from AFP produced elsewhere.

pmid-6193860.summary_ja: 本報告は、左卵巣に大きな胎児性癌を有した11歳女児の症例である。左付属器切除術とダクチノマイシンによる化学療法を施行した。術前の血清AFP(70,350 ng/ml)と尿中hCG(16,000 IU/L)は術後に正常範囲へ低下した。免疫組織化学染色では、hCGは合胞体栄養膜様巨細胞に、AFPは単核上皮細胞に局在していた。患者は術後8年間生存しており、卵巣胎児性癌としては稀な長期生存例である。
pmid-6193860.summary_en: This case report describes an 11-year-old girl with a large embryonal carcinoma of the left ovary. She underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy plus chemotherapy with dactinomycin. Preoperative serum AFP (70,350 ng/ml) and urinary hCG (16,000 IU/L) fell to normal after surgery. Immunohistochemistry localized hCG to syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells and AFP to mononuclear epithelial cells. The patient has survived eight years, making this a rare long-term survivor of ovarian embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-6193875.summary_ja: 本研究は、リンパ節転移巣に由来するヒト精巣胎児性癌(絨毛癌成分を含む)をヌードマウスに異種移植したものである。異種移植腫瘍は10代の継代を通じて維持され、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンを合成する能力を保持していた。94匹の血清β-hCG値は腫瘍体積と有意に相関した。電子顕微鏡所見は上皮性起源を示唆し、染色体解析ではヒト型核型と第1染色体の一貫した3倍体が認められた。
pmid-6193875.summary_en: This 1983 study established a human testicular embryonal carcinoma, with choriocarcinoma elements, in nude mice from a lymph node metastasis. The xenografts were maintained through ten animal passages and retained the ability to synthesize human chorionic gonadotropin. Serum beta-hCG levels in 94 animals correlated significantly with tumour volume. Electron microscopy suggested epithelial origin, and chromosomal analysis showed a human pattern with a consistent trisomy of chromosome 1. The model offers a tool for studying human germ cell tumour biology in vivo.

pmid-6193922.summary_ja: 本総説は、20歳以下の女性で最も多い卵巣癌である卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍をまとめたものである。早期病変は良好に治療可能であるとされる。適切な管理には、腫瘍内の組織成分の正確な同定、正しい手術手技、適切な術後療法が必要である。いずれかを誤ると不利な結果を招くため、確立されたガイドラインの遵守が不可欠と強調している。
pmid-6193922.summary_en: This review summarizes germ cell tumours of the ovary, which are the most common ovarian cancer in women aged 20 years or younger. The authors note that early-stage disease is treatable with good outcomes. Successful management requires accurate identification of the histological elements within the tumour, the correct surgical procedure, and appropriate postoperative therapy. The authors warn that errors in any of these areas can lead to poor outcomes, so adherence to established guidelines is essential.

pmid-6194845.summary_ja: 本研究は、組織学的に純粋な精巣セミノーマで血清β-hCGが陽性であった8例を報告したものである。8例すべてで血清AFPは正常範囲にとどまった。血清β-hCG値は病期と相関しなかった。観察期間は11〜48か月であった。全例が初回治療として放射線療法を受け、1例は化学療法を、別の1例は放射線療法後13か月で両側リンパ節郭清を受けた。セミノーマにおけるβ-hCGの診断と管理上の意義が示されている。
pmid-6194845.summary_en: This study reports eight patients with histologically pure testicular seminoma and positive serum beta-hCG levels. Serum AFP remained normal in all eight, and beta-hCG levels did not correlate with tumour stage. Immunoperoxidase staining of formalin-fixed specimens was performed. Observation periods ranged from 11 to 48 months. All patients received primary radiotherapy, one received chemotherapy, and another underwent bilateral lymphadenectomy 13 months after radiotherapy. The findings highlight the diagnostic and management relevance of beta-hCG in seminoma.

pmid-6195275.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニットのカルボキシル末端ペプチドに対する抗血清を用いた尿中hCG測定法（CTP-RIA）を開発し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患50例で評価した。正常上限は24時間尿で1.1 IUとされた。胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎などでは治療後に正常化し、再発は認められなかった。一方、転移性絨毛癌の1例では正常域に戻った後にhCGが再上昇し、正常域でも腫瘍細胞が残存しうることが示された。
pmid-6195275.summary_en: This study developed a radioimmunoassay (CTP-RIA) for urinary hCG using an antiserum against the carboxyl-terminal peptide of the hCG beta subunit, and evaluated it in 50 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease. Normal urinary hCG was defined as below 1.1 IU/24 h. Levels normalized after therapy in hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and undetermined cases, without recurrence. In one patient with metastatic choriocarcinoma, hCG reappeared after normalization, suggesting that viable cells may persist within the normal range. The assay may improve detection of persistent or recurrent disease.

pmid-6195554.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣がん65例に対する集中化学療法後の外科的再評価を検討した。マーカーは正常化したが残存病変を認めた31例に手術を行い、生検または完全切除を実施した。活動性腫瘍は5例、成熟奇形腫は6例で、他は壊死または瘢痕であった。所見に基づき治療方針を決定し、手術例の4年生存率は90%を超えた。
pmid-6195554.summary_en: This study reviewed 65 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular cancer treated with intensive chemotherapy. Chemotherapy induced complete remission in 28 patients, and 31 patients with normalized markers but residual abnormalities underwent surgery. Surgery was limited to biopsy or complete excision without radical retroperitoneal dissection. Vital tumor was found in five patients, mature teratoma in six, and necrosis or scar in the rest. These findings guided further treatment, and the four-year actuarial survival of operated patients exceeded 90%.

pmid-6195919.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の過去20年間の診断と治療の進歩をまとめた総説である。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の高感度測定法が診断・病期分類に役立った。シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンによる併用化学療法により、非セミノーマ性腫瘍の治癒率は約75%に向上した。残存病変は可能であれば外科的切除を検討し、進行セミノーマには化学療法を行うことが推奨されている。
pmid-6195919.summary_en: This review summarizes advances in the management of testicular germ cell neoplasms over two decades. Sensitive radioimmunoassays for alpha-fetoprotein and hCG beta aided diagnosis, staging and treatment. Combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin transformed nonseminomatous tumors from a disease with high mortality into one with roughly 75 percent cure rates. The authors recommend treatment at experienced centers, surgical resection of residual disease when feasible, and radiotherapy alone for most curable seminomas, with chemotherapy for advanced disease.

pmid-6195930.summary_ja: 精巣に生じた2例の腫瘍を報告し、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、栄養膜様成分が規則的に配列したびまん性の構造を示した。1例では胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍が数珠状に絡み合い、もう1例では卵黄嚢成分が肝細胞様細胞の集塊へと分化していた。ポリエンブリオーマなどと区別するため、これらを混合型胚細胞腫瘍の新しい形態として「びまん性エンブリオーマ」と命名した。
pmid-6195930.summary_en: This paper describes two testicular tumors with a diffuse, orderly arrangement of embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor and trophoblastic elements, proposed as a distinctive form of mixed germ cell neoplasia. In one case, embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor wound around each other in a necklace pattern. In the other, yolk sac differentiation was more advanced, with clusters resembling hepatocytes. The authors term these tumors diffuse embryomas to distinguish them from polyembryomas and other malignant mixed germ cell tumors.

pmid-6195947.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者18例で、ブレオマイシン、ビンブラスチン、シスプラチン併用療法後の肺機能を測定した。主な変化は肺毛細血管血液量（Vc）の著明な低下で、他の指標の変化は軽微であった。最終投与から4か月後も回復は認められなかった。ブレオマイシンによる無症候性の肺障害には血管障害が重要と考えられ、その後の肺毒性を有する治療には注意が必要とされた。
pmid-6195947.summary_en: This study measured pulmonary function in 18 patients with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treated with bleomycin, vinblastine and cisplatin (DDP), to assess subclinical bleomycin-induced lung toxicity. The main finding was a marked decrease in pulmonary capillary blood volume (Vc), with only minor changes in other parameters. Function had not recovered four months after the last bleomycin dose. The authors conclude that vascular injury may be important in this subclinical lung injury and advise caution with other lung-toxic treatments afterward.

pmid-6195980.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後に胸部転移に対して手術を行った精巣がん72例を報告した。後腹膜病変を伴う24例では、胸骨正中切開または開胸と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を一期的に行った。手術死亡はなかった。化学療法により多くの転移巣は成熟奇形腫へと変化し、播種性疾患の全体的な治癒率は約80%であった。
pmid-6195980.summary_en: This report describes 72 patients with disseminated testicular germ cell cancer who underwent thoracic surgery for metastases after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. In 24 patients with concurrent retroperitoneal disease, one-stage median sternotomy or thoracotomy with retroperitoneal node dissection was performed. There was no operative mortality. Chemotherapy converted many metastases to mature teratoma, and the overall cure rate for disseminated disease was about 80 percent, with 83 percent long-term survival after one-stage thoracoretroperitoneal surgery.

pmid-6196076.summary_ja: 病期I精巣奇形腫の患者45例を前向きにサーベイランスし、フォローアップのみで管理した。34例（76%）は追加治療を必要としなかった。11例が再発し、化学療法と放射線療法で救済された。再発の多くは初回評価後3か月以内であった。フォローアップ方針は、密接な監視体制を備えた地域拠点施設でのみ実行可能と結論された。
pmid-6196076.summary_en: This prospective surveillance study followed 45 patients with stage I testicular teratoma managed by follow-up alone. Thirty-four patients (76%) required no further treatment. Eleven relapsed and were salvaged with chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Most relapses (seven) occurred within three months of initial assessment, and only one occurred after 12 months. The authors conclude that follow-up is feasible but should be limited to regional centres with facilities for close monitoring.

pmid-6196499.summary_ja: ヒト胸腺卵黄嚢腫瘍（YSK-1）を無胸腺ヌードマウスに継代移植し、その性質を検討した。組織学的・超微細構造的にシラー・デュバル小体や内胚葉洞などの卵黄嚢腫瘍の特徴が維持されていた。担癌マウスの血清と腫瘍細胞からαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、CEA、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)などが検出され、AFPは腫瘍の増大と並行して上昇した。
pmid-6196499.summary_en: The authors established a human thymic yolk sac tumor, YSK-1, in athymic nude mice and characterized it through serial transplantation. Histology and electron microscopy showed Schiller-Duval bodies, endodermal sinus structures and other yolk sac features that persisted after serial passage. Radioimmunoassay and immunohistochemistry detected AFP, CEA, hCG, alpha-1-antitrypsin and transferrin in tumor-bearing mice and in tumor cells, and serum AFP rose in parallel with tumor growth.

pmid-6196749.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍170例(セミノーマ88例、非セミノーマ82例)の術前血清AFPとhCG、および腫瘍組織を検討した。病期は臨床・放射線学的分類で評価された。AFPやhCGは転移性疾患と特に関連せず、進行例で高値が多いのは腫瘍量の多さを反映すると考えられた。病期I非セミノーマでは63%がhCG高値を示した。
pmid-6196749.summary_en: This study analyzed preoperative serum AFP and hCG and primary tumor tissue in 170 consecutive patients with testicular germ cell tumors (88 seminomas, 82 nonseminomas), staged with a clinicoradiological system. Neither marker was especially associated with metastatic disease; the higher frequency of raised values in advanced stages probably reflected greater tumor burden. Raised hCG was common in stage I nonseminomas, with 63% of such patients showing elevation.

pmid-6196750.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍や胎児性癌成分を含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍12例を免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法で染色し、胎児ヘモグロビン(HbF)の局在を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分は9例で陽性、胎児性癌細胞も7例で一部陽性であった。精巣腫瘍患者の末梢血HbFは骨髄ではなく腫瘍由来の可能性があり、血清腫瘍マーカーとしての評価が推奨されている。
pmid-6196750.summary_en: This study used immunoperoxidase staining to detect fetal hemoglobin (HbF) in 12 testicular germ cell tumors containing yolk sac tumor and/or embryonal carcinoma components. HbF was found in yolk sac tumor components in nine tumors, in some embryonal carcinoma cells in seven, and in vascular blood cells. The findings suggest that circulating HbF in patients with testicular tumors may originate from the tumor rather than the bone marrow, and the authors recommend evaluating HbF as a serologic tumor marker.

pmid-6196751.summary_ja: コンカナバリンAアフィニティクロマトグラフィーにより、卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む小児患者15例および異種移植ヌードマウスの血清AFPの糖鎖変異を解析した。卵黄嚢腫瘍では、コンカナバリンAに結合しないAFPが約半数を占め、ヌードマウスではほぼ全てであった。肝由来AFPではこの変異体は少なかった。異種移植モデルは、AFPの糖鎖付加と分泌の解明に有用と示唆された。
pmid-6196751.summary_en: Using concanavalin A affinity chromatography, the authors characterized carbohydrate variants of alphafetoprotein (AFP) in sera from 15 infants and children, including five with endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors, and in nude mice bearing human endodermal sinus tumors. Sera from patients with endodermal sinus tumors and pancreatic carcinoma contained a high proportion of AFP that did not bind concanavalin A, as did xenograft mouse sera, whereas hepatic-origin AFP showed few such variants. The study suggests xenograft models can help clarify AFP glycosylation and secretion.

pmid-6196755.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における血清乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)とそのアイソザイムLDH-1の意義を総説した。血清LDHの上昇は腫瘍容積と概ね相関し、病期III転移例では生存を予測した。LDHは診断感度90%とされ、AFPやhCGと併用する補助的腫瘍マーカーとして有用と結論された。
pmid-6196755.summary_en: This overview reviews serum lactate dehydrogenase (S-LDH) and its isoenzyme LDH-1 in testicular germ cell tumors. Raised S-LDH occurred in about half of tumor patients and correlated with total tumor volume, and S-LDH predicted survival in patients with stage III metastases. Diagnostic sensitivity was 90% and specificity 68% for S-LDH. The authors conclude that LDH, particularly LDH-1, can serve as a supplementary tumor marker alongside AFP and hCG.

pmid-6196756.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢由来の悪性腫瘍が卵黄嚢に存在する胚細胞から生じるかを検討したラット実験である。ブスルファンで妊娠ラットの胚細胞を除去したが(12日齢胚の生殖隆起で確認)、卵黄嚢癌や奇形癌の発生頻度や潜伏期間に変化はなかった。したがって、卵黄嚢由来の悪性腫瘍は胚細胞起源ではないと結論された。
pmid-6196756.summary_en: The authors tested whether malignant yolk sac-derived tumors arise from germ cells present in the yolk sac. Pregnant rats were treated with busulphan, which eliminated germ cells in the genital ridges of 12-day embryos. This treatment did not change the incidence or latency of yolk sac carcinomas or teratocarcinomas. The authors concluded that malignant yolk sac-derived tumors are not of germ cell origin.

pmid-6196757.summary_ja: 妊娠特異的β1-糖タンパク質(SP1)に対するマウスモノクローナル抗体の、免疫染色とラジオイムノアッセイへの適性を評価した。正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌を特異性よく染色し、背景染色も少なかった。免疫組織化学では多クローン性抗血清より優れるが、ラジオイムノアッセイには不適であった。
pmid-6196757.summary_en: The authors evaluated mouse monoclonal antibodies against pregnancy-specific beta-1-glycoprotein (SP1) for immunoperoxidase staining and radioimmunoassay. The antibodies stained normal placentas, hydatidiform moles, invasive moles, and choriocarcinomas with good specificity and minimal background, making them superior to polyclonal antisera for immunohistochemistry. However, they were unsuitable for radioimmunoassay.

pmid-6196898.summary_ja: 広範囲に進展した原発縦隔セミノーマの患者2例を報告する。ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンによる化学療法で完全寛解を得た。両例とも46カ月および66カ月にわたり再発なく生存している。放射線療法の照射野を超える進展例でも、化学療法で治療可能と示唆された。
pmid-6196898.summary_en: The authors report two patients with extensive primary mediastinal seminoma who achieved complete remission with vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin after disease extended beyond a rational radiation field. Both remained alive without recurrence for 46 and 66 months. The report extends prior experience and suggests chemotherapy can successfully treat mediastinal seminoma that extends beyond the field of radiotherapy.

pmid-6196899.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍20例を間接免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法で染色し、AFPとhCGの局在を検討した。AFPは卵黄嚢腫瘍15例中13例、奇形腫11例中3例、胎児性癌14例中3例で陽性であった。hCGは合胞体栄養膜細胞で陽性となり、組織所見は血清値と良好に相関した。
pmid-6196899.summary_en: The authors used indirect immunoperoxidase staining to localize AFP and hCG in 20 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell cancers. AFP was found in 13 of 15 yolk sac tumors, 3 of 11 teratomas, and 3 of 14 embryonal carcinomas. hCG was detected in syncytiotrophoblasts in 14 of 15 cases and in 2 of 2 choriocarcinomas. Tissue staining correlated with serum levels, indicating yolk sac tumor is the main site of AFP synthesis and syncytiotrophoblasts the only site of hCG synthesis.

pmid-6197005.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍67例について、免疫組織化学的にAFPとHCGの局在を検討した。セミノーマ30例ではAFP陽性はなく、HCG陽性の巨細胞は1例のみであった。非セミノーマでは、AFP陽性が54%、HCG陽性が51%であった。HCGは絨毛癌成分などの合胞体栄養膜様細胞に、AFPは卵黄嚢腫瘍成分などに認められた。純粋な胎児性癌では両マーカーとも陰性であった。
pmid-6197005.summary_en: This study applied immunoperoxidase staining to 67 testicular germ cell tumors to localize AFP and HCG. None of 30 seminomas showed AFP positivity, and only one contained HCG-positive giant cells. Among nonseminomatous tumors, 54% were AFP-positive and 51% HCG-positive. HCG was seen in syncytiotrophoblast-like cells of choriocarcinomatous areas and as single cells in embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma, and yolk sac tumor. AFP appeared in yolk sac tumor components and in embryonal carcinoma areas of mixed tumors. Pure embryonal carcinomas were negative for both markers.

pmid-6197347.summary_ja: 正常妊娠、稽留流産、栄養膜疾患の栄養膜細胞について、核DNA量と増殖動態を検討した。増殖細胞は主に細胞性栄養膜細胞であった。I型胞状奇胎は2C周期にあり、II型胞状奇胎と侵入奇胎では倍数化や異数化が認められた。絨毛癌は2C周期になく、過剰4C領域で変化が見られた。
pmid-6197347.summary_en: This study measured nuclear DNA content and proliferation kinetics of trophoblastic cells from 8 normal pregnancies, 2 missed abortions, and 14 trophoblastic disease cases, using Feulgen cytofluorometry combined with autoradiography. Syncytiotrophoblasts were rarely labeled, and most proliferating cells were cytotrophoblasts. Normal pregnancy and type I hydatidiform mole cells were in the 2C cycle. Type II hydatidiform mole and invasive mole showed heterogeneous populations undergoing polyploidization or aneuploidization. In choriocarcinoma, cells were not in the 2C cycle and showed hyper-4C changes.

pmid-6197552.summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植したヒト卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍3種に対し、PVBとVACの化学療法効果を比較した。両療法とも全腫瘍の体積を有意に縮小させた。腫瘍体積と血清αフェトプロテイン値との間には強い相関が認められた。PVBはVACに代わる有効な選択肢と考えられる。
pmid-6197552.summary_en: This study compared PVB (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin) with VAC (vincristine, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide) in three human ovarian yolk sac tumors heterotransplanted into nude mice. Both regimens, given for 3 weeks, significantly reduced tumor volume in all treated tumors. Tumor weights relative to untreated controls were 1.3% and 1.6% for YST-1, 2.5% and 3.3% for YST-2, and 5.5% and 2.7% for YST-3, respectively. In YST-1 and YST-2 tumors, tumor volume correlated strongly with serum alpha-fetoprotein levels in the mice. The study supports PVB as an active alternative to VAC.

pmid-6197705.summary_ja: 妊娠19週で血清AFPが高値を示し、超音波検査で仙尾部奇形腫が疑われた症例である。羊水中のAFPとアセチルコリンエステラーゼは正常であった。妊娠24週で胎児死亡が確認され、大きな仙尾部奇形腫を伴う胎児が娩出された。羊水マーカーが正常でも奇形腫を除外できないことを示す。
pmid-6197705.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with two serial serum AFP values above twice the median at 19 weeks' gestation. Ultrasound suggested a possible sacrococcygeal teratoma, but amniotic fluid AFP and acetylcholinesterase were both normal. The patient continued the pregnancy. At 24 weeks, fetal demise was confirmed. Prostaglandin induction produced a macerated female fetus with a large sacrococcygeal teratoma. The case shows that normal amniotic fluid markers do not exclude a fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-6198410.summary_ja: 妊娠ラットの胎児膜に発癌物質を作用させて誘発した卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織発生を検討した。腫瘍と母体組織と考えられる胎児膜は、PAS陽性顆粒やAFPの局在などの特徴を共有していた。電子顕微鏡では糸状の核小体を持つ未熟な核が見られ、胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的とされた。腫瘍は胎児膜から発生したと結論された。
pmid-6198410.summary_en: This study examined the histogenesis of yolk sac tumors induced in rats by treating pregnant rat fetal membranes with carcinogens. The authors compared tumor tissue with the presumed mother tissue, the fetal membrane. Both showed PAS-positive non-glycogenic granules and AFP localization by fluorescent antibody staining. Electron microscopy revealed shared round homogeneous material and well-developed rough endoplasmic reticulum. The tumor showed immature nuclei with thread-like nucleolonema, a feature characteristic of germ cell tumors. The authors concluded that the tumor arose from the fetal membrane.

pmid-6198501.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の起源と分類に関する総説である。腫瘍マーカーなどの新しい技術の応用により、従来の見解の再評価が進んでいる。論争のいくつかの側面が検討されている。抄録が短いため、具体的な結論は抄録からは判断できない。
pmid-6198501.summary_en: This review examines testicular germ cell tumors. It notes that recent techniques, particularly the identification of tumor markers, are prompting a reassessment of opinions about the origin and classification of these neoplasms. The author examines several aspects of this ongoing controversy. Because the abstract is brief, the review's specific conclusions cannot be determined from the abstract alone. The topic remains relevant to the classification and histogenesis of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6198739.summary_ja: 原発性悪性縦隔奇形腫の男性患者8例の治療成績を報告している。全例で血清hCGまたはAFPの上昇が見られた。シスプラチンを含む間欠的併用化学療法の後に根治的切除を行い、5例が長期生存した。手術を受けなかった2例は死亡した。
pmid-6198739.summary_en: This series reports eight male patients with primary malignant mediastinal teratoma, with a mean age of 24 years. All had raised serum hCG or AFP. Patients received intermittent combination chemotherapy including cisplatin. Six responded, with marker normalization, and then underwent radical excision. Viable malignancy was found in four specimens, which received postoperative chemotherapy. Five patients remained alive and well 13 to 136 months after treatment. The two patients who did not undergo surgery died. The authors attribute the better results to chemotherapy combined with carefully timed surgery.

pmid-6199468.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の女性9例を対象に、腫瘍減量術後にシスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン(PVB)化学療法を施行した1983年の報告。病期I 5例、病期III 3例、再発1例を含む。全例が無病生存中で、毒性は時に重篤だが速やかに回復可能だった。
pmid-6199468.summary_en: This 1983 study reports nine women with ovarian germ cell tumors (endodermal sinus tumors, immature teratomas, and mixed germ cell tumors) treated with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB) after cytoreductive surgery. Five patients had stage I disease, three had stage III, and one had recurrent disease. All nine were alive and free of disease at a median follow-up of 31 months from diagnosis. Toxicity was occasionally severe but rapidly reversible.

pmid-6199471.summary_ja: 進行卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児4例に対し、ビンクリスチン、シスプラチン、ブレオマイシンによる導入療法と、ビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミドによる維持療法を行った。導入療法で3例が部分奏効し、2例の再手術では瘢痕組織のみであった。2例は治療開始後40か月以上無病生存している。
pmid-6199471.summary_en: This report describes four children with advanced yolk sac tumor treated with an aggressive combination program. Induction over six weeks used vincristine, cisplatin, and bleomycin, and maintenance used vincristine, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide. Three patients with measurable disease had partial responses to induction, and two who underwent second-look surgery showed only scar tissue. Two patients were disease-free for more than 40 months from the start of therapy, with no significant renal or pulmonary toxicity.

pmid-6199475.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対しPVB化学療法を受けた36歳男性が、左同名性半盲、脳症、非優位半球頭頂葉の部分症候群を発症した。症状は完全に消失し、化学療法による毒性だが可逆的な副作用と考えられた。胚細胞腫瘍患者でのPVBレジメンに伴う神経学的合併症の症例報告である。
pmid-6199475.summary_en: This report describes a 36-year-old man receiving cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin for testicular carcinoma who developed dense left homonymous hemianopsia, encephalopathy, and a partial nondominant parietal lobe syndrome. All signs and symptoms resolved completely, suggesting the events were a toxic but reversible side effect of chemotherapy. The case highlights neurological complications of PVB regimens in germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-6199531.summary_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマ(病期II、N4)の52歳男性に対し、根治的精巣摘除術の後、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンによる化学療法を行い部分奏効を得た。血清hCGとhCG-βを経時的に測定し、遊離hCG-βに類似する物質が転移巣の縮小と並行して減少することを示した。
pmid-6199531.summary_en: A 52-year-old man with advanced testicular seminoma (stage II, N4) underwent right radical orchiectomy followed by vinblastine, bleomycin, and cisplatin chemotherapy, achieving a partial response. He remained well for 24 months. Serum hCG and hCG-beta were serially monitored using three double-antibody radioimmunoassays. A substance immunologically similar to free hCG-beta fell in parallel with cytoreduction of metastases, and the authors discuss a rational therapeutic approach and the utility of this serum marker.

pmid-6200036.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌(CE/44)の生体内分化を、系統、性別、移植形式の違いから検討した1983年の基礎研究。雌マウスではより速く悪性度の高い増殖を示した。インターフェロンは皮下腫瘍の増殖を抑えて神経上皮分化を促したが、悪性度の高い栄養膜様細胞を選択的に増やし、腹水腫瘍では雌に出血死をもたらした。
pmid-6200036.summary_en: This 1983 study examines in vivo differentiation of the CE/44 mouse teratocarcinoma, an embryonal carcinoma model, across mouse strains, sexes, and graft types. Tumors grew faster and more malignantly in female mice, and take and growth were stable in hybrid F1 mice but unstable over passages. Interferon slowed subcutaneous growth and favored neuroepithelial differentiation, but selectively expanded a highly malignant trophoblastic cell type that caused hemorrhagic death in female animals with ascitic tumors.

pmid-6200044.summary_ja: 1976～1981年のデンマークのDATECA研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織型と病期ごとの腫瘍マーカーを検討した。セミノーマでは8%、非セミノーマ性疾患では63%でマーカーが陽性だった。病期が進むほど陽性率は高く、マーカー陰性例は予後が良好であった。
pmid-6200044.summary_en: This Danish DATECA study from 1976 to 1981 analyzed biochemical markers in testicular germ cell tumors by histology and stage. Among 746 fully monitored patients, marker positivity (elevated AFP and/or hCG) was 8% in seminoma and 63% in nonseminomatous disease. Marker prevalence increased with stage, and marker-negative patients had a better prognosis. Elevated AFP correlated with a primary endodermal sinus tumor component, and elevated hCG with a choriocarcinoma component.

pmid-6201566.summary_ja: シスプラチン導入療法後の精巣がん検体16例を軟寒天で培養し、7例(44%)でコロニーを形成した。VP-16のin vitro感受性試験で4例中3例の増殖が抑制され、そのうち2例はVP-16を用いた救援療法で奏効した。コロニーのAFPとhCG染色は血清値と一部一致した。
pmid-6201566.summary_en: Sixteen testicular cancer specimens obtained after cisplatin-based induction were cloned in soft agar, and seven (44%) formed colonies across histologic subtypes. In vitro VP-16 exposure reduced colony formation below 50% of controls in three of four tested specimens, and two of those patients responded to a VP-16-based salvage regimen. AFP and hCG immunostaining of colonies partly matched serum levels. One residual retroperitoneal mass with teratoma histology formed AFP-positive colonies, and the patient later developed elevated serum AFP.

pmid-6203379.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の10例に精巣摘除術後、BOM療法(導入)とCOM療法(維持)を行った。全例が1年6か月から5年3か月まで無病生存している。導入のみの4例中2例で再発したが、他のレジメンで完全奏効した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清や放射線療法の代替となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-6203379.summary_en: Ten patients with stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors underwent orchiectomy, followed by BOM (bleomycin, vincristine, methotrexate with leucovorin rescue) induction and COM (cyclophosphamide, vincristine, methotrexate) maintenance. All ten remained disease-free for 1.5 to 5.3 years. Relapse occurred in two of four patients who received induction only, and they responded to other regimens. The authors suggest combination chemotherapy may be an alternative to retroperitoneal node dissection and radiation therapy.

pmid-6208545.summary_ja: 新生児の肝奇形腫の症例で、組織学的には三胚葉成分を含む未熟奇形腫が主体であった。悪性組織は認められず、臨床的な転移もなかった。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は著明に上昇していた。小児肝奇形腫の文献レビューも併せて示され、まれな性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の病像を提示している。
pmid-6208545.summary_en: This pediatric pathology report describes a hepatic teratoma in a newborn, histologically a predominantly immature teratoma containing tissue from all three germ layers. No malignant tissue was identified, and the child showed no clinical metastasis. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated. The article also reviews the literature on hepatic teratomas in children, providing context for this rare extragonadal germ cell tumor presentation.

pmid-6222124.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株の培養上清に含まれる免疫抑制因子を解析した1983年の研究。この因子はサプレッサーT細胞を誘導し、IgGのFc部分に強く結合したことからFcγ受容体様分子と推定された。他のヒト癌細胞株の上清にも類似分子が認められ、腫瘍による免疫抑制との関連が考察されている。
pmid-6222124.summary_en: This 1983 study examined immunosuppressive factors released by choriocarcinoma cell lines. Culture supernatants contained an immunosuppressive factor that induced suppressor T cells, along with a nonspecific lymphocyte proliferation factor. The immunosuppressive factor bound the Fc portion of IgG, suggesting an Fc gamma receptor-like molecule. Similar molecules were found in supernatants of various other human cancer cell lines. The findings are discussed in relation to tumor-induced immunosuppression and trophoblast-derived factors.

pmid-6229588.summary_ja: 4例の患者から得た16個の卵巣類皮嚢腫を染色体および遺伝子マーカーで解析した研究。全例が46,XX型で、13個は第一減数分裂後の胚細胞、3個は第一減数分裂前の胚細胞に由来すると推定された。単一宿主の多発卵巣類皮嚢腫は、異なる胚細胞から多様な機序で生じると結論づけられた。
pmid-6229588.summary_en: This cytogenetic study examined sixteen ovarian dermoid cysts from four patients to clarify the origin of gonadal teratomas. All tumors had a 46,XX karyotype. Thirteen tumors showed homozygous chromosomal heteromorphisms and mostly homozygous gene markers, suggesting origin from a germ cell after the first meiotic division. Three tumors showed heterozygous patterns like the host, suggesting origin before the first meiotic division. Multiple ovarian dermoid cysts in one host thus appear to arise from different germ cells by diverse mechanisms.

pmid-6295621.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者103例を対象に、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と術後ダクチノマイシン療法の成績を検討した1983年の研究。病期I例の3年生存率は96%、補助化学療法を受けた病期IIA/IIB例では88%だった。病期IIC例は28.5%にとどまり、単剤補助化学療法の再評価が提言された。
pmid-6295621.summary_en: This 1983 study reviewed 103 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) and postoperative dactinomycin. Stage I patients who underwent RPLND alone had a 96% three-year survival. Among stage IIA/IIB patients receiving adjuvant dactinomycin, survival was 88%, while stage IIC patients had 28.5% survival. The authors suggest that single-agent adjuvant dactinomycin should be reevaluated.

pmid-6296544.summary_ja: 両側の精巣に同時性に発生した原発性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告と文献的考察。385例中9例（2.3%）が両側性原発胚細胞腫瘍で、そのうち1例は両精巣に同時に発生していた。治療は単発例と同様に、組織型と転移の状況に基づいて行うとされる。
pmid-6296544.summary_en: This report describes a case of synchronous bilateral primary germ cell tumors of the testis, which are exceedingly rare. In a series of 385 patients, the authors identified nine with bilateral primary germ cell tumors (2.3%), including one with synchronous involvement of both testes. The most common synchronous testicular tumors are seminomas, followed by embryonal carcinomas, teratocarcinomas, and choriocarcinomas. Treatment follows the same principles as for solitary testicular tumors, based on histology and metastasis.

pmid-6296679.summary_ja: 1958〜1978年に絨毛癌または侵入奇胎で治療された457例の長期生存者を対象に、細胞傷害性化学療法後の二次腫瘍発生を追跡した研究である。大多数がメトトレキサートを投与され、57%は他の抗がん剤も併用された。平均7.8年、総計3522患者年の観察で二次腫瘍は白血病と乳癌の2例のみで、期待値3.5例を下回った。中期的に発癌性はないと結論している。
pmid-6296679.summary_en: This 1983 NEJM study followed 457 long-term survivors treated for choriocarcinoma or invasive mole between 1958 and 1978 to assess second tumor risk after cytotoxic chemotherapy. Most patients received methotrexate, and 57% also received other cytotoxic agents such as dactinomycin, vincristine and cyclophosphamide. Over a mean of 7.8 years and 3522 patient-years, only two second neoplasms developed (one acute leukemia, one breast carcinoma), fewer than the 3.5 expected. The authors concluded that methotrexate-based chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma does not appear carcinogenic in the medium term.

pmid-6296681.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞におけるレトロウイルス感染とプロウイルスのメチル化を調べた基礎研究。EC細胞ではプロウイルスがde novoにメチル化されるが、分化した奇形癌細胞ではメチル化されない。メチル化は遺伝子発現抑制の維持に役立つが、初期胚では追加の機構が働くと示唆される。
pmid-6296681.summary_en: This 1983 Nature study examined retrovirus infection in mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells. Input proviruses were blocked at transcription and became de novo methylated in EC cells but not in differentiated teratocarcinoma cells.
