pmid-6297849.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株F-9を用い、基底膜タンパク質であるラミニンとIV型コラーゲンの合成を定量した1982年の基礎研究。レチノイン酸による内胚葉様細胞への分化誘導で産生が5～10倍に増加し、ジブチリル環状AMPが特にIV型コラーゲンで増強作用を示した。インスリンなどのホルモンの効果は限定的であった。
pmid-6297849.summary_en: This 1982 Connective Tissue Research paper uses the murine embryonal carcinoma line F-9 to quantify synthesis of basement membrane proteins laminin and type IV collagen. Retinoic acid-induced differentiation toward endoderm-like cells increased their production 5-10 fold, with dibutyryl cyclic AMP enhancing the effect, especially for type IV collagen. Insulin, EGF and NGF had only modest, variable effects. Most of the protein was secreted into the medium. The study is a basic model of EC differentiation rather than clinical management.

pmid-6298118.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株LICR LON HT39/7に対するモノクローナル抗体を作製した1982年の報告。抗体FC 10.2は未分化な奇形腫由来細胞や胚細胞腫瘍内の内胚葉領域に限局する200kDa膜糖タンパク質を認識し、原始内胚葉のマーカーとして有用であった。
pmid-6298118.summary_en: This 1982 International Journal of Cancer report describes monoclonal antibodies raised against the human embryonal carcinoma line LICR LON HT39/7, using formol-saline fixed cells to yield antibodies that recognize histologically processed antigens. One antibody, FC 10.2, recognizes a 200 kDa membrane glycoprotein restricted to undifferentiated teratoma-derived cells, fetal intestine and bronchus, and endodermal areas within germ-cell neoplasms. It serves as a marker of primitive endoderm for histopathological identification of germ-cell tumor components.

pmid-6299165.summary_ja: 1982年のシンガポールの総説で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療の進歩をまとめる。早期例では生存率がほぼ100%に達しており、診断法の改善、高リスク群の同定、集中的化学療法、選択的手術、腫瘍マーカーであるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を用いた綿密なフォローアップが寄与したとする。
pmid-6299165.summary_en: This 1982 Singapore review summarizes advances in managing gestational trophoblastic disease. Near-100% survival is now reported for early-stage disease, attributed to improved diagnosis, identification of high-risk groups, effective intensive chemotherapy, selective adjunctive surgery, and close follow-up with serial monitoring of hCG as a tumor marker. The authors highlight how these developments have reduced morbidity and mortality. The article is a narrative review focused on clinical management of GTD rather than a primary study.

pmid-6299166.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の易感受性や進展にHLA抗原が関与するかを検討した1982年の報告。HLA抗原と易感受性の間に関連は認められず、患者・夫・腫瘍間の適合性試験からも進展への関与は小さいと考えられた。腫瘍細胞の表面HLA発現は乏しいと推定され、正常および異常栄養膜細胞のHLA発現も論じられている。
pmid-6299166.summary_en: This 1982 Singapore paper examines whether HLA antigens influence susceptibility and progression of trophoblastic disease. The authors report that susceptibility is not associated with HLA antigens. Compatibility testing between patient, husband and tumor suggested HLA may not play an important role in progression either. Direct evidence indicated tumor cells probably express few HLA antigens on their surface. The authors also discuss HLA expression on normal and abnormal trophoblasts. The paper addresses tumor immunology in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6750912.summary_ja: 男性の胃癌2例にみられた絨毛癌様変化を報告した。両例とも腺癌と絨毛癌の成分を含み、腺癌から絨毛癌への形態学的移行が追跡された。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は合胞体栄養膜細胞に局在し、腺癌成分は陰性であった。1例では術前血清hCGが胃切除後に低下し、胃癌によるhCG産生の病因的意義が論じられた。
pmid-6750912.summary_en: This report describes two males with gastric carcinoma showing choriocarcinomatous change. Both tumors contained adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma components, and a morphologic transition from adenocarcinoma to choriocarcinoma was traceable. Immunoperoxidase staining localized hCG to syncytiotrophoblasts, with weak staining in cytotrophoblasts, while adenocarcinoma components were negative. Human placental lactogen was absent in both cases. In one patient, preoperative serum hCG was 19.9 mIU/ml and fell to 1.2 mIU/ml after gastrectomy. The authors discuss how gastric carcinoma may produce hCG and contribute to the pathogenesis of gastric choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6751106.summary_ja: 卵巣の充実性奇形腫の稀な合併症である腹膜神経膠腫症の2例を報告し、既報30例を検討した。腹膜や大網に生じる粟粒状の成熟グリア性播種で、ほぼ全例が良性とされ確認生検のみで足りることが多い。奇形腫性播種との鑑別が重要で、後者は予後不良を示し積極的治療を要する。GFAP陽性はグリア性であることを裏付ける。
pmid-6751106.summary_en: This report describes two new cases of gliomatosis peritonei, a rare complication of solid ovarian teratomas, and reviews 30 previously reported cases. Gliomatosis consists of miliary, mature glial implants on the peritoneum or omentum. The authors consider it benign in almost all cases, so biopsy confirmation alone is usually sufficient. It must be distinguished from teratomatous implants, which may indicate poor prognosis and need aggressive treatment. Prognostic value of serum alpha-fetoprotein in immature ovarian teratoma was inconclusive. Glial fibrillary acidic protein staining confirms the glial nature of the implants.

pmid-6759363.summary_ja: 奇形腫と卵巣腫瘍に焦点を当て、生体内での腫瘍組織発生の推定法を検討した。4つの基準のうち、移行像による顕微鏡的連続性は奇形腫では確かな根拠がないとされた。多発する小奇形様巣を伴うディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を詳細に検討し、第二の組織が第一の組織に由来するという考察が示された。間葉の役割も論じられる。
pmid-6759363.summary_en: This paper addresses how tumor histogenesis can be deduced in vivo, focusing on teratomas and ovarian tumors. Four criteria are considered: location relative to small early tumors, relative tissue availability versus tumor frequency, resemblance to tumor tissue, and microscopic continuity through transitional forms. The author argues each has pitfalls, and that the fourth criterion gives no convincing data for teratomas. A dysgerminoma with multiple small teratoid foci is described, and an origin of the second tissue from the first is argued. The role of mesenchyma in teratoma development is discussed.

pmid-6761280.summary_ja: マウスの胚由来奇形癌の発生を、宿主の免疫因子がどう調節するかを検討した。放射線照射、シクロホスファミド処理、脾摘、奇形癌細胞による免疫を施した宿主に胚を移植した。照射とシクロホスファミドは悪性腫瘍の発生率を低下させ、胸腺細胞の養子移入で回復した。発生は胸腺と脾臓の放射線・シクロホスファミド感受性細胞に規定され、その総数が発生の受容性を決めると結論された。
pmid-6761280.summary_en: This study examined how host immune factors regulate embryo-derived teratocarcinogenesis in mice. Seven-day embryos were transplanted under the kidney capsule of syngeneic hosts that were irradiated, cyclophosphamide-treated, splenectomized, or immunized with teratocarcinoma cells. Irradiation and cyclophosphamide reduced malignant tumor yield, and this was reversed by recovery or adoptive transfer of thymus cells. Splenectomy reduced yield in C57BL/6 but not C3H mice, while immunization had no effect. Regulation appears to depend on radiation- and cyclophosphamide-sensitive thymic and splenic cells.

pmid-6763331.summary_ja: 持続する喀血を呈した67歳男性で、肺原発絨毛癌と診断された症例を報告した。国際文献上、既報は他に見当たらないとされる。尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)（プロランB）の増加が早期診断の最も重要な手がかりとされ、治療は気管支肺癌の腫瘍学的基準に従う外科手術が推奨されている。
pmid-6763331.summary_en: This report describes a 67-year-old man with persistent hemoptysis found to have primary choriocarcinoma of the lung. The authors note that only previous cases were found in the international literature. Hyperprolanuria B (elevated urinary hCG, historically called prolan B) is considered the most important factor for early diagnosis. The recommended treatment is surgery following oncologic criteria for bronchopulmonary cancer, and the report highlights the rarity of this entity.

pmid-6802482.summary_ja: 1982年の研究で、ヒト奇形癌腫細胞株Tera IとPA1の表面から遊離する高分子量糖ペプチドの性質を解析した。酸性ムコ多糖でもムチン型糖ペプチドでもなく、マウス胎児性癌細胞由来のものと類似する特徴を示した。GCT由来細胞の糖鎖構造に種を超えた共通性がある可能性を示唆する。
pmid-6802482.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer Research study characterizes high-molecular-weight glycopeptides released from the surface of human teratocarcinoma cell lines Tera I and PA1. After galactose labeling and mild trypsin digestion, the glycopeptides were digested with pronase and analyzed. They were neither acidic mucopolysaccharides nor short-chain mucin-type glycopeptides. Their sensitivity to endo-beta-galactosidase and their binding to fucose-binding lectins closely resembled glycopeptides from mouse embryonal carcinoma cells. The findings suggest a shared structural pattern between human and mouse germ cell tumor-derived cells.

pmid-6804138.summary_ja: 1982年の前向き研究で、非セミノーマ型精巣癌31例の化学療法中の甲状腺機能を評価した。治療中にT4NやT3、rT3が上昇し、基礎TSHやTRHに対するTSH反応は低下した。化学療法が脱ヨード酵素の活性に影響し、甲状腺ホルモンのクリアランスが遅延したためと考察。
pmid-6804138.summary_en: This 1982 Clinical Endocrinology study prospectively evaluated thyroid function in 31 patients with non-seminoma testicular carcinoma undergoing chemotherapy. During treatment, serum T4, T3 and reverse T3 rose significantly, while basal TSH and the TSH response to TRH fell. Prolactin responses to TRH increased. The authors attribute these changes to delayed thyroid hormone clearance, probably from chemotherapy affecting deiodinating enzyme activity. The raised T4 and lowered TSH persisted after therapy, while free T3 remained unchanged, suggesting the hypothalamic-pituitary axis was unaffected.

pmid-6804234.summary_ja: 1982年の研究で、in vitroで分化能をもつヒト奇形癌由来細胞株PA 1が産生する細胞関連グリコサミノグリカンを同定した。ヒアルロン酸、コンドロイチン硫酸/デルマタン硫酸、ヘパラン硫酸、ケラタン硫酸様分子を、特異的な酵素や化学分解で確認した。ヒトGCT由来細胞株の生化学的特徴を示す研究である。
pmid-6804234.summary_en: This 1982 European Journal of Biochemistry study identifies the glycosaminoglycans produced by human teratocarcinoma-derived PA 1 cells, which can differentiate in vitro. Using radioactive sulfate and glucosamine labeling, the authors detected hyaluronate, chondroitin sulfate/dermatan sulfate copolymers, heparan sulfate and keratan sulfate-like molecules. Each fraction was confirmed by specific enzymatic or chemical degradation. The work provides a biochemical profile of cell-associated glycosaminoglycans in a human germ cell tumor-derived line.

pmid-6806257.summary_ja: 1982年の研究で、胎児性癌細胞表面の糖転移酵素（ガラクトシルトランスフェラーゼ）がポリラクトサミン糖複合体に結合する受容体であることを示した。分化したEC細胞は抗EC抗血清に反応しなくなった。GCT細胞の表面糖鎖と細胞間相互作用に関する基礎研究である。
pmid-6806257.summary_en: This 1982 Journal of Biological Chemistry study shows that poly-N-acetyllactosamine glycoconjugates are endogenous substrates for surface galactosyltransferase on embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells. Anti-EC antiserum inhibited endogenous galactosylation, stimulated exogenous galactosylation, and immunoprecipitated most of the product. Differentiated EC cells lost reactivity with this antiserum. Forced galactosylation released polylactosaminyl glycoconjugates from the cell surface. The authors conclude that surface galactosyltransferase binds these glycoconjugates and serves as at least one of their receptors on EC cells.

pmid-6806417.summary_ja: 1982年の日本の研究で、妊娠ラットの卵黄嚢に発がん物質を投与し、卵黄嚢腫瘍に類似した腫瘍を誘発した。16週までに約70%で腫瘍が生じ、30%では純粋型卵黄嚢腫瘍様の組織像が認められた。AFPの蛍光抗体染色でも陽性を示し、ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍の実験モデル確立を目指した。
pmid-6806417.summary_en: This 1982 Japanese study reports an experimental model of yolk sac tumor in rats. Carcinogen was administered directly to the yolk sac of pregnant Wistar rats on gestational day 10. By 16 weeks, about 70% of treated rats developed tumors. Most were histologically teratomas, but 30% showed pure-type yolk sac tumor patterns, including reticular and endodermal sinus or polyvesicular vitelline features. Hyaline bodies were demonstrated by PAS staining, and AFP was detected by fluorescent antibody staining. The authors aimed to contribute to an experimental model resembling human yolk sac tumor.

pmid-6889460.summary_ja: 1982年の報告。胚細胞腫瘍または卵巣癌の81例にシスプラチン併用化学療法を実施し、8例(9.8%)でてんかん発作が生じた。シスプラチンとの因果関係は確立できなかったが、低ナトリウム血症や治療前の腎機能障害が関与した可能性が示された。
pmid-6889460.summary_en: This 1982 report reviewed 81 patients with germ cell tumors or ovarian carcinoma treated with cisplatin-containing combination chemotherapy. Eight patients (9.8%) developed epileptic seizures during or within three months of treatment. A definite causal link to cisplatin could not be established, but seizures were rarely seen with other cytotoxic drugs. Possible contributing factors included hyponatremia and pretreatment renal impairment.

pmid-6889461.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の29例を対象に、シスプラチン併用化学療法後のマグネシウム値を追跡した。76%が治療中に低マグネシウム血症となり、11例は中止後も最長3年持続した。持続例では尿中マグネシウム排泄の亢進が多く、症状は稀であった。
pmid-6889461.summary_en: This report followed 29 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis after cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. Most (76%) became hypomagnesemic during treatment. Eleven of 22 affected patients remained persistently hypomagnesemic for up to three years after stopping cisplatin, while others normalized over a median of 0.6 years. Urinary magnesium excretion was inappropriately elevated in most persistent cases, and symptoms were rarely reported.

pmid-6889850.summary_ja: 再発仙尾部奇形腫の3歳半の女児に高用量シスプラチンを11コース投与したところ、視神経乳頭腫脹と腱反射消失が出現した。剖検で後索の有髄線維消失と神経膠症が確認された。シスプラチン療法に伴う神経病理学的変化を剖検で示した初の症例とされる。
pmid-6889850.summary_en: This case report describes a 3.5-year-old girl with recurrent sacrococcygeal teratoma who received eleven high-dose courses of cisplatin. She developed optic disc swelling and loss of tendon reflexes. Postmortem examination confirmed optic disc swelling and spinal cord changes, including loss of myelinated fibers and gliosis of the dorsal columns. The authors describe this as the first postmortem demonstration of neuropathologic changes associated with cisplatin therapy.

pmid-6890971.summary_ja: 1982年の研究で、絨毛癌細胞株(BeWo、HCCM-5)に対するインターフェロンαとβの効果を検討した。絨毛癌株と卵黄嚢腫瘍株は婦人科腺癌株より感受性が高かった。移植ハムスターでは接種後1〜7日目のIFN-β投与で腫瘍重量が約半分に減少した。
pmid-6890971.summary_en: This 1982 study tested human interferon-alpha and interferon-beta against choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo and HCCM-5, compared with endometrial and ovarian adenocarcinoma lines. Choriocarcinoma lines and a yolk sac tumor line were relatively sensitive, while gynecologic adenocarcinomas were resistant. In hamsters bearing BeWo or HCCM-5 tumors, daily interferon-beta from day 1 to day 7 roughly halved tumor weight, whereas later treatment had little effect.

pmid-6891627.summary_ja: 転移性悪性奇形腫に対する高用量シスプラチン併用化学療法で、硫酸マグネシウムの予防投与が低マグネシウム血症を防げるかを検討した。投与群8例と対照群8例を比較した。症候性域に低下したのは対照群5例、投与群1例であった。定期的な補充を推奨した。
pmid-6891627.summary_en: This study assessed whether prophylactic magnesium sulphate prevents hypomagnesaemia during high-dose cisplatin combination chemotherapy for metastatic malignant teratoma. Eight supplemented patients were compared with eight matched patients who did not receive routine supplementation. Magnesium levels fell into the symptomatic range in five of eight unsupplemented patients versus one of eight supplemented patients, and mean levels were significantly higher in the supplemented group. The authors recommend routine supplementation.

pmid-6892189.summary_ja: 精巣由来と考えられる絨毛癌の24歳男性例。上腹部不快感と女性化乳房で受診し、肺病変と後腹膜転移、LH・hCG高値を認めた。シスプラチン・ビンクリスチン・ブレオマイシン(Einhorn法)の3コース後にhCGは正常化し、肺病変も縮小した。
pmid-6892189.summary_en: This 1982 Japanese case report describes a 24-year-old man with choriocarcinoma of probable testicular origin. He presented with upper abdominal discomfort and gynecomastia, with pulmonary nodules, retroperitoneal metastasis, and elevated LH and hCG. Biopsy of an inguinal mass confirmed choriocarcinoma. Treatment with cisplatin, vincristine and bleomycin (Einhorn protocol) normalized serum hCG after three courses, and pulmonary lesions decreased.

pmid-6892200.summary_ja: 難治性絨毛癌の有効な治療法を探るため、ヌードマウスに移植したヒト絨毛癌に各種抗癌剤を投与した。増殖抑制はビンクリスチン、シスプラチン、メルファラン等で認められた。メルファランが抑制効果と生存率の両面で最も有効で、併用・維持療法の検討が提案された。
pmid-6892200.summary_en: This study tested various anticancer agents against human choriocarcinoma xenografts in nude mice to identify effective therapy for refractory choriocarcinoma. Tumor growth inhibition was seen with vincristine, VP-16, cisplatin, melphalan, cyclophosphamide and carboquone. Survival was 100% with melphalan, bleomycin and carboquone, while all mice died in the actinomycin D, vinblastine, VP-16 and vincristine groups. Melphalan performed best overall, and the authors suggest combination and maintenance studies.

pmid-6956527.summary_ja: 培養したヒト妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株GCC-SVとLu-75のHLA発現を血清学的に調べた研究。GCC-SVは患者のHLA-A2抗原を発現した一方、Lu-75は直接法でHLA-Aが検出されなかった。両株ともヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生能を有し、2年以上維持されていた。いずれの株でも父親由来のHLA-A抗原は確認されなかった。
pmid-6956527.summary_en: This 1982 study examines HLA expression on two cultured human gestational choriocarcinoma cell lines, GCC-SV and Lu-75, which were maintained in culture and serially passaged. Serological testing, including protein A assays and absorption tests, showed that GCC-SV expressed the patient's HLA-A2 antigen, whereas Lu-75 did not show direct HLA-A reactivity but was positive for beta 2-microglobulin. The authors conclude that paternal HLA-A antigens were not demonstrated on these choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-6956766.summary_ja: 奇形腫発生の感受性が高い系統と低い系統のマウス胎仔精巣で、原始胚細胞の増殖を比較した研究。原始胚細胞の有糸分裂は妊娠13日にピークに達し、奇形癌化の感受性期と一致した。増殖期間が長い精巣ほど奇形腫が多く、原始胚細胞数が著しく少ない胎仔では両側性の奇形腫が高頻度に生じた。
pmid-6956766.summary_en: This study compares primordial germ cell proliferation in fetal testes of mouse strains with high and low susceptibility to congenital testicular teratomas. Germ cell mitosis peaked at day 13 of gestation, matching the window of teratocarcinogenesis susceptibility. Testes with longer proliferative periods had more teratomas. Fetuses with markedly reduced primordial germ cell numbers showed a very high teratoma incidence, usually bilateral. The findings link early germ cell proliferation to testicular teratoma development.

pmid-6959618.summary_ja: 家族性46XY純粋性腺異形成症に伴うディスジャーミノーマと性腺芽細胞腫の症例報告と文献的概説。46XY性腺異形成は性腺芽細胞腫、続発するディスジャーミノーマの高リスクと関連する。家族性の場合は兄弟姉妹のスクリーニングが必要とされる。遺伝学やH-Y抗原の病態も概説されている。
pmid-6959618.summary_en: This case report and review addresses dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma in familial 46XY pure gonadal dysgenesis. The authors note that 46XY gonadal dysgenesis, first described by Swyer in 1955, carries a high risk of gonadoblastoma and subsequent dysgerminoma. They recommend screening siblings in familial cases. The review also covers the genetics and pathophysiology of gonadal dysgenesis and H-Y antigen, which have helped clarify mechanisms of sexual development.

pmid-6961419.summary_ja: 同一患者の良性卵巣奇形腫7個を、遺伝学的マーカーを用いて解析した研究。減数分裂I期の失敗が起源として示唆され、一部の同型接合腫瘍は一倍体配偶子の核内倍加に由来すると考えられた。複数の卵巣奇形腫が多様な起源を持つことを示し、遺伝子マッピングへの影響も論じている。
pmid-6961419.summary_en: Researchers examined seven benign ovarian teratomas from a single patient using centromere heteromorphisms and enzyme markers in cultured cells. Three tumors were fully homozygous, while four were heterozygous at centromeres but homozygous for at least one enzyme marker. Linkage analysis in somatic cell hybrids showed linkage phases differed from the host. The findings exclude suppression of meiosis II as the origin, suggesting most arise from failure of meiosis I, while some homozygous tumors may derive from endoreduplication of a haploid gamete. The authors discuss implications for centromere-based gene mapping.

pmid-6963167.summary_ja: 卵管奇形腫は極めてまれで、1865年以降の報告は47例のみである。多くは嚢胞性で術前診断されず、組織像は卵巣奇形腫に類似する。本報告は48例目で、報告例中最小とされる良性卵管奇形腫の症例である。未経産や出産経験の少なさとの関連も指摘されている。
pmid-6963167.summary_en: A benign teratoma of the Fallopian tube is described, the 48th reported case since 1865 and apparently the smallest. Such tumors are very rare, mostly cystic, usually located in the ampulla or isthmus, and typically undiagnosed before surgery. Histology resembles ovarian and other teratomas. Only one malignant tubal teratoma has been recorded. Association with nulliparity or reduced parity was noted in some cases. The report summarizes the clinical and pathological features of this rare entity.

pmid-6978028.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫9例のCT所見を、単純X線、超音波、病理所見と比較した研究。6例で特異的診断が可能であった。脂肪性腫瘤に球状石灰化や歯などが突出する所見が特徴で、隣接臓器への浸潤の評価にも有用であった。
pmid-6978028.summary_en: Nine benign cystic teratomas were evaluated by computed tomography and compared with radiographic, sonographic, and pathologic findings. CT gave a specific diagnosis in six cases and was suggestive in two, outperforming other imaging methods. It reliably predicted or excluded invasion of adjacent structures but not adherence. Characteristic features include a predominantly fatty mass with a denser dependent component and globular calcification, bone, or teeth projecting into the cyst. The authors illustrate the different calcification patterns for the first time.

pmid-7037656.summary_ja: 合成黄体形成ホルモン放出因子(LRF)が、正常栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌(BeWo)細胞からのhCG放出に与える影響を検討した研究。LRFは正常で最大4倍、悪性で最大6倍のhCG放出増加を示した。絨毛癌を含む栄養膜細胞に対する特異的な作用が示された。
pmid-7037656.summary_en: The effect of synthetic luteinizing hormone-releasing factor (LRF) on hCG release was studied in isolated cell columns of normal syncytiotrophoblasts and choriocarcinoma (BeWo) cells. LRF increased hCG release up to 4-fold in normal trophoblasts and up to 6-fold in malignant trophoblasts. The results indicate a specific stimulatory effect of LRF on both normal and malignant trophoblast cells. The study links hormone regulation of trophoblastic hCG secretion to choriocarcinoma biology.

pmid-7044103.summary_ja: 卵巣に生じた甲状腺腫様カルチノイド2例を免疫組織化学と超微細構造で検討した。濾胞上皮にはサイロキシンが認められ、顆粒を含む細胞はカルシトニン陽性を示した。1例は中腸カルチノイド成分を有し、カルチノイド症候群を伴う初の報告である。本腫瘍は多様な分化を示す奇形腫の一型と結論づけられている。
pmid-7044103.summary_en: This immunocytochemical and ultrastructural study examines two ovarian strumal carcinoids, a teratoma subtype containing thyroid tissue. Immunoperoxidase staining showed thyroxine in follicular epithelium, and ultrastructure revealed thyroid features along with granule-containing cells resembling C-cells and foregut-hindgut carcinoids. Calcitonin-positive interfollicular cell proliferation appeared to mediate the transition from thyroid tissue to carcinoid pattern. One tumor had midgut carcinoid elements and was the first reported strumal carcinoid associated with carcinoid syndrome. The authors conclude that these neoplasms are teratomas exhibiting multiple differentiation patterns.

pmid-7046336.summary_ja: 胎児頸部奇形腫の新症例1例を既報116例に加え、悪性奇形腫は文献上6例のみと報告した。羊水過多や出生時の気道・食道閉塞の可能性を含め、産科的診断と管理を論じている。鑑別診断には嚢胞性リンパ管腫や甲状腺腫などが挙げられる。稀な疾患に対する産科医向けの指針として、臨床像、治療、予後を概説している。
pmid-7046336.summary_en: This review adds one new case to 116 previously reported cervical teratomas of the fetus and identifies only six prior reports of malignant teratoma. It discusses diagnosis and obstetric management, including tumor incidence, the likelihood of polyhydramnios, and the risk of acute airway or esophageal obstruction at birth. The differential diagnosis includes cystic hygroma, congenital goitre, bronchial cyst, lymphangioma, neuroblastoma, parotid tumor and thyroid carcinoma. The authors provide a synoptic description of clinical manifestations, treatment and prognosis to guide obstetricians managing this rare entity.

pmid-7046639.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌を有する36歳女性に、そう痒を伴う水疱性皮疹が出現した。生検と直接免疫蛍光法により疱疹性妊娠と診断された。メトトレキサート療法で癌と皮疹が同時に改善した。絨毛癌と疱疹性妊娠の関連を免疫蛍光所見とともに報告した初めての症例である。
pmid-7046639.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma who developed a pruritic, bullous eruption. Skin biopsy showed subepidermal bullae with eosinophilic infiltrate, and direct immunofluorescence demonstrated IgG and C3 deposition at the basement membrane zone, establishing herpes gestationis. Methotrexate therapy cured the carcinoma and resolved the skin lesions simultaneously. The authors note this as the first report linking herpes gestationis and choriocarcinoma with immunofluorescence findings, and they review the rarity of this association and its relation to hydatidiform mole and oral contraceptive use.

pmid-7053266.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における根治的精巣摘除術後の治療選択を総説した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清は病期分類の精度と高い治療効果を示し、合併症と死亡率は低いとされる。一方で、不要な治療の負担や臨床病期分類の限界、再発の早期発見も検討されている。救済治療の成功率が高い点も論じられている。
pmid-7053266.summary_en: This review examines treatment options after radical orchiectomy for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is presented as providing the most accurate staging and high therapeutic effectiveness, with minimal early and late morbidity and low mortality. The authors also weigh alternatives to surgery, considering the burden of unnecessary therapy, the accuracy of clinical staging, the ability to detect early relapse, and the high success rate of salvage treatment. The discussion reflects management debates for this highly curable tumor.

pmid-7053836.summary_ja: 1982年のCancer誌報告で、乳児2例の縦隔未熟奇形腫を扱う。1例は完全切除、1例は切除不能で、いずれも臨床経過は良性様であった。文献レビューにより、卵巣や仙尾部と異なり縦隔未熟奇形腫では組織学的予後指標が未確立であることを示す。一方、年長児や若年成人では胎児性癌に類似した悪性腫瘍として振る舞う。
pmid-7053836.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer report describes two infants with immature mediastinal teratoma, one completely excised and one unresectable, both showing benign clinical behavior. The authors review published cases and conclude that histologic grading has not yet been established for mediastinal immature teratomas as it has for ovarian or sacrococcygeal tumors. Immature teratomas in older children and young adults, however, behave as highly malignant tumors similar to embryonal carcinoma. The findings highlight age-dependent clinical behavior in mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-7055769.summary_ja: 1982年のCan J Surg誌の症例報告で、若年女性の良性充実性卵巣奇形腫が直腸へ穿通し、腸管内へ脱出した例を扱う。腸症状の精査中に上部直腸の脱出性腫瘤として発見された。切除標本の組織学的検査で診断が確定した。仙尾部由来を含む奇形腫が直腸穿通を起こす機序について考察している。
pmid-7055769.summary_en: This Canadian Journal of Surgery case report describes a young woman with a benign solid complex ovarian teratoma that perforated into the rectum and prolapsed into the bowel lumen. The tumor presented as a prolapsing mass in the upper rectum during evaluation for bowel symptoms. Histologic examination confirmed the diagnosis after surgical resection. The authors discuss mechanisms by which teratomas, including pararectal sacrococcygeal lesions, may perforate the rectum. The case illustrates an unusual gastrointestinal complication of a benign ovarian germ cell tumor.

pmid-7057506.summary_ja: 1982年のJ Urol誌の研究で、鼡径部または陰嚢の手術歴後に発生した精巣腫瘍患者20例を検討した。セミノーマ6例は同側鼡径部を含む放射線療法、非セミノーマ14例は後腹膜リンパ節郭清±化学療法を受けた。鼡径リンパ節転移や再発は認められなかった。表在鼡径リンパ節と陰嚢への追加治療は推奨しないとしている。
pmid-7057506.summary_en: This 1982 J Urol study reviewed 20 men with testicular tumors arising after prior inguinal or scrotal surgery. Six patients with seminoma received radiotherapy including the ipsilateral groin, while 14 with nonseminomatous tumors underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with or without chemotherapy. No patient developed inguinal lymph node metastasis, and no recurrence was detected during follow-up. The authors therefore did not recommend additional treatment to the superficial inguinal nodes and scrotum.

pmid-7057637.summary_ja: 1982年のJ Surg Oncol誌の研究で、非セミノーマ精巣腫瘍患者86例のリンパ管造影による後腹膜転移診断を検討した。画像所見を後腹膜リンパ節郭清または開腹時の組織所見と対比した。全体の信頼度は78%で、陽性所見は88%、陰性所見は74%であった。後腹膜転移は患者の58%で検出された。確実に転移を示すリンパ節サイズの閾値は確立できなかった。
pmid-7057637.summary_en: This 1982 J Surg Oncol study evaluated lymphography for detecting retroperitoneal lymph node metastases in 86 patients with nonseminomatous testicular tumors. Lymphogram findings were correlated with histology from retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or laparotomy. Overall reliability was 78%, with 88% for positive and 74% for negative studies. Retroperitoneal metastases were detected in 58% of patients using lymphography. The authors found no size threshold above which node metastases could be reliably identified.

pmid-7059933.summary_ja: 1982年のCancer誌の症例報告で、片側の純粋卵巣ディスジャーミノーマの若年女性で血清LDHが6倍以上に上昇した例を扱う。術後2週間でLDHは正常化し、ジャーミノーマ細胞が起源と考えられた。既報4例を含め文献的に検討し、LDHは診断と経過観察の腫瘍マーカーとして有用だと提唱している。
pmid-7059933.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer case report describes a young woman with a unilateral pure ovarian dysgerminoma and more than sixfold elevation of serum LDH, with increases in isoenzymes 1, 2, and 3. LDH normalized two weeks after surgery, suggesting germinoma cells as the source. The authors review four previously reported cases and propose LDH as a useful tumor marker for diagnosis and surveillance of germinomas, dysgerminomas, and seminomas. Elevated LDH in other neoplasms is also reviewed.

pmid-7061901.summary_ja: 1982年の日本の論文で、薬剤耐性絨毛癌を移植したヌードマウスによる実験的化学療法を報告した。MTX併用療法が無効な場合、ACDとCPMの併用(VCR追加も含む)が有効であった。2症例に臨床応用し、1例はhCG陰性化と寛解、もう1例はhCG低下と肺転移の縮小が得られた。実験モデルが耐性絨毛癌の合理的化学療法の指針になるとしている。
pmid-7061901.summary_en: This 1982 Japanese paper reports experimental chemotherapy using drug-resistant choriocarcinoma transplanted into nude mice. Combinations including ACD and CPM, with or without VCR, were effective when MTX-based regimens failed. Two clinical patients were treated accordingly: one achieved hCG normalization and remission with ACD and CPM, and the other showed hCG regression and reduction of pulmonary metastasis with ACD, CPM, and VCR. The authors conclude that experimental models can guide rational chemotherapy for resistant choriocarcinoma.

pmid-7062893.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の患者で、頭部CTに脳実質病変がないにもかかわらず頭蓋内圧亢進を呈した症例に関する論文である。頭蓋外からの転移が脳からの静脈還流を阻害し、頭蓋内圧亢進を来しうることが示された。転移性腫瘍では脳実質病変の有無にかかわらず、この機序を考慮する必要がある。
pmid-7062893.summary_en: This case-based report describes a patient with metastatic germ cell cancer who presented with increased intracranial pressure despite a head CT showing no parenchymal lesions. The authors propose that cranial metastases obstructing venous outflow from the brain can cause this presentation. Recognizing this mechanism matters because clinicians may otherwise assume parenchymal brain metastases and miss the cause. The paper highlights a diagnostic pitfall in patients with metastatic germ cell tumors who have raised intracranial pressure but no visible brain lesions.

pmid-7064001.summary_ja: 1966年から1975年にケープタウンのグルート・スール病院で診療した卵巣腫瘍を解析した報告である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の頻度が欧米の報告より高く、カラードおよび黒人患者で増加が見られた。その理由は明らかにされていない。卵巣奇形腫の疫学情報を提供する記述的研究である。
pmid-7064001.summary_en: This South African hospital-based analysis reviews ovarian neoplasms treated at Groote Schuur Hospital from 1966 to 1975. It finds a relatively high incidence of mature cystic teratomas compared with European and North American series, with the increase apparent among Coloured and Black patients. The authors could not identify the reasons for this difference. The study provides epidemiological information on ovarian teratomas, a germ cell tumor subtype, across populations. It is a descriptive report, so causal conclusions are limited.

pmid-7064252.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘤に対して常に精巣摘除術が必要かを検討した泌尿器科の論文である。小さく可動性のある精巣内病変で長期経過の症例では、白膜を切開して精巣内を探索することで、不要な精巣摘除を避けうると述べている。良性精巣内腫瘍6例も報告している。精巣腫瘤の管理に関する情報を提供する。
pmid-7064252.summary_en: This urology paper questions whether every testicular mass requires orchiectomy. It describes exploring the testis through the tunica albuginea in selected cases with small, movable intratesticular lesions and a long history, potentially avoiding unnecessary orchiectomy. The authors present six cases of rare benign intratesticular tumors and a rare indication for testicle-preserving surgery. The work informs management of testicular masses, a setting central to testicular germ cell tumor care, though the abstract does not explicitly address malignant germ cell tumors.

pmid-7064584.summary_ja: 新生児の頸部奇形腫の症例報告である。奇形腫は主に新生児に見られる稀な病変で、胎児や死産児に見られることもある。出生前に超音波検査で診断されたが、呼吸窮迫のため児は死亡した。このような症例では緊急手術が不可欠であると著者らは強調している。
pmid-7064584.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with cervical teratoma, a rare lesion found mostly in newborns and occasionally in fetuses or stillborn infants. Prenatal ultrasonography enabled diagnosis, but the infant died from respiratory distress. The authors emphasize that urgent surgery is essential in such cases. The report illustrates the clinical course and the need for timely surgical intervention in neonatal extragonadal teratoma with airway compromise.

pmid-7067040.summary_ja: マンチェスター小児腫瘍登録に基づく集団研究で、小児胚細胞腫瘍の出生前要因を検討している。発生率は100万人年あたり約1から約4へ上昇した。胚細胞腫瘍は先天奇形、特に中枢神経系の奇形と関連し、妊娠中の感染とも関連が示された。母体の慢性疾患や薬剤使用などの要因は、さらなる検討が必要である。
pmid-7067040.summary_en: This population-based study from the Manchester Children's Tumour Registry examines prenatal origins of childhood germ cell tumours. Pathologic review ensured diagnostic accuracy, and incidence rose from about 1 to 4 per million person-years. Analysis of case records and maternal obstetric records linked germ cell tumours with congenital malformations, particularly of the central nervous system, and showed an association with infections during pregnancy. Other factors, including maternal chronic illness and drug use, may be relevant but require further study.

pmid-7067347.summary_ja: ゴナドトロピン産生セミノーマ14例を検討した論文である。血清・尿中hCG上昇、または組織学的にhCGを含む合胞体栄養膜巨細胞により同定された。通常のセミノーマより予後不良で、進行病期で発見される傾向がみられた。臨床的・生物学的に異なる胚細胞腫瘍の一群として治療計画を立てるべきと述べている。
pmid-7067347.summary_en: This article describes gonadotrophin-producing seminomas, identified either by elevated serum or urinary hCG or by syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells containing hCG on histology. A review of 14 patients showed these tumours have a worse prognosis than typical seminomas and tend to present at a more advanced stage. The authors argue they are clinically and biologically distinct and should be treated accordingly. The findings bear on risk stratification and treatment planning for seminoma.

pmid-7069243.summary_ja: 本研究は、1971～1979年に治療した胞状奇胎後の侵入奇胎44例と絨毛癌14例を解析し、適切なフォローアップ期間を検討したものである。侵入奇胎は、尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が下垂体LHレベルを下回る前に発見された。絨毛癌の多くはそれより遅く診断され、最長で7年2か月後であった。正常なLHレベルを示した後の再上昇は絨毛癌を示唆すると述べている。
pmid-7069243.summary_en: This 1982 Japanese clinical study reviewed 44 postmolar invasive mole and 14 postmolar choriocarcinoma cases treated from 1971 to 1979 to determine how long patients should be followed after molar pregnancy. Invasive moles were detected before urinary hCG fell below the pituitary LH level, or by the fifth postmolar month. Most choriocarcinomas were diagnosed later, up to 7 years and 2 months after evacuation. The authors conclude that follow-up must extend at least that long. They also note that a normal LH-level hCG pattern predicts choriocarcinoma rather than invasive mole, which is key to managing postmolar patients.

pmid-7069752.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、XY性腺異形成症で性腺芽腫、筋緊張性ジストロフィー、原因不明の慢性腎疾患を合併した患者を記述したものである。腎疾患とXY性腺異形成症の併存は、本症例を含む3例で認められた。両者の間には未解明の病因的関連が示唆されている。性腺芽腫は異形成性性腺から生じる胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変であり、臨床的に重要な所見である。
pmid-7069752.summary_en: This 1982 case report describes a patient with XY gonadal dysgenesis who had gonadoblastoma, myotonic dystrophy and chronic renal disease of unknown cause. The authors note that renal disease and XY gonadal dysgenesis co-occurred in this and two other subjects. This suggests a possible but still obscure etiologic link between the two conditions. Gonadoblastoma is a precursor lesion of germ cell tumors arising in dysgenetic gonads, making this a relevant clinical observation of gonadal germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-7070731.summary_ja: 本研究は201例の妊娠奇胎を解析し、部分胞状奇胎の臨床病理学的特徴を完全胞状奇胎と比較したものである。部分奇胎は完全奇胎の特徴の多くを持つが、より軽症の希薄化された型と考えられた。転移性疾患や顕性の絨毛癌は認められなかった。術後hCG値に基づく持続性絨毛性疾患について、さらなる検討が必要とされている。
pmid-7070731.summary_en: This 1982 Magee-Womens Hospital study analyzed 201 molar pregnancies to characterize partial hydatidiform mole and compare it with classic complete mole. Partial mole shares most pathologic and clinical features of complete mole but appears to be a milder, diluted form. It affects placental morphology, embryo fate, hCG levels and persistent trophoblastic disease. Preeclampsia can be equally severe but occurs later. No metastatic disease or overt choriocarcinoma was observed. The authors call for further study of post-evacuation hCG titers and the underlying pathology.

pmid-7072027.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある235例を検討し、対側精巣に腫瘍が生じた6例（2.7%）を報告したものである。セミノーマ後の発生が多く（113例中4例、3.5%）、初回腫瘍の平均発症年齢は25歳、腫瘍間の平均間隔は8.8年であった。転移経路の変化により二次腫瘍の病期分類は困難であり、初回治療により治療選択肢も制限されると指摘している。
pmid-7072027.summary_en: This 1982 study reviewed 235 patients with a history of testicular germ cell tumor and found that 6 (2.7%) developed a tumor in the contralateral testis. Metachronous involvement was more frequent after seminoma, occurring in 4 of 113 seminoma cases (3.5%). The mean age at the first tumor was 25 years, earlier than expected, and the mean interval between tumors was 8.8 years. The authors note that altered metastatic routes complicate accurate staging of second tumors, and that prior therapy for the first tumor limits treatment options.

pmid-7073378.summary_ja: 本研究は、1963～1980年に縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された男性12例の治療成績を報告したものである。化学療法と放射線療法のみで治療された8例は死亡し、生存期間中央値は6か月であった。外科的切除を受けた4例の生存者は、12～56か月無病で経過した。局所病変の持続が主要な課題であり、最適な併用療法の確立には多施設共同研究が必要とされている。
pmid-7073378.summary_en: This 1982 Annals of Thoracic Surgery report describes twelve men with mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with chemotherapy, with or without surgery and radiation, between 1963 and 1980. Eight patients treated with chemotherapy and radiotherapy alone died, with a median survival of six months. The four survivors were alive at 12 to 56 months without evidence of disease, and all had surgical resection either before or after chemotherapy. The authors identify persistent local disease as a key problem and call for multicenter collaboration to define optimal combined-modality therapy.

pmid-7074578.summary_ja: 小児卵巣ディスジャーミノーマの治療を検討した1982年の報告。局所病変の4例は手術のみで無病生存し、進行例の5例は化学療法(放射線療法の併用の有無を含む)で治療され、3例が無病生存した。再発したのは悪性胚細胞腫瘍が混在していた2例のみである。骨盤内と生殖臓器を温存する初回化学療法を提案している。
pmid-7074578.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer study reviews management of childhood ovarian dysgerminoma, the most common malignant ovarian tumor in children. Four children with localized disease were treated with surgery alone and remained disease-free. Five with extensive disease received primary chemotherapy, with or without adjuvant radiotherapy, and three were alive and disease-free. Recurrence occurred only in two patients with mixed malignant germ cell tumors. The authors propose initial chemotherapy to control tumor while sparing pelvic and reproductive organs.

pmid-7074590.summary_ja: 1950〜1975年のMayo Clinicでのセミノーマ483例の後方視的検討で、精巣病変を伴わない原発性後腹膜セミノーマは12例(2.5%)だった。放射線療法単独で治療された11例のうち7例が生存した。予後不良因子は非典型的組織像、非被包性腫瘍、症状を伴う腹部腫瘤、機能しない腎臓である。腫瘍床と大動脈傍リンパ節への照射を提案している。
pmid-7074590.summary_en: This Mayo Clinic retrospective review (1950 to 1975) of 483 seminomas identified 12 patients (2.5%) with primary retroperitoneal seminoma and no testicular involvement. Mean age was 47 years. Eleven received radiation alone, and seven remained alive with median follow-up of six years. Favorable factors were typical histology and an encapsulated tumor. Unfavorable factors were atypical histology, a nonencapsulated tumor, a symptomatic abdominal mass, and a nonfunctioning kidney. The authors suggest irradiating the tumor bed and para-aortic nodes to at least 2,000 rads.

pmid-7076870.summary_ja: 46XY表現型女性に生じた両側性性腺芽腫/ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告。血中のβ-hCGとテストステロンの上昇、FSHの低下が腫瘍の活動性を反映していた。手術とコバルト療法の後、3年時点で生存し良好な状態である。ホルモンマーカーが胚細胞性の腫瘍活動を追跡できることを示した症例である。
pmid-7076870.summary_en: This 1982 J Clin Pathol case report describes bilateral gonadoblastoma/dysgerminoma in a 46,XY phenotypic female. Elevated circulating beta-hCG and testosterone, together with decreased FSH, reflected tumor activity. After surgery and cobalt therapy, the patient remained alive and well at three years. The case illustrates how hormonal markers can track activity of gonadal germ cell neoplasia in a patient with a 46,XY karyotype.

pmid-7078992.summary_ja: 正期産の男児の胎盤に生じた奇形腫様病変の症例報告。組織発生には議論がある。本例と既報例は、組織学的にも臨床的にも良性とみられた。著者らは、胎盤奇形腫を真の腫瘍ではなく、胎児無形体(fetus amorphus)の極端な形と考えている。
pmid-7078992.summary_en: This 1982 Pathology case report describes a teratoma-like lesion arising in the placenta of a full-term male infant delivered by a 33-year-old woman. The histogenesis of such lesions is disputed. The authors note that this case and all previously reported cases appear histologically and clinically benign. They favor the view that placental teratoma is an extreme form of fetus amorphus rather than a true neoplasm.

pmid-7080327.summary_ja: 精巣標本92例(悪性43例、良性49例)の微小石灰化を検討した1982年の研究。悪性腫瘍の74%に石灰化がみられ、奇形腫(87%)はセミノーマ(60%)より多かった。良性標本では16%のみであった。石灰化の配列と分布は悪性と良性の鑑別に役立つ可能性がある。日常的な精巣撮影は胚細胞上皮を傷つけるおそれがあると指摘している。
pmid-7080327.summary_en: This 1982 Urology study examined microcalcifications in postoperative testicular specimens from 92 patients, 43 with malignant and 49 with benign disease. Microcalcifications were found in 74% of malignant tumors, more often in teratomas (87%) than seminomas (60%), and in 16% of benign specimens. The authors suggest that the pattern and distribution of calcifications may help distinguish malignant from nonmalignant lesions. They caution that routine orchioradiography risks damaging germinal epithelium, though it may be justified in occult carcinoma.

pmid-7082911.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者200例に対する157件の超音波検査の結果を報告した1982年の研究。16例(8.0%)で肝転移が確認された。低エコー、高エコー、ターゲット状の3つの所見パターンがみられた。低エコー病変は転移性セミノーマに典型的で、転移性奇形腫は3パターンのいずれも示しうる。治療反応の評価における超音波検査の有用性を考察している。
pmid-7082911.summary_en: This 1982 British Journal of Radiology study reports ultrasonographic findings in 200 patients with testicular tumor, 157 scans in total. Liver metastases were demonstrated in 16 patients (8.0%). Three patterns were seen: ill-defined echopoor lesions, well-defined echogenic lesions, and target lesions. Echopoor lesions were typical of metastatic seminoma, while metastatic teratoma could show any of the three patterns. The authors discuss the value of ultrasound in assessing therapeutic response of hepatic metastases from testicular tumor.

pmid-7083140.summary_ja: 片側精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を受けたセミノーマ患者で、性腺線量と精子形成を追跡した1982年の研究。残存精巣への線量は平均78radであった。65rad超を受けた14例中10例で無精子症が生じた。12例は30〜80週以内に精子が回復し、回復時期は線量に依存すると考えられた。回復期の乏精子症患者は妊孕性を持つ可能性があると助言している。
pmid-7083140.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer study monitored gonadal radiation dose and spermatogenesis in seminoma patients treated with radiation after unilateral orchiectomy. Patients received 3,200 rad in 16 fractions over four weeks to para-aortic and ipsilateral pelvic and inguinal nodes. The remaining testis received an average of 78 rad. Aspermia occurred in 10 of 14 patients who received over 65 rad to the gonad. Sperm recovered in 12 patients within 30 to 80 weeks. Recovery time appeared dose dependent, and the authors advise that oligospermic patients may be fertile during recovery.

pmid-7083164.summary_ja: マウス胚盤胞による胎児性癌(EC)細胞のコロニー形成抑制を測定するin vitro試験を開発した1982年の研究。曝露時間とともに回収率は2時間で84%、14時間で57%、24時間で27%に低下した。EC細胞周期を同期させると応答も同期し、その応答はG1期と関連すると考えられた。以前に報告された腫瘍形成の抑制を再現する試験系である。
pmid-7083164.summary_en: This 1982 Cancer Research study developed an in vitro assay measuring how the mouse blastocyst suppresses embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell colony formation. EC cells exposed to the blastocoele and then recovered after immunosurgery showed colony-forming recovery of 84% at 2 hours, 57% at 14 hours, and 27% at 24 hours. Synchronizing the EC cell cycle synchronized this response, which appeared linked to G1 phase. The assay reproduces previously described blastocyst suppression of EC tumor formation in the same cell line.

pmid-7083462.summary_ja: 1982年の報告で、妊娠性絨毛癌に対するエトポシド(VP16-213)の有用性を検討した。薬剤抵抗性例では約57%に奏効(PRまたはIMP)が得られ、中等度リスク群では79%が完全寛解に達した。高リスク群では併用療法により67%が完全寛解となった。著者らは、中等度・高リスクの妊娠性絨毛癌の第一選択薬の一つとしてエトポシドを位置づけるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-7083462.summary_en: This 1982 report describes the use of etoposide (VP16-213) in gestational choriocarcinoma. Drug-resistant patients showed partial response or improvement in about 57%. Among medium-risk patients initially treated with etoposide, 79% reached complete remission. In high-risk patients, combination therapy with methotrexate and actinomycin-D, followed by vincristine and cyclophosphamide, yielded 67% complete remission. The authors conclude that etoposide should be considered a first-line agent for medium- and high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-7085374.summary_ja: 1958〜1976年に治療された精巣セミノーマ444例を解析した。全体の5年生存率は87%で、病期I・II・IIIでそれぞれ94%、74%、32%であった。腹部触知病変のない病期II患者では非照射の縦隔に再発がなかったため、予防的縦隔照射は不要と考えられた。縦隔再発の多くは再照射で救済可能であった。他部位再発や内臓病変に対しては新たな治療法の検討が必要とされる。
pmid-7085374.summary_en: This study reviewed 444 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated at Princess Margaret Hospital between 1958 and 1976. Overall five-year survival was 87%, with stage-specific rates of 94%, 74%, and 32%. Stage II patients without palpable abdominal disease had no mediastinal recurrences without irradiation, so prophylactic mediastinal irradiation appeared unnecessary. Mediastinal relapses in patients with abdominal disease were largely salvageable with irradiation. New treatment approaches are needed for relapses at other sites and for visceral disease.

pmid-7087519.summary_ja: 1982年の症例報告で、6歳男児の心臓内奇形腫の摘出に成功したことを報告している。心筋および刺激伝導系を損傷せずに切除され、術前に二次元心エコー検査で奇形腫が示唆されていた。報告された心臓内奇形腫は7例目で、切除成功例としては2例目とされる。性腺外に生じた奇形腫の診断と外科的治療を示す症例である。
pmid-7087519.summary_en: This 1982 case report describes successful surgical excision of an intracardiac teratoma in a six-year-old boy. The tumor was removed without injury to the myocardium or conduction system, and preoperative two-dimensional echocardiography had suggested the diagnosis. The authors note this is the seventh reported intracardiac teratoma and the second successfully excised. The report illustrates diagnostic and surgical management of an extragonadal teratoma located in the heart.

pmid-7093170.summary_ja: 1977〜1981年に逐次併用化学療法を受けた転移性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍21例を報告している。内訳は悪性奇形腫18例とディスジャーミノーマ3例である。悪性奇形腫の予測生存率は71%で、ディスジャーミノーマの3例はいずれも寛解を維持した。死亡は主に悪性奇形腫の4例で、広範な前治療や再発が関与していた。著者らは、早期に治療を開始すれば大多数は治癒可能と結論づけている。
pmid-7093170.summary_en: This 1982 study reviewed 21 patients with metastatic ovarian germ cell tumours treated with sequential combination chemotherapy from 1977 to 1981, including 18 with malignant teratomas and three with dysgerminomas. Most malignant teratoma patients remained untreated and in remission, with a projected survival of 71%. Four malignant teratoma patients died, mostly after extensive prior treatment or relapse. All three dysgerminoma patients remained in remission. The authors conclude that most metastatic ovarian germ cell tumours are curable when treated early.

pmid-7093962.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の血清胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)を後方視的研究で検討した。活動性セミノーマ28例中16例でPLAPが上昇し、非セミノーマ性がんでの上昇は少数にとどまった。対照群は正常値であった。連続測定でも不適切な上昇はなく有用な情報を提供した。著者らは、PLAPがセミノーマの臨床的に有用な血清腫瘍マーカーであると結論している。
pmid-7093962.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) as a serum tumor marker in testicular cancer using a sensitive ELISA. PLAP was elevated in 16 of 28 men with active seminoma, and in 71% of those patients either PLAP or hCG was elevated. Only four of 22 nonseminomatous cancer patients had elevated PLAP, and control patients, including cured men, had normal levels. Serial measurements showed PLAP gave clinically useful information without inappropriate elevations. The authors conclude that PLAP is a clinically useful serum tumor marker for seminoma.

pmid-7095898.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌由来のクローン性ヒト胎児性癌細胞株の性状を解析した。ヌードマウスで腫瘍を形成し、SSEA-3およびHLAクラスI抗原を発現するが、SSEA-1は発現しない。低密度培養では分化能を示し、SSEA-1の誘導や形態の変化が見られた。本細胞株はヒト奇形癌研究や初期発生における細胞分化解析のモデルになると著者らは述べている。
pmid-7095898.summary_en: This study characterizes a clonal human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell line derived from a testicular teratocarcinoma, which forms tumors in athymic mice. The cells express the stage-specific embryonic antigen SSEA-3 and HLA class I molecules, but not SSEA-1. When cultures are started at low density, the cells can differentiate, with induction of SSEA-1 and morphologically distinct cells. The authors suggest this line provides a model for studying other human teratocarcinoma lines and early human cellular differentiation.

pmid-7100471.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍による後腹膜リンパ節転移に対し化学療法±放射線療法後にリンパ節郭清を受けた42例を対象とした。術後病理所見とCT値・腫瘍体積を比較した。活動性悪性腫瘍では平均37.7HU、非悪性では18.7HUであった。体積は悪性との相関がなく、血清マーカーは活動性悪性の7例中2例でしか上昇していなかった。20ml超の腹部転移では平均CT値が治療効果判定に有用とされた。
pmid-7100471.summary_en: Forty-two patients with retroperitoneal nodal metastases from testicular tumors, treated with chemotherapy with or without radiation, underwent lymphadenectomy. Postoperative histology was compared with mean CT attenuation values and tumor volumes. Masses with active malignancy averaged 37.7 HU, versus 18.7 HU for non-malignant masses. Volume did not correlate with malignancy, and serum markers were elevated in only two of seven patients with active disease. The authors propose mean CT attenuation as a key parameter for monitoring response in abdominal metastases larger than 20 ml.

pmid-7107698.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株(P19など)を非毒性濃度のレチノイン酸で処理すると、神経様細胞やグリア細胞へ分化することを示した。神経フィラメントの免疫染色で神経細胞が確認され、アセチルコリンエステラーゼ活性も上昇した。48時間後には神経細胞が出現し、毒性は認められなかった。レチノイン酸は他系譜を排除するのではなく、神経・グリアへの分化を誘導すると結論している。
pmid-7107698.summary_en: Murine embryonal carcinoma cells, including the P19 line, were aggregated and cultured with nontoxic concentrations of retinoic acid. Treated cells rapidly developed neuron-like cells, confirmed by neurofilament staining, along with glial and fibroblast-like cells, and showed elevated acetylcholinesterase activity. Neurons appeared within 48 hours. No retinoic acid toxicity was seen, suggesting the drug induces neural and glial differentiation rather than selecting against other lineages.

pmid-7108858.summary_ja: 129/Svマウスに精子で免疫し、その後マウス奇形癌6050を接種した。雄では精子免疫により腫瘍の発生と増殖が抑制され、雌では逆に促進された。両性の免疫血清はヒト精子と強く結合した。奇形癌細胞と精子が共有する抗原に基づき、雄では免疫療法的、雌では増強的な作用があると結論している。
pmid-7108858.summary_en: 129/Sv mice were immunized with sperm and then inoculated with the mouse teratocarcinoma line 6050. Sperm immunization significantly inhibited tumor incidence and growth in males, while presensitized females showed the opposite, enhanced tumor growth. Immune sera from both sexes bound human spermatozoa strongly. The authors conclude that sperm antigen immunization has immunotherapeutic effects in males and enhancing effects in females, linked to an antigen shared with teratocarcinoma cells.

pmid-7109544.summary_ja: ラットの胚由来卵黄嚢腫瘍は、正常の基底膜に似た多層状の細胞外マトリックスを産生した。この腫瘍由来のラミニンに対する抗体は、検査したすべての正常組織の基底膜と反応し、正常ラット腎臓でラミニンの超微細構造上の局在を明らかにした。マウスより大型のラットモデルは、ラミニンやIV型コラーゲン、ヘパラン硫酸の研究に有用であると結論している。
pmid-7109544.summary_en: Rat embryo-derived yolk sac tumor produces a multilamellar extracellular matrix resembling normal basement membranes. Laminin isolated from this tumor resembles that from EHS sarcoma, and antibodies raised against it react with basement membranes in all normal tissues tested. These antibodies localized laminin ultrastructurally in normal rat kidney. The authors propose the rat model as a useful system, larger than mouse tumor models, for studying laminin, type IV collagen, and heparan sulfate.

pmid-7110336.summary_ja: 多能性マウスP19胎児性癌細胞の凝集体をDMSOまたは高濃度レチノイン酸で処理した。DMSOでは心筋と骨格筋が急速に形成され、神経やグリアは形成されなかった。レチノイン酸では神経組織とグリア組織が形成され、筋組織は形成されなかった。同一の胎児性癌細胞集団から、薬剤によって二系統の胚組織を作り分けられることを示し、細胞決定の研究に有用である。
pmid-7110336.summary_en: Pluripotent murine P19 embryonal carcinoma cells were aggregated and treated with DMSO or high-dose retinoic acid. DMSO induced rapid formation of cardiac and skeletal muscle without neurons or glia. Retinoic acid generated neuronal and glial tissue but no muscle. The findings show that drugs can direct the same embryonal carcinoma population toward two distinct embryonic tissue lineages, making these cells useful for studying developmental cell determination.

pmid-7114357.summary_ja: 副腎からの転移の可能性が1例あるものの、悪性神経外胚葉成分のみ、またはほぼそれのみからなる卵巣腫瘍5例を報告する。原発性と考えられた4例は主に13〜17歳の患者で、このうち7年を超えて生存したのは1例のみであった。5例目は神経芽腫が臨床的に原発性卵巣癌として発症した症例であった。予後は全体に不良であった。
pmid-7114357.summary_en: This report describes five cases of ovarian tumors composed exclusively or almost exclusively of malignant neuroectodermal elements, considered a distinctive monodermal teratoma form. Four were primary ovarian tumors, mostly in adolescents aged 13 to 17, while one was likely metastatic from the adrenal gland. Survival was poor, with only one of the four primary cases surviving beyond seven years. The fifth patient had neuroblastoma that presented clinically as a primary ovarian cancer.

pmid-7116291.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性241例を対象とした研究である。総鞘膜への進展は9例中8例で、精索浸潤は31例中29例で転移と関連していた。腫瘍径は転移率と相関しなかった。これらの知見は補助療法試験の設計や、精巣摘除術後の無治療観察方針の判断に役立つとされる。
pmid-7116291.summary_en: This study of 241 men with testicular germ-cell neoplasms examined how local tumor spread and tumor size affect metastasis. Tumor extension through the tunica vaginalis was associated with abdominal lymph node or distant metastases in eight of nine patients, and spermatic cord invasion in 29 of 31. Tumor size did not correlate with metastatic rate. The authors conclude that these T-classification findings can inform adjuvant therapy trials and support a no-treatment approach after orchiectomy for selected patients.

pmid-7116308.summary_ja: 過去20年間に絨毛性疾患センターで治療された妊娠性絨毛癌の剖検31例を検討した研究である。死因は腫瘍出血や肺不全が最も多かった。化学療法の量は転移の数や分布に明らかな影響を与えなかった。多コース化学療法を受けた4例では細胞性栄養膜細胞が優位な非定型像を示し、より侵襲性の高い腫瘍の特徴を反映する可能性がある。
pmid-7116308.summary_en: This clinicopathologic study reviewed 31 autopsied cases of gestational choriocarcinoma treated at a trophoblastic disease center over two decades. Tumor hemorrhage and pulmonary insufficiency were the most common causes of death. The amount of chemotherapy did not clearly change the number or distribution of metastases. Four patients given multiple chemotherapy courses showed atypical patterns with cytotrophoblast predominance and infiltrative growth, which the authors suggest may reflect a more aggressive tumor form rather than a direct drug effect.

pmid-7130773.summary_ja: 卵巣胎児性癌(Higuchi-Kato)20例を3群に分けて臨床病理学的に検討した研究である。患者の年齢中央値は20歳で、ほぼ全例で腫瘍は片側性であった。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は臨床経過とよく相関し、有用な腫瘍マーカーであった。若年の病期Ia例では、卵巣機能温存を目的とした片側付属器切除と術後化学療法が治療法として提案された。
pmid-7130773.summary_en: This Japanese clinicopathological study examines 20 patients with ovarian embryonal carcinoma (Higuchi-Kato), grouped into three categories. The median age was 20 years, and tumors were unilateral in nearly all cases. Prognosis was better in Group C. Serum AFP correlated well with clinical course and served as a good tumor marker. For young patients with stage Ia disease, the authors propose unilateral adnexectomy with contralateral wedge resection and intensive postoperative chemotherapy to preserve ovarian function.

pmid-7132362.summary_ja: 乳児期に発症する頸部（甲状腺領域）の奇形腫の文献レビューと、新たな2症例の報告。乳児例は良性で、甲状腺由来と考えられている。呼吸窮迫で発症することが多く、腫瘍が大きい場合は羊水過多を伴う。速やかな外科的切除と、術前後の甲状腺機能検査による甲状腺機能低下症の予防が重要と強調している。
pmid-7132362.summary_en: This 1982 report describes congenital cervical teratoma of the thyroid region in infancy, adding two new cases to 132 previously reported. Presentation is typically early respiratory distress, sometimes with polyhydramnios when the tumor is large. Infant teratomas are benign and believed to arise from the thyroid. The authors stress prompt surgical removal and thyroid function testing before and after surgery to prevent hypothyroidism.

pmid-7139531.summary_ja: 肝様分化を示す卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の7症例（7〜43歳）を、光顕・超微細構造・免疫組織化学的に検討した。全例で肝様パターンが目立ち、4例でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。病期I の2例は1年以内に再発した。超微細構造は肝細胞癌に類似していた。
pmid-7139531.summary_en: This study examines seven cases of ovarian yolk sac tumor with hepatoid differentiation, in patients aged 7 to 43. Light microscopy, ultrastructure, and immunohistochemistry were combined. All tumors showed prominent hepatoid patterns; AFP was detected in four and albumin in two, while hCG was negative in four. Two stage I tumors recurred within a year, and ultrastructural features resembled hepatocellular carcinoma.

pmid-7139575.summary_ja: 精巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍と混合型胚細胞腫瘍の2例を無胸腺マウスに連続移植した1982年の実験報告。移植腫瘍は元の組織像を保持し、AFP反応性も維持された。混合型腫瘍の増殖はゴンペルツ式に適合した。精巣がんのヌードマウスモデルとして有用な知見を示している。
pmid-7139575.summary_en: Two human testicular tumors, a yolk sac tumor and a mixed germ cell tumor, were serially transplanted into athymic nude mice. Transplants kept the histologic patterns of their donors, and both donor and transplanted tumors were alpha-fetoprotein reactive. Growth of the mixed tumor fit a Gompertz model. Ultrastructure matched previously described testicular tumors. This is a 1982 experimental model report.

pmid-7140928.summary_ja: 5年間に連続して受け取った生殖腺の胚細胞腫瘍100例を解析した1982年の研究。卵巣では全能性を示す良性奇形腫が最も多く、精巣腫瘍の大部分は無能性のジャーミノーマであった。卵子と精子の発生機能の違いを、生殖腺内の局所的フィードバックと関連づけて論じている。
pmid-7140928.summary_en: This 1982 study analyzes 100 consecutive gonadal germ cell tumors received over five years. Benign ovarian teratomas with totipotent differentiation were most common in the ovary, whereas testicular tumors were mostly nullipotent germinomas. Testicular teratomas show embryoid bodies and organoid differentiation. The authors propose that ovum and sperm contribute differing developmental functions, shaped by local feedback within gonadal zones.

pmid-7141907.summary_ja: 1950〜1976年に主に当施設で治療された精巣がん831例を、TNM分類で病期分類し、組織型および病期別の予後を検討した1982年の研究。補助化学療法の有無による5年生存率の比較も行われ、複数の病期で補助化学療法群の生存率が高かった。
pmid-7141907.summary_en: This 1982 retrospective study covers 831 patients with testicular cancer (teratocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, pure choriocarcinoma) treated mainly from 1950 to 1976, staged by TNM classification. It reports survival by histology and TNM category, and compares 5-year survival with and without adjuvant chemotherapy after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy or radiotherapy. Adjuvant chemotherapy was associated with better survival in several stages.

pmid-7142899.summary_ja: 1982年のラット実験で、胎仔摘出後に転位させた卵黄嚢から奇形腫が誘発される初期過程を形態学的に追跡した。内胚葉様・中胚葉様の細胞増殖とともに、術後数日で未分化な細胞集団が出現した。これらは幹細胞様で、再分化により分化構造を生じると考えられた。毛細血管に富む肉芽組織がこの過程を促進した。
pmid-7142899.summary_en: This 1982 experimental study examines early cellular events when displaced visceral yolk sac is transplanted in rats after fetectomy, inducing teratomas. Morphological time-course analysis showed proliferation of cells with endodermal or mesodermal features, along with a population of poorly differentiated cells appearing days after surgery. The authors propose these cells are stem-like and give rise to differentiated structures through redifferentiation. Granulation tissue rich in capillaries appeared to enhance this process. Similarities and differences with blastema formation are discussed. The work offers insight into how yolk-sac-derived teratomas originate.

pmid-7142904.summary_ja: 1982年の研究で、核型正常な雄性胎児性癌細胞株P19とそのクローン株をマウス胚盤胞に注入した。中期妊娠期に多数のキメラが得られたが、多くは形態異常を示し、全例で胎児性癌由来の腫瘍が形成された。単一細胞でも正常組織と腫瘍の両方に寄与した。核型の正常性や胚への高い定着だけでは、正常な発生挙動への復帰は保証されないと結論づけた。
pmid-7142904.summary_en: This 1982 study tested whether a karyotypically normal male embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell line, P19, and a clonal subline, P19S18, can revert to normal embryonic behaviour after injection into mouse blastocysts. Many midgestation chimaeras formed, with EC cells colonizing a wide range of normal tissues, but most were morphologically abnormal and all contained EC-derived tumours. Few live chimaeras were obtained. Even a single P19S18 cell could contribute to both normal and tumour tissue. The authors conclude that neither a normal karyotype nor high embryo colonization is sufficient to ensure reversion of EC cells to normal development.

pmid-7144697.summary_ja: 1982年の症例報告で、20歳男性の大型悪性縦隔ジャーミノーマが胸部大動脈を圧迫し、大動脈縮窄に類似した所見を呈した。高血圧、大腿動脈拍動の著明な減弱、背部に放散する収縮期雑音がみられた。X線治療後に拍動は触知可能となり血圧も正常化した。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍が血管圧迫による偽縮窄症状で発症しうることを示す。
pmid-7144697.summary_en: This 1982 case report describes a 20-year-old man with a large malignant mediastinal germinoma that compressed the thoracic aorta. Hypertension, markedly reduced femoral pulses, and a systolic murmur radiating to the back mimicked coarctation of the aorta. After X-ray therapy, femoral pulses became palpable and blood pressure normalized. The authors note that aortic compression by a malignant teratocarcinoma mimicking coarctation had not previously been reported. The case shows that mediastinal germ cell tumours can present with vascular compression and pseudo-coarctation physiology, which should be considered in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-7147224.summary_ja: 1982年の研究で、マウス卵黄嚢癌の培養細胞を血清濃度10%と1%で比較し、走査・透過型電子顕微鏡で観察した。10%血清では多細胞性の球状集塊を形成し、微絨毛や発達したゴルジ体を示した。1%血清では球状構造を作らず扁平化し、これらの特徴を欠いた。低血清下で分泌糖タンパク質の糖鎖形成が変化する可能性も示唆された。
pmid-7147224.summary_en: This 1982 study examined murine parietal yolk sac carcinoma cells grown in vitro in media with 10% versus 1% fetal bovine serum, using scanning and transmission electron microscopy. In 10% serum, cells formed multicellular spheres and were oval, with surface microvilli, organized microtubules, abundant free polysomes and a well-developed Golgi apparatus. In 1% serum, they failed to form spheres, flattened over the growth surface, and lacked these features. The authors suggest these ultrastructural differences may explain altered glycosylation of secreted glycoproteins under low serum conditions. The work is an in vitro model of yolk sac tumour cell behaviour.

pmid-7150938.summary_ja: 1982年の泌尿器科研究で、精巣腫脹29例に水路法超音波検査を実施した。液体を含む病変は正確に描出された。セミノーマは無エコー域として描出され、肉芽腫性精巣炎と区別できなかったが、正常精巣の均一なエコー像とは明瞭に異なった。副睾丸の描出は不明瞭だった。水路法超音波は有望な診断手段と結論づけられた。
pmid-7150938.summary_en: This 1982 urology study evaluated water-path ultrasound in 29 patients with testicular swellings. Fluid-containing lesions such as hydroceles and epididymal cysts were accurately depicted. Seminomas appeared as anechoic areas that could not be distinguished from granulomatous orchitis, but differed clearly from the homogeneous echo pattern of normal testis. Depiction of the epididymis was less clear. The authors conclude that water-path ultrasonography is a promising addition to the diagnostic armamentarium for scrotal swellings, although it did not separate seminoma from inflammatory lesions.

pmid-7151813.summary_ja: 1982年の前向き研究で、後腹膜リンパ節浸潤の診断に超音波検査、CT、リンパ管造影を比較した。対象96例にはホジキン病、非ホジキンリンパ腫、精巣腫瘍（セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ）が含まれた。感度はCTが92%と最も高く、特異度は超音波検査が95%で最も高かった。診断戦略の再評価が必要と結論づけられた。
pmid-7151813.summary_en: This prospective study compared echography, computed tomography and lymphography for detecting infiltrating retroperitoneal lymph node involvement. Ninety-six patients with Hodgkin's disease, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and seminomatous or non-seminomatous testicular tumours underwent all three examinations. Sixty-two patients, including 30 non-seminomas and 32 Hodgkin's disease cases, underwent laparotomy and were analysed against histopathology. CT showed the highest sensitivity (92%) and echography the highest specificity (95%); lymphography gave 83% sensitivity and 84% specificity. The authors call for re-evaluation of the diagnostic strategy for retroperitoneal nodal disease.

pmid-7152170.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9を胸腺や水晶体由来の体細胞と融合させると、多能性を獲得したハイブリッド細胞株が得られた。これらは同系マウスで神経管、軟骨、骨格筋、繊毛上皮など多様な組織へ分化する腫瘍を形成し、in vitroでも複数の細胞型に分化した。細胞融合により分化制御遺伝子を導入できる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-7152170.summary_en: The authors fused nullipotent embryonal carcinoma F9 cells with somatic cells freshly collected from thymus and lens. The resulting hybrid cell lines acquired pluripotency. In solid tumors formed in syngeneic mice, they differentiated into neural tubes, cartilage, skeletal muscle, ciliated epithelium and other tissues, and cells from these tumors differentiated into several cell types in culture. The authors suggest that cell fusion might introduce genes that regulate differentiation into F9 cells.

pmid-7153081.summary_ja: 1938年から1976年にアイオワ大学病院で治療された卵巣未分化胚細胞腫17例を後方視的に検討した。大半は11～30歳だった。7例が原病で死亡し、10例は無病生存で、中央値102か月のフォローアップであった。術後放射線療法は、ディスジャーミノーマに対する手術の有用な補助療法であると結論づけている。
pmid-7153081.summary_en: This retrospective review evaluated 17 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated at the University of Iowa Hospitals between 1938 and 1976. Most were aged 11 to 30 years. Seven patients died of disease, while ten remained free of evidence of disease, with a median follow-up of 102 months in that group. The authors conclude that postoperative radiation therapy is a valuable adjunct to surgery for dysgerminoma.

pmid-7153601.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌患者から5種類の永続細胞株を樹立し、Qバンド法で染色体を解析した。全株で亜四倍体のモード数を示し、構造異常染色体も認められた。男児出産後由来のBeWo株はY染色体を失っていたが、Jar株は保持していた。完全胞状奇胎由来の1株にもY染色体が認められ、その意義を考察した。
pmid-7153601.summary_en: Five permanent cell lines were established from patients with gestational choriocarcinoma. Q-banded chromosome analysis showed a hypotetraploid modal number in all lines, with unidentifiable structurally altered chromosomes in each. The BeWo line, derived after delivery of a male infant, had lost its Y chromosome, while the Jar line retained it. One of two lines from a complete hydatidiform mole also carried a Y chromosome, and the authors discuss the significance of these findings.

pmid-7161011.summary_ja: 卵巣セミノーマの腰椎転移に対し、右腎静脈下方で下大静脈を含めて腫瘍を切除し、続いて4000 radの放射線療法を行った症例報告。切除後は腰静脈と左性腺静脈が静脈還流を代償することが静脈造影で示された。術後15年時点で患者は良好な状態を保っており、このような症例では積極的な外科的管理が妥当であると著者らは結論づけている。
pmid-7161011.summary_en: A case report of lumbar metastasis from an ovarian seminoma in a woman treated with en bloc resection of the tumor together with the inferior vena cava below the right renal vein, followed by 4000 rad of radiation therapy. Phlebography demonstrated the compensatory role of lumbar and left gonadal veins after IVC resection. Fifteen years after surgery, the patient remained in good physical condition. The authors argue that aggressive surgical management is justified in such situations.

pmid-7161670.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍の臨床病理学的検討。性腺および性腺外に発生し、高い悪性度と広範な転移を示す。精巣腫瘍では13例中9例が生存し、精巣摘除術とリンパ節切除を中心に、化学療法や放射線療法を併用する多剤併用療法が推奨されている。αフェトプロテインは有用な腫瘍マーカーとされる。
pmid-7161670.summary_en: A clinicopathological review of endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors, which arise in the gonads and extragonadal sites and are highly malignant. Nine of 13 boys with testicular tumors survived, all treated with orchiectomy and lymph node excision. Children with large extragonadal pelvic and retroperitoneal tumors also survived after surgery combined with chemotherapy and radiation. The authors recommend multimodal therapy, and they describe alpha-fetoprotein as a valuable tumor marker.

pmid-7166333.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株1003を無血清の定義培地で培養し、接着因子としてラミニンとフィブロネクチンを比較した基礎研究。ラミニンは細胞の接着、増殖、神経突起伸展を改善した。低密度播種では胚性ミオシン陽性の多核筋管の形成も誘導したが、フィブロネクチン系ではこの筋分化は認められなかった。
pmid-7166333.summary_en: Using the embryonal carcinoma line 1003 cultured in a defined serum-free medium, the authors compared fibronectin and laminin as attachment substrates. Laminin improved cell attachment, spreading, growth, and neurite extension. At low seeding density it induced formation of multinucleated myotubes that stained for embryonic myosin. Fibronectin cultures with polylysine, FGF, or serum-spreading factor did not show muscular differentiation.

pmid-7167411.summary_ja: 10歳時に卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫で手術を受けた患者が、12〜13年後に反復する疼痛と骨盤内腫瘤で再手術を受けた症例報告。腹膜に神経膠組織の播種と子宮内膜症が認められ、両者の併存は初めての報告である。卵巣奇形腫の被膜破綻に伴う播種性転移と解釈されている。
pmid-7167411.summary_en: A woman operated on for a benign cystic ovarian teratoma at age ten presented 12 to 13 years later with recurrent pain and pelvic masses. Biopsies revealed disseminated peritoneal gliomatosis together with endometriosis, a combination not previously reported. The glial implants showed partial infiltration into fat and diffuse calcification, with regressive changes. The authors interpret the peritoneal gliomatosis as implantation metastases from an ovarian teratoma of varying maturity.

pmid-7173530.summary_ja: フィーダー細胞を用いず、β-メルカプトエタノール含有培地で単一の多能性胎児性癌細胞を培養すると、特徴的で再現性のあるコロニー形態を示すことを報告。コロニーから幹細胞株を再樹立でき、コロニー形態の変化した変異株も単離された。胎児性癌細胞の分化の遺伝学的・系譜解析への応用が示唆される。
pmid-7173530.summary_en: Individual pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cells were cultured without a feeder layer in medium containing beta-mercaptoethanol, forming colonies with a distinctive and reproducible gross morphology. Stem cell lines could be re-derived from these colonies, and variant lines with altered colony morphology were isolated and confirmed to be embryonal carcinoma lines. The findings suggest that genetic and lineage analysis of EC cell differentiation may be feasible.

pmid-7173531.summary_ja: フィーダー依存性の多能性テラトカルチノーマ細胞を、フィーダーなしのβ-メルカプトエタノール含有培地で培養し、初期分化マーカーを比較した。低密度でPNA受容体を失い、プラスミノーゲンアクチベーター分泌が増加し、抗F9血清への感受性を失った。フィーダー細胞の存在は分化を抑制すると考えられる。
pmid-7173531.summary_en: Feeder-dependent pluripotent teratocarcinoma cells were cultured without feeders in beta-mercaptoethanol-containing medium and compared with feeder-cultured cells for early differentiation markers. Cells in this medium lost peanut agglutinin receptor expression at low density, increased plasminogen activator secretion, and lost sensitivity to anti-F9 serum, indicating stem cell differentiation. Feeder-layer cultures showed no such marker changes, suggesting feeder cells inhibit differentiation.

pmid-7173948.summary_ja: 1982年の報告で、精巣腫瘍の異種移植片から胎児性癌の新規ヒト細胞株を樹立した。細胞は未分化で、アルカリホスファターゼ活性が高く、hCGやAFPは産生しなかった。マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9と表面抗原を共有し、マウスEC細胞株と類似した特徴を示した。
pmid-7173948.summary_en: This 1982 study established a new human cell line from a xenografted testicular embryonal carcinoma, which showed undifferentiated histology in both the original tumor and the xenograft. The cells displayed high alkaline phosphatase activity and partly normal karyotypes, and they did not produce hCG or AFP. They shared surface antigens with the murine embryonal carcinoma line F9, supporting similarity to murine EC cell lines.

pmid-7175625.summary_ja: 15か月の男児に急速に進行する眼球突出が生じ、眼窩と鼻咽頭に及ぶ性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。放射線療法と3剤併用化学療法で治療され、8年以上生存している。性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍は一般に致死的であるため、長期生存は注目に値する。
pmid-7175625.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-month-old boy with rapidly progressive proptosis whose orbital and nasopharyngeal tumor was identified as an extragonadal endodermal sinus (yolk sac carcinoma) tumor. He was treated with radiation and three-drug chemotherapy and has survived more than eight years. The report emphasizes that extragonadal endodermal sinus tumors are highly malignant and generally lethal, which makes this long-term survival notable.

pmid-7179044.summary_ja: 妊娠20週の胎盤の絨毛間腔に、予期せず絨毛癌の病巣が見つかった症例報告である。母体は絨毛癌による肺塞栓と急性肺性心で死亡した。絨毛が正常に見える場合でも早期の絨毛癌が成立しうると結論づけており、妊娠性絨毛癌の早期病変の理解に示唆を与える。
pmid-7179044.summary_en: This case report describes an unexpected focus of choriocarcinoma in the intervillous space of a 20-week placenta. The mother died from choriocarcinomatous pulmonary emboli and acute cor pulmonale after a short admission. The authors conclude that early choriocarcinoma can be present with otherwise normal villi, so the diagnosis is tenable in such settings.

pmid-7183691.summary_ja: レチノイン酸処理によるマウス胎児性癌細胞の分化で、増殖速度が低下する現象をクローン解析で検討した。増殖の遅い細胞は細胞選択によるものではなく、処理後約48時間で出現し安定していた。分化した細胞は腫瘍形成能も低下し、96時間以上処理したクローンは30日間で腫瘍を形成しなかった。
pmid-7183691.summary_en: This study analyzed at the clonal level how retinoic acid changes the growth rate of mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, using a sub-tetraploid PC13 clone. The slower growth phenotype was not caused by selection, appeared about 48 hours after treatment, and remained stable. Differentiated derivatives also showed reduced tumorigenicity, and clones exposed for over 96 hours could not form tumors within 30 days.

pmid-7183735.summary_ja: マウス胎仔の生殖隆起を成体精巣に移植する、または分離した胚細胞と体細胞を再集合させて移植し、精巣奇形腫を誘発した。奇形腫の感受性は主に体細胞ではなく胚細胞の遺伝子型に依存していた。また、胚細胞の年齢や体細胞の年齢も奇形発生の感受性に影響した。
pmid-7183735.summary_en: This study induced testicular teratomas experimentally by grafting 12.5-day mouse genital ridges into adult testes, or by implanting reaggregated germ and somatic cells. Teratoma susceptibility depended mainly on the genotype of the germ cells rather than the somatic cells. Germ cells from older gonads lost susceptibility when combined with 12.5-day somatic cells, and somatic cell age also influenced teratocarcinogenesis.

pmid-7184889.summary_ja: デンバー都市圏で1969年と1979年の各半年間に診断された原発性卵巣腫瘍を、集団ベースで組織病理学的に再検討した。発生率は両期間で有意な変化はなかった。最も多い単一腫瘍は良性嚢胞性奇形腫（26.5%）で、体腔上皮性腫瘍が最大の群を占め、悪性腫瘍の大半も占めた。境界悪性腫瘍の多さや、浸潤癌の多くが診断時に播種していたことを確認した。両側性、年齢、重複悪性腫瘍、鑑別診断と悪性度判定の問題も論じている。
pmid-7184889.summary_en: This population-based histopathologic review examined all primary ovarian neoplasms diagnosed in the Denver metropolitan area during two six-month periods, in 1969 and 1979. Incidence did not change significantly between the two periods. Benign cystic teratoma was the most frequent single tumor (26.5%), while coelomic epithelial tumors formed the largest group and most malignant cases. The authors confirm high rates of borderline tumors reported elsewhere, note that invasive carcinomas were usually disseminated at diagnosis, and discuss bilaterality, patient age, multiple primary malignancies, and diagnostic and grading difficulties.

pmid-7199128.summary_ja: 転移性精巣絨毛癌の53歳患者が、シスプラチンと抗菌薬の併用療法後に腎不全で死亡した症例報告である。血清クレアチニンはシスプラチン投与8日目に上昇し、セファロチン、ゲンタマイシン、カルベニシリンの投与開始後に急激に悪化した。腎不全は進行し、抗菌薬治療開始から8日後の治療24日目に死亡した。著者らは、シスプラチンと抗菌薬による腎障害が最も考えられる原因だと結論づけ、白金製剤投与中の患者ではセファロチンとゲンタマイシンの併用を避けるよう勧めている。
pmid-7199128.summary_en: A 53-year-old patient with metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma died of renal failure after treatment with cisplatin combined with antibiotics. Serum creatinine rose on day 8 of cisplatin therapy, then sharply worsened after cephalothin, gentamicin, and carbenicillin were started. Renal failure progressed until death on day 24, eight days after antibiotic treatment began. The authors conclude that renal injury from cisplatin and the antibiotics most likely caused the decline. They recommend avoiding the combination of cephalothin and gentamicin in patients receiving platinum-based therapy.

pmid-7199553.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株GCH-nuを用い、絨毛癌の化学療法中に一過性にhCGが上昇する、いわゆる「細胞効果」を検討した。メトトレキサートは細胞増殖を中等度に抑制し、2〜4日間でhCG値を5倍程度に上昇させた。性ステロイドは変化せず、細胞は核の腫大や多核化、細胞質の空胞化を示し、熱安定型ALP活性も増加した。著者らは、メトトレキサートが合胞体型細胞への分化を誘導し、それがhCG上昇を持続させると結論づけている。
pmid-7199553.summary_en: This study examines the so-called cellular effect, a temporary rise in hCG during methotrexate treatment of choriocarcinoma, using the GCH-nu cell line. Methotrexate moderately suppressed growth and raised hCG levels in cells and medium five- to sevenfold over two to four days. Sex steroids were unchanged, while cells showed enlarged nuclei, multinucleation, vacuolization, and increased heat-stable alkaline phosphatase activity. Protein content per cell rose tenfold. The authors conclude that methotrexate may induce differentiation toward syncytial cells, which sustain the hCG elevation.

pmid-7200560.summary_ja: 30年間に米国2施設で治療された原発性縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍28例を検討した。純粋セミノーマの患者の多くは放射線療法後に無病生存し、転移例の1例は併用化学療法で完全寛解した。非セミノーマ成分を含む17例のうち、無病で生存しているのは3例のみだった。シスプラチン・ブレオマイシンを基本とする化学療法群の生存期間中央値は14か月で、他のレジメン群の4か月より長かった。著者らは、セミノーマには放射線療法、非セミノーマには積極的な多剤併用療法を推奨している。
pmid-7200560.summary_en: Twenty-eight patients with primary malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors, treated at two US institutions over 30 years, were reviewed. Most patients with pure seminoma were disease-free after radiation therapy, and one with metastatic disease responded to combination chemotherapy. Among patients with nonseminomatous tumors, only three of 17 were alive and disease-free. Those given cisplatin-bleomycin-based chemotherapy had a longer median survival than those given other regimens, 14 versus 4 months. The authors recommend radiation therapy for pure seminoma and aggressive multimodality therapy with cisplatin-bleomycin chemotherapy for nonseminomas.

pmid-7200598.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ型精巣がんと免疫グロブリンのアロタイプ（Gm、A2m、Km）との関連を、遺伝学的素因の観点から検討した研究である。オランダ人患者52例を対象とし、組織学的診断で分類した群においても、アロタイプの分布は正常集団と有意差がなかった。著者らは、両者の間に関連はないと結論づけている。
pmid-7200598.summary_en: This study tested whether immunoglobulin allotypes are associated with nonseminoma testicular cancer. Gm, A2m, and Km allotypic markers were examined in 52 Dutch patients. Distributions did not differ significantly from those in the normal population, including when patients were grouped by histological diagnosis. The findings indicate no relationship between nonseminoma testicular cancer and these immunoglobulin allotypes. The study addresses a possible genetic susceptibility factor in a single national cohort.

pmid-7200599.summary_ja: キング・ジョージ5世記念病院で25年間に診断された卵巣腫瘍約1,700例をWHO分類に基づいて分類し、そのうち胚細胞腫瘍467例を詳細に検討した。内訳はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）4例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例、原発性絨毛癌1例、未熟奇形腫6例、成熟奇形腫454例、混合性悪性胚細胞腫瘍1例である。性腺芽腫を伴うディスジャーミノーマ2例も議論のため含め、詳細な組織学的評価と臨床的関連を示した。
pmid-7200599.summary_en: All ovarian neoplasms diagnosed over 25 years at King George V Memorial Hospital were classified using WHO criteria. Of about 1,700 tumors, 467 were germ cell tumors, including four dysgerminomas, one endodermal sinus tumor, one primary choriocarcinoma, six immature teratomas, 454 mature teratomas, and one mixed malignant germ cell tumor. Two cases of gonadoblastoma with associated dysgerminoma were also included for discussion. The paper presents detailed histological assessment and documents the major clinical correlates of these tumors.

pmid-7201746.summary_ja: 病期IIIの精巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者42例で、血清乳酸脱水素酵素（LDH）アイソザイム1（LD-1）の異常を検討した研究である。LD-1異常は計81%で認められ、その頻度は病変の広がりと相関した。組織型による差はみられなかった。持続または再発性のLD-1上昇を示した患者は進行または再発していた。臨床的に病変のない患者は正常値であり、経時的な測定は治療への反応を反映した。
pmid-7201746.summary_en: This study assessed serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (LD-1) in patients with stage III malignant germ cell tumors of the testis. LD-1 was abnormal in 81% of 42 patients, and elevation frequency rose with disease extent. Elevations occurred across histologic cell types. Criteria 1 and 2 identified 28 patients (67%), and criterion 3 identified six more (14%). Patients with persistent or recurrent LD-1 elevation showed progressive or recurrent disease, while patients without clinical disease had normal values. Serial LD-1 measurements reflected response to therapy.

pmid-7201846.summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを用い、メトトレキサートなどの抗代謝薬・細胞傷害性薬剤がヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生に与える影響を検討した。細胞傷害薬により細胞タンパク質あたりのhCG産生が増加し、ビンクリスチン下ではhCG産生細胞の割合が約5%から約40%に上昇した。著者らは、細胞傷害薬が細胞栄養膜細胞から合胞体への分化を促進し、絨毛癌の化学感受性の高さを部分的に説明しうると考察している。
pmid-7201846.summary_en: This study examines how antimetabolites and other cytotoxic agents (methotrexate, actinomycin D, bleomycin, vincristine, hydroxyurea) affect hCG production in the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line. Cytotoxic exposure increased hCG output per cell protein and raised the fraction of hCG-producing cells from about 5% to about 40% under vincristine. The authors propose that cytotoxic agents promote cytotrophoblast differentiation into syncytium, which may partly explain the unusual chemosensitivity of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-7201941.summary_ja: 本研究は、奇形癌細胞と着床前マウス胚に共通する細胞表面マーカーとして、Dolichos biflorus凝集素(DBA)の受容体を報告した。DBAは2細胞期から初期胚盤胞まで陽性を示し、tw32変異ホモ接合体胚でも染色された。この受容体は成体組織ではごく限られた組織にしか見られないため、胚性細胞や奇形癌細胞の指標となりうる。ForssmanやF9、SSEA-1抗原とは異なる成分と考えられる。
pmid-7201941.summary_en: This study identifies Dolichos biflorus agglutinin (DBA) binding sites as a cell surface marker shared by teratocarcinoma cells and preimplantation mouse embryos. DBA-FITC staining was detected from the 2-cell to early blastocyst stages, including in embryos homozygous for the tw32 mutation. Because DBA receptors are found in only limited adult tissues, they may serve as a marker of embryonic and teratocarcinoma cell identity. The authors conclude that these receptors differ from the Forssman, F9, and SSEA-1 antigens.

pmid-7202115.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株と壁側内胚葉細胞株の細胞融合により得られたハイブリッドは、内胚葉の機能を発現し、胎児性癌の腫瘍形成能などは消失した。1,358クローンのいずれにも胎児性癌の形態は見られなかった。壁側内胚葉細胞が拡散性因子により胎児性癌の性質を抑制すると示唆される。
pmid-7202115.summary_en: The authors fused the embryonal carcinoma line FOT5 with parietal endodermal cells to generate hybrid clones. The hybrids expressed parietal endodermal functions, including plasminogen activator activity, basement membrane proteins, and cytoskeletal proteins. Embryonal carcinoma functions such as tumorigenicity, stage-specific embryonic antigen, and high alkaline phosphatase activity were extinguished, and none of 1,358 clones showed embryonal carcinoma morphology. The results suggest that parietal endodermal cells contain diffusible factors that suppress embryonal carcinoma phenotypes.

pmid-7202257.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の脳転移と診断された24例を解析した報告である。剖検例での脳転移の頻度は66.7%で、多くは単発性かつ出血性であった。診断には胞状奇胎の既往、尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の測定、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見が有用とされた。神経症状が進行する症例では、外科的切除に化学療法と放射線照射を組み合わせる治療が推奨されている。
pmid-7202257.summary_en: This report reviews 24 patients with histologically confirmed brain metastasis of choriocarcinoma, including autopsy and operative findings. Brain metastases occurred in 66.7% of autopsied patients and were mostly single and hemorrhagic. Diagnosis relied on a history of molar pregnancy, urinary hCG measurements, and CT findings. The authors recommend surgical resection followed by chemotherapy and irradiation for patients with progressive neurological decline.

pmid-37281313.summary_ja: 1982年の発生学的研究。マウス胎児性癌（EC）細胞を初期胚と短時間接触させると、非悪性の分化へ転換しうるかを検討した。EC細胞と8細胞期胚の凝集、胚盤胞培養、内部細胞塊の解析を行った。接触時間が長いほどEC巣が減少し、腫瘍由来の非悪性細胞が確認された。マウスの基礎実験であり、患者を対象とした臨床研究ではない。
pmid-37281313.summary_en: This 1982 developmental biology study tests whether brief contact with early mouse embryos can switch mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells toward nonmalignant differentiation.
