EC cells were aggregated with 8-cell embryos, cultured into blastocysts, and their inner cell masses examined. Longer contact reduced EC foci, and protein pattern analysis confirmed that nonmalignant cells were of tumor origin. This is murine experimental work rather than patient-based clinical literature.

pmid-6174520.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来を含むマウス胚体外内胚葉細胞株で、55kDaの細胞骨格タンパク質Endo Aを解析した研究である。胎児性癌細胞はレチノイン酸による分化誘導後にのみEndo Aを産生した。奇形癌由来細胞や胎児性癌細胞は主に分化のモデルとして用いられており、腫瘍そのものの臨床的検討は含まれない。
pmid-6174520.summary_en: This 1982 J Biol Chem study characterises Endo A, a 55-kDa cytoskeletal protein in murine extra-embryonic endodermal cell lines derived from teratocarcinomas or embryos. Endo A was detected in parietal and visceral endoderm lines but not in embryonal carcinoma cells, except after retinoic acid-induced differentiation. The protein is phosphorylated on serine and is distinct from vimentin and keratins. Teratocarcinoma-derived and embryonal carcinoma cells serve mainly as model systems for differentiation.

pmid-6183004.summary_ja: マウス4〜8細胞期胚で免疫したラットのモノクローナル抗体は、炭水化物抗原SSEA3を認識した。この抗原は卵母細胞から原始内胚葉へと段階特異的に限局する。マウス奇形癌幹細胞は陰性であったが、ヒト奇形癌幹細胞は陽性であった。
pmid-6183004.summary_en: A rat monoclonal antibody raised against mouse 4- to 8-cell embryos recognizes a carbohydrate stage-specific embryonic antigen (SSEA3). The antigen is restricted from oocytes and inner cell mass to primitive endoderm. Murine teratocarcinoma stem cells are negative, whereas human teratocarcinoma stem cells are positive. The antigen is absent from many other cell lines but present on human erythrocytes, and is found on glycolipids and glycopeptides.

pmid-6187267.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来の細胞株TeraIおよびPA1と成人由来細胞株を比較し、HLAおよびβ2ミクログロブリン遺伝子の転写を解析した。未分化なマウス胎児性癌様のTeraI株では両遺伝子の発現が低く、PA1株や成人由来株では強く検出された。発現量は細胞の分化度と相関し、遺伝子発現は主に転写レベルで制御されると示唆された。
pmid-6187267.summary_en: Poly(A+) RNA from teratocarcinoma-derived lines TeraI and PA1 was compared with adult cell lines to examine HLA and beta-2 microglobulin transcription. TeraI, which resembles undifferentiated mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, showed weak hybridization to HLA and beta-2m probes, while PA1 and the adult lines hybridized strongly. Expression correlated with differentiation status, suggesting these genes are mainly controlled at the transcriptional level.

pmid-6221027.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来の幹細胞株F9および12-1と、その分化誘導細胞12-1aから染色体蛋白質を抽出して比較した。幹細胞はDNase Iに対する感受性が高く、コアヒストンのアセチル化も高かった。HMG 9は分化に伴い消失した。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、多能性とクロマチン構造の関係に焦点を当てている。
pmid-6221027.summary_en: Chromosomal proteins were extracted from mouse teratocarcinoma stem cell lines F9 and 12-1 and from their differentiated derivative 12-1a. Stem cell chromatin was more sensitive to DNase I, and its core histones were more acetylated. HMG 1 and HMG 2 were more abundant in stem cells, and a new protein, HMG 9, was lost upon differentiation. The study focuses on chromatin features linked to pluripotency rather than clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-6277598.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞の血清フリー環境下での増殖に対する増殖刺激活性(MSA)の効果を検討した。100 ng/mlのMSAで胎仔ウシ血清の必要性が完全に置き換わり、細胞には特異的な受容体が認められた。インスリン様成長因子I・IIは結合を競合したが、インスリンは競合しなかった。
pmid-6277598.summary_en: The study tested whether multiplication-stimulating activity (MSA), an insulin-like growth factor, supports growth of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells under serum-free conditions. MSA at 100 ng/ml fully replaced the need for fetal calf serum, and F9 cells showed specific high-affinity MSA receptors. Insulin-like growth factors I and II competed for binding, whereas insulin did not. The F9 line was used as a model with properties similar to embryonic stem cells.

pmid-6286241.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌由来の内胚葉様細胞を血清を含まない培地で培養し、基底膜成分の合成と分解を検討した基礎研究である。レチノイン酸によりIV型コラーゲンの蓄積が増え、ラミニンやIV型コラーゲンを分解するプロテアーゼ活性も誘導された。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を対象とした研究ではなく、胚細胞腫瘍への関連は間接的である。
pmid-6286241.summary_en: This 1982 laboratory study examined endoderm cells derived from mouse embryonal carcinoma cells in serum-free medium. Retinoic acid increased accumulation of type IV collagen and stimulated latent protease activity that degraded laminin and type IV collagen. The laminin-degrading activity was plasminogen dependent. The work uses EC cells as a differentiation model rather than studying human germ cell tumors clinically, so its relevance to GCT management is indirect.

pmid-6286643.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを用い、hCGのN型およびO型糖鎖付加の時間的関係を検討した基礎研究である。N型糖鎖付加は翻訳と同時か直後に起こり、O型糖鎖やGlcNAcの付加は分泌直前にゴルジ体で起こると考えられた。腫瘍マーカーとしてのhCGの臨床応用を直接扱うものではない。
pmid-6286643.summary_en: In the BeWo human choriocarcinoma cell line, this 1982 study examined the temporal relationship between N- and O-glycosylation of hCG. The results suggested N-glycosylation occurs co-translationally or shortly after translation, while O-linked GalNAc addition and peripheral GlcNAc addition occur just before secretion, presumably in the Golgi. It is a biochemical study of hCG processing, with clinical relevance to hCG as a tumor marker limited to basic biology.

pmid-6287239.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPで分化させると、p53蛋白質が減少することを示した基礎研究である。減少の原因は蛋白質の安定性ではなく、翻訳可能なp53 mRNA量の低下であった。モデル細胞系での分子機構の解析であり、患者の胚細胞腫瘍や治療を扱うものではない。
pmid-6287239.summary_en: In F9 and related embryonal carcinoma cells, this 1982 study showed that retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP induce differentiation accompanied by decreased p53 levels. The decline arose from reduced amounts of translatable p53 mRNA rather than altered protein stability. The work is mechanistic research on p53 regulation in a model EC system, not on patient germ cell tumors or their treatment.

pmid-6302111.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞F9においてポリオーマウイルスがT抗原を発現しない理由を検討した1982年の基礎研究。レチノイン酸による内胚葉系分化細胞はウイルス感受性を獲得したが、併用誘導細胞は強い抵抗性を示した。胎児性癌細胞はウイルス学のモデルとして用いられており、臨床的な関連は限られる。
pmid-6302111.summary_en: This 1982 J Cell Physiol supplement examines why polyoma virus fails to express T antigen in murine F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, while retinoic acid-induced endodermal derivatives become susceptible. Free viral DNA was lost during continued growth in EC cells. Viral expression was obtained when DNA was introduced before induction, while dual retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP-induced endodermal cells were highly refractory. The work uses EC cells mainly as a virology model, so clinical relevance to germ cell tumors is limited.

pmid-6302113.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌細胞F-9の分化誘導では、いくつかの分化マーカーは誘導されるが、内在性レトロウイルス糖タンパク質gp70は未分化・分化後ともに発現しないことを示した1982年の基礎研究。外来性レトロウイルスには感染可能であった。免疫活性化リンパ球がgp70を発現する知見との関連も議論されているが、臨床的意義は限られる。
pmid-6302113.summary_en: This 1982 J Cell Physiol supplement reports that in vitro differentiation of murine F-9 teratocarcinoma cells induces several differentiation markers but not endogenous retroviral glycoprotein gp70, neither in undifferentiated nor differentiated cells. The cells remain productively infectable by exogenous retroviruses. The authors relate these findings to observations that all antigen-activated lymphocytes express endogenous gp70. The study is a basic retrovirology and differentiation experiment using F9 cells as a model, with limited clinical bearing on germ cell tumors.

pmid-6327274.summary_ja: 通常は野生型ポリオーマウイルスに抵抗性のマウス栄養膜細胞株で増殖するウイルス変異体を分離した1982年の研究。変異は複製起点と構造タンパク質遺伝子の間の制御領域に位置し、2つの独立した変異体に共通する26塩基対の欠失が同定された。胎児性癌細胞株F9などで増殖するPyEC変異体との類似性も示された。
pmid-6327274.summary_en: This 1982 EMBO Journal paper isolates polyoma virus mutants able to grow in mouse trophoblast cell lines, which normally resist wild-type infection. The mutations map to a regulatory region between the replication origin and structural protein genes. The authors note similarity to previously described PyEC mutants that grow in embryonal carcinoma lines such as F9 and PCC4. A 26-bp deletion is identified in two independent PyTr mutants. The work is virology using EC cells as hosts, with little direct relevance to germ cell tumor clinical care.

pmid-6749300.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌由来の内胚葉様細胞の培養上清から、フィブロネクチン結合性を示す非らせん型の基底膜コラーゲンを単離した1982年の研究。三重らせん構造やジスルフィド架橋を欠くが細胞接着を促進し、内胚葉細胞の接着にはフィブロネクチンが必要であった。細胞外マトリックス研究であり、臨床的な腫瘍管理とは直接関係しない。
pmid-6749300.summary_en: This 1982 Cell paper isolates a nonhelical, fibronectin-binding basement membrane collagen from culture media of mouse teratocarcinoma-derived endodermal cells, using affinity chromatography on collagen-binding fibronectin fragments. A second collagen not binding fibronectin was isolated by salt precipitation. The affinity-purified collagen lacks triple-helix structure and disulfide crosslinks, yet promotes cell attachment, with fibronectin needed for endodermal cell attachment. The study is basic extracellular matrix biology using teratocarcinoma-derived cells as a source.

pmid-6750025.summary_ja: 1982年の研究で、マウス奇形癌の単一胚様体から7種類の胚様体株を単離し、発生学的性質を比較した。腹腔内継代後の空洞形成、生体内増殖、心筋分化、固形腫瘍の分化能を評価し、心筋分化能により3群に分類された。in vitroでの高い分化能は、生体内での空洞形成能と相関した。
pmid-6750025.summary_en: This 1982 study isolated seven embryoid body lines from a single mouse teratocarcinoma embryoid body and compared their developmental properties. Lines were assessed for cavity formation after short-term intraperitoneal passage, in vivo growth, cardiac muscle differentiation in vitro, and solid tumor differentiation in vivo. The lines fell into three groups by cardiac differentiation capacity. Strong in vitro differentiation correlated with cavity formation during the in vivo phase, which was followed by primitive-streak-like structures giving rise to mesoderm.

pmid-6762310.summary_ja: 5系統のマウス胎児性癌細胞株におけるコラーゲン合成を免疫蛍光法で調べた。全株がIV型コラーゲンを発現し、1株はIII型も発現した。レチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPにより形態の異なる分化細胞が生じ、I・III・V型コラーゲンを新たに発現した。胎児性癌由来の内胚葉系・栄養膜系の株も解析された。
pmid-6762310.summary_en: This study examined collagen synthesis in five mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines using immunofluorescence. All lines expressed type IV collagen, and one also expressed type III. Retinoic acid and dibutyryl-cAMP induced morphologically distinct differentiated cells that expressed new collagen types, including types I, III, and V. Two established lines representing parietal endoderm and trophoblastoma were also characterized, with the trophoblastoma line producing types I, III, and IV, and the endodermal line producing type IV.

pmid-6891836.summary_ja: マウステラトカルシノーマ細胞株H6の分化と細胞融合を解析した体細胞遺伝学の基礎研究である。レチノイン酸で終末分化する性質や薬剤耐性変異株を用いた。未分化細胞との融合で初期分化細胞が救済されたが、分化の兆候は速やかに失われた。臨床的な腫瘍管理ではなく分化生物学が主題である。
pmid-6891836.summary_en: This somatic cell genetics study characterizes H6, a clonal CBA mouse teratocarcinoma line that grows in suspension without calcium and terminally differentiates after retinoic acid exposure. Drug-resistant variants were isolated, and hybrids were made between undifferentiated stem cells and differentiated derivatives. Undifferentiated cells rescued early-differentiating cells, but differentiation signs were soon lost in these hybrids. The work addresses differentiation biology rather than clinical tumor management.

pmid-6958907.summary_ja: 従来H-2を欠くとされていた奇形癌由来マウス細胞株TerCが、低レベルのH-2抗原を発現することを示した研究。感度の高い細胞傷害試験で検出され、吸収試験でも確認された。クローン間の差はわずかで、培養期間による増加もみられなかった。分化する亜集団によるものではないとされる。
pmid-6958907.summary_en: This study shows that the murine teratocarcinoma-derived cell line TerC expresses low levels of H-2 K- and D-end specificities, despite earlier reports that it lacked H-2 products. A sensitive cytotoxic assay using antibody and complement detected these specificities, confirmed by oligospecific antisera and absorption analyses. Clonal variants showed little difference, and expression did not rise with culture time. The low H-2 levels were not due to a differentiating subpopulation.

pmid-7045228.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞(ECC)と着床前胚を用い、中性糖脂質抗原の発現を抗体と化学分析で検討した。グロボテトラオシルセラミドとForssman抗原は胚で異なる結合時期を示した。抗体反応性と化学構造の対応は細胞型によって一定しないことも示された。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍を対象とした研究ではなく、基礎的な発生免疫学の報告である。
pmid-7045228.summary_en: This study uses mouse embryonal carcinoma (ECC) cells and preimplantation embryos to characterize neutral glycolipid antigens. Antibodies to globotetraosylceramide and Forssman antigen show distinct binding timing and intensity in embryos, while both react similarly with F9 ECC. Chemical analysis identified globotetraosylceramide as the most abundant glycolipid in F9 cells and showed that the two Forssman-reactive glycolipids differ from the classical sheep erythrocyte antigen. The findings caution against extrapolating antibody reactivity to chemical structure across cell types. The work is basic developmental immunology rather than clinical germ cell tumor research.

pmid-7068681.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9などを用い、ヒストンH1のサブタイプとリン酸化状態を解析したものである。分化型の内胚葉様細胞株ではH1bなどが欠失していた。H1サブタイプは機能的に異なり、H1bやH1dは細胞分裂に必須ではないと考察している。胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞をモデルとして用いた基礎生化学研究である。
pmid-7068681.summary_en: This 1982 biochemical study analyzed histone H1 subtypes and their phosphorylation in the murine embryonal carcinoma cell line F9 and in other embryonal carcinoma and differentiated endoderm-like teratocarcinoma lines. Two-dimensional electrophoresis resolved at least 15 H1 components, revealing five subtypes, each phosphorylated to varying degrees. Differentiated lines lacked H1b, and one also lacked H1d. The authors suggest that H1 subtypes have distinct functions and that neither H1b nor H1d is essential for cell division. The paper uses germ cell tumor-derived cells as a model for chromatin biology rather than studying the tumor itself.

pmid-7086331.summary_ja: 1982年の発生生物学研究で、マウス奇形癌由来の胎児性癌(EC)細胞株2種を着床前胚と凝集させ、生存可能なキメラを作製した。子宮内胚と成体でキメラ形成頻度を評価した。胚ではEC細胞が主に胚外膜に分布し、成体でのキメラ頻度の低下の原因と考えられた。本研究は多能性細胞としてのEC細胞を利用したもので、腫瘍生物学や臨床管理は扱っていない。
pmid-7086331.summary_en: This 1982 developmental biology study generated viable chimaeras by aggregating two murine teratocarcinoma-derived embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines with preimplantation embryos. Chimerism was assessed in in-utero conceptuses and adult mice. Chimerism was more frequent in conceptuses (37% and 73%) than in adults. In chimeric conceptuses, EC cells mainly colonized extraembryonic membranes, which explained the lower frequency in adults. The work uses EC cells as pluripotent tools rather than examining tumor biology or clinical management.

pmid-7138371.summary_ja: 乳児期に発症する先天性舌下類皮嚢腫のレビューで、定義、分類、臨床的特徴をまとめている。口腔底前方が最も多い部位とされる。胚細胞腫瘍ではなく発生性の嚢胞と位置づけられるため、当サイトの対象としての適合性は不確かである。
pmid-7138371.summary_en: This paper reviews congenital sublingual dermoid cysts, which are rare in infancy because most oral dermoids present in young adults. It summarizes the definition, classification, and clinical features of these cysts, noting that the anterior floor of the mouth is the most common oral site. The lesion is a developmental cyst of the head and neck rather than a germ cell neoplasm, so its relevance to this site is uncertain.

pmid-7158680.summary_ja: 複数のマウス系統について、胎児性癌細胞株F9などに対するin vitroのNK活性を検討した。NK活性はin vivoのF9抵抗性とは相関しなかった。F9の溶解効率はYACと並行していたが、全体の溶解率は低かった。コールド競合実験から、胎児性癌細胞の固有の溶解抵抗性が示唆された。
pmid-7158680.summary_en: The study compared in vitro natural killer activity against embryonal carcinoma lines F9, PCC4/Aza and PCC3/A/1, and YAC targets, across several mouse strains. NK activity did not correlate with in vivo F9 resistance, although lysis patterns for F9 and YAC paralleled each other with generally low F9 lysis. Cold competition suggested an intrinsic lysis resistance of embryonal carcinoma cells. Parietal endoderm and trophoectodermal lines were also examined.

pmid-7201471.summary_ja: 分化させたマウス胎児性癌細胞で、胚外内胚葉の細胞骨格タンパク質Endo AおよびEndo Bをコードするメッセンジャー RNAを同定した研究である。未分化なF9.22細胞ではほとんど発現がなく、壁側内胚葉細胞では多量に発現していた。レチノイン酸処理により48〜72時間後にF9.22細胞で発現が誘導され、タンパク質の発現と一致した。本研究は腫瘍学的解析というより、胎児性癌細胞の分化マーカーの特徴づけが主である。
pmid-7201471.summary_en: Researchers identified the messenger RNAs encoding two extra-embryonic endodermal cytoskeletal proteins, Endo A and Endo B, in differentiated murine embryonal carcinoma cells. Both transcripts were absent or at basal levels in undifferentiated F9.22 embryonal carcinoma cells but abundant in parietal endoderm cells. Retinoic acid induced expression in F9.22 cells within 48 to 72 hours, coinciding with protein expression. Transcript sizes were about 2.0 and 1.5 kilobases. The work characterizes a differentiation marker program of embryonal carcinoma cells rather than tumor biology.

pmid-9732745.summary_ja: 未分化の胎児性癌細胞がレトロウイルスの複製を阻害する仕組みを検討した。この阻害は分化細胞の核質との融合により解除されるが、細胞質との融合では解除されなかった。奇形癌幹細胞におけるプロウイルス遺伝子の発現制御は分化細胞とは異なり、その制御は核に限局することが示された。
pmid-9732745.summary_en: This study shows that undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cells block retrovirus gene expression, and that this block can be overcome by fusion with differentiated cell karyoplasts but not cytoplasts. The findings suggest that proviral gene expression in teratocarcinoma stem cells is controlled differently from differentiated cells, and that this control is limited to the nucleus. The paper uses teratocarcinoma stem cells as the experimental system to study retroviral regulation.

pmid-29112221.summary_ja: 1960年から1976年に治療された停留精巣を伴う非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍107例を解析した1981年の報告である。精巣がん患者の9.8%に停留精巣が認められた。組織型は胎児性癌、奇形癌、奇形腫、絨毛癌を含み、5年生存率は52.3%であった。年齢、病理、病期は停留精巣を伴わない非セミノーマ性腫瘍と同様であった。
pmid-29112221.summary_en: This 1981 study analyzed 107 patients with cryptorchidism and non-seminomatous germ cell cancer treated between 1960 and 1976. Cryptorchidism was present in 9.8% of testicular cancer patients. Histologies included embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma, teratoma and choriocarcinoma. Five-year survival was 52.3%. Age distribution, pathology and stage were similar to non-seminomatous tumours without cryptorchidism.

pmid-29112237.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍103例を対象に、診断の遅れを検討した1981年の報告である。初診時の臨床診断は44%で誤っており、27%は6か月以上診断が遅れた。病期、分布、生存は組織型と相関したが、症状期間や患者・医師側の遅延とは相関しなかった。非セミノーマ性腫瘍は進行例が多く予後不良であった。
pmid-29112237.summary_en: This 1981 study examined diagnostic delay in 103 patients with malignant germ cell tumours. The initial clinical diagnosis was incorrect in 44% of patients, and 27% were diagnosed more than six months late. Stage, distribution and survival correlated with histology but not with symptom duration or patient or doctor delay. Non-seminomatous tumours had more advanced stages and lower survival. The authors recommend early testicular examination in at-risk men.

pmid-29112245.summary_ja: 1981年の研究で、マウスにおける実験的に誘発された精巣奇形腫を検討した。妊娠12日目の胎児の生殖隆起を陰嚢内精巣に移植すると奇形腫が形成され、陰嚢の低温が重要な因子であった。初期病変には胚性癌細胞が含まれていた。胚細胞を欠く胎児からの移植では奇形腫が形成されず、精巣奇形腫が原始生殖細胞に由来することが示された。
pmid-29112245.summary_en: This 1981 study examined experimentally induced testicular teratomas in mice. Teratomas developed when genital ridges from 12-day-old fetuses were grafted into scrotal adult testes, with low scrotal temperature proving critical. Early lesions contained embryonal carcinoma cells. Grafts from germ cell-deficient fetuses did not form teratomas, showing that testicular teratomas arise from primordial germ cells. The model supports the study of teratocarcinogenesis.

pmid-29112252.summary_ja: 1981年の報告で、セミノーマと非セミノーマは組織発生的に近縁で、上皮内癌の像を示す共通の前駆細胞に由来しうるという改訂胚細胞説を提唱する。精子細胞性セミノーマは例外で、精母細胞に由来する可能性があるとされた。精巣の上皮内癌と各種胚細胞腫瘍の浸潤性増殖を結びつける仮説である。
pmid-29112252.summary_en: This 1981 paper proposes a revised germ cell theory. It suggests seminomas and non-seminomas are histogenetically related and may arise from a common precursor, the germ cell showing the carcinoma-in-situ pattern. Spermatocytic seminoma is considered an exception, possibly originating from spermatocytes. The hypothesis links testicular carcinoma-in-situ to the invasive growth of different germ cell tumour types.

pmid-29112261.summary_ja: 1981年の総説で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍、特に非セミノーマ性腫瘍の管理におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の有用性を評価する。代謝減衰率解析などの近年の進歩も論じる。SP-1や胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼなど、精巣がんの新たな腫瘍マーカーの候補も紹介する。
pmid-29112261.summary_en: This 1981 review evaluates the tumour markers alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) in managing testicular germ cell tumours, particularly non-seminomatous types. It discusses recent advances such as metabolic decay rate analysis. The authors also review possible new markers, including SP-1 and placental alkaline phosphatase, for testicular cancer.

pmid-29112266.summary_ja: 1981年の総説で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の胚体外成分を扱う。卵黄嚢成分は非セミノーマ性腫瘍の約3分の2にみられる。真の絨毛性分化はまれで予後が極めて不良であり、hCGを産生する。純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍は乳児を除き少ないが、AFPを産生することが多い。
pmid-29112266.summary_en: This 1981 review describes extra-embryonic elements in testicular germ cell tumours. Yolk sac elements occur in about two-thirds of non-seminomatous tumours. True trophoblastic differentiation is rare, carries a very poor prognosis and produces hCG. Pure yolk sac tumours are uncommon except in infants and often produce AFP, though AFP is not specific. Yolk sac tumours have a prognosis similar to undifferentiated malignant teratoma.

pmid-29112267.summary_ja: 1981年の総説で、免疫不全マウスや無胸腺マウスにおけるヒト胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植モデルの現在および将来の用途をまとめる。組織学的、免疫細胞化学的、超微細構造解析用の腫瘍材料の作製、放射線・化学療法感受性試験、腫瘍画像診断法の開発などが含まれる。
pmid-29112267.summary_en: This 1981 review summarizes the use of human germ cell tumour xenografts in immunosuppressed and athymic animals. Applications include generating human tumour material for histological, immunocytochemical and ultrastructural analysis, testing radio- and chemosensitivity, and developing new tumour imaging techniques. The authors discuss the current and potential value of this model for studying germ cell tumours.

pmid-29112268.summary_ja: 成人精巣腫瘍の男性292例の症状を検討した1981年の報告である。セミノーマ140例(中央値44.2歳)は主に精巣腫大で発症した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍152例(中央値29.8歳)は局所痛や背部痛で発症し、経過は短かった。約25%が副睾丸炎や水瘤、捻転と誤診され、7%は停留精巣の既往を有していた。
pmid-29112268.summary_en: This 1981 study describes the signs and symptoms of adult testicular tumours in 292 men. Seminomas, in 140 patients with median age 44.2 years, presented mainly with testicular swelling. Non-seminomatous tumours, in 152 men with median age 29.8 years, presented with local or back pain after shorter histories. About 25% were misdiagnosed as epididymitis, hydrocele or torsion. Seven per cent had a history of undescended testes.

pmid-29112295.summary_ja: 1981年の総説で、ヒト奇形腫由来の複数の細胞株について、抗血清、モノクローナル抗体、レクチンを用いた細胞表面分子の構成を検討した知見をまとめる。マウス奇形癌系との比較も行う。細胞表面分子に対する抗体の腫瘍画像診断や薬剤標的化への応用可能性も論じる。
pmid-29112295.summary_en: This 1981 review summarizes the cell surface composition of several human teratoma-derived cell lines. It uses antisera, monoclonal antibodies and lectins, and compares findings with murine teratocarcinoma systems. The authors also discuss potential uses of antibodies against cell surface molecules in tumour imaging and targeted drug delivery.

pmid-37281756.summary_ja: 同種異系マウスにおいて、マウス腹水型奇形癌(胚様体)が固形腫瘍を形成する条件を検討した研究である。Balb/cマウスへの静脈内投与では、同系129/Svマウスと同様に分化組織を含む肺コロニーが形成された。腹腔内投与では主に未分化な胎児性癌細胞からなるコロニーが生じた。胎児性癌細胞は拒絶されやすいが、分化することで逃避できることが示された。
pmid-37281756.summary_en: This study examined when murine ascitic teratocarcinoma cells (embryoid bodies) form solid tumours in allogeneic mice. Intravenous injection in Balb/c mice produced lung colonies with differentiated tissues, as in syngeneic 129/Sv mice. Intraperitoneal injection produced abdominal colonies containing mainly undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cells. Lung colonies showed that embryonal carcinoma cells are rejected but can escape by differentiating.

pmid-6100956.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス奇形癌由来の胎児性癌（EC）幹細胞がSV40やポリオーマウイルスに感受性を示さない理由を検討した1981年の基礎研究である。高力価の反復感染、DEAE-デキストランや4-ニトロキノリン1-オキシドによる前処理、アデノウイルス5との同時感染を試みたが、T抗原の発現もウイルスDNAの複製も誘導できなかった。
pmid-6100956.summary_en: This 1981 basic-science study examines embryonal carcinoma (EC) stem cells from murine teratocarcinoma, which resist infection by simian virus 40 and polyoma. The authors tested several strategies to overcome this block, including high-titer repeated infections, DEAE-dextran and 4-nitroquinoline 1-oxide pretreatment, and co-infection with adenovirus 5. None induced SV40 T-antigen expression or productive viral DNA replication, so the block to viral infection persisted despite these modifications.

pmid-6110783.summary_ja: 触知できない片側性の精巣を有する無症状の成人において、CTで腹腔内精巣由来の精巣がんが確認された症例報告である。著者らは、思春期以降に精巣を触知できない患者すべてに対し、非侵襲的な検査法としてCTを推奨している。停留精巣では悪性腫瘍のリスクが高いため、身体診察では見つけにくい腫瘍の検出に有用とされる。
pmid-6110783.summary_en: This case report describes an adult with an asymptomatic, impalpable unilateral testis in whom computed tomography revealed carcinoma of an intra-abdominal testis. The authors recommend CT as a non-invasive technique for all postpubertal patients with impalpable testes, to detect tumors that clinical examination may miss. Given the increased malignancy risk associated with undescended testes, they argue that imaging should be used as a screening tool in this population.

pmid-6111501.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺形成不全であるSwyer症候群に性腺芽腫を合併した症例の報告である。Y染色体の一部を有する患者では、良性・悪性を問わず性腺腫瘍のリスクがあるため、性腺摘除を行うべきだと著者らは強調している。付属器腫瘤を触知しないことで安全と誤解されやすい点も指摘している。
pmid-6111501.summary_en: This short report presents a patient with Swyer syndrome, a form of 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis, who had gonadoblastoma. The authors stress that anyone carrying a portion of the Y chromosome should undergo gonadal extirpation because of the risk of gonadal neoplasia, whether benign or malignant. They note that such patients may wrongly appear free of risk in the absence of a palpable adnexal mass, and they use this case to counter that misconception.

pmid-6114032.summary_ja: 20か月の男児で、重度の成長障害・知的障害、両側緑内障、尿道下裂、停留精巣、無虹彩症を認めた症例である。核型解析で11p13を含む欠失を伴う複雑な3染色体再構成が見つかり、外性器手術で両側の性腺芽腫を伴う男性仮性半陰陽と診断された。カタラーゼ欠損から、カタラーゼ遺伝子の11p13への局在も示された。
pmid-6114032.summary_en: This report describes a 20-month-old boy with severe growth and intellectual delay, bilateral glaucoma, hypospadias, cryptorchidism, and aniridia. Karyotyping revealed a de novo complex three-chromosome rearrangement with an 11p13 deletion. Genital surgery found male pseudohermaphroditism with bilateral gonadoblastoma. The authors also assigned the catalase gene to 11p13 using this patient's catalase deficiency, linking gonadal tumor risk to a contiguous 11p13 deletion.

pmid-6114639.summary_ja: 嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫と精巣奇形癌におけるAPUD細胞の分布を調べた研究である。卵巣奇形腫では腸管型・気道型APUD細胞が脳組織を伴わずに出現し、メラノサイトは脳組織と共存していた。精巣奇形癌では腸管型APUD細胞が脳組織なしで見られた。著者らは、これらの細胞は奇形腫内の腸管・気道上皮に由来すると結論づけている。
pmid-6114639.summary_en: This study investigated APUD (amine precursor uptake and decarboxylation) cells in cystic ovarian teratomas and testicular teratocarcinomas. The authors examined whether intestinal and respiratory APUD cell types coexist with brain tissue, which would be expected from neuroectodermal differentiation. In ovarian teratomas, intestinal and respiratory APUD cells occurred without brain tissue, whereas melanocytes coexisted with it. In testicular teratocarcinomas, intestinal APUD cells appeared without brain tissue, and the authors concluded these cells derive from intestinal and respiratory epithelium within the tumors.

pmid-6115708.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍646例を後方視的に検討し、そのうち53例が停留精巣の既往を有していた。停留精巣が持続した症例では、精巣外に位置するセミノーマの割合が高かった。精巣固定術を受けた患者は診断時年齢が若く、早期の非セミノーマが多かった。固定術が腫瘍リスクを下げるかは判断できないが、早期診断につながる可能性があるとしている。
pmid-6115708.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 646 patients with testicular tumors, of whom 53 had a history of maldescent. Tumor types included seminoma, teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma, and choriocarcinoma. Persistent maldescent was associated with a higher proportion of seminomas located outside the scrotum. Patients who underwent orchiopexy were diagnosed at younger ages and more often had earlier-stage nonseminomas. The authors could not determine whether orchiopexy reduces tumor risk, but it appears to lead to earlier diagnosis.

pmid-6118858.summary_ja: 胚細胞由来精巣腫瘍について、疫学、発症機序、臨床像、診断をまとめた2部構成の第1部である。好発年齢は20〜34歳で、停留精巣、異形成精巣、対側腫瘍、外傷が関連因子とされる。無痛性の腫大と硬結が典型的な所見である。陰嚢内腫瘤は悪性と見なし、診断に迷う場合は鼠径部からの切除を勧めている。
pmid-6118858.summary_en: This review, the first part of a two-part series, covers epidemiology, pathogenesis, clinical presentation, and diagnosis of germ cell testicular tumors. These tumors are most common in men aged 20 to 34 and have been linked to incompletely descended testis, dysgenetic testis, contralateral tumor, and trauma. They typically present as painless enlargement and induration. The authors advise treating any testicular or intrascrotal mass as neoplastic until proven otherwise, and resolving diagnostic doubt by inguinal exploration.

pmid-6119370.summary_ja: Russell-Silver症候群の男性で、手術で修復した鼠径部停留精巣の後に進行した胎児性癌が発生した症例報告である。この症候群の男性の約42%に停留精巣があるが、精巣悪性腫瘍の報告はこれまでなかった。停留精巣、鼠径ヘルニア、精巣萎縮が本症例のリスク因子とされる。精巣異常の適切な管理についても論じている。
pmid-6119370.summary_en: This report describes a Russell-Silver dwarf whose surgically corrected inguinal cryptorchidism was followed by advanced embryonal carcinoma. Cryptorchidism occurs in about 42 percent of male patients with this syndrome, yet testicular malignancy had not been reported in it before. The authors identify cryptorchidism, inguinal hernia, and testicular atrophy as risk factors in this case. They also discuss optimal management of testicular abnormalities in Russell-Silver dwarfism.

pmid-6124207.summary_ja: シンガポール総合病院で治療された、片側の腹腔内停留精巣に生じた悪性腫瘍の成人男性3例の症例報告である。腫瘍はセミノーマ2例と絨毛癌1例で、いずれも大きく進行した状態で受診した。原発巣の外科的切除に加え、放射線療法または化学療法が行われた。絨毛癌の患者は化学療法開始後まもなく死亡し、セミノーマの2例は生存しており、うち1例は6年以上再発がない。
pmid-6124207.summary_en: This report describes three adult men with malignant tumors arising in unilateral intra-abdominal undescended testes, treated at Singapore General Hospital. Two tumors were seminomas and one was choriocarcinoma, all large and advanced at presentation. Treatment consisted of surgical excision of the primary lesion followed by radiotherapy or chemotherapy. The choriocarcinoma patient died soon after chemotherapy began, while the two seminoma patients survived, one for more than six years without recurrence.

pmid-6161688.summary_ja: 1981年の症例報告。若年成人男性に発生した後腹膜原発の性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍に対し、シクロホスファミド、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、アクチノマイシンD、クロラムブシルの6剤併用化学療法を施行した。部分奏効が得られ、既報例と比べ生存期間の著明な延長が認められた。
pmid-6161688.summary_en: This 1981 case report describes a young adult man with primary extragonadal yolk sac tumor arising in the retroperitoneum. Because chemotherapy for extragonadal origin had not previously been described, the authors used a six-drug combination: cyclophosphamide, vinblastine, bleomycin, cisplatin, actinomycin-D, and chlorambucil. The treatment produced a partial response and substantially prolonged survival compared with previously reported cases, supporting multiagent chemotherapy for this rare tumor.

pmid-6161690.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者が、ブレオマイシンを含む化学療法終了後の胸部CTで肺病変を指摘された。再発転移と判断されたが、両側開胸術でみられたのは肺線維症のみだった。ブレオマイシン誘発性肺線維症はCT上で転移と酷似しうるため、再発と断定する前に薬剤毒性を考慮すべきと示した症例である。
pmid-6161690.summary_en: A 1981 report describing a patient with testicular carcinoma who developed lung lesions on chest CT after completing chemotherapy including bleomycin. The findings were interpreted as recurrent metastatic disease, but bilateral thoracotomy revealed only pulmonary fibrosis. The case shows that bleomycin-induced fibrosis can closely mimic metastatic relapse on CT, so clinicians should consider drug toxicity before assuming recurrence and avoid unnecessary surgery.

pmid-6161691.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ精巣がん30例で、臨床病期と病理病期の不一致を血清hCGおよびAFPで検討した。マーカーを考慮すると病期分類の誤差は47%から37%に低下した。病期が進むほど上昇頻度が増加し、連続測定が病期分類と管理に必要と結論された。
pmid-6161691.summary_en: Study of 30 men with nonseminomatous testicular cancer confined to the retroperitoneum, comparing clinical and pathologic staging with serum hCG and AFP levels. Marker data reduced staging error from 47% to 37%. Markers were falsely normal in some early-stage patients but never falsely elevated, and marker frequency rose with stage. Serial hCG and AFP measurements were judged essential for staging and management.

pmid-6162398.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対しブレオマイシン治療を受けた患者に、開胸術で2回麻酔を施行した報告。ブレオマイシンは肺を感作させ、通常安全な酸素濃度でも急性肺障害を起こしうる。本症例では術後の肺障害は認められなかった。投与歴のある患者の麻酔管理上の注意点を示す。
pmid-6162398.summary_en: Report of two anesthetics administered to one patient undergoing thoracotomy after bleomycin treatment for testicular teratoma. Bleomycin is known to sensitize the lungs, so oxygen can cause acute lung injury even at concentrations usually considered safe. In this patient, no postoperative lung damage occurred on either occasion. The paper highlights an anesthetic consideration for patients previously treated with bleomycin, suggesting that oxygen concentration should be carefully managed in such cases.

pmid-6162971.summary_ja: 2家系で精巣腫瘍が発生した症例報告。父と息子が純粋セミノーマを発症し、別家系の非双生児兄弟ではいずれも精巣がんが生じ、一方は停留精巣由来だった。停留精巣では悪性腫瘍のリスクが高いことが知られており、家族内集積のまれな報告として重要である。
pmid-6162971.summary_en: Report of testicular cancer in two families. A father and son both developed pure seminoma, and in another family two non-twin brothers each had testicular cancer, one arising in an undescended testis. The authors note that the increased risk of malignancy in undescended testes is well established. The report adds to the rare literature on familial clustering of testicular tumors.

pmid-6163174.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ精巣腫瘍の臨床病期Iおよび病期IIにおける所属リンパ節の管理法3種を比較した。臨床病期Iでは精巣摘除術と放射線療法単独が、リンパ節郭清併用と同等の成績を示した。リンパ節郭清では射精障害や不妊をきたすことが多かった。病期IIでは術前放射線療法とリンパ節郭清の併用が最も優れた。
pmid-6163174.summary_en: Compares three approaches to regional lymph node management in clinical Stage I and Stage II nonseminomatous testicular tumors. For Stage I, orchiectomy with radiotherapy alone matched orchiectomy with lymphadenectomy, while lymphadenectomy usually caused aspermia. For Stage II, preoperative radiotherapy followed by lymphadenectomy gave better results than either approach alone. Radiotherapy efficacy depended on tumor volume, with lower local control when metastases exceeded 2 cm.

pmid-6163522.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍9例から培養を試み、5株で長期増殖培養を樹立した。単層増殖には腫瘍由来の間質細胞との接触が必要な株もあった。全株でアルカリフォスファターゼが高値で、約半数は胎盤型の性質を示した。一部の株は一時的にhCGやCEAを産生したが、その能力は後に失われた。
pmid-6163522.summary_en: Describes establishing long-term monolayer cultures from nine human testicular germ cell tumors, with five successfully established. Three lines needed contact with tumor-derived stromal cells to proliferate in monolayer. Two were established as pure lines, one of which was cloned. All cultures had elevated alkaline phosphatase, about half of placental type. Some cultures transiently produced hCG or CEA before losing this capacity.

pmid-6164245.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎15例、侵入奇胎6例、絨毛癌7例の組織でPAPP-Aを免疫組織化学的に検討した。PAPP-Aは全胞状奇胎の合胞体栄養膜細胞に認められ、侵入奇胎では6例中5例、絨毛癌では7例中6例で陽性だった。侵入性病変において陽性例と陰性例の間に臨床的な差はなかった。
pmid-6164245.summary_en: Immunoperoxidase study of placenta-associated plasma protein A in formalin-fixed tissue from 15 hydatidiform moles, 6 invasive moles, and 7 choriocarcinomas. PAPP-A was detected in the syncytiotrophoblast of all hydatidiform moles, in five of six invasive moles, and in six of seven choriocarcinomas. PAPP-A positivity did not differ clinically from negative cases in invasive disease. The marker may aid in characterizing gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-6164464.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性62例で血清hCG、AFP、LDH、CEAを測定した。少なくとも1つのマーカーが91%で上昇していた。hCGやAFPの持続上昇や再上昇は、必ず残存または再発腫瘍を伴っていた。CEAは有用ではなかった。腫瘍マーカーは精巣がんの管理に不可欠で、繰り返し測定すべきと結論された。
pmid-6164464.summary_en: Serum hCG, AFP, LDH, and CEA were measured in 62 men with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors. At least one marker was elevated in 91%, and hCG or AFP was elevated in most patients. Sustained or rising hCG or AFP always accompanied persistent or recurrent tumor. CEA was not useful. Yolk sac elements always raised AFP, and choriocarcinoma always raised hCG. The authors conclude that markers are indispensable and should be measured repeatedly.

pmid-6164466.summary_ja: 未治療の進行精巣がん41例にVAB-4併用化学療法を実施した臨床研究。全体の80%が完全寛解に達し、化学療法のみで寛解した例の12%が再発した。転移病変の範囲や腫瘍マーカーが寛解率に影響し、胎児性癌の例やAFPが上昇しない例で寛解率が高かった。骨髄抑制は3例に生じ、1例が寛解中に敗血症で死亡した。
pmid-6164466.summary_en: This 1981 Cancer study reports outcomes of 41 evaluable patients with advanced testicular carcinoma treated with VAB-4 combination chemotherapy without prior treatment. Complete remission was achieved in 80 percent overall, and 12 percent of chemotherapy-induced remissions relapsed at a median follow-up of 27 months. Bulk and extent of metastatic disease, primary histology, and tumor markers influenced remission rates. Patients with embryonal carcinoma or without alpha-fetoprotein elevation had higher complete remission frequencies. Myelosuppression occurred in three patients, and one patient died from sepsis while in remission.

pmid-6164475.summary_ja: 精巣が正常な非セミノーマ性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の6例で、血清hCGとAFPの経時的測定を検討した研究。マーカー値は治療反応に伴い低下し、病勢進行に伴い上昇して、各例の臨床経過と一致した。精巣所見が手掛かりとならない本群では、連続測定が病態評価と経過観察に有用であると結論づけられた。
pmid-6164475.summary_en: This 1981 Cancer report examines serial serum hCG and AFP measurements in six patients with nonseminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumors and clinically normal testes. Marker levels decreased with effective therapy and rose with disease progression, correlating closely with the clinical course in each patient. The authors conclude that serial hCG and AFP determinations are valuable for evaluating and following disease in this group, where testicular examination offers no guidance. The small series was intended to confirm the reliability of these markers in extragonadal disease.

pmid-6164697.summary_ja: 組織学的にセミノーマと診断されたがAFPが著明に高値のリンパ節転移から、免疫不全マウスで異種移植株HX 53を樹立した研究。解析の結果、セミノーマに類似する充実性の卵黄嚢癌の亜型、あるいはセミノーマと卵黄嚢癌の間の連続的な分化像が示唆された。形態のみに頼る診断の限界と、両者の境界についての問題提起が行われている。
pmid-6164697.summary_en: This 1981 J Clin Pathol hypothesis paper describes a xenograft line, HX 53, established in immunosuppressed mice from a lymph node metastasis histologically diagnosed as seminoma but with markedly elevated alpha-fetoprotein. Histological, immunocytochemical, and ultrastructural analyses suggested either a solid variant of yolk sac carcinoma that mimics seminoma morphologically, or a continuum of differentiation between seminoma and yolk sac carcinoma. The findings question the strict separation of these germ cell tumor entities and the reliance on morphology alone for diagnosis.

pmid-6165424.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍126例の治療成績を検討した研究。全体の生存率は81%、無病生存率は70%であった。早期例では放射線療法後に21%が再発したものの生存率は95%であった。進行例の無病生存は転移腫瘍の量と組織型に依存し、胎児性癌は奇形癌より良好であった。血清AFPとβ-hCGは経過観察の指標として有用だが、腫瘍量で補正すると予後因子としての意義は乏しかった。
pmid-6165424.summary_en: This 1981 British Journal of Urology report reviews 126 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis, including 98 untreated patients. Overall survival was 81 percent and disease-free rate 70 percent. Early-stage patients had 95 percent survival despite a 21 percent relapse rate after radiotherapy. Disease-free survival in advanced disease depended on metastatic volume and histology, with embryonal carcinoma faring better than teratocarcinoma. Serum AFP and beta-hCG were useful monitors but lacked prognostic significance after accounting for tumor volume.

pmid-6165455.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫68例を未熟組織の量で分類し解析した研究。75%が良性で、未熟成分を有するものは11.8%、悪性は13.2%であった。悪性例はすべて卵黄嚢腫瘍でAFP陽性であり、平均生存期間は8.9か月と全例予後不良であった。未熟成分の再発・転移は認めず、早期の適切な治療により予後は良好であると述べられている。
pmid-6165455.summary_en: This 1981 Cancer review analyzes 68 sacrococcygeal teratomas graded by the amount of immature tissue. Most were benign (75 percent), 11.8 percent were immature, and 13.2 percent were malignant. All malignant lesions were endodermal sinus tumors that stained for AFP and were uniformly fatal, with mean survival of 8.9 months. Early adequate treatment yielded favorable outcomes, and immature elements showed no local recurrence or metastasis. The authors argue that immature sacrococcygeal teratomas should be separated from tumors containing malignant elements because their prognoses differ.

pmid-6165459.summary_ja: 精巣がん12例の原発巣・転移巣由来の15細胞株で性染色体を解析し、胚細胞の形質転換時期を検討した研究。14株でXとYが同時に存在した。XとYは減数第一分裂で分離するため、形質転換は減数分裂前に起きたと結論づけられた。精巣がんは未熟な性質をもち、宿主とは独立して分化しうることが示唆された。
pmid-6165459.summary_en: This 1981 Cancer Research study examines sex chromosome composition in 15 cell lines from 12 patients with testicular cancer to determine when germ cell transformation occurs. Simultaneous X and Y chromosomes were found in 14 of 15 lines. Because X and Y segregate during the first meiotic division, the authors conclude that transformation happens before meiosis. Barr bodies found in cells with multiple X chromosomes reflected the primitive nature of testicular cancer and its ability to differentiate independently of the host.

pmid-6165464.summary_ja: 正常の合胞体栄養膜細胞と悪性の絨毛性腫瘍におけるα2マクログロブリンの発現を検討した研究。胞状奇胎では検出されたが、侵入奇胎と絨毛癌では検出されなかった。正常の合胞体栄養膜細胞は血清からα2Mを取り込んだが、絨毛癌細胞は取り込まなかった。本タンパクは浸潤時のタンパク分解の調節に関与する可能性があると考察されている。
pmid-6165464.summary_en: This 1981 Cancer Research study examines alpha 2-macroglobulin (alpha 2M) in normal and malignant syncytiotrophoblasts. Immunostaining detected alpha 2M in normal placental syncytiotrophoblasts and hydatidiform moles but not in invasive moles or choriocarcinomas. In culture, choriocarcinoma cells did not produce alpha 2M and did not take it up from serum, whereas normal syncytiotrophoblasts absorbed serum alpha 2M. The authors propose that alpha 2M regulates proteolysis during trophoblast invasion, so its loss may relate to invasive behavior.

pmid-6165945.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍111例で血清AFP、CEA、hCG、hPL、SP1を測定した。組織型ごとに特徴的なマーカー産生パターンがみられ、卵黄嚢成分はAFP、合胞体栄養膜成分はhCGなど、分化した奇形腫はCEAを産生した。血清マーカーは精巣摘除術後の診断と病期分類に有用で、残存腫瘍の評価にも免疫染色より有用と考えられた。
pmid-6165945.summary_en: Serum levels of AFP, CEA, hCG, hPL and SP1 were measured in 111 patients with testicular germ cell tumors. Histologic subtypes produced characteristic marker patterns: yolk sac elements produced AFP, syncytiotrophoblastic elements produced hCG, hPL or SP1, and differentiated teratomas produced CEA. Seminoma and pure embryonal carcinoma were usually marker-negative until advanced disease. Serum markers after orchiectomy or lymphadenectomy aided diagnosis and staging, and were more informative about residual disease than immunoperoxidase staining of resected tissue.

pmid-6165946.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍20例でAFPの免疫組織化学染色を行った。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を含む腫瘍はすべてAFP陽性であった。胎児性癌や未熟奇形腫の一部でもAFPが検出され、AFP産生は卵黄嚢腫瘍に限られないことが示された。セミノーマはすべて陰性であった。
pmid-6165946.summary_en: Twenty germ cell tumors were examined by immunoperoxidase staining for alpha-fetoprotein (AFP). All tumors containing endodermal sinus tumor elements were AFP-positive. AFP was also found in some embryonal carcinomas, where it was localized to the tumor cells themselves, and in some immature teratomas. All seminomas were negative. The findings indicate that AFP production is not restricted to endodermal sinus tumor, and that AFP staining can help identify late embryonal carcinoma or early endodermal sinus differentiation.

pmid-6167120.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍63例で血清ホルモンと腫瘍マーカーを測定した。再発例ではエストラジオールが上昇し、FSHの低下とLH反応の低下が再発の早期兆候であった。β-hCG陽性の再発例ではテストステロンが上昇し、中等度のhCGがテストステロン産生を刺激すると考えられた。
pmid-6167120.summary_en: Serum oestradiol, testosterone, LH, FSH, beta-hCG and AFP were measured in 63 patients with testicular tumours. Recurrence was associated with elevated oestradiol, and decreasing FSH and LH responses were among the earliest signs of recurrence. Testosterone rose in beta-hCG-positive recurrence, suggesting that moderate hCG levels stimulate testicular testosterone production while high levels do not further increase it. Increased precursor-to-oestradiol conversion was seen in both beta-hCG-positive and beta-hCG-negative tumours.

pmid-6167351.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株GCH-1とGCH-2はβ2-ミクログロブリンを合成しなかった。一方、非妊娠性の胃由来絨毛癌細胞株では合成が確認された。GCH-1のmRNAも無細胞系で標識タンパクを生じず、有効なmRNAが欠如していることが示された。
pmid-6167351.summary_en: Two gestational choriocarcinoma cell lines, GCH-1 and GCH-2, did not produce detectable beta 2-microglobulin when metabolically labeled and purified by affinity chromatography. By contrast, a nongestational choriocarcinoma line derived from male stomach cells did synthesize it. Polyadenylated mRNA from GCH-1 cells also failed to direct labeled beta 2-microglobulin synthesis in a cell-free system, whereas mRNA from the nongestational line did. The authors conclude that GCH-1 cells lack effective beta 2-microglobulin messenger RNA.

pmid-6167354.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍で有糸分裂中も残存する核小体を検討した。胎児性癌、セミノーマ、絨毛癌の細胞栄養膜細胞では70%以上の分裂像で核小体が残存したが、分化した細胞ではまれであった。残存核小体は転写活性を示した。
pmid-6167354.summary_en: Persistent nucleoli during mitosis were examined in a series of human germ cell-derived tumors. Embryonal carcinomas, seminomas and the cytotrophoblasts of choriocarcinomas showed persistent nucleoli in over 70% of mitoses. Differentiated derivatives, including those of embryonal carcinoma and endodermal sinus tumors, rarely retained nucleoli. The retained nucleoli appeared transcriptionally active, suggesting that undifferentiated germ cell tumor cells maintain nucleolar function through mitosis.

pmid-6168276.summary_ja: 1981年の研究で、ヌードマウスにヒト絨毛癌(CC3)の異種移植モデルを確立し、抗ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン抗体の腫瘍局在を評価した。同種由来の非特異的抗体と比較し、腫瘍と肺の同位体放射能から求めた特異性指数は1.3～2.0であった。標的化細胞傷害薬の開発に向けた抗体局在研究の基盤となる知見を示した点に意義がある。
pmid-6168276.summary_en: This 1981 study established a human choriocarcinoma xenograft (CC3) in nude mice to evaluate antibody localization for targeted cell-killing agents. Affinity-purified antibodies against human chorionic gonadotropin were compared with nonspecific antibodies from the same species. Biodistribution was assessed by isotope activity in tumor and lung. Pretreating nonspecific antibodies with ammonium thiocyanate was needed for equivalent distribution in normal mice. Specificity indices ranged from 1.3 to 2.0, indicating modest tumor-preferential localization of the anti-hCG antibodies. The model served as a tool for antibody-directed therapy research in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6168360.summary_ja: 1981年の報告で、転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がん74例にVAB-3併用化学療法を施行した。単独で54%が完全奏効し、残存成熟奇形腫の外科的切除を加えると全体で61%となった。生存例の追跡中央値は35か月で、45%が無病生存であった。完全奏効は長期生存と有意に関連し、毒性による死亡はなかった。
pmid-6168360.summary_en: This 1981 report describes 74 evaluable patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer treated with the VAB-3 regimen (vinblastine, actinomycin-D, bleomycin, cisplatin). Complete remission occurred in 54% with VAB-3 alone and 61% overall after surgical excision of residual mature teratoma in five patients. With median follow-up of 35 months among survivors, 45% were disease-free. Complete remission strongly predicted long survival. No treatment-related deaths occurred, and the authors emphasized that aggressive chemotherapy combined with surgery is key to achieving cure.

pmid-6168361.summary_ja: 1981年の研究では、播種性精巣がんで白金併用化学療法後に残存した病変の外科的切除成績を検討した。肺病変と後腹膜病変の切除を受けた計62例を解析した。成熟奇形腫や線維組織の患者はほぼ無病であったが、癌の患者は22例中2例のみが持続的に無病であった。血清マーカー陰性でも癌は否定できず、残存癌には追加の化学療法が必要と結論された。
pmid-6168361.summary_en: This 1981 study reviewed surgical resection of residual disease after platinum-based chemotherapy in disseminated testicular cancer. Twenty-one patients underwent pulmonary resection and 41 underwent retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Imaging could not distinguish fibrous tissue, mature teratoma, and carcinoma. Patients with fibrous tissue or mature teratoma were largely disease-free without further therapy, while only two of 22 with resected carcinoma remained continuously disease-free. Seronegativity did not exclude carcinoma. The authors suggested additional platinum chemotherapy for residual carcinoma.

pmid-6168554.summary_ja: 卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍38例と胎児性癌4例を組織学的・臨床的に検討したレビューである。これらは分化の違いのみで区別される一群の胚性卵巣腫瘍とする考えを提示している。46,XY核型の症例や、対側卵巣に性腺芽腫を伴う症例も報告された。術後の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の経時測定の有用性を強調している。
pmid-6168554.summary_en: This histopathological review examines 38 yolk sac tumours of the ovary and four so-called embryonal carcinomas, along with their clinical features. The authors propose that these neoplasms form a single taxonomic group of embryonal ovarian tumours that differ only in their concomitant differentiation patterns. Notable findings include one yolk sac tumour in a 46,XY individual and another associated with a gonadoblastoma in the contralateral ovary. The study emphasizes the value of postoperative serial serum AFP assays for monitoring.

pmid-6169388.summary_ja: 1981年の研究で、131I標識の抗αフェトプロテイン抗体を用いた体外スキャンにより胚細胞腫瘍の転移を検出した。原発切除後の11例を解析し、AFP高値の8例全例で転移が描出された。治療後にAFPが正常化すると再スキャンは陰性化した。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床管理に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-6169388.summary_en: This study used sheep IgG antibody against alpha-fetoprotein labeled with iodine-131 and emission scanning to localize germ cell tumor metastases. Eleven patients were studied after primary tumor resection, ten with malignant teratoma and one with endodermal sinus tumor. All eight patients with elevated AFP had metastases seen on antibody scans, and two of three with normal AFP had positive scans. Repeat scans turned negative after treatment in patients whose AFP normalized. The authors concluded antibody scanning may be useful in managing germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-6169850.summary_ja: 1981年の泌尿器科研究で、高病期セミノーマ19例に白金併用化学療法を施行した。63%が完全寛解、残りが部分寛解で、58%が無病であった。放射線照射歴のない6例中5例は完全寛解に至った。成績は病期III非セミノーマ性精巣がんの化学療法成績と同程度であった。
pmid-6169850.summary_en: This 1981 urology study reports 19 patients with high-stage seminoma treated with platinum-based regimens including vinblastine, bleomycin, and in five cases doxorubicin. Twelve (63%) achieved complete remission and seven partial remission, with 58% disease-free at last follow-up. Among six patients without prior irradiation, five reached complete remission. The single failure had massive hepatic metastases. Median follow-up was 19 months. The authors noted outcomes paralleled chemotherapy results in stage III nonseminomatous testicular cancer.

pmid-6170417.summary_ja: 精巣がん80例を前向きに追跡し、LDH、AFP、hCGを平均18.1か月にわたり測定した。LDH上昇は腫瘍量とともに増加し、病期IIIで78.0%であった。初診時LDH正常の患者は平均生存期間が15.5か月と、上昇例の9.2か月より長かった。LDHは予後判定と、腫瘍量の多い症例のモニタリングに有用と結論された。
pmid-6170417.summary_en: This prospective study of 80 patients with testicular cancer serially measured LDH, AFP, and hCG over a mean of 18.1 months. LDH elevation rose with tumor bulk: 78% in stage III versus 26% in stage II and 20% in stage I before orchiectomy. Patients with normal initial LDH had longer mean survival (15.5 vs 9.2 months). The authors concluded LDH aids prognosis and monitoring of bulky disease, and that combined LDH and hCG monitoring is used for seminoma.

pmid-6170418.summary_ja: 精巣がん50例を対象とした二重盲検研究で、参照検査室の血清AFP・hCG測定の偽陽性・偽陰性率を検討した。血清hCGは14%で偽陽性、2%で偽陰性、AFPは12%で偽陽性、偽陰性はなかった。尿中hCGをLHと同時測定することで血清hCGの偽陽性を除外できた。治療前にはマーカー上昇を臨床像と照合すべきと結論づけた。
pmid-6170418.summary_en: In a double-blind study of 50 patients with testicular cancer, reference-laboratory serum AFP and hCG assays were compared against clinical status. Serum hCG gave false positives in 14% and a false negative in 2%; AFP gave false positives in 12% and no false negatives. Measuring urinary hCG with a highly specific carboxyl-terminal assay alongside LH helped exclude false-positive serum hCG. The authors conclude that elevated markers must be correlated with clinical status before treatment is started.

pmid-6170420.summary_ja: VAC化学療法に不応の転移性性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児2例に、シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ドキソルビシン・ブレオマイシン(cis-VAB)療法を実施した。両例とも完全奏効が得られ、1例は転移判明後3年半無腫瘍で生存した。主な毒性はシスプラチンによるもので管理可能だった。cis-VABは安全で有効な治療法であり、予後不良例での大規模研究が必要とした。
pmid-6170420.summary_en: Two children with metastatic extragonadal endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor that had failed VAC chemotherapy were treated with cisplatin, vinblastine, doxorubicin and bleomycin (cis-VAB). Both achieved complete response; one remained tumor-free 3.5 years after metastasis and 2.5 years after stopping therapy. Toxicity was mainly related to cisplatin and was manageable. The authors conclude cis-VAB is safe and effective and recommend a larger study in poor-prognosis children.

pmid-6170422.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍5例と充実性奇形腫3例の術後血清AFPを経時的に測定し、産後女性と比較した。いずれも指数関数的に低下したが、不完全切除例では低下が遅かった。術後のAFP上昇は2例の再発を示し、未熟奇形腫1例では化学療法でAFPが低下した。術後AFPの低下速度は切除の完全性を示し、経時測定は再発の検出と化学療法の評価に有用とした。
pmid-6170422.summary_en: Serial postoperative serum AFP was studied in five patients with ovarian yolk sac tumor and three with solid ovarian teratoma, and compared with postpartum women. AFP fell exponentially in all groups, but more slowly after incomplete resection. Postoperative elevation signaled recurrence in two patients, and chemotherapy lowered AFP in one immature teratoma. The authors conclude the decline rate of postoperative AFP indicates completeness of resection and that serial AFP is useful for detecting recurrence and monitoring chemotherapy.

pmid-6170952.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍82例で、AFP・hCG・LDHと臨床病期の関係を検討した。上昇率はIIA期12%、IIB期67%、III期85%だった。化学療法によるマーカー正常化は腫瘍縮小を示したが、成熟奇形腫の残存により完全消失を確実には予測できなかった。病期分類における腫瘍マーカーの価値は限定的とした。
pmid-6170952.summary_en: In 82 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis, alpha-fetoprotein, hCG and LDH levels were analyzed against clinical stage. Markers were elevated in 12% of stage IIA, 67% of IIB and 85% of stage III patients, and only two of 34 patients were restaged by markers. Marker normalization during chemotherapy indicated regression, but it did not reliably predict complete eradication, probably because mature teratoma may persist. Markers were thus of limited value for staging.

pmid-6170953.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍26例で、化学療法中のAFP・hCG低下パターンを解析した。直線的低下か見かけの半減期の延長かの2型に分かれた。直線的低下で腫瘍が完全消失したのはAFP38%、hCG40%のみだった。半減期の延長は主に成熟奇形腫による活動性腫瘍を示し、治療結果を確実には予測できなかった。
pmid-6170953.summary_en: Serum AFP or hCG decline was followed in 26 patients with disseminated non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors during chemotherapy. Linear decline or an increasing apparent half-life (AHL) was observed. A linear decline predicted complete tumor elimination in only 38% (AFP) and 40% (hCG) of patients, whereas an increasing AHL indicated active tumor, mostly mature teratoma, in 60% (AFP) and 83% (hCG). Half-life patterns therefore did not predict the outcome with certainty.

pmid-6171134.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍7例と妊娠初期のヒト卵黄嚢9例を、超微細構造と免疫蛍光で比較した。腫瘍細胞は妊娠7週以前の卵黄嚢内胚葉に類似していた。Schiller-Duval小体、内胚葉洞構造、明細胞型パターンを示し、微絨毛やグリコーゲン、粗面小胞体を有していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍は初期卵黄嚢内胚葉の表現型を反映すると結論づけた。
pmid-6171134.summary_en: Seven human ovarian yolk sac tumors were compared ultrastructurally and immunofluorescently with nine human yolk sacs from early pregnancy. Tumor cells forming Schiller-Duval bodies, endodermal sinus structures and clear-cell patterns resembled yolk sac endoderm before the seventh gestational week, showing microvilli, glycogen rosettes, rough endoplasmic reticulum and diastase-resistant PAS-positive granules. Cells facing mesenchyma showed basement membrane-like material and tubular structures. The authors conclude the tumor reflects an early yolk sac endodermal phenotype.

pmid-6171335.summary_ja: 閉経後女性に生じた稀な原発性胃絨毛癌の症例で、剖検により確定診断された。免疫組織化学で栄養膜腫瘍細胞のhCGを証明した。閉経後であったため、月経ホルモンの影響を受けずに腫瘍のホルモン作用を評価できた。エストロゲン・プロゲステロン関連の反応は卵巣を介さず、腫瘍自身による産生が示唆された。
pmid-6171335.summary_en: A rare primary gastric choriocarcinoma was diagnosed in a postmenopausal woman, confirmed by autopsy and immunohistochemical demonstration of hCG in trophoblastic tumor cells. The authors briefly discuss its possible origin. Because the patient was postmenopausal, the tumor's hormonal effects on target tissues could be examined without the confounding influence of normal menstrual hormones. The estrogen- and progesterone-related responses appeared not to be ovarian-mediated, implicating direct production by the tumor.

pmid-6172141.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍(HX39)の膜成分に対して作製したモノクローナル抗体LICR LON/HT13を、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植片を持つ免疫抑制マウスに投与した研究です。抗体は腫瘍に選択的に集積し、生存腫瘍細胞の細胞膜付近に局在しました。腫瘍の血管構築が分布に影響し、正常マウスIgGは集積しませんでした。
pmid-6172141.summary_en: A monoclonal antibody, LICR LON/HT13, raised against membrane components of a human germ cell tumour (HX39), was injected into immune-suppressed mice bearing human germ cell tumour xenografts. Organ and tumour radioactivity, together with quantitative autoradiography, showed selective antibody accumulation in tumours. Localisation was seen in viable tumour cells, closely associated with their cell membranes, and tumour vascular architecture influenced distribution. Radiolabelled normal mouse IgG did not localise, supporting antibody-based targeting of germ cell tumours.

pmid-6172347.summary_ja: 妊娠12日目に胎仔を摘出したラットに生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍を、形態学的・組織化学的に解析した研究です。119匹中95匹に腫瘍が発生し、卵黄嚢腫瘍のほか絨毛癌や奇形腫などがみられました。腫瘍保有ラットの血清はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性で、AFPは細胞内の小胞体とゴルジ装置に局在しました。
pmid-6172347.summary_en: Yolk sac tumours were experimentally induced in rats by removing fetuses on day 12 of gestation, leaving fetal membranes outside the uterus. Of 119 operated rats, 95 developed tumours, including yolk sac tumours, adenocarcinomas, choriocarcinomas and teratomas. Tumour-bearing rats had AFP-positive sera from three weeks after surgery. Cultured cells showed a PAS-positive basement membrane-like stroma resembling Reichert's membrane, and AFP was localised to the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi complex. Histogenesis of the tumour was discussed.

pmid-6172898.summary_ja: ヒトの卵黄嚢腫瘍をヌードマウスに移植し、組織学的・超微細構造的に検討した研究です。移植腫瘍はシラー・デュバル小体や卵黄嚢構造などヒト腫瘍と同様の特徴を示しました。腫瘍保有マウスの血清と嚢胞液からは、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、AFP、CEAが検出されました。
pmid-6172898.summary_en: A yolk sac tumour was transplanted into athymic nude mice and examined histologically and ultrastructurally. The transplant showed Schiller-Duval bodies, yolk sac structures and features matching human tumours. The tumour and normal human yolk sac synthesised AFP as well as albumin, prealbumin, alpha1-antitrypsin and transferrin. Radioimmunoassay detected AFP, CEA and hCG in tumour-bearing mouse sera and cyst fluid. Immunohistochemistry showed tumour cells producing CEA, alpha1-antitrypsin, transferrin, hCG and AFP, consistent with the radioimmunoassay findings.

pmid-6172910.summary_ja: 精巣の乳児型胎児性癌(卵黄嚢腫瘍)の小児5例を報告し、文献的考察を加えた論文です。治療は年齢で異なり、1歳未満はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による非手術的な病期分類が可能とされます。2歳未満は転移が証明された場合のみ後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を行い、化学療法は転移例に限り、放射線療法は適応外とされています。
pmid-6172910.summary_en: Five children with infantile embryonal carcinoma (yolk sac tumour) of the testis are presented alongside a literature review. Management depends on age. Under one year, non-operative staging with AFP and CT is possible. Between one and two years, laparotomy staging is recommended. Under two, RPLND is performed only when metastases are demonstrable; from age two, RPLND is performed unilaterally or bilaterally depending on retroperitoneal metastases. Chemotherapy is required only for metastatic disease, and radiotherapy is not indicated.

pmid-6174083.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患の41例から経時的に採取した血清を用い、SP1、hCG、PP5、α2-PAGを測定した研究です。PP5は胞状奇胎例のみで検出され、排出後数時間で消失しました。SP1とhCGは残存腫瘍活動性の鋭敏な指標となり、再発の臨床症状が現れる数か月前に治療強化の必要性を示しました。
pmid-6174083.summary_en: Serial serum samples from 41 patients with trophoblastic tumour were analysed for SP1, hCG, PP5 and alpha2-PAG. SP1 and hCG were elevated in most patients, while PP5 was detected only in hydatidiform mole and disappeared within hours of evacuation. SP1 and hCG fell during treatment, but seronegativity took months, and both were sensitive indicators of residual tumour activity, signalling need for more effective treatment before clinical recurrence. alpha2-PAG correlated with the clinical course in only 80% of patients, indicating limited value.

pmid-6174958.summary_ja: 精巣と卵巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍10例で、AFP、hCGとその遊離サブユニット、SP1の局在を免疫組織学的に検討した研究です。AFPは胎児性癌の細胞や卵黄嚢腫瘍成分に認められ、胎児性癌から卵黄嚢腫瘍への移行像も示されました。hCGは胎児性癌内の合胞体栄養細胞様巨細胞に局在し、胎児性癌が絨毛癌や卵黄嚢腫瘍へ分化する能力を持つことが示唆されました。
pmid-6174958.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry for AFP, hCG and its free subunits, and SP1 was performed on 10 non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis and ovary. AFP was found in embryonal carcinoma cells, often alongside yolk sac tumour, with transitions from tubular embryonal carcinoma to yolk sac tumour cells. hCG was located in syncytiotrophoblast-like giant cells within embryonal carcinoma, with beta subunit detected more often than alpha subunit or SP1. The authors suggest that embryonal carcinoma can differentiate into choriocarcinoma and yolk sac tumour components.

pmid-6175355.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC4-azal細胞の皮下接種により奇形癌様の充実性腫瘍を作製し、AFPの局在を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究です。AFPは未熟な胎児性成分や管腔状に配列した神経上皮様構造で陽性でしたが、未分化成分や成熟成分では陰性でした。細胞内にAFPが存在するには、一定以上の細胞分化と組織構築が必要と結論づけられています。
pmid-6175355.summary_en: Solid tumours with teratocarcinoma histology were induced in mice by subcutaneous inoculation of murine embryonal carcinoma PCC4-azal cells. Immunoperoxidase staining with anti-mouse AFP antibodies showed AFP in immature embryonal or fetal components and in differentiating neuroepithelial structures. Mature, undifferentiated and unstructured components were AFP negative. The authors conclude that intracellular AFP requires both a minimum degree of cell differentiation and tissue organisation.

pmid-6175520.summary_ja: 卵巣に生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍4例を報告し、放射免疫測定法による血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の経時的測定結果を示した論文です。自然経過、予後、治療は十分に解明されていないと指摘されています。著者らは、AFP測定が治療モニタリングと、臨床所見より前の再発検出に鋭敏な方法であると強調しています。
pmid-6175520.summary_en: Four cases of ovarian endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumour are described, with serial AFP measurements by radioimmunoassay. The authors note that these tumours are now recognised more often, and that their natural history, prognosis and therapy remain incompletely resolved, so reporting new cases is valuable. They emphasise radioimmunoassay AFP as a highly sensitive method for monitoring therapy and detecting recurrence before clinical evidence appears.

pmid-6259178.summary_ja: 1981年のJ Cell Biol誌の論文で、自然発生の精巣奇形癌から樹立された胎児性癌細胞株PCC7-Sの分化を解析した。浮遊凝集体化により細胞容積の減少、G1期停止、コリン作動性酵素活性の上昇、F9胚抗原の消失が起こる。付着後には神経突起伸長とナトリウム流入が認められ、コリン作動性ニューロンへの分化が優先的に生じることを示した。
pmid-6259178.summary_en: This 1981 J Cell Biol study examines PCC7-S, an embryonal carcinoma cell line established from a spontaneous testicular teratocarcinoma. When cells are aggregated in suspension and replated, they show reduced cell volume, G1 arrest, altered protease and cholinergic enzyme activities, and loss of the embryonic antigen F9. Attached aggregates develop neurite outgrowth with neuronal ultrastructure and sodium influx, indicating preferential differentiation toward cholinergic neurons. The authors discuss the model's utility for studying early commitment to differentiation.

pmid-6260933.summary_ja: 1981年のJ Reprod Med誌の総説で、胞状奇胎と妊娠性絨毛癌からなる絨毛性増殖の形態と分類を扱う。部分奇胎から絨毛性腫瘍が生じることがあり、催奇形性と発癌性の関連が指摘される。妊娠性絨毛癌は妊娠の合併症であり、分類は栄養膜の挙動に基づくべきだと論じ、腫瘍性の性質に応じて段階づけた用語を提案している。
pmid-6260933.summary_en: This 1981 J Reprod Med article reviews the morphology and taxonomy of trophoblastic growths, focusing on the hydatidiform mole-gestational choriocarcinoma complex. It describes partial moles as a source of trophoblastic neoplasms and links teratogenic and carcinogenic events. The author argues that gestational choriocarcinoma is a complication of pregnancy and that trophoblastic behavior should guide classification. Simple terms, chorioma and choriocarcinoma, graded by neoplastic attributes, are proposed.

pmid-6264739.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍31例で後腹膜のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)とリンパ管造影を比較した1981年の報告である。正常または判定困難な例ではリンパ管造影で十分だった。異常例ではCTが転移の範囲をより正確に示し、照射野の決定に有用であった。治療方針を変えうる症例にCTを用いる検査順序が提案されている。
pmid-6264739.summary_en: This 1981 comparison evaluated computed tomography and lymphography of the retroperitoneum in 31 men with testicular tumors. Lymphography was sufficient when normal or equivocal, while CT gave more information in abnormal cases by defining the extent of metastatic disease and planning radiation fields. The authors propose an investigation sequence that reserves CT for cases where it is likely to change treatment.

pmid-6266253.summary_ja: hCGのβ末端ペプチドに対する抗血清を用いた高感度の尿中hCG測定法を開発した。血清β-hCG測定より持続性腫瘍の検出に優れ、絨毛癌の女性では血清hCGの再出現を予測した。化学療法中に正常化し、長期寛解後も正常値を保った。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の持続例の診断に有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-6266253.summary_en: This study developed a highly sensitive radioimmunoassay for urinary hCG using an antiserum to the beta carboxy-terminal peptide. Compared with serum beta subunit assays, it detected persistent tumor more effectively, and in women with choriocarcinoma it predicted later serum hCG reappearance. Levels normalized during chemotherapy and stayed normal in long-term remission. The authors conclude that urinary hCG measurement improves detection of persistent gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6266307.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞をレチノイン酸で処理すると分化が誘導され、腫瘍形成能が低下することを示した。一部の細胞は反応せず、EC細胞株ごとにレチノイン酸結合蛋白(RABP)の量が異なった。レチノイン酸に反応しない変異株は他の分化刺激にも応答せず、レチノイン酸-RABP複合体の機能が分化の鍵であると考察されている。
pmid-6266307.summary_en: This study examines how retinoic acid (RA) induces differentiation of embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells and reduces their tumorigenicity. A subpopulation of EC cells remains unresponsive, and levels of RA-binding protein differ among EC lines. The authors isolated RA-resistant mutants that also lost differentiation capacity under other stimuli, suggesting that the RA-RABP complex is critical to the differentiation program.

pmid-6267861.summary_ja: hCGのβサブユニットに対する抗体を用いたサンドイッチ型酵素免疫測定法を開発した。感度は1チューブあたり0.3 mIUで、LHやFSHとの交差反応はほとんどなかった。放射免疫測定法との相関は良好であった。絨毛癌患者の連続血清で評価され、絨毛性疾患の臨床診断に有用であった。
pmid-6267861.summary_en: This study describes a sandwich enzyme immunoassay for hCG using an antibody to the beta subunit, with sensitivity down to 0.3 mIU per tube and minimal cross-reactivity with LH and FSH. Results correlated well with radioimmunoassay (r = 0.98). Serial serum samples from healthy women and women with choriocarcinoma showed the assay is useful in clinically diagnosing trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6268665.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患27例の超音波所見を検討し、完全胞状奇胎、部分胞状奇胎、奇胎と胎児の共存、胎盤水腫変性、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌を含む転移性病変の6群に分類した。この分類と超音波検査が診断および治療方針の決定に有用であることを示した報告。
pmid-6268665.summary_en: Sonographic findings in 27 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease were reviewed and classified into six subgroups: complete mole, partial mole, coexisting mole and fetus, hydropic placental degeneration, locally invasive mole, and metastatic trophoblastic disease including choriocarcinoma. The authors show how this categorization reflects newer concepts of trophoblastic pathology and argue that ultrasonography is useful for diagnosis and for guiding subsequent management. The report establishes an imaging framework for gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6269502.summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍患者の尿中hCG、SP1、血清および脳脊髄液中のβ-hCGを免疫学的手法で測定した。胞状奇胎摘出後は各マーカーが類似し、SP1は通常最初に消失した。転移性絨毛癌では血清・脳脊髄液中のSP1がβ-hCGより低く、化学療法に伴い全マーカーが低下した。SP1は絨毛性腫瘍治療のモニタリングに有用となり得ると結論づけた。
pmid-6269502.summary_en: In patients with trophoblastic tumours, the authors measured urinary hCG, pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP1), and serum and CSF beta-hCG using immunoassays. After hydatidiform mole removal the markers were similar, though SP1 usually disappeared first. In metastatic choriocarcinoma, SP1 was lower than beta-hCG in serum and CSF, and all markers declined during chemotherapy. The authors suggest SP1 may be useful for monitoring the treatment of trophoblastic tumours.

pmid-6272237.summary_ja: 妊娠女性34例と絨毛性疾患患者13例の血清で、妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク(SP1)のコンカナバリンA結合を検討した。正常妊娠や胞状奇胎では非結合分画が全SP1の0.5〜4.3%だったのに対し、絨毛癌6例中5例では4.8〜30%に上昇した。コンカナバリンA非結合SP1の分泌は悪性栄養膜組織の特徴であり、糖鎖修飾の変化を反映する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6272237.summary_en: This study measured binding of pregnancy-specific beta-1-glycoprotein (SP1) to Concanavalin A in serum from 34 pregnant women and 13 patients with trophoblastic disease. In normal pregnancy and hydatidiform moles, the Con A non-binding fraction was 0.5–4.3% of total SP1. In 5 of 6 choriocarcinoma patients, it rose to 4.8–30%. The authors suggest that secretion of this non-binding SP1 is a characteristic of some malignant trophoblast tissues, possibly reflecting altered glycosylation, and could help distinguish malignant from benign trophoblastic disease.

pmid-6274140.summary_ja: 絨毛癌18例と胞状奇胎8例の血清を解析し、プロラクチンとエストラジオールは栄養膜マーカー陽性の検体で高値を示した。この差は化学療法中も維持された。免疫染色では、正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の合胞体栄養膜細胞にプロラクチンが認められた。悪性の合胞体栄養膜細胞が、直接分泌または下垂体へのエストロゲン刺激を介して血中プロラクチンに寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6274140.summary_en: This 1981 study measured circulating chorionic gonadotropin, pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein, prolactin, and oestradiol in 219 serum samples from 18 patients with choriocarcinoma and 45 samples from 8 patients with hydatidiform mole. Prolactin and oestradiol were higher in samples containing trophoblastic markers, a difference preserved during chemotherapy. Immunoperoxidase staining showed prolactin in the syncytiotrophoblast of normal placenta and in hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma. The authors suggest malignant syncytiotrophoblast may contribute to circulating prolactin, either by direct secretion or through oestrogen stimulation of the pituitary.

pmid-6274232.summary_ja: 活動性の胚細胞腫瘍58例と寛解の20例で、PS β1G、hCG、AFP、CEAを測定した。寛解例はすべて陰性であった。4マーカーの併用陽性率は75%で、単独より高かった。hCGは全組織型で最も陽性率が高く、AFPは胎児性癌と関連しセミノーマでは陽性とならなかった。CEAは陽性となることが少なく、診断的価値は低いとされた。
pmid-6274232.summary_en: This study assayed PS beta 1G, hCG, AFP, and CEA in 58 patients with active germ cell tumors and 20 patients in remission. All markers were negative in patients in remission and in one case of pure teratoma. Combined positivity of the four markers was 75%, higher than any single marker. hCG had the highest positivity across histological types, while AFP was mainly associated with embryonal carcinoma and was absent in seminoma. CEA was rarely positive and always accompanied other markers, so the authors judged it of little diagnostic use for germ cell tumors.

pmid-6274977.summary_ja: 培養ヒト絨毛癌細胞に対するメトトレキサートの作用を、in vitroでフローサイトメトリーにより解析した。高用量では細胞死とDNA合成阻害が起きた。タンパク質産生に関連する蛍光強度は増加した。低用量を48時間後に除去すると、細胞の約半数は対照レベルまで回復した。
pmid-6274977.summary_en: This 1981 study examined how methotrexate (MTX) affects cultured human choriocarcinoma cells in vitro. Cells were treated with two MTX concentrations and analyzed by flow microfluorometry after propidium iodide and FITC staining to assess cell cycle compartments, nucleic acid, and protein content. MTX increased FITC intensity associated with protein production at doses that both killed cells and inhibited DNA synthesis. After low-dose MTX was removed at 48 hours, about half of the cells recovered to control levels, whereas DNA synthesis inhibition persisted at high dose.

pmid-6277037.summary_ja: 化学療法前の絨毛性腫瘍女性24例の血清に、夫のリンパ球と反応する細胞傷害性抗体が検出された。抗体はIgMで、主にB細胞と反応した。標的抗原はHLA-D抗原とは異なり、胎盤に発現していると考えられた。絨毛性悪性腫瘍の増殖を促進する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-6277037.summary_en: This 1981 immunology study found lymphocytotoxic antibodies reacting with husbands' lymphocytes in 24 sera from women with trophoblastic neoplasia, collected before chemotherapy. The antibodies were most active at +4 degrees C, mainly reacted with B lymphocytes, and were IgM. Their target antigen was distinct from HLA-D antigens. The antigen appeared to be expressed on placenta, as the antibodies were absorbed by trophoblastic homogenates and one serum reacted with JAR choriocarcinoma cells. The authors suggest these antibodies may enhance growth of trophoblastic malignancies.

pmid-6452197.summary_ja: hCG産生腫瘍の患者で、エストラジオール産生とDHEAS変換を測定した。絨毛癌の男性5例ではエストラジオールが高値であった。hCGβフラグメントの上昇が軽度の場合、エストロゲン産生は鋭敏な腫瘍マーカーとならなかった。hCGが著明に上昇する場合に限り有用とされた。
pmid-6452197.summary_en: This 1981 study measured urinary and plasma estradiol and peripheral conversion of DHEAS to estradiol in patients with hCG-producing neoplasms. Five men with choriocarcinoma had elevated estradiol production, high plasma estradiol, and 0.5 to 11.7% DHEAS conversion. Six patients with ectopic gonadotropin-producing tumors had milder elevations. Most patients with only minimal hCG beta-fragment elevation had no increase in estradiol. The authors conclude estrogen production is a sensitive tumor marker only when hCG is substantially elevated, reflecting extragonadal trophoblastic function.

pmid-6453633.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の病期I患者では、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の補助化学療法が検討された。初期の24例では生存率が70%未満であった。1973年に補助化学療法を導入して以降、この群では再発がみられていない。
pmid-6453633.summary_en: This 1981 clinical report addresses chemotherapy for non-seminomatous testicular tumours at stage I. Patients with disseminated teratoid tumours benefit from chemotherapy, but stage I patients usually receive no further treatment after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy because of drug toxicity, and 10 to 20% later die of widespread disease. In an earlier series of 24 patients, stage I survival was below 70%. After adjuvant chemotherapy was introduced in 1973, the authors observed no relapses in this group.

pmid-6455604.summary_ja: 両側腎腫大、大量蛋白尿、急性腎不全を呈したセミノーマ患者の症例です。セミノーマの腎浸潤以外に腎不全の原因は認められませんでした。放射線療法により腎機能と腎の大きさ・構造が著明に改善しました。転移性セミノーマでは腫瘍治療の効果が得られるまで透析が正当化されると結論づけています。
pmid-6455604.summary_en: A patient with seminoma presented with bilateral enlarged kidneys, massive proteinuria, and acute renal failure. No cause other than infiltration by the seminoma was identified. Renal function, kidney size, and architecture improved markedly after radiotherapy. The authors conclude that dialysis is justified in metastatic seminoma while tumor therapy is given, because the renal failure can be reversed by treating the tumor.

pmid-6783360.summary_ja: 1973～1978年の精巣腫瘍患者を検討し、55%が奇形腫でした。放射線療法によりセミノーマと奇形腫の大半で顕微鏡的病変が消失しました。転移性奇形腫では、ビンブラスチンとブレオマイシンの併用で30例中12例が完全寛解に達しました。腫瘍マーカーは再発予測の価値が限られていました。
pmid-6783360.summary_en: This study reviews 1973–1978 patients with testicular tumors, in whom 55% had teratomas. Radiotherapy sterilized microscopic disease in most seminoma and teratoma patients. Vinblastine plus bleomycin achieved complete remission in 12 of 30 patients with metastatic teratoma, and adding cisplatin roughly doubled the response rate. Alpha-fetoprotein and hCG were elevated in most advanced teratomas but had limited value in predicting relapse. The authors suggest adjuvant chemotherapy be explored in early disease.

pmid-6789857.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍異種移植片の細胞表面抗原に対するマウス単クローン抗体を作製し、放射性ヨウ素標識後の局在を評価しました。正常組織よりも腫瘍への集積が選択的で、他の胚細胞腫瘍異種移植片にも局在しました。非胚細胞腫瘍には局在せず、臨床的意義の評価が必要とされています。
pmid-6789857.summary_en: The authors developed a mouse monoclonal antibody against a cell-surface antigen on a human germ cell tumor xenograft. After radioiodination, it localized preferentially in xenografted tumors compared with normal tissues, and this was blocked by excess unlabeled antibody. Smaller tumors localized better. The antibody also localized to other germ cell tumor xenografts but not to non-germ cell tumors. The authors conclude that clinical value should now be assessed.

pmid-6793227.summary_ja: 1961～1976年にスタンフォード大学で根治的メガボルテージ放射線療法を受けた原発性縦隔セミノーマ13例の解析。10年生存率は69%、無再発生存率は54%。原発巣に4700ラド超を照射された患者では局所・全身再発はなかった。再発パターンと診断評価の推奨を論じ、縦隔と頸部への4500～5000ラドの一次照射を適切な治療として提案している。
pmid-6793227.summary_en: This 1981 Stanford study reviewed 13 patients with primary mediastinal seminoma treated with definitive megavoltage radiotherapy between 1961 and 1976. Ten-year actuarial survival was 69% and relapse-free survival 54%. No patient receiving over 4700 rads to the primary lesion relapsed locally or systemically. Patterns of relapse and diagnostic evaluation recommendations are discussed, and primary mediastinal and neck irradiation at 4500 to 5000 rads is proposed as appropriate treatment.

pmid-6793588.summary_ja: ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍の腹水から分泌されるコンドロイチン硫酸プロテオグリカンを単離し、糖鎖とアミノ酸組成を解析した基礎研究。主にコンドロイチン硫酸から成り、一部デルマタン硫酸を含む。ウサギで作製した抗体は培養腫瘍細胞由来のプロテオグリカンを免疫沈降し、細胞表面への局在が示された。臨床研究ではなく、腫瘍細胞を材料とした生化学的研究である。
pmid-6793588.summary_en: This study isolated a chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan secreted into ascites fluid by a rat yolk sac tumor and characterized its glycosaminoglycan chains and amino acid composition. Chondroitinase digestion indicated mainly chondroitin sulfate with some dermatan sulfate. Rabbit antibodies raised against the proteoglycan immunoprecipitated labeled proteoglycan from cultured tumor cells, and immunofluorescence showed the molecule localized to the cell surface. The work is basic biochemical research using yolk sac tumor cells as its source.

pmid-6794899.summary_ja: 1950～1976年にメガボルテージ照射を受けた純粋精巣セミノーマ171例の生存率と再発形式を解析。5年・10年生存率は93%。5年生存率は病期IIIとIVで45%、病期IとIIで95%と、進行例で有意に低かった。早期では節外再発が多く、進行例では腹部再発が多かった。救済治療、hCG産生セミノーマ、対側精巣の二次セミノーマの管理も論じられている。
pmid-6794899.summary_en: This study analyzed 171 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated with megavoltage irradiation from 1950 to 1976. Survival was 93% at five and ten years, but five-year survival was 45% for Stage III and IV disease versus 95% for Stage I and II. Extranodal relapses were more common in early stages, while abdominal recurrences occurred in advanced disease. The authors also discuss salvage treatment, management of hCG-producing seminomas, and second testicular seminomas, emphasizing aggressive and appropriate radiation technique.

pmid-6795602.summary_ja: MSVを接種してラット胎児性癌5系統を誘発し、腹水胎児性癌細胞に対する抗血清を作製。非特異反応を吸収除去後、ラット胎児性癌と未分化マウス奇形癌細胞に反応したが、分化した腫瘍細胞、他の腫瘍、精子を含む正常組織には反応しなかった。本抗原は着床前胚にも検出され、胚と胎児性癌に共通する表面抗原と考えられた。
pmid-6795602.summary_en: Researchers induced five rat embryonal carcinomas with MSV and raised antisera against ascitic embryonal carcinoma cells. After absorption to remove nonspecific reactivity, the antisera reacted with rat embryonal carcinomas and undifferentiated mouse teratocarcinoma cells, but not with differentiated tumor cells, other tumors, or normal tissues including spermatozoa. The antigen was also detected on preimplantation embryos from the 4-cell stage to the late blastocyst, suggesting a shared embryonic surface marker.

pmid-6796949.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分類（セミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形癌、奇形腫、絨毛癌）と、病期分類が治療選択と予後に重要であることを概説。純粋セミノーマでは根治的精巣摘除術後の後腹膜・同側骨盤リンパ節へのメガボルテージ照射が基本で、生存率は病期Iでほぼ100%、病期IIIで約20%。非セミノーマ性腫瘍では後腹膜リンパ節郭清と放射線療法または化学療法を組み合わせた局所療法を述べる。
pmid-6796949.summary_en: This review classifies testicular germ cell tumors, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma, teratoma, and choriocarcinoma, and emphasizes that staging guides treatment selection and prognosis. For pure seminoma, megavoltage irradiation to retroperitoneal and ipsilateral pelvic nodes after radical orchiectomy is the basis of therapy, with survival ranging from nearly 100% in Stage I to about 20% in Stage III. For nonseminomatous tumors, regional therapy combining retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy with radiation or chemotherapy is described.

pmid-6920297.summary_ja: 悪性奇形腫に対する化学療法後にSIADHを発症した14歳女児の症例報告。原因としてビンクリスチンが最も疑われる。SIADH時に尿中カリクレイン活性は高く、低Na血症の改善とともに低下し、ナトリウム排泄量と相関した。カリクレイン・キニン系がSIADHでみられる過剰なナトリウム利尿に関与する可能性が提唱されている。胚細胞腫瘍治療に伴う薬剤関連合併症の報告である。
pmid-6920297.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl developed SIADH after chemotherapy for malignant teratoma, most likely caused by vincristine. Urinary kallikrein activity was elevated during SIADH and fell as hyponatremia improved, and sodium clearance correlated with kallikrein excretion. The authors propose that the kallikrein-kinin system may contribute to the excessive natriuresis seen in SIADH. This case report describes a drug-related complication of germ cell tumor treatment.

pmid-6937063.summary_ja: 32歳女性の喀痰と、肺および鎖骨上リンパ節の転移性栄養膜腫瘍を報告した症例報告である。原発巣は退縮した卵巣奇形腫と考えられた。喀痰細胞診では細長い線維状の悪性細胞がみられ、扁平上皮癌との誤診に注意を促している。絨毛癌は化学療法によく反応するため、正しい診断が重要である。
pmid-6937063.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with hemoptysis and metastatic trophoblastic tumor in the lungs and a supraclavicular lymph node, most likely originating from a regressed primary ovarian teratoma. Sputum cytology revealed malignant cells with elongated, fiberlike shapes and orange-staining cytoplasm. The authors detail these cytologic features of choriocarcinoma and compare them with prior literature. They emphasize the risk of misdiagnosing the cells as squamous carcinoma, as correct recognition matters because choriocarcinoma responds well to chemotherapy.

pmid-6950573.summary_ja: ヒト奇形腫由来の6細胞株について、プロゲステロンの合成、分泌、代謝を検討した研究である。プロゲステロンを分泌したのは2株のみで、全株が極性の代謝物へと代謝した。この代謝は成人の上皮細胞や線維芽細胞の培養でも認められた。SuSa株で3β-ヒドロキシステロイド脱水素酵素活性が最も高かった。
pmid-6950573.summary_en: This study examined progesterone synthesis, secretion, and metabolism in six human teratoma-derived cell lines, to test for trophoblast-related steroidogenic function. Only SuSa and HX-39 produced measurable progesterone, while all lines metabolized progesterone to a polar metabolite identified as 3β,6α-dihydroxy-5α-pregnan-20-one. This metabolism also occurred in adult epithelial and fibroblast cultures. Dehydrogenase-isomerase activity was highest in SuSa and lower in the other lines.

pmid-6963958.summary_ja: 妊娠中のパタスザルにエチルニトロソウレア(ENU)を投与すると、ヒトの妊娠性絨毛癌に類似した致死的腫瘍が発生した。腫瘍は肺や腹部臓器に多発し、原発性の子宮病変は通常認められなかった。組織学的に細胞栄養膜細胞様の細胞からなり、絨毛性ゴナドトロピン測定は診断に寄与しなかった。栄養膜のENU感受性を示し、妊娠性絨毛癌の動物モデルとなることが示された。
pmid-6963958.summary_en: This 1981 study describes a fatal choriocarcinoma-like tumor induced in patas monkeys by ethylnitrosourea given during pregnancy. Tumors were highly hemorrhagic, mainly found in the lungs and abdominal viscera, with no obvious primary uterine lesion; histology showed cytotrophoblast-like cells. Chorionic gonadotrophin assays did not contribute to diagnosis.
