pmid-7331855.summary_en: Five patients with ovarian dermoid cysts, which are benign cystic teratomas, were evaluated using computed tomography. The authors compared the CT appearance of these tumors with their findings on conventional radiography. They conclude that CT provides valuable additional information for preoperative evaluation of cystic teratomas. The study supports CT as an adjunct to imaging for ovarian lesions before surgery.

pmid-7332899.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者48例と対照30例で、第1、9、16番およびY染色体の構成的ヘテロクロマチン(C-banding)を比較した。第9番染色体のヘテロクロマチック指数は患者で統計学的に有意な異型性を示した。異型性はセミノーマから悪性度の高い奇形腫へ増加した。第9番染色体の変化が腫瘍の悪性度と関連する可能性が示唆される。
pmid-7332899.summary_en: This study examined constitutive heterochromatin (C-banding) of chromosomes 1, 9, 16, and Y in 48 patients with germ cell tumors and 30 controls. The heterochromatic index of chromosome 9 showed significant heteromorphism in patients. Heteromorphism increased from seminoma to the more malignant teratoma. The findings suggest chromosome 9 heterochromatic changes may be linked to tumor malignancy grade.

pmid-7336166.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫に赤血球増多症を伴う症例を報告する。腫瘍摘出後に赤血球量は徐々に減少し、血液学的異常は寛解した。腫瘍液には有意な造血刺激活性が含まれていた。卵巣嚢腫に伴う赤血球増多症の初めての報告例とされ、まれな合併症として注目される症例である。
pmid-7336166.summary_en: A patient with an ovarian dermoid cyst and erythrocytosis is described. After surgical removal of the tumor, red cell mass progressively decreased and the hematologic abnormalities remitted. The tumor fluid contained significant erythropoietic stimulating activity. The authors note this appears to be the first documented case of erythrocytosis associated with an ovarian cyst.

pmid-7336484.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫245例中、未熟奇形腫は6例(2.4%)であった。全例がFIGO IA(i)期で、保存的手術のみで治療され、2.2～10.6年の無病生存が得られている。著者らは、IA(i)期グレード1の未熟奇形腫、および最大径9cm以下のグレード2の腫瘍に対して保存的手術が治療の第一選択であると結論づけている。
pmid-7336484.summary_en: A series of 245 ovarian teratomas included six immature teratomas, all FIGO stage IA(i). All patients were treated with conservative surgery alone and remain alive without disease after 2.2 to 10.6 years. The authors conclude that conservative surgery is the treatment of choice for stage IA(i) grade 1 immature teratoma, and also for grade 2 tumors 9 cm or less in diameter.

pmid-7338227.summary_ja: 後腹膜に大きな腫瘤を形成した進行性の性腺外セミノーマ5例の報告です。手術による切除に加え、術後の放射線療法と化学療法を併用することで、多くの症例が数年間無再発を維持しました。治療の時期を適切に選ぶことが重要であると結論づけています。
pmid-7338227.summary_en: This report describes five patients with advanced extragonadal type-I seminomas featuring large retroperitoneal masses with lymph node or lung metastases and invasion of adjacent organs and vessels. Large masses were resected in some cases, and combined postoperative radiotherapy and chemotherapy achieved long-term tumor-free survival in three patients and full remission in two others. The authors emphasize that correct timing of multimodal therapy is of prime importance.

pmid-7348004.summary_ja: 先天性ヒト奇形腫の中に、発生中の大脳新皮質に似た層構造を持つ神経外胚葉成分が見られた症例の報告です。放射状グリア線維や内側から外側へ分化する神経細胞配列が確認されました。皮質下からの求心性線維がなくても皮質形成が起こる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-7348004.summary_en: This report describes a congenital human teratoma containing a neuroectodermal component that organized into a structure resembling developing neocortex, with germinal, intermediate, and cortical zones. Radial glial fibers and radially oriented neurons showing inside-out differentiation were observed, and an outer mesothelial layer covered the cortex. The authors suggest the cortical plate formed without afferent subcortical input, and that the integrity of the outer glial-mesenchymal barrier may be needed for normal cortical arrangement.

pmid-7349816.summary_ja: 絨毛組織の酵素組織化学的研究で、正常絨毛、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、妊娠性絨毛癌の酵素活性を比較しています。侵入奇胎は胞状奇胎に近い分布を示しました。妊娠性絨毛癌では分布が多様で、細胞性栄養膜細胞ではLDH活性が強いことが示されました。他の絨毛病変とは酵素学的に異なると結論されています。
pmid-7349816.summary_en: This 1981 enzyme histochemistry study compares alkaline phosphatase, acid phosphatase, heat-stable alkaline phosphatase, and LDH in normal chorionic villi, hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and gestational choriocarcinoma. Patterns in invasive mole closely resembled those in hydatidiform mole, while choriocarcinoma showed heterogeneous localization, with stronger LDH activity in cytotrophoblasts. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma differs enzymatically from other villous lesions.

pmid-7454183.summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)51例の超音波所見を検討した1981年の研究です。典型的な所見は約3分の1にとどまり、充実性や嚢胞性など多彩な像を示しました。超音波検査は正診に大きく寄与し、放射線被曝がないため初期画像検査として推奨されています。
pmid-7454183.summary_en: This 1981 study reviews ultrasound images from 45 patients with 51 surgically proven benign cystic teratomas, or dermoid cysts, of the ovary. Contrary to the classic description of an echogenic focus with acoustic shadowing, the findings were varied: one-third were typical, while others were predominantly solid, almost entirely cystic, or not visible. Ultrasonography contributed substantially to correct diagnosis and, lacking ionizing radiation, is suggested as the initial imaging modality for suspected ovarian dermoid cysts.

pmid-7459822.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群を有する16歳男性に生じた原発性縦隔胎児性癌の症例報告です。胚細胞腫瘍、特に性腺外発生例とクラインフェルター症候群の関連は稀ですが、近年認識されてきたと述べられています。縦隔の胚細胞悪性腫瘍を診る若年患者では染色体検査を考慮すべきと示唆しています。
pmid-7459822.summary_en: This case report describes a primary mediastinal embryonal carcinoma in a 16-year-old boy with Klinefelter's syndrome. The authors highlight the rare and recently recognized association between germ cell tumors, particularly extragonadal ones, and Klinefelter's syndrome. The report adds to evidence that extragonadal germ cell tumors may arise in patients with this chromosomal disorder. Its importance lies in alerting clinicians to consider chromosomal evaluation in young patients with mediastinal germ cell malignancy.

pmid-7464404.summary_ja: 頭頸部に同時発生した非表皮性腫瘍の2症例の報告です。1例は慢性リンパ性白血病と、後腹膜原発の性腺外セミノーマからの転移性セミノーマの併存で、頭頸部病変の所見が検討されています。もう1例はリンパ腫と頸動脈小体腫瘍の併存です。併存する悪性腫瘍に関する文献的考察も行われています。
pmid-7464404.summary_en: This report describes two patients with simultaneous non-epidermoid neoplasms of the head and neck. One case combined chronic lymphocytic leukemia with metastatic primary retroperitoneal extragonadal seminoma, and the head and neck manifestations of the metastatic seminoma are discussed. The other combined lymphocytic lymphoma with a carotid body tumor. The authors review the literature on these associations and the complications arising when reticuloendothelial malignancies coexist with head and neck neoplasms.

pmid-7465151.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫が術前に隣接臓器を自然破裂・穿孔させる合併症は稀である。1952〜1979年にジョンズ・ホプキンス病院で経験された4例を基に、その発生頻度、病因、病理を検討した1981年の報告。稀ではあるが、手術計画において留意すべき臨床的に重要な合併症であることを示している。
pmid-7465151.summary_en: This 1981 report describes spontaneous preoperative rupture or perforation of an adjacent organ by a benign cystic teratoma, an uncommon complication. Four documented cases seen at The Johns Hopkins Hospital between 1952 and 1979 form the basis of the discussion. The authors examine the incidence, etiology, and pathology of this complication and highlight that, although rare, it is clinically important for surgical planning.

pmid-7468547.summary_ja: 生後8か月の女児に生じた前縦隔奇形腫の症例報告（1981年）。腫瘍内の胃粘膜が潰瘍化して肺実質へ進展し、それに続発する生命を脅かす喀血を呈した。乳児の縦隔奇形腫の稀な臨床像を示し、肺出血が緊急対応を要する合併症となりうることを強調している。
pmid-7468547.summary_en: This 1981 case report describes an 8-month-old girl with an anterior mediastinal teratoma who presented with life-threatening hemoptysis. The bleeding resulted from ulceration of the tumor's gastric mucosa extending into the lung parenchyma. The report highlights an unusual presentation of mediastinal teratoma in infancy and shows that pulmonary hemorrhage can be a life-threatening complication requiring urgent attention.

pmid-7468743.summary_ja: 右精巣セミノーマに対する根治的精巣摘除術と放射線照射の4か月後に、疼痛性眼球突出、眼筋麻痺、視力低下を生じた28歳男性の症例。眼窩生検で精巣由来の転移性セミノーマと確定した。コバルトによる眼窩照射で症状は改善した。精巣由来の眼窩転移の初報告であり、早期の照射が眼合併症を減らしうると述べている。
pmid-7468743.summary_en: This 1981 case report describes a 28-year-old man who developed painful exophthalmos, ophthalmoplegia, and visual loss four months after radical orchiectomy and irradiation for right testicular seminoma. An orbital biopsy confirmed metastatic seminoma. Orbital cobalt irradiation improved the exophthalmos, ophthalmoplegia, and vision. The authors report the first case of orbital seminoma metastatic from the testis and suggest that timely irradiation can reduce ocular morbidity.

pmid-6170985.summary_ja: 未分化な胚細胞腫瘍のモデルであるマウスF9奇形癌幹細胞で、MHCクラスI関連遺伝子H-2とβ2-ミクログロブリンの発現を検討した。mRNAは分化細胞の10分の1以下だった。遺伝子の転写抑制が示唆され、サイレント遺伝子はDNase I感受性が高かった。未分化腫瘍細胞の免疫回避に関連するが、対象はマウスモデルである。
pmid-6170985.summary_en: F9 murine teratocarcinoma stem cells, a model of embryonal carcinoma, were examined for expression of H-2 and beta-2-microglobulin, which mediate MHC class I antigen presentation. Blot hybridization showed these mRNAs were at most one-tenth of levels in differentiated daughter cells. The authors propose transcriptional silencing of the genes, accompanied by increased DNase I sensitivity of the silent genes. The findings relate to immune evasion by undifferentiated teratocarcinoma cells but concern a murine model.

pmid-6261425.summary_ja: 1981年のSteroids誌の論文で、絨毛癌由来のヒト栄養膜細胞株JArにおけるアロマターゼ活性の誘導を解析した。ジブチリルcAMPとテオフィリンにより活性は96時間にわたり直線的に上昇し、シクロヘキシミドやアクチノマイシンDで抑制されることから、高分子合成への依存が示された。臨床の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を扱った研究ではなく、細胞モデルとしての利用である。
pmid-6261425.summary_en: This 1981 Steroids study examines estrogen secretion and aromatase activity in the JAr human trophoblast (choriocarcinoma-derived) cell line following treatment with dibutyryl cyclic AMP plus theophylline. Aromatase specific activity rises linearly over 96 hours, and cycloheximide or actinomycin D abolishes the stimulation, indicating dependence on macromolecular synthesis. Mixing experiments argue against a limiting stimulatory factor, and NADPH has no effect. The work uses the choriocarcinoma line as a model; clinical gestational trophoblastic disease is not studied.

pmid-6266815.summary_ja: SV40形質転換ヒト胎盤細胞と絨毛癌細胞で、糖質コルチコイドがhCGおよびhCGαの合成に与える影響を検討した。妊娠初期の形質転換胎盤細胞ではhCG合成が強く抑制され、hCGα合成は誘導された。絨毛癌細胞や妊娠末期の胎盤細胞では変化がなかった。エストラジオールとプロゲステロンは無影響であり、妊娠初期のhCG調節における糖質コルチコイドの特異的役割が示唆された。
pmid-6266815.summary_en: This study examined how glucocorticoids regulate hCG and hCG alpha synthesis in SV40 tsA-transformed human placental cells and in choriocarcinoma cells. In transformed first-trimester placental cells, glucocorticoids strongly inhibited hCG synthesis while inducing hCG alpha, whereas choriocarcinoma cells and term placental cells were unaffected. Estradiol and progesterone had no effect, suggesting a specific glucocorticoid role in hCG regulation during early pregnancy.

pmid-6271898.summary_ja: 未分化多能性の胎児性癌細胞株PCC4はレトロウイルス感染に抵抗性を示し、分化した筋芽細胞由来株PCD1は許容的であった。PCC4では48時間後もウイルスRNAの発現や組み込み型プロウイルスは認められず、遊離プロウイルスDNAは両株で合成された。制限は、プロウイルスDNA合成と染色体への組み込みの間で起きると考えられた。
pmid-6271898.summary_en: Retrovirus infection of mouse teratocarcinoma-derived cells was compared between an undifferentiated pluripotent embryonal carcinoma line (PCC4), which resisted infection, and a differentiated myoblast-derived line (PCD1), which was fully permissive. PCC4 cells showed no viral RNA expression at 48 h and no integrated proviral DNA, although free proviral DNA forms were synthesized in both lines. The restriction therefore appears to occur between proviral DNA synthesis and genomic integration, linking viral replication to cellular differentiation state.

pmid-6275841.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞を用い、BrdUおよびdbcAMPが胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼを誘導するかを検討した。誘導は酵素活性の変化ではなく、酵素タンパク質の蓄積によることが示された。研究の主題は酵素の生物学であり、臨床的な疾患の研究ではない。
pmid-6275841.summary_en: This 1981 biochemistry study used BeWo human choriocarcinoma cells to test whether bromodeoxyuridine and dibutyryl cyclic AMP induce placental alkaline phosphatase. Using immunoprecipitation and gel electrophoresis of metabolically or surface-labelled cells, both agents increased accumulation of a protein that is immunochemically identical to placental alkaline phosphatase and co-migrates with it in two-dimensional gels. The authors concluded that induction reflects accumulation of enzyme protein rather than altered catalytic activity. The work concerns enzyme biology rather than clinical disease.

pmid-6940125.summary_ja: 変異原処理により、レチノイン酸に分化応答しないマウス胎児性癌細胞株を2株樹立した研究である。腫瘍原性は保持していたが、腫瘍内および凝集体での分化は乏しかった。レチノイン酸の取り込みは正常で、細胞質内結合タンパク質の活性がほぼ消失していた。分化には結合タンパク質複合体の形成が必要であることが示唆される。
pmid-6940125.summary_en: This study isolated two mutant mouse embryonal carcinoma lines from PCC4.aza1R cells, treated with a mutagen, which failed to differentiate in response to retinoic acid. The mutants retained tumorigenic potential but differentiated poorly in tumor form and in aggregates. Retinoic acid uptake was unchanged, but cytoplasmic retinoic acid-binding protein activity was virtually absent. The findings support that retinoic acid-induced differentiation requires formation of retinoic acid-binding protein complexes.

pmid-6947232.summary_ja: 核型が正常な倍数体マウス奇形癌細胞株METT-1の発生能を検討した研究である。胚盤胞へのマイクロインジェクションにより、約13%の個体がキメラとなり、内部組織にも広く寄与した。細胞由来の機能的な卵母細胞が生じ、次世代へマーカー遺伝子が伝達された。培養操作と生殖系列発生をつなぐ手段として有用であることが示された。
pmid-6947232.summary_en: The authors tested METT-1, a karyotypically normal euploid mouse teratocarcinoma line, for developmental potential after microinjection into C57BL/6 blastocysts. About 13% of mice were chimeric, with substantial contribution to internal tissues. The cells gave rise to functional oocytes, and chimeras transmitted the marker genes to second-generation mice. The findings indicate that teratocarcinoma stem cells can bridge in vitro manipulation and germline development, enabling production of mice with predetermined genetic changes.

pmid-7025272.summary_ja: 1981年の体細胞遺伝学の研究で、胎児性癌細胞株PCC4と成体マウス胸腺細胞とのハイブリッドを作製した。ハイブリッドは胎児性癌様の表現型を示し、胚性抗原t12を発現したが、H-2抗原は検出されなかった。発生初期と雄の生殖細胞でのみ発現する遺伝子が再活性化されたと解釈された。胎児性癌細胞は実験ツールとして用いられており、腫瘍そのものが主題ではない。
pmid-7025272.summary_en: A 1981 somatic cell genetics study fused PCC4 embryonal carcinoma cells with adult mouse thymocytes. The hybrids showed an embryonal carcinoma phenotype, expressed the embryonic T/t-complex antigen t12, and lacked detectable H-2 antigens. The authors interpret this as reprogramming of the thymocyte genome, reactivating a gene normally expressed only early in development and in male germ cells. Embryonal carcinoma cells serve as a tool, so the paper is basic genetics rather than tumor-focused.

pmid-7237557.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来細胞株の形質膜における脂質の側方拡散を蛍光プローブで測定した研究である。胎児性癌細胞は内胚葉細胞株より拡散が速く、膜コレステロールは少なかった。レチノイン酸による分化誘導で拡散とコレステロール量は内胚葉型へ変化した。臨床腫瘍ではなく細胞モデルを用いた基礎膜生物学の研究である。
pmid-7237557.summary_en: This study measured lateral diffusion of a fluorescent lipid probe in plasma membranes of teratocarcinoma-derived cell lines. Embryonal carcinoma cells showed faster diffusion and lower membrane cholesterol than endodermal lines. Retinoic acid-induced differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells reduced diffusion toward endodermal levels and increased membrane cholesterol. The work is basic membrane biology using cell models rather than clinical tumor material.

pmid-7240123.summary_ja: レクチンDolichos biflorus agglutinin(DBA)が胎児性癌細胞と奇形癌の内胚葉細胞に結合し、宿主細胞には結合しないことを示した。F9およびOTT6050細胞からDBA受容体を単離し、高分子量の糖タンパク質であることを明らかにした。臨床腫瘍ではなく細胞株を用いた糖鎖生物学の研究である。
pmid-7240123.summary_en: This study shows that the lectin Dolichos biflorus agglutinin binds embryonal carcinoma cells and teratocarcinoma endodermal cells but not host cells. The authors isolated and characterized DBA-binding glycoprotein receptors from F9 and OTT6050 cells, finding high-molecular-weight glycoproteins with substantial carbohydrate content. Pronase digestion yielded large glycopeptides. The work is a glycobiology study using cell lines and is not focused on clinical tumor behavior.

pmid-7263644.summary_ja: 1981年の生化学研究で、奇形癌および胚盤胞由来のマウス胚外内胚葉細胞に発現する細胞骨格タンパク質endo Bを同定した。endo Bは胚性癌幹細胞には乏しいが、レチノイン酸で分化誘導すると増加した。チューブリンやビメンチンなどとは異なると結論づけている。臨床疾患ではなく、胚性癌を分化モデルとして用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-7263644.summary_en: This 1981 biochemical study identifies endo B, a cytoskeletal protein of Mr 50,000, expressed in murine extra-embryonic endodermal cells derived from teratocarcinomas and blastocysts. Endo B was scarce in embryonal carcinoma stem cells but increased when those cells were induced to differentiate with retinoic acid. The authors conclude it is distinct from tubulin, vimentin, desmin, and keratin. Embryonal carcinoma serves as a model of malignant stem cells differentiating to benign endoderm rather than as a clinical disease focus.

pmid-7264551.summary_ja: 1981年の発生生物学研究で、奇形癌細胞株PCC3/A/1の培養系に多能性造血細胞が存在することを示した。これらは刺激後に赤血球、マクロファージ、巨核球を含むコロニーを形成した。胚性造血のモデルとしての奇形癌の有用性を示唆している。臨床的な生殖細胞腫瘍の治療ではなく、造血分化の基礎研究である。
pmid-7264551.summary_en: This 1981 developmental biology study shows that the teratocarcinoma line PCC3/A/1, which differentiates in vitro into primitive erythrocytes, also contains multipotential hemopoietic cells in the same cultures. When stimulated with conditioned medium, these cells formed colonies containing erythrocytes, macrophages, and megakaryocytes. The findings support teratocarcinoma cultures as a model of embryonic hematopoiesis. The work addresses hematopoietic differentiation biology rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-7280932.summary_ja: 1981年の報告。マウス奇形癌（teratocarcinoma）由来のin vitro細胞株METT-1を樹立したと報告している。核型は正常で、凍結融解や長期培養後も倍数性を維持し、胚盤胞へ注入すると体細胞と生殖細胞の両方へ分化する能力（発生全能性）を示した。遺伝子変異の選択や遺伝子導入実験に有用で、所望の遺伝的変化をもつマウス作出への応用が示唆される。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の臨床に直接関わる研究ではない。
pmid-7280932.summary_en: This 1981 report describes METT-1, a karyotypically normal, female-derived in vitro line established from a mouse teratocarcinoma that was induced by ectopic transplantation of an embryo. The line retains euploidy over many passages, including after freezing and thawing, and is developmentally totipotent, contributing to somatic and germline tissues when injected into blastocysts. The authors propose it as a tool for selecting mutant genes and for gene-transfer experiments to generate mice with predetermined genetic changes. The work is basic developmental genetics in mice and has no clinical focus on human germ cell tumors.

pmid-7327851.summary_ja: 小児の口腔底に生じた巨大(5～8cm)類皮嚢腫の4例を報告する。いずれも気道を脅かすサイズであった。各症例で下顎オトガイ結節に付着する明確な茎が認められ、手術時に切断すると遺残を生じうる。発生起源は不確かであり、臨床像と病因について考察している。胚細胞腫瘍そのものの報告ではなく、先天性嚢胞の症例報告として位置づけられる。
pmid-7327851.summary_en: This report describes four children with massive (5 to 8 cm) dermoid cysts of the floor of the mouth that threatened the airway. Each cyst had a distinct stalk attaching at the genial tubercle of the mandible, a feature that may leave a remnant if transected during surgery. The embryologic origin is uncertain, and the authors discuss the clinical presentation and possible pathogenesis of these lesions.

pmid-7459855.summary_ja: 1981年の研究で、テラトカルシノーマ由来のマウス胎児性癌細胞株によるベンゾ(a)ピレンの代謝を検討しています。細胞株間で代謝活性化が100倍以上異なりました。細胞毒性は代謝活性化の程度と相関しました。研究の主眼は発癌物質の代謝であり、胚細胞腫瘍の臨床や生物学そのものではありません。
pmid-7459855.summary_en: This 1981 study examines how murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines, derived from teratocarcinomas, metabolize benzo(a)pyrene. Metabolic activation varied more than 100-fold among lines, and most intracellular radioactivity localized to nuclei. Some lines were sensitive to the carcinogen while others were resistant, with cytotoxicity correlating with metabolic activation. The work focuses on chemical carcinogen metabolism rather than germ cell tumor biology or clinical management.

pmid-14582174.summary_ja: 1980年の研究。マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9の移植において、MHC近傍外にある半優性H-2連鎖遺伝子が腫瘍形成に影響するかを、H-2同質遺伝子対マウスで検討。C57BL/6対では、この遺伝子座は第17染色体上でH-2領域の外側に位置すると報告。
pmid-14582174.summary_en: This 1980 study examines how a semidominant H-2-linked locus outside the immediate MHC affects tumor formation by the murine embryonal carcinoma line F9 in H-2 congenic mice. Congenic substitutions on C57BL/6 and AKR backgrounds decreased allograft resistance to F9, and F1 hybrids showed intermediate resistance, consistent with single-locus control. Using F2 analyses, the authors localized the locus in the C57BL/6 pair to chromosome 17, outside the H-2, Qua2/3, and PGK-2 region.

pmid-18788150.summary_ja: 1980年の総説。胚細胞と性索間質成分が混在する性腺腫瘍として、性腺芽腫と混合性胚細胞-性索間質腫瘍の2型を比較。組織像、遺伝学、内分泌学的特徴を整理し、発生年齢や性別の違いを示す。
pmid-18788150.summary_en: This 1980 review covers gonadal neoplasms that combine germ cells and sex cord stromal derivatives, describing two entities: gonadoblastoma and mixed germ cell-sex cord stroma tumour. It compares their pathology, clinical presentation, genetics, and endocrine features. Gonadoblastoma is common in virilized phenotypic females and often bilateral, while mixed tumours mainly occur in female infants and children.

pmid-22457930.summary_ja: 1980年の研究。129/Jマウスと異系統のF1雑種を用い、マウス胎児性癌株PCC3とF9に対する抵抗性を検討。雑種はいずれも親系統より強い抵抗性を示し、その機序は免疫学的と考えられた。胚細胞腫瘍モデルの免疫研究。
pmid-22457930.summary_en: This 1980 study examines immune resistance to two murine embryonal carcinoma lines, PCC3 and F9, in F1 hybrids between syngeneic 129/J mice and allogeneic strains. Most hybrids resisted PCC3 more strongly than the 129/J parent, and all resisted F9 more strongly. Resistance did not require a hybrid H-2 complex, suggesting an immunological mechanism. The work uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a tumour model.

pmid-29603156.summary_ja: 1980年の進捗報告。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理を、WHO分類とその他の分類法の対応を中心に総説。胎児性癌の分化、合胞体栄養膜細胞を含むセミノーマの予後、hCGとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の組織学的発現を整理。
pmid-29603156.summary_en: This 1980 progress report reviews pathology of testicular germ cell tumors after the National Conference on Urological Tumors. It discusses the WHO classification and its conversion to other systems. It also notes that embryonal carcinoma can differentiate into yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, or teratoma, and that seminomas with syncytiotrophoblasts have less favorable prognoses. HCG and AFP expression patterns are correlated with histology.

pmid-29603160.summary_ja: 1980年の総説。精巣セミノーマの臨床病期別治療成績を検討し、病期I・IIの3年生存率は91%と報告。病期分類法の不統一から新しい病期分類を提案。病期IIIの3年生存率は28%にとどまり、有効な化学療法の確立が課題。
pmid-29603160.summary_en: This 1980 review assesses modern treatment of testicular seminoma across clinical stages, reporting a 91% three-year survival for 1,346 stage 1 and 2 patients. It proposes a clinically useful staging system because prior staging methods varied. It discusses radiotherapy and chemotherapy, the limited role of cytoreductive surgery, and the poor 28% three-year survival in stage 3 disease.

pmid-29603170.summary_ja: 1980年の総説。小児の精巣がんは成人と組織型や化学療法への耐容性が異なる。乳児期の卵黄嚢腫瘍は精巣摘除術のみで治癒することが多い。年長児の胎児性癌は、精巣摘除、リンパ節郭清、病期に応じた化学療法を要する。
pmid-29603170.summary_en: This 1980 review describes testicular cancer in children, which differs from adult disease in histology and chemotherapy tolerance. Embryonal adrenocarcinoma (endodermal sinus tumor) in infants is often cured by orchiectomy alone. Embryonal carcinoma in older children requires orchiectomy, node dissection, and stage-based chemotherapy. Paratesticular rhabdomyosarcoma needs retroperitoneal node dissection, with chemotherapy and radiation therapy.

pmid-29603174.summary_ja: 386例の精巣胚細胞がん患者において、血清AFPおよびhCGを放射免疫測定法で前向きに測定した研究である。活動性の非セミノーマ性腫瘍患者の約90%でマーカーが上昇していた。これらのマーカーは病期分類の誤りを減らし、治療のモニタリングや予後判定に役立った。セミノーマでは血清AFPは通常上昇しなかった。
pmid-29603174.summary_en: This 1980 study prospectively measured serum AFP and hCG in 386 patients with testicular germ cell cancer using radioimmunoassays. About 90% of patients with active nonseminomatous tumors had elevated markers. Markers reduced clinical staging errors to 5-14% and guided monitoring and prognosis. Seminomas rarely produce AFP, limiting marker use in scrotal masses. Urinary hCG measurement was also explored.

pmid-6103979.summary_ja: 悪性精巣腫瘍230例のうち12例に停留精巣の既往があった。停留精巣の悪性化リスクは正常集団の17倍であり、鼠径ヘルニアではリスク上昇は認められなかった。思春期後の停留精巣摘除を勧めている。セミノーマでは鼠径リンパ節への照射、非セミノーマ性腫瘍では半陰嚢切除と鼠径リンパ節郭清が必要とされる。
pmid-6103979.summary_en: Of 230 patients with malignant testicular tumours, 12 had a history of undescended testis and 8 had inguinal hernia. The risk of malignant degeneration in an undescended testis was 17 times that of the normal population, while inguinal hernia showed no increased risk. The authors advise removing undescended testes after puberty. For seminoma, irradiation of inguinal nodes is needed, while non-seminomatous tumours require hemiscrotectomy and inguinal lymph node dissection.

pmid-6105754.summary_ja: 停留精巣を伴った精巣腫瘍7例の検討で、うち2例は停留を疑われていなかった。全例に精巣摘除術を施行した。セミノーマには放射線療法、中間型悪性奇形腫には可能な限り後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、未分化型悪性奇形腫（病期IV）はシスプラチンによる化学療法で良好な結果が得られた。停留精巣は探索し、疑わしい場合は切除すべきと提言している。
pmid-6105754.summary_en: Seven patients with testicular tumors were reviewed, two of whom had previously unsuspected cryptorchidism. All underwent orchiectomy. Seminomas received radiation therapy, intermediate malignant teratomas underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection when possible, and an undifferentiated malignant teratoma (stage IV) responded well to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. A lymphoblastic sarcoma was treated with methotrexate and vincristine. The authors advise exploring and excising undescended testes.

pmid-6107141.summary_ja: 1952〜1976年に当院で治療した精巣腫瘍760例のうち21例が対側精巣に腫瘍を発症した。そのうち2例は同時性、19例は異時性であった。停留精巣の既往は約半数にみられ、両腫瘍の組織型は一致していた。病期I（第2腫瘍）の多くは治癒したが、精巣外進展例の予後は不良で化学療法が推奨されるとしている。
pmid-6107141.summary_en: Among 760 men with testicular tumours at the Royal Marsden Hospital (1952–1976), 21 developed a contralateral tumour, two synchronously and 19 metachronously. Nearly half had a history of maldescent, and both tumours shared the same histology in all such cases. Most second tumours were seminomas. Stage I patients with second tumours were largely cured, whereas those with extratesticular spread fared poorly, so chemotherapy was recommended for them.

pmid-6107388.summary_ja: 1934〜1975年に治療した停留精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍の125例を解析した研究である。83例は停留の矯正を受け、42例は未矯正のまま腫瘍を発症した。5年生存率は矯正の有無で差がなく、純粋セミノーマで78%と良好であった。大半の生存者には放射線療法または化学療法が行われた。
pmid-6107388.summary_en: This study analyzed 125 patients with cryptorchidism and testicular germinal tumors treated from 1934 to 1975. Cryptorchidism was corrected in 83 patients, while 42 uncorrected patients presented with tumors. Histology included pure seminoma (54), embryonal carcinoma (35), teratocarcinoma (33), and pure choriocarcinoma (3). Five-year survival was similar for corrected and uncorrected cases, with better outcomes for pure seminoma. Most survivors received irradiation or chemotherapy.

pmid-6108001.summary_ja: 原発性精巣奇形腫53例について、ホルムアルデヒド誘発蛍光法と免疫組織化学法で腸内分泌細胞を検討した。11例に消化管上皮様の内分泌細胞が認められ、腸クロム親和性細胞が最も多かった。内分泌細胞は未分化な幹細胞に由来し、原発性精巣カルチノイドは既存の奇形腫から発生し得ると示唆している。
pmid-6108001.summary_en: The authors examined 53 primary testicular teratomas for enteroendocrine cells using formaldehyde-induced fluorescence and immunohistochemistry. Eleven tumors contained endocrine cells resembling gastrointestinal epithelium, most often enterochromaffin cells, followed by somatostatin-, glucagon-, and pancreatic polypeptide-immunoreactive cells. The findings suggest that these cells derive from undifferentiated intestinal stem cells and that primary testicular carcinoids may develop from pre-existing teratomas.

pmid-6108374.summary_ja: 8歳の男児が、左精巣の精巣固定術の2年後にセミノーマを発症した症例を報告している。小児のセミノーマは稀であり、文献上最年少の症例とされる。停留精巣の治療歴と小児の胚細胞腫瘍との関連に注意を促している。
pmid-6108374.summary_en: The authors report an 8-year-old boy who developed a seminoma two years after orchiopexy of the left testis. Seminoma is rare in childhood, and this patient is believed to be the youngest reported case in the literature. The report highlights an association between prior undescended testis surgery and germ cell tumor in a young child, and it suggests that such children warrant long-term surveillance of the operated testis.

pmid-6109663.summary_ja: 20年間に当院で治療した妊娠性絨毛性疾患850例のうち600例以上を検討し、外科手術の役割を評価した。大きな腫瘍塊の切除は、その後の化学療法の効果を高めた。膣結節の切除は出血がない限り通常不要であった。絨毛癌の治療では、ホルモンモニタリングを伴う化学療法が最も重要である。
pmid-6109663.summary_en: The authors reviewed over 600 of 850 gestational trophoblastic disease cases treated over 20 years to evaluate surgery's role. Procedures included hysterectomy, thoracotomy, vaginal nodule excision, and neurosurgical removal of cerebral metastases. Removing a large tumor mass improved response to later chemotherapy, while vaginal nodule excision was usually unnecessary unless bleeding occurred. Hormonal monitoring with chemotherapy remains the most important treatment for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6153725.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とhCGの役割を総説した。進行例では94%で上昇したが、後腹膜転移例の38%では偽陰性であり、早期例での使用は限定的である。丁寧な後腹膜リンパ節郭清が補助化学療法の決定を左右し、無腫瘍生存率は病期Aで100%、病期Bで91%、病期Cで61%であった。
pmid-6153725.summary_en: This review assesses alpha-fetoprotein and hCG as markers in non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Markers were elevated in 94% of advanced cases but were falsely negative in 38% of patients with retroperitoneal metastases, limiting their use in early-stage disease. Meticulous retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy determines adjuvant therapy. Prophylactic and aggressive chemotherapy reduced recurrence, and tumor-free survival was 100% for stage A, 91% for stage B and 61% for stage C.

pmid-6153786.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の患者を対象に、化学療法中のAFP、CEA、hCGおよびβ-hCGの推移を追跡した報告である。AFPは正常範囲内で推移し、CEAは肺転移の出現と相関した。hCGの上昇後の低下は感受性を、低下後の急上昇は耐性を示唆した。耐性の早期発見のため、少なくとも10日間は2日ごとのhCG測定を勧めている。
pmid-6153786.summary_en: This case report follows a patient with metastatic choriocarcinoma treated with chemotherapy, tracking serum AFP, CEA, hCG and its beta subunit. AFP stayed within the normal range, CEA levels tracked the development of lung metastases, and hCG patterns reflected sensitivity and resistance. An initial rise followed by a fall indicated response, while a rapid rise above baseline indicated resistance. The authors recommend measuring hCG every 2 days for at least 10 days to detect chemotherapy resistance early.

pmid-6153825.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者91例で、妊娠関連蛋白SP-1を放射免疫測定法により測定した。活動性疾患の患者の52%で上昇し、非活動性の例では全例正常であった。上昇はAFPよりhCGと関連したが、両マーカーが正常でも上昇する例があった。連続測定した21例中5例では、他の腫瘍マーカーでは得られない情報が得られた。
pmid-6153825.summary_en: This study measured serum SP-1, a pregnancy-associated protein, in 91 men with germ cell testicular cancer. SP-1 was elevated in 52% of patients with active disease and was normal in all patients with inactive disease. Elevations were more often linked to hCG than to AFP, but occurred even when both established markers were normal. In serial samples from 21 patients, SP-1 provided useful information beyond the other markers in 5. The authors conclude that SP-1 is clinically useful, while noting that its alpha and beta forms need further study.

pmid-6154413.summary_ja: 思春期の女児にみられた卵巣の未熟奇形腫(WHO grade 1)の症例報告である。腹膜に神経膠組織の播種(腹膜神経膠腫症)を伴っていた。術前に上昇していた血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は、片側卵管卵巣摘出後に正常化した。術後3年以上無症状で経過しており、AFPの反復測定が良好な経過の指標になるとしている。
pmid-6154413.summary_en: This case report describes an adolescent girl with a grade 1 immature teratoma of the ovary accompanied by glial peritoneal implants (peritoneal gliomatosis). Serum AFP was elevated before surgery and normalized after unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. She remained symptom-free for more than three years. The authors suggest that repeated normal AFP measurements can guide and predict a favorable clinical course, and they discuss the WHO grading of the teratoma and related literature.

pmid-6154414.summary_ja: 病期IIIまたは再発した病期I・IIの精巣がん28例を対象に、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンを4～6サイクル投与し、その後1年間ビンブラスチンによる維持療法を行った報告である。化学療法と手術により82%が完全寛解に達し、寛解した23例のうち再発は1例であった。著者らは、導入期間を長くすると再発を防げる可能性を示唆し、維持療法の有用性には疑問を呈して、さらなる検討が必要としている。
pmid-6154414.summary_en: This report treats 28 patients with stage III or recurrent stage I or II testicular cancer using four to six cycles of vinblastine, bleomycin and cisplatin, followed by one year of vinblastine maintenance. Complete remission was achieved in 82% after chemotherapy and surgery, with one relapse among the 23 remitters. The authors suggest that longer induction schedules may prevent relapses and question the value of maintenance therapy, which needs further study.

pmid-6154417.summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌で、MAC療法(メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、アルキル化剤)に不応となった2例の報告である。シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンによる治療で、臨床的およびβ-hCGの血清値とも持続的な寛解が得られた。化学療法の失敗は毒性か腫瘍の耐性によると考察し、従来の併用療法不応例でも代替レジメンで効果が得られうることを示した。
pmid-6154417.summary_en: Two patients with high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma who failed MAC chemotherapy (methotrexate, actinomycin D and an alkylating agent) achieved sustained clinical and serum beta-hCG remission after treatment with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin. The report notes that chemotherapy failure may result from excessive toxicity or tumor resistance. It suggests that alternative combination regimens can still produce durable responses after conventional therapy has failed in this disease.

pmid-6154525.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおける血清AFP高値の意義を検討した報告である。純粋セミノーマでAFPが上昇した場合は、非セミノーマ成分や肝転移の存在が示唆される。軽度の上昇は肝再生に伴う場合もある。AFPの連続測定と免疫細胞化学により2例を提示し、鑑別の重要性と治療選択への影響を論じている。
pmid-6154525.summary_en: This report examines the significance of elevated serum AFP in testicular seminoma. Elevated AFP in patients with pure seminoma may indicate non-seminomatous elements or liver metastases, while modest elevations can also arise from liver regeneration. Using serial radioimmunoassay and immunocytochemistry, the authors illustrate these distinctions with two patients and argue that they are important for selecting therapy.

pmid-6154657.summary_ja: 合胞栄養膜の原形質膜抗原(TrPM)に対する特異抗血清を用い、正常・異常胎盤と各種腫瘍における発現を比較した。胞状奇胎では10例中7例が陽性であったが、侵入奇胎と絨毛癌は全例陰性であった。一方、栄養膜由来ではない大腸癌や肝癌などに陽性例がみられ、悪性化に伴う栄養膜様形質の獲得が示唆された。
pmid-6154657.summary_en: This study used an antiserum to syncytial trophoblast plasma membrane (TrPM) to compare antigen expression across normal and abnormal placentas and various neoplasms. Normal and abnormal placentas expressed TrPM antigens, and malignant trophoblastic neoplasms lost expression: 7 of 10 hydatidiform moles stained positive, while all invasive moles and choriocarcinomas were negative. Several non-trophoblastic carcinomas unexpectedly expressed the antigen, suggesting a trophoblast-like phenotype.

pmid-6155193.summary_ja: AFPを産生する腫瘍の検出と局在診断を目的として、131I標識抗AFP抗体を12例に投与した報告である。肝細胞癌と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の転移巣の4例で、腫瘍部位が描出された。AFPを産生しないはずの8例でも一部に集積がみられたが、肝がんや精巣がんより弱かった。血中AFPが高値でも描出は妨げられなかった。
pmid-6155193.summary_en: This study used 131I-labeled anti-AFP goat antibodies in 12 patients to detect and localize AFP-producing tumors. Tumor sites were visualized in 4 patients with hepatocellular carcinoma or metastatic testicular germ cell carcinoma, and normal goat IgG did not localize similarly. Among 8 patients with tumors not expected to produce AFP, 5 of 19 sites showed some accretion, weaker than in liver or testicular cancers. High circulating AFP did not prevent successful imaging.

pmid-6155194.summary_ja: 南西腫瘍学グループの第II相研究で、転移性原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の19例に、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンによる導入療法を行い、奏効者には維持療法を実施した。奏効率は56%で、完全寛解3例、部分寛解6例であったが、奏効期間の平均は2か月と短かった。毒性は著明で、1例が死亡した。著者らは、これらの患者は精巣がんの患者より治療成績が劣るとし、他のレジメンの検討が必要だと結論づけている。
pmid-6155194.summary_en: This Southwest Oncology Group phase II study treated 19 patients with metastatic primary extragonadal germ cell cancer using vinblastine, bleomycin and cisplatin induction, followed by maintenance for responders. The response rate was 56%, with three complete and six partial remissions, but the mean response duration was only two months. Toxicity was significant and one death occurred. The authors conclude that these patients respond less well than those with testicular cancer and that other regimens should be investigated.

pmid-6155364.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の現行分類を改訂すべきか検討した短報である。近年の知見では、これらの腫瘍はhCGやAFPを高頻度に産生することが示されており、現行分類の不備が指摘されている。AFP・hCG産生を担う細胞型の同定が重要とされるが、具体的な改訂案は抄録に示されていない。
pmid-6155364.summary_en: This short paper examines whether the current classification of testicular germ cell tumours should be revised. It argues that the classification may be inadequate in light of recent evidence showing that these tumours frequently produce hCG and AFP. The paper emphasises identifying the cell types responsible for this marker production, which it suggests should inform reclassification. The brief abstract provides limited detail on specific proposed revisions.

pmid-6155365.summary_ja: 1980年の方法論的報告。様々な胚細胞腫瘍の組織切片中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を、放射免疫電気泳動法で検出する手法を記述している。AFPは卵黄嚢腫瘍成分の重要な指標であるため、組織内での局在を確認することで腫瘍の組成把握に役立つ可能性がある。腫瘍病理学への応用の展望も述べられている。
pmid-6155365.summary_en: This 1980 methodological report describes a radioimmunoelectrophoretic technique for detecting alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) directly in tissue sections of various germ cell tumours. The authors outline how the method can be applied in oncological pathology, offering a way to localize AFP within tumour tissue rather than relying only on serum measurements. Because AFP is a key marker for yolk sac elements, such localization could help pathologists characterize tumour composition and clarify the source of marker production.

pmid-6155479.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ精巣腫瘍で広範な転移を有する26例を報告。術前に白金製剤ベースの化学療法を行い、その後減量手術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を実施した。約80%が治癒と推定された。切除組織の性状が予後を左右し、成熟奇形腫や線維・嚢胞成分のみの場合は良好、腫瘍成分が残存する例では不良だった。巨大転移例には術前化学療法が最も有効と結論している。
pmid-6155479.summary_en: This 1980 report describes 26 patients with widespread metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours treated with platinum, vinblastine and bleomycin chemotherapy before cytoreductive surgery and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Most patients (85%) were well after treatment, and about 80% were presumed cured. The nature of the resected tissue was the key prognostic factor: patients with fibrous, cystic or mature teratoma elements fared well, while those with persistent cancer had poorer outcomes. The authors suggest pretreatment with chemotherapy before surgery in bulky disease gives the most effective cytoreduction and survival.

pmid-6155756.summary_ja: 1980年の免疫組織化学的研究。正常ヒト卵黄嚢の内胚葉細胞およびそれに分化を示す腫瘍において、ヘモグロビンAとFの局在を初めて示した。卵黄嚢で形成される赤血球が内胚葉由来であるという仮説を支持する。卵黄嚢腫瘍と卵黄嚢分化を伴う胎児性癌で陽性だった一方、他の胚細胞腫瘍59例では陰性であった。卵黄嚢分化の指標となりうる所見である。
pmid-6155756.summary_en: This 1980 immunohistochemistry study reports hemoglobin A and F in endodermal cells of normal human yolk sacs and in yolk sac differentiated tumours. Staining was seen in epithelial and erythroid-like cells of the yolk sac, supporting the idea that yolk sac erythrocytes derive from endoderm. Among tumours, eight endodermal sinus tumours and one embryonal carcinoma with vitelline areas showed this localization, whereas none of 59 other germ cell tumours did. The finding offers a distinctive marker feature of yolk sac differentiation within germ cell tumours.

pmid-6155988.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、性腺および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍387例の血清AFPをラジオイムノアッセイで測定した。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を含む腫瘍では、部位や転移の有無にかかわらずAFPが著明に上昇し、その量とも相関した。純粋なセミノーマ、ディスジャーミノーマ、奇形腫ではAFPは正常だった。AFPの連続測定は、胚細胞腫瘍の診断、治療モニタリング、転移・再発の早期発見に有用と結論している。
pmid-6155988.summary_en: This 1980 study measured serum AFP by radioimmunoassay in 387 patients with gonadal and extragonadal germ cell tumours. Markedly elevated AFP occurred whenever tumours contained endodermal sinus (yolk sac) elements, irrespective of location or metastasis, and levels correlated with the amount of yolk sac component. Pure seminoma, dysgerminoma and teratoma had normal AFP, as did 81 non-germ cell gonadal tumours. The authors conclude that serial AFP measurements are highly valuable for diagnosis, monitoring treatment, and detecting metastases and recurrence in germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-6156532.summary_ja: 1980年の報告で、精巣がんの巨大な後腹膜転移に対する減量手術において下大静脈を一塊切除する方法を述べている。切除できる腫瘍量の増加、大動脈後方の腫瘍へのアクセス、肺塞栓や出血のリスク低減が利点とされる。手術による合併症は許容範囲で、直接の手術死亡はないと報告している。
pmid-6156532.summary_en: This 1980 Urology report describes en bloc resection of the inferior vena cava during cytoreductive surgery for bulky retroperitoneal metastases from testicular cancer. The authors outline its advantages: it allows removal of larger tumour volumes, provides access to tumour lying behind the aorta, lowers the risk of pulmonary embolism from caval clot or tumour, and reduces haemorrhage risk from vascular injury. They report that surgical morbidity has been acceptable and no direct operative deaths have occurred.

pmid-6156864.summary_ja: 1980年の症例報告。血清AFPが上昇した卵巣奇形腫で、腹膜にグリア組織の播種を伴っていた。繰り返しの外科的切除後にAFPは陰性化した。AFPは卵巣奇形腫の腫瘍マーカーとなりうると述べている。文献レビューとともに、腹膜グリア播種の発生機序とAFPとの関連を考察している。
pmid-6156864.summary_en: This 1980 case report describes an ovarian teratoma with glial implants on the peritoneum in a patient with raised serum AFP. After repeated surgical excision of the tumour and implants, AFP became negative, suggesting AFP may serve as a tumour marker in ovarian teratoma. The authors review the published literature on ovarian teratoma with peritoneal glial implants and discuss the pathogenesis of glial implantation and its relationship to AFP elevation.

pmid-6157321.summary_ja: 本研究は、前縦隔に原発した卵黄嚢腫瘍の新たな7例を報告し、報告例は計21例となった。若年男性に好発し、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇を伴うことが多く、予後は不良である。前縦隔腫瘍の鑑別診断に本腫瘍を含めるべきと結論している。
pmid-6157321.summary_en: This 1980 report describes seven new cases of endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor arising in the anterior mediastinum, bringing the reported total to 21. The tumor is a germ cell tumor that typically affects young men, often produces elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein, and carries a poor prognosis. The authors recommend including it in the differential diagnosis of anterior mediastinal tumors. Of the 21 reported cases, the two disease-free survivors had been treated with excision combined with chemotherapy.

pmid-6157763.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JaRおよびBeWoにおけるHLA-A、-B、-C抗原の発現を調べた。両株ともβ2-ミクログロブリンを含むが、JaR株とBeWo株の一亜株は表面HLA-ABC抗原を発現していなかった。絨毛癌や栄養膜細胞でのHLA-ABCの欠如は、β2-ミクログロブリンの欠損によるものではないと結論している。
pmid-6157763.summary_en: This 1980 study examined HLA class I antigen expression in two human choriocarcinoma cell lines, JaR and BeWo. Both contained beta 2-microglobulin, but the JaR line and one BeWo subline did not express surface HLA-A, -B, or -C antigens, even in sensitive radioimmunoassays of cell-free extracts. The authors conclude that the lack of HLA-ABC expression in choriocarcinoma and trophoblast is not due to a deficiency of beta 2-microglobulin, unlike the Burkitt lymphoma line Daudi. The findings relate to immune recognition of trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-6157840.summary_ja: 精巣がん118例を対象とした前向き研究で、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が病期分類の精度向上に有用かを検討した。病期Iでは誤分類率が9〜14%、病期IIでは5〜10%に低下した。手術後も高値が持続する場合は進行病期を示唆し、追加治療の指針になると結論している。
pmid-6157840.summary_en: This prospective study evaluated whether serum alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotropin can improve staging accuracy in testicular cancer. In 118 patients with embryonal carcinoma with or without teratoma, marker assays reduced staging errors to 9 to 14 percent in stage I and 5 to 10 percent in stage II. Persistently elevated markers after orchiectomy, lymphadenectomy, or negative lymph node dissection indicated advanced disease, guiding further therapy and adjuvant trials.

pmid-6158129.summary_ja: 縦隔の希少腫瘍である血管周皮腫、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍の計9例（各3例）の経過を報告した。セミノーマ3例は全例が男性で、手術不能のため放射線療法を受け、2例が生存していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍は予後不良で、化学療法と放射線療法を受けた1例が20か月生存した。
pmid-6158129.summary_en: This 1980 report describes nine patients with rare primary mediastinal tumors: hemangiopericytoma, seminoma, and endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor, three of each. Two hemangiopericytoma patients underwent radical surgery and remained disease-free. All three male seminoma patients were inoperable and received radiotherapy, with two alive at one and three years. Of the three yolk sac tumor patients, one died within two weeks, another died after chemotherapy, and one survived 20 months after chemotherapy and irradiation.

pmid-6158296.summary_ja: 婦人科腫瘍が産生する物質の臨床的・病理学的応用を概説した総説である。現時点で臨床的価値が確立した唯一の抗原はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)であり、卵黄嚢腫瘍や奇形腫を含む胚細胞腫瘍で産生される。他の抗原は診療に不可欠ではなく、診断や治療の改善には更なる研究が必要と結論している。
pmid-6158296.summary_en: This review examines tumor-derived products in gynecologic neoplasia and their clinical and pathological applications. It notes that alphafetoprotein is currently the only antigen of proven clinical value in gynecological tumors. Its production by germ cell tumors, particularly yolk sac tumors and teratomas, makes it close to an ideal tumor marker. The authors conclude that other gynecologic tumor antigens are not yet essential for patient care, and further research is needed to improve diagnosis and management.

pmid-6158584.summary_ja: セミノーマと初期診断された31例のうち、血清AFPまたはhCGが上昇した症例の経過を解析した。AFPの上昇は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の確実な所見とされ、それに応じた治療が必要と結論している。低病期のセミノーマでは放射線療法の効果が良好だったが、転移性セミノーマでのhCG高値は予後不良を示す。
pmid-6158584.summary_en: This urology study analyzed case histories of 31 patients initially diagnosed with seminoma who had elevated serum AFP or hCG. Elevated AFP was considered firm evidence of non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, requiring treatment accordingly. Isolated hCG elevation could indicate either seminoma or non-seminomatous tumor. Patients with seminoma and raised hCG responded well to radiation therapy at low stage, but elevated hCG in metastatic seminoma predicted poor outcome with conventional treatment. The authors propose a treatment plan for these patients.

pmid-6158975.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーであるAFPとhCGの解釈を、臨床データと異種移植モデルで検討した。マーカー陽性の進行例65例のうち23例で、マーカーと腫瘍反応の乖離が認められた。免疫抑制マウスの悪性奇形腫異種移植では、腫瘍内AFP濃度は血中AFPに反映されたが、腫瘍径とはよく相関しなかった。
pmid-6158975.summary_en: This study critically assessed alpha-fetoprotein and hCG as markers in malignant testicular tumours, using clinical data and a xenograft model. Among 65 patients with marker-positive advanced disease, 23 showed discordance between markers and tumour response. In transplanted human malignant teratoma xenografts in immunosuppressed mice, tumour AFP concentration reflected blood AFP levels but did not correlate well with tumour size. One xenograft line showed marker-negative cells evolving from an initially AFP-positive patient.

pmid-6159032.summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍の患者20例に、ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチンの併用療法を実施した。全例で明確な奏効が得られ、完全奏効の程度は初回治療時の病変範囲と放射線療法の既往に左右された。本併用療法の高い有効性が示された。
pmid-6159032.summary_en: Twenty patients with metastatic testicular tumours were treated with a combination of vinblastine, bleomycin and cisplatin. All of them showed an unequivocal response to treatment. The completeness of response depended on the extent of disease at the start of treatment and on whether patients had received prior radiotherapy. The authors conclude that this combination is highly active in metastatic testicular cancer. This is a small clinical series from the early chemotherapy era.

pmid-6159033.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣患者14例に3剤併用療法を行い、測定可能病変を有する13例中9例が完全寛解、3例が部分寛解を示した。完全寛解例は再発していない。精巣がんに対する本療法の有効性が示された。
pmid-6159033.summary_en: Fourteen patients with disseminated non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis were treated with vinblastine, bleomycin and cisplatin. Of 13 patients with measurable disease, 9 achieved complete and 3 partial remission. No patient with complete remission has relapsed. About 79% of patients were free of disease for 3 or more months, with several followed for over two years. The authors conclude that the combination is effective in testicular cancer despite significant toxicity.

pmid-6159075.summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍に対し、逐次的多剤療法で完全寛解を目指した前向き臨床試験である。治療完了した15例中11例が完全寛解に達し、7例は維持療法なしで15〜36ヵ月無病であった。集中的な初回療法による根治の可能性が示された。
pmid-6159075.summary_en: This prospective trial tested sequential multimodality therapy to achieve long-term complete remission without maintenance in disseminated testicular cancer. Patients received vinblastine and bleomycin, followed by cisplatin, actinomycin D and vincristine until surgically proven complete remission. Of 15 patients completing therapy, 11 achieved complete remission and 7 remained disease-free without maintenance for 15 to 36 months. The authors recommend intensive primary therapy aimed at cure and call for further study of maintenance therapy.

pmid-6159120.summary_ja: 播種性セミノーマ19例に白金製剤・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン±アドリアマイシンを投与した。19例中12例（63%）が完全寛解し、寛解例に再発はなかった。転移性セミノーマの成績は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と同等と報告された。
pmid-6159120.summary_en: Nineteen patients with disseminated seminoma received platinum, vinblastine and bleomycin, with or without Adriamycin. Nine had elevated hCG and two had elevated AFP. Twelve of 19 patients (63%) achieved complete remission, with a median duration of 18 months, and none of these relapsed. Four remained in continuous complete remission for over two years. The authors conclude that results in metastatic seminoma are comparable to those in non-seminomatous germ cell tumours, so similar strategies should be used.

pmid-6159485.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍50例で血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を追跡した。悪性と確認された36例中34例（94%）でいずれかのマーカーが上昇していた。マーカー値は化学療法の効果を概ね反映した。
pmid-6159485.summary_en: Serum AFP and hCG levels were used in managing 50 consecutive patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis. Of 36 patients with documented malignancy, 34 (94%) had elevated one or both markers. Markers were elevated before lymphadenectomy in 9 of 15 clinical stage A or B patients not cured by orchiectomy. In stage C disease, all patients had elevated markers, and marker levels generally reflected the effect of chemotherapy on measurable disease.

pmid-6160088.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍73例（セミノーマ46例、非セミノーマ27例）のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を免疫組織化学的に検討した。胎児性癌ではhCG陽性83%、AFP陽性75%であった。セミノーマではAFPは陰性で、マーカーによる分類の有用性は限定的と結論された。
pmid-6160088.summary_en: This retrospective immunohistochemical study examined hCG and AFP in 46 seminomas and 27 non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. Syncytiotrophoblast-like giant cells with hCG were found in three seminomas, while AFP was absent in seminomas. Mature teratomas were negative for both markers. In embryonal carcinomas, hCG was present in 83% and AFP in 75%. The authors conclude that marker staining provides limited additional classification value and that prognostic studies are needed.

pmid-6160380.summary_ja: 小児の転移性胎児性癌（精巣）に化学療法のみで成功した症例を報告した。多発肺転移が消失し、腹部腫瘤は縮小・消失した。26ヵ月後も無病で、腎機能とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常であった。成人での有効性を小児に広げる症例報告である。
pmid-6160380.summary_en: This case report describes a child with widespread metastases treated successfully with chemotherapy alone. One course of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin cleared multiple pulmonary metastases, and four courses shrank and sterilised an abdominal mass. Twenty-six months after starting treatment, the patient was well, off therapy for 14 months, and free of disease, with normal creatinine clearance and AFP. The authors note that the adult experience with this regimen is favourable and suggest further paediatric trials, despite substantial toxicity.

pmid-6161257.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、胚細胞由来の精巣がん26例の固定組織におけるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク質の局在を免疫細胞化学的に検討した。血清マーカーの上昇率と腫瘍細胞内の局在率は一致せず、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の腫瘍マーカー評価に示唆を与えている。
pmid-6161257.summary_en: This 1980 study examined immunocytochemical localization of hCG, AFP, and pregnancy specific beta-1 glycoprotein in formaldehyde-fixed tissues from 26 patients with germinal testicular cancer. The findings were compared with serum marker levels. Serum AFP, hCG, and PSG were elevated in 58%, 65%, and 27% of patients, and in 85% when all markers were considered. Cellular localization was found in 19% for AFP, 46% for hCG, and 35% for PSG. Together, the markers were detected in tumor cells in 58% of patients. The study highlights the discordance between serum and tissue marker detection in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-6161630.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、ステージIIIおよびIVの精巣悪性奇形腫の予後因子を解析した。腫瘍径5cm超、肺転移8個超、AFP高値、hCG高値が不良な予後と関連した。AFPまたはhCGの上昇を併せ持つ患者の予後は特に不良であった。血清マーカーの定期的な測定が推奨されている。
pmid-6161630.summary_en: This 1980 study analyzed prognostic factors in patients with stage III and IV malignant teratoma of the testis. Tumor diameter above 5 cm and more than 8 pulmonary metastases were adverse factors. Histologic subtype also mattered, with the trophoblastic type faring worst. Serum AFP above 10^3 MRC u/ml and serum hCG beta above 10^5 miu/ml each predicted poor outcome, and having either marker elevated gave a much worse prognosis. Prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy had no significant effect. The authors recommend reporting serum AFP and hCG levels in testicular teratoma series and measuring them regularly during follow-up.

pmid-6163266.summary_ja: 1980年の日本の研究で、婦人科悪性腫瘍125例の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を放射免疫測定法で測定した。卵黄嚢腫瘍と充実性奇形腫で上昇が多く、絨毛癌や未分化胚細胞腫では正常範囲であった。血清AFPは両腫瘍の診断に有効とされた。
pmid-6163266.summary_en: This 1980 Japanese study measured serum AFP by radioimmunoassay in 125 patients with gynecologic malignancies. AFP was often elevated in yolk sac tumor and solid teratoma. It was within normal limits in vulvar, cervical, endometrial, and ovarian carcinomas, as well as in uterine choriocarcinoma and ovarian dysgerminoma. The authors conclude that serum AFP is an effective diagnostic marker for both yolk sac tumor and solid teratoma. Its usefulness for detecting other gynecologic cancers is limited, because it is normal in those conditions.

pmid-6163519.summary_ja: 成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍における卵黄嚢腫瘍成分の頻度を、後方視的症例群と前向き症例群で比較した。セミノーマを除くと、それぞれ28.7%と44.4%に認められた。血清AFPは同成分の存在とよく相関した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は独立した胚細胞腫瘍として分類すべきと結論づけられている。
pmid-6163519.summary_en: This study compared the frequency of endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor elements in adult testicular germ cell tumors across a retrospective series of 200 cases and a prospective series of 147 cases. Excluding pure seminomas, EST/YST elements were found in 28.7% of the retrospective and 44.4% of the prospective cases. These elements were always admixed with other germ cell components, and they were histologically similar to infantile EST/YST. Serum AFP correlated well with the presence of EST/YST elements. The authors conclude that EST/YST is a distinct germ cell neoplasm that should be recognized in testicular tumor classification and that careful pathology review is essential.

pmid-6165791.summary_ja: 1980年の日本の研究で、卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍のAFP、hCG、CEAを免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法で局在化した。AFPは胎児性癌と充実性奇形腫の多くで陽性であった。hCGは合胞体栄養膜巨細胞に限局し、AFPとは別の細胞で産生されていた。CEAは検出されなかった。
pmid-6165791.summary_en: This 1980 Japanese study used immunoperoxidase staining to localize AFP, hCG, and CEA in ovarian malignant germ cell tumors and correlated the results with histology. AFP was found in 9 of 10 embryonal carcinomas (endodermal sinus tumor) and 4 of 5 solid teratomas, and two AFP-positive embryonal carcinomas had normal serum AFP. hCG appeared in syncytiotrophoblast giant cells of 4 embryonal carcinomas and 2 solid teratomas. AFP and hCG were produced by different cells. CEA was not detected in the tumors studied. Immature neural components were negative for all three markers.

pmid-6169654.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の8株の細胞株について、絨毛性ゴナドトロピン、αフェトプロテイン、アルカリホスファターゼなどのマーカーを比較した。主に絨毛癌や卵黄嚢細胞から成る株はなかったが、マウス胎児性癌に似た細胞を含む株が複数あった。免疫不全動物では胎児性癌様の腫瘍を形成した。ヒト胎児性癌細胞はマウスと異なり、胚盤胞期以前の段階に相当すると提案されている。
pmid-6169654.summary_en: Eight cell lines established from human testicular germ cell tumors were characterized for markers including chorionic gonadotropin, alpha-fetoprotein, alkaline phosphatase, plasminogen activator, and SV40 infectivity. None consisted mainly of choriocarcinoma or yolk sac cells, but several contained cells resembling murine embryonal carcinoma. Some lines formed tumors resembling embryonal carcinoma in immunosuppressed animals. The authors propose that human embryonal carcinoma cells correspond to a preblastocyst developmental stage, unlike murine cells.

pmid-6243192.summary_ja: ウェストバージニア大学医療センターで10年間に精巣胚細胞腫瘍を後方視的に検討した研究。診断・治療の進歩にもかかわらず、受診の遅れや不適切な管理が生存改善を妨げていた。著者らは患者教育と、精巣腫瘤すべてを重篤な可能性として扱う医師の意識向上を強調した。高い疑い指数と積極的な治療を推奨している。
pmid-6243192.summary_en: A ten-year retrospective study of germ cell tumors of the testis at West Virginia University Medical Center examined delayed presentation and management. Delayed diagnosis and occasional mismanagement continued to limit survival despite advances in diagnosis and therapy. The authors emphasize patient education and physician awareness of the seriousness of all testicular masses. They advocate a high index of suspicion and aggressive management to improve long-term survival in this highly lethal disease.

pmid-6243407.summary_ja: デューク大学の地域栄養膜疾患センターで、胞状奇胎以外の妊娠性絨毛性疾患500例以上のうち、絨毛癌の脳転移14例を検討した。多剤併用化学療法と脳照射の併用により7例(50%)が寛解した。診断、治療レジメン、合併症、生存について報告している。早期診断と積極的治療が良好な転帰の鍵と考えられた。
pmid-6243407.summary_en: Duke University's Southeastern Regional Trophoblastic Disease Center reviewed 14 patients with cerebral metastases from choriocarcinoma among more than 500 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease other than primary hydatidiform mole. Vigorous multiagent chemotherapy combined with cerebral irradiation achieved remission in 50% (7/14). The authors describe diagnosis, chemotherapy regimens, complications, and survival. Early diagnosis and aggressive therapy were identified as key factors for successful outcome.

pmid-6244747.summary_ja: 妊娠性および非妊娠性の絨毛性腫瘍について、その歴史的な知見の進展を概観した総説である。組織発生をめぐる長年の論争、子宮外および男性での発症の認識、胚細胞が前駆細胞として疑われた経緯を整理している。さらに、臨床病理学的特徴と鑑別診断上の問題を、現代の化学療法の観点から検討している。
pmid-6244747.summary_en: This historical and pathobiologic review traces key milestones in understanding gestational and nongestational trophoblastic neoplasia. It covers the long controversy over histogenesis, the recognition of extrauterine and male cases, and the suspected totipotential germ cell origin. The authors also examine clinicopathologic features and differential diagnostic problems in light of the modern chemotherapeutic approach.

pmid-6248013.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患96例を対象に、血清hCGβサブユニットの臨床的有用性を放射免疫測定法で評価した研究である。初期値は胞状奇胎の亜型と相関し、悪性合併症を予測した。除去後の絨毛性栄養膜の持続も確認された。連続測定値は病勢を正確に反映し、治療中止の時期の判断に役立つことが示された。
pmid-6248013.summary_en: This study evaluates the clinical usefulness of serum chorionic gonadotropin beta subunit by radioimmunoassay in 96 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease. Initial levels correlate with hydatidiform mole subtypes and predict malignant sequelae. Trophoblastic persistence after evacuation is confirmed, with a beta subunit half-life of 4 days early on. Serial values accurately track disease course and guide when treatment can be stopped.

pmid-6248746.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対し、ホリン酸救援を伴う中等量メトトレキサートの化学療法を検討した研究である。26例中、非転移性および転移性の持続例19例のうち18例で寛解が得られた。絨毛癌では7例中3例のみ有効であった。副作用は軽微で、後の妊孕性や児への影響は認められなかった。
pmid-6248746.summary_en: This study reports a medium-dose methotrexate regimen with folinic acid rescue for gestational trophoblastic disease, monitored by beta-hCG. Among 26 treated patients, 18 of 19 with nonmetastatic or metastatic persistent disease achieved biochemical and clinical remission. The regimen was ineffective in three of seven patients with choriocarcinoma. Side effects were minor, with no apparent effects on later fertility or on the babies studied.

pmid-6249709.summary_ja: 妊娠関連糖タンパクβ1SP1の放射免疫測定法を開発し、正常妊娠と絨毛性疾患での値を測定しました。胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胚性癌の症例では、β1SP1が検出されなくなった後もhCGは検出され、hCGの方が鋭敏な指標でした。
pmid-6249709.summary_en: This study develops a radioimmunoassay for the pregnancy-associated glycoprotein beta 1SP1 and measures its levels in normal pregnancy and in trophoblastic disease. In patients with hydatidiform mole, choriocarcinoma, and embryonal carcinoma, hCG remained detectable after beta 1SP1 became undetectable, so hCG was the more sensitive indicator. Among 100 hCG-positive samples, beta 1SP1 was detected in 86, while only 1 of 21 hCG-negative samples was positive. Bronchial carcinoma samples were negative for beta 1SP1.

pmid-6250214.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌を生じる細胞と発生中のマウス胚の細胞の類似性を論じた総説です。奇形癌幹細胞は胚の細胞と融合して正常なマウスへ発生することもあります。奇形癌由来の幹細胞株は、初期哺乳類発生の研究に新たな手法をもたらしました。
pmid-6250214.summary_en: This review discusses the close similarity between cells that give rise to mouse teratocarcinomas and cells of the developing mouse embryo. In some cases, teratocarcinoma stem cells can integrate with embryonic counterparts and develop into normal mice. Stem cell lines derived from mouse teratocarcinomas have enabled new biochemical, immunological, and genetic approaches to early mammalian development. The article focuses on the biology of germ cell tumor stem cells rather than clinical management.

pmid-6250719.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で処理したF9奇形癌幹細胞が、ジブチリルcAMPによって体壁内胚葉様の細胞へ分化することを示しました。誘導された細胞はラミニンやIV型コラーゲンなどを産生します。薬剤を除去しても分化状態は維持されました。
pmid-6250719.summary_en: This study shows that F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells treated with retinoic acid can be converted into parietal endoderm by dibutyryl cAMP. The induced cells synthesize plasminogen activator, laminin, and type IV collagen, and show low alkaline phosphatase and lactate dehydrogenase. Their phenotype matches definitive parietal endoderm. The differentiated state persists without continued drug exposure, and cAMP agents act only on cells pretreated with retinoic acid.

pmid-6251723.summary_ja: 治療後1年以上経過してから妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍が再発した2例を報告しています。両例とも非転移性で、再発前2〜3年間は血清hCG値が陰性でした。見かけ上治療が成功した後も、長期のフォローアップが必要であると強調しています。
pmid-6251723.summary_en: This report describes two patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia who relapsed more than one year after apparently successful therapy. Both had nonmetastatic disease, were clinically disease-free, and had negative serum beta-hCG titers for two to three years before recurrence. The authors emphasize the need for prolonged follow-up monitoring of patients even after apparently successful treatment and long periods of negative hCG results.

pmid-6251724.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者20例で甲状腺機能を評価しました。広範な転移を伴う絨毛癌の2例が明らかな甲状腺中毒症を示し、血清hCG値は極めて高値でした。甲状腺刺激活性はhCG値と密接に相関し、絨毛癌に伴う甲状腺中毒症の原因はhCG自身の甲状腺刺激作用であると結論づけています。
pmid-6251724.summary_en: This study evaluated thyroid function in 20 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Two patients with widely metastatic choriocarcinoma were overtly thyrotoxic and had very high serum hCG levels. Thyroid-stimulating activity in serum and urine correlated closely with hCG levels and had the biologic characteristics of purified hCG. The authors conclude that the thyrotropic activity intrinsic to hCG causes choriocarcinoma-associated thyrotoxicosis.

pmid-6251725.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患のモニタリング用マーカーとして妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク(SP1)を評価しました。非転移性の病変では、SP1とhCGの減少曲線はよく一致しました。転移性絨毛癌の3例中2例では、hCGが低下する一方でSP1は横ばいまたは上昇しました。
pmid-6251725.summary_en: This study evaluates pregnancy-specific beta 1-glycoprotein (SP1) as a marker for monitoring trophoblastic disease. In patients with post-molar pregnancy and nonmetastatic disease, SP1 and hCG regression curves closely paralleled each other. In metastatic choriocarcinoma, SP1 and hCG patterns were discordant in two of three patients, with SP1 plateauing or rising while hCG fell. The authors suggest SP1 may give additional information beyond hCG, but its role is incompletely defined.

pmid-6252781.summary_ja: 等電点電気泳動と放射免疫測定法を用いて、血清hCGの等電点不均一性を比較しました。正常妊娠、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎では同じ7つの成分が見られました。絨毛癌の血清にのみ、等電点3.2、3.5、3.7の3成分が追加で認められました。
pmid-6252781.summary_en: This study compares the isoelectric heterogeneity of serum hCG in normal pregnancy and trophoblastic disease using isoelectric focusing and radioimmunoassay. Normal pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, and invasive mole all showed the same seven hCG components. Sera from patients with choriocarcinoma contained three additional components with isoelectric points of 3.2, 3.5, and 3.7. The authors suggest these choriocarcinoma-specific components could support a new diagnostic test for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6253107.summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍の免疫組織化学で、早期胎盤・胞状奇胎・絨毛癌の合胞栄養膜にLRF様物質を認めた。妊娠中の志願者10名に外因性LRFを投与したが、2時間の経過中に血清の絨毛性ゴナドトロピンや他の胎盤性蛋白の濃度に変化はなかった。正常および悪性栄養膜におけるその意義は今後の検討課題とされた。
pmid-6253107.summary_en: This study used immunoperoxidase staining to detect luteinizing hormone-releasing factor (LRF)-like material in the syncytiotrophoblast of early placenta, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma. It then tested exogenous LRF in ten pregnant volunteers, finding no change in serum levels of chorionic gonadotropin or other placental proteins over 2 hours. The authors conclude that the significance of LRF-like material in normal and malignant trophoblast remains unclear and requires further study.

pmid-6254188.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎や絨毛癌に由来する転移性栄養膜疾患が原因で、くも膜下出血を起こした2症例を報告した。悪性転化は主に妊娠後1年以内に起こるため、胞状奇胎後はフォローアップと妊娠回避が重要とされる。血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の持続高値が指標となり、絨毛癌は胞状奇胎より予後が不良である。文献的考察も含む。
pmid-6254188.summary_en: Two women presented with subarachnoid hemorrhage caused by metastatic trophoblastic disease, a complication of molar pregnancy or choriocarcinoma. The authors emphasize that malignant transformation can occur at any time, most often within a year of pregnancy, so close follow-up and pregnancy prevention are important. Persistent serum hCG elevation is a key indicator, and chemotherapy and irradiation give a good prognosis for persistent molar disease but a less favorable one for choriocarcinoma. The report includes a review of the literature.

pmid-6254740.summary_ja: 子宮の絨毛性偽腫瘍の症例を報告した。掻爬および子宮摘出標本の誤った解釈により、不要な手術と化学療法が行われた。絨毛癌との鑑別に役立つ組織学的基準を強調し、ホルモン産生と掻爬後数か月にわたる腫瘍の持続も記録している。悪性腫瘍に似る胎盤部位病変の典型例である。
pmid-6254740.summary_en: This case report describes a trophoblastic pseudotumor of the uterus, initially misinterpreted on curettage and hysterectomy specimens, which led to unnecessary surgery and chemotherapy. The paper emphasizes histologic criteria that distinguish this lesion from choriocarcinoma. The authors also document hormone production and persistence of the tumor for months after curettage, illustrating how these placental-site lesions can mimic malignancy.

pmid-6255743.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患の19例の血清を用い、妊娠特異的β1グリコプロテイン(SP1)の分子的不均一性を交差免疫電気泳動で示した。絨毛癌の1症例では、SP1を消費する因子が検出され、硫酸アンモニウムで沈殿した。血中SP1の定量への影響と、病勢モニタリングでの解釈が議論されている。
pmid-6255743.summary_en: Sera from 19 patients with trophoblastic disease were analyzed by immunoelectrophoresis using antisera against pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP1). Crossed immunoelectrophoresis revealed molecular heterogeneity of SP1. A factor that consumes SP1 was identified in a patient with choriocarcinoma and was precipitated with ammonium sulfate. The authors discuss implications for quantifying circulating SP1 in trophoblastic disease, which may affect how the marker is interpreted during disease monitoring.

pmid-6256264.summary_ja: 和歌山県の栄養膜性疾患登録制度に基づき342例を解析した研究（1972〜1977年）。胞状奇胎が81.3%、侵入奇胎が8.2%、絨毛癌が5.3%を占めた。胞状奇胎の16.5%が悪性合併症を生じ、40歳以上で頻度が特に高かった。疫学的検討の重要性を強調している。
pmid-6256264.summary_en: Retrospective registry analysis of 342 trophoblastic disease cases in Wakayama, Japan (1972 to 1977). Hydatidiform moles comprised 81.3%, invasive moles 8.2%, choriocarcinoma 5.3%, and transitional moles 3.5%. Malignant complications developed in 16.5% of molar pregnancies, with a markedly higher frequency in women over 40. The authors emphasize that epidemiologic study of trophoblastic disease can yield important data.

pmid-6261041.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌細胞株の胚外内胚葉への分化に伴うヒストンH1A/H1B比とヌクレオソーム反復長の変化を解析した研究。胚性癌細胞ではH1A/H1B比が高く、分化した内胚葉では低下する。一方、ヌクレオソーム反復長と基底膜糖タンパク質やプラスミノーゲン活性化因子などの分化機能との単純な相関は認められなかった。
pmid-6261041.summary_en: Compares histone composition and nucleosome repeat length in murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines (F9.22, PSA1), primary extra-embryonic endoderm derived from PSA1 EC differentiation, and long-term endodermal lines. The H1A/H1B ratio shifts markedly during differentiation: EC cells showed 1.49 or greater, versus less than 0.9 for endoderm. Nucleosome repeat length varies between states, but the authors find no simple correlation with differentiated functions such as basement membrane glycoprotein expression and plasminogen activator activity.

pmid-6263807.summary_ja: ラット胚性癌由来株F3/1は、C型ウイルス粒子を産生しないため同系宿主で非免疫原性であった。内在性マウスC型ウイルスの重感染によりMSVゲノムが救済され、MSVを放出する産生株F3/1-Pへ変換された。F3/1-Pは同系動物で強い免疫原性を示し、潜在性ウイルスゲノムの活性化により腫瘍の免疫原性を変えうることを示唆している。
pmid-6263807.summary_en: Describes a rat embryonal carcinoma-derived cell line (F3/1) that is non-immunogenic in syngeneic hosts because it does not produce C-type virions. Superinfection with endogenous mouse C-type virus rescued the murine sarcoma virus genome, converting the line into a producer (F3/1-P) that releases MSV and became strongly immunogenic in syngeneic animals. The study suggests that non-immunogenic tumors may be converted to immunogenic ones by activating dormant viral genomes with a helper virus.

pmid-6263992.summary_ja: 大阪大学病院で18年間に治療した卵巣腫瘍504例の臨床病理学的検討。大半は良性の嚢胞性腫瘍で、類皮嚢腫が191例を占めた。若年者では未分化胚細胞腫と胎児性癌が多く、悪性卵巣腫瘍の予後は概して不良であった。
pmid-6263992.summary_en: Clinicopathologic review of 504 ovarian tumors treated at Osaka University Hospital over 18 years. Most were benign cystic tumors, including 191 dermoid cysts. Among malignant tumors, dysgerminomas and embryonal carcinomas were common in young patients. Malignant transformation of dermoid cysts was rare and occurred in older women. Bilaterality was more frequent in malignant tumors (20%). Marker substances aided diagnosis and follow-up, and malignant tumors were treated with radical surgery and chemotherapy, though prognosis was generally poor.

pmid-6263994.summary_ja: 1971〜1976年に治療された侵入奇胎39例を検討した研究。手術（病巣切除または子宮全摘）と化学療法がそれぞれ約80%に施行された。治療後に11例で計14回の妊娠があり、2例が自然流産、1例が奇胎妊娠であった。絨毛癌を2例に生じたが、いずれも寛解している。
pmid-6263994.summary_en: Reviews 39 invasive mole patients treated at one clinic between 1971 and 1976. Surgery was performed in 79.5% (focal removal or hysterectomy) and chemotherapy in 79.5%. Invasive lesions were uterine, with variable myometrial invasion depth. Fourteen pregnancies occurred in 11 patients afterward, including two spontaneous abortions and one molar pregnancy. Two patients developed choriocarcinoma, both in remission, and 37 patients were healthy at the time of reporting.

pmid-6263995.summary_ja: 人工妊娠中絶2,433例、流産695例、正期産1,724例、胞状奇胎43例を対象に、妊娠終了後の尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の消退を検討した研究。消退は正期産で最も速く、胞状奇胎で最も遅かった。3〜8年のフォローアップで悪性合併症は認められず、hCG測定が奇胎後絨毛癌の予防に有用であることを示唆している。
pmid-6263995.summary_en: Examines urinary hCG regression after termination of various pregnancies: 2,433 induced abortions, 695 spontaneous abortions, 1,724 term deliveries, and 43 hydatidiform moles. hCG regression was fastest after term delivery and slowest in hydatidiform mole, and was slower when trophoblast gestational age was younger. No malignant sequelae were observed during 3 to 8 years of follow-up, supporting the role of hCG monitoring in preventing postmolar choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6263999.summary_ja: 1971〜1978年に血清hCG値で経過観察した栄養膜性疾患の臨床経過を解析。胞状奇胎178例のうち20例が掻爬後に侵入奇胎または絨毛癌へ進展した。侵入奇胎・絨毛癌59例では、化学療法を追加しなかった3例に再発がみられたが、追加した40例には再発がなかった。寛解の判定基準を提示している。
pmid-6263999.summary_en: Analyzes clinical courses of trophoblastic disease monitored by serum hCG from 1971 to 1978. Of 178 hydatidiform mole cases, 20 progressed to invasive mole or choriocarcinoma after curettage. Among 59 invasive mole and choriocarcinoma cases, hCG normalized after treatment; recurrence occurred in 3 patients without additional chemotherapy but in none of 40 who received it. Remission criteria are defined: hCG at the LH level for hydatidiform mole, and no cellular effect after two chemotherapy courses for malignant disease.

pmid-6283861.summary_ja: 1980年、ナイジェリア・ザリアの病院で6年間に診察された奇形腫132例を検討した。成人例の大半は良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫で、悪性転化は3例、卵巣甲状腺腫は4例だった。精巣および仙尾部奇形腫は極めてまれで、後者は卵黄嚢腫瘍と再分類された。
pmid-6283861.summary_en: This 1980 hospital-based study from Zaria, Nigeria reviewed 132 teratomas over six years. Most extragonadal tumours occurred in children, while among 105 adult tumours, 94 were benign cystic ovarian teratomas, mainly in the third and fourth decades. Malignant transformation occurred in three benign ovarian teratomas, and four struma ovarii cases were identified. Testicular and sacrococcygeal teratomas were rare, and the latter was reclassified as an endodermal sinus tumour.

pmid-6449607.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の小児25例(卵黄嚢腫瘍20例、奇形腫5例)を後方視的に検討した。先天奇形は卵黄嚢腫瘍3例と成熟奇形腫1例で認められ、後大静脈尿管、膀胱憩室、ダウン症候群、同側鼠径ヘルニアがみられた。精巣腫瘍の小児では先天異常の有無を注意深く診察すべきと結論している。
pmid-6449607.summary_en: This retrospective study examined congenital anomalies in 25 children with testicular germ cell tumours, including 20 yolk sac tumours and five teratomas. Anomalies were found in three yolk sac tumour patients and one patient with mature teratoma. Observed defects included retrocaval ureter, bladder diverticulum, Down syndrome and ipsilateral inguinal hernia. The authors recommend that children with testicular tumours be carefully examined for congenital abnormalities.

pmid-6453912.summary_ja: 絨毛癌培養上清に含まれる免疫抑制物質の性質を検討した研究である。hCGに依存せず、抗原非特異的サプレッサーT細胞を介して混合リンパ球反応や抗体産生を抑制した。作製した抗血清は絨毛癌細胞と正常栄養膜細胞に反応し、抑制活性を中和した。絨毛癌の栄養膜細胞が母体の免疫攻撃を逃れる機構が示唆された。
pmid-6453912.summary_en: This 1980 Japanese study examined an immunosuppressive substance released by choriocarcinoma culture fluid. The fluid suppressed mixed lymphocyte reactions, antibody production, and allo-killer induction independently of hCG, acting through antigen-nonspecific suppressor T cells. A rabbit antiserum against the fraction reacted with choriocarcinoma cells and normal trophoblast and neutralized the suppression. The authors propose that choriocarcinoma trophoblasts escape maternal immune attack through this mechanism.

pmid-6775725.summary_ja: 腫瘍の臨床的・画像的徴候がない精巣悪性腫瘍治療後の患者で血清ホルモン値を測定した1980年の研究である。LHは15%、FSHは50%で上昇し、特に放射線療法や化学療法後に顕著だった。テストステロンは多くの患者で低値を示し、併用化学療法中に著明に低下したが、治療終了後に可逆的に回復した。
pmid-6775725.summary_en: This 1980 study measured serum hormone levels in patients treated for malignant testicular tumours who had no clinical or radiological evidence of tumour. LH rose in 15% and FSH in 50%, particularly after radiotherapy or chemotherapy. Testosterone was low in most hemicastrated patients, and during combination chemotherapy it fell markedly but recovered after treatment. Oestradiol and prolactin rose slightly to moderately.

pmid-6777031.summary_ja: ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍3株をヌードマウスに継代移植し、形態と機能を検討した1980年の研究である。移植腫瘍の超微細構造は原発巣と一致したが、管状構造が主体となった。腫瘍株ごとに異なる成人型血漿タンパク質やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生し、その産生は継代間で安定していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍は正常組織の蛋白産生機能をほぼ保持していると示唆された。
pmid-6777031.summary_en: This 1980 study serially transplanted three human yolk sac tumours into nude mice and characterised them morphologically and functionally. Transplants showed mainly tubular structures with less endodermal sinus architecture, though ultrastructure matched the originals. Transplanted tumours produced adult-type plasma proteins and AFP, and the set of proteins varied by tumour line but remained stable across passages. Immunoelectron microscopy localised these proteins to the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi, suggesting near-complete retention of normal protein-producing function.

pmid-6781377.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の治療を受けた患者の血清ペプチドホルモンを検討した1980年の研究である。治療後にLHやFSHが変化し、TSH上昇を伴う代償性甲状腺機能低下症や、プロスタグランジンF2αの上昇がみられた。ホルモン評価では、治療後の正常な変化と内分泌活性腫瘍の再発を区別する必要があると述べている。
pmid-6781377.summary_en: This 1980 study assessed serum peptide hormones in patients treated for testicular tumours. Treatment caused significant changes in LH and FSH, sometimes with compensated hypothyroidism marked by raised TSH, and prostaglandin F2 alpha levels rose after therapy regardless of stage. Patients often reported impotence and infertility during follow-up. The authors stress that hormonal interpretation must distinguish normal post-treatment changes from recurrence of an endocrine-active tumour, and that some impotence arises from primary testicular damage rather than recurrence.

pmid-6893396.summary_ja: 精巣に生じた組織学的に非典型的なセミノーマの症例報告です。腫瘍は篩状の胞巣構造を示し、典型的なリンパ球浸潤を欠く線維性間質に囲まれていました。超微細構造は古典的セミノーマと区別できませんでした。腹部転移を伴う大きな腫瘍でしたが化学療法に良好に反応し、初回治療後4年の時点で腫瘍は認められていません。
pmid-6893396.summary_en: This report describes a histologically atypical testicular seminoma with a cribriform, nested growth pattern and sclerosing fibrous bands lacking typical lymphoid infiltrates. Ultrastructural features matched classic seminoma. Despite a large tumor and abdominal metastases, the patient responded favorably to chemotherapy and remained tumor-free four years after initial therapy. The case highlights that seminoma variants may lack the usual lymphocytic infiltrate, which could complicate diagnosis.

pmid-6929907.summary_ja: 77歳男性に生じた、上顎歯肉への絨毛癌転移の症例報告です。原発巣の病勢は入院時から急速で、診断は口腔内生検で確定しました。このような転移形式は極めてまれで、原発巣の同定が困難だった点が特徴です。歯肉病変が未同定の悪性腫瘍の初発徴候となりうることを示しています。
pmid-6929907.summary_en: This case report describes choriocarcinoma metastatic to the maxillary gingiva in a 77-year-old man. The primary disease was fulminant from admission, and the diagnosis was established through oral biopsies. The authors highlight the rarity of this metastatic pattern, the patient's age and race, and the difficulty in identifying a primary site. The report emphasizes that gingival involvement can be the first presentation of an otherwise unidentified malignancy.

pmid-6930148.summary_ja: 悪性縦隔奇形腫から樹立されたヒト細胞株の報告です。細胞は軽度に異型性のある線維芽細胞様で、倍加時間は24時間でした。幹細胞系は過三倍体で78本の染色体を持ちました。多くの核型で7個の共通マーカー染色体が見られました。原腫瘍には複数の組織成分があったにもかかわらず線維芽細胞様の細胞が優勢となった理由も考察されています。
pmid-6930148.summary_en: This 1980 report describes an established human cell line derived from a malignant mediastinal teratoma. The cells were slightly atypical fibroblast-like, doubled every 24 hours, and had a hypertriploid karyotype with a stemline of 78 chromosomes. Most karyotypes shared seven marker chromosomes, with additional low-frequency markers. The authors discuss why fibroblastic cells dominated despite the original tumor containing multiple tissue types, suggesting that fibroblasts grow readily in culture.

pmid-6931103.summary_ja: 再発した卵巣奇形癌患者の腹水細胞から樹立された細胞株PA Iの特性を報告した研究です。初期継代は異数性でしたが、後期継代は二倍体核型を示し胎児性癌細胞に類似しました。後期の細胞は胎児性癌の核とエンドダーム様の外層からなる胚様体を形成しました。ヒト発生機構の研究モデルとしての有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-6931103.summary_en: This 1980 Int J Cancer study characterizes PA I, a cell line derived from ascitic fluid of a patient with recurrent ovarian teratocarcinoma. Early passages were aneuploid, while later passages showed a diploid karyotype and resembled embryonal carcinoma cells. Late-passage cells formed embryoid bodies with an embryonal carcinoma core and endoderm-like rind, and showed limited differentiation in vitro. The authors propose PA I as a model for studying human developmental mechanisms.

pmid-6931966.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の体外分化過程から分離された、初の骨形成細胞株の報告です。同系マウスへの皮下注射で、軟骨基質を経て形成される骨小体が生じました。骨小体は非悪性で約2週間後に増殖を停止しました。特定条件下では骨肉腫などの腫瘍が生じ、そこから新たな細胞株が樹立されています。
pmid-6931966.summary_en: This 1980 Nature article reports the first bone-forming cell line, isolated from in vitro differentiating teratocarcinoma (embryonal carcinoma) cells. Subcutaneous injection into syngeneic mice produced ossicles that formed via a cartilage intermediate and were colonized by host marrow. The ossicles were non-malignant and stopped growing after about two weeks. Under certain conditions, osteosarcomas, chondroosteosarcomas, and fibrosarcomas arose, from which further cell lines were established.

pmid-6932211.summary_ja: 1980年の報告で、子宮内妊娠に併存した絨毛癌の2症例を提示している。既報28例を文献的にレビューし、初発症状の形式、母体の生存率、発症機序について検討した。妊娠と絨毛癌の併存はまれであり、本論文は絨毛癌の臨床像と母体予後を把握するための歴史的な臨床参考文献である。
pmid-6932211.summary_en: This 1980 report describes two cases of choriocarcinoma coexisting with an intrauterine pregnancy. The authors review 28 previously published cases, examining mode of presentation, maternal survival, and proposed pathogenesis. Coexistence of choriocarcinoma with pregnancy is rare, and the review gives an overview of how these tumors present and what outcomes mothers experience. It is a historical clinical reference for gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-6932851.summary_ja: 1980年の研究で、精巣腫瘍患者の血清プロラクチン値を測定した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の11例中7例で高値を示し、特に転移性疾患で顕著だった。セミノーマ症例ではほぼ正常範囲だった。非セミノーマ性腫瘍2例では、プロラクチンとhCGが並行して推移し臨床経過をよく反映した。血清プロラクチンは非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の補助的な腫瘍マーカーとなり得ると結論づけている。
pmid-6932851.summary_en: This 1980 study measured serum prolactin in patients with testicular tumors. Prolactin was elevated in 7 of 11 patients with non-seminomatous tumors, especially those with metastatic disease, while seminoma patients were largely normal. In two non-seminomatous patients, prolactin and hCG levels changed in parallel and tracked clinical course. The authors suggest serum prolactin may serve as an additional tumor marker for non-seminomatous testicular tumors, complementing established markers such as hCG.

pmid-6935496.summary_ja: 1980年の症例報告で、精巣由来と推定される胚細胞癌の男性患者に、診断後9か月以内に急性リンパ性白血病が発症した経過を記述している。両腫瘍の関係の可能性について考察している。胚細胞腫瘍患者は生存期間の延長に伴い二次がんのリスクが高まる可能性があるため、継続的な経過観察の必要性を強調している。
pmid-6935496.summary_en: This 1980 case report describes acute lymphocytic leukemia that developed within nine months of diagnosis in a man with germ cell carcinoma of presumed testicular origin. The authors discuss possible relationships between the two neoplasms.
